Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Calendar notifications in the background
Summary: Coming soon for the new Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Users can enable Calendar notifications on their desktop when Outlook is not launched. Users can select the notification to open the Calendar event details. When this will happen: Targeted Release: We will begin rolling out in late November 2024 and expect to complete in late December 2024. General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): We will begin rolling out in early January 2025 and expect to complete in early February 2025. How...

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Update to custom scripting governance in App Catalog site
Summary: Starting mid-January 2026, custom scripting will be disabled by default on the tenant-wide SharePoint App Catalog site to enhance security. App operations remain unaffected, but new custom script changes will be blocked. Admins can temporarily opt out using PowerShell commands and should inform site owners accordingly.

Title: External recipients MailTip offline behavior update for Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android
Summary: Updated November 15, 2024: After further review we have decided not to proceed with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Easily insert hyperlinks in messages
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to create hyperlinks in chats by pasting a URL over selected text, similar to Outlook and Loop. This feature will be available on Teams for Windows and Mac, with rollouts beginning in early January 2025 for Targeted Release and late January 2025 for General Availability. No admin action is needed.

Title: Categorize single items in conversation view in new Microsoft Outlook for Windows and web
Summary: The new Outlook feature allows categorizing individual emails in conversation view, with a rollout starting mid-November 2024, completing by mid-February 2025. No admin action is required for this update associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 416450.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introduction of cost estimator and transparency report
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces a Data Security Investigations cost estimator and usage report for better budget planning and cost transparency. Rolling out from December 2025 to March 2026, these features enable detailed billing insights with no admin action needed and are enabled by default for all tenants.

Title: Microsoft Purview: New Purview Data Security Investigations (DSI) solution
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations (DSI) is an AI-powered solution launching in public preview April–May 2025 and general availability October 2025–January 2026. It helps security teams identify, analyze, and mitigate data risks across Microsoft 365 with deep content analysis and collaboration tools.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management - Data security alert triage agent generally available
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management's Security Copilot alert triage agent is generally available worldwide from late November to mid-December 2025. It prioritizes alerts, allows user feedback on prioritization, disables custom instructions temporarily, and removes the file risk summary. No admin changes are needed; SCUs must be provisioned.

Title: Collaborate with Microsoft Loop Pages in Teams Channels
Summary: Microsoft Loop Pages will be integrated as tabs in Teams channels, enabling creation, editing, and sharing directly within Teams. Public preview starts September 2025, with general availability in October 2025. The feature is on by default, supports mobile viewing, notifications, and requires reviewing permissions and governance policies.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Apps now supported in Shared Channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports apps in Shared Channels, allowing users to add bots, tabs, and message extensions directly. Rollout starts mid-October 2025 (targeted) and mid-January 2026 (general). Apps must be added per channel with new governance controls. Admins and developers should update policies and app manifests accordingly.

Title: Power Automate – Copilot created flow regeneration feature
Summary: On December 13, 2024, a new feature will be introduced that allows users to regenerate flows created by Copilot. How does this affect me? Previously, when using Copilot to create flows, makers would have to manually update their prompts to have a new flow created. This new feature introduces a 'Regenerate' button, which will enable Copilot to create a new variation of that flow without needing to edit the original prompt. What do I need to do to prepare? This message is for awareness and no acti...

Title: Purview | Insider Risk Management: New pay-as-you-go model for cloud storage apps, cloud services, and Microsoft Fabric
Summary: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management indicators for cloud storage apps, cloud services, and Microsoft Fabric will switch to a pay-as-you-go model in January 2025. Organizations must link an Azure subscription for billing and can opt-in via the new Microsoft Purview portal. Rollout updates and preparation steps are provided.

Title: We’re updating how we bill for mid-term subscription changes
Summary: Starting November 18, 2025, mid-term subscription changes will be billed the next day instead of the following month, varying by region. This applies to direct Microsoft purchases with invoices starting with “G.” No action is needed; the update is automatic.

Title: Power Automate - Enable process mining integration in process map
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable process mining integration in process map in Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on December 12, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to access flow-centric health and performance metrics directly within the process map, and enable seamless, one-click process mining integration for advanced analysis. Built-in process mining provides instant variant analysis, allowing you to quickly identify slow or unreliable rou...

Title: Microsoft Purview: New data security controls for detecting sensitive data shared over the network
Summary: Microsoft Purview now detects sensitive data shared over networks, integrating with Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)/Security Service Edge (SSE) solutions to inspect traffic and identify data sent to unmanaged cloud apps. Admins can create granular policies and manage them centrally via the Purview portal. Activation and configuration by admins are required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Improve real-time analytics with intent group and agent groups
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable Intent group and Agent group metrics for real-time analytics in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on November 14, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature provides several key improvements to our contact center analytics and reporting: Filters and Auto Refresh: The landing page displays real-time operational metrics with intent group and user group filters. The auto-refresh feature ensures supervisors have continuous ac...

Title: Microsoft Purview | New Copilot Security Controls in Microsoft Admin Center
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces new Copilot security controls in Microsoft Admin Center, including a default DLP policy in simulation mode, visibility into oversharing risks, and admin-configurable protections. Rollout begins mid-November 2025 (preview) and mid-January 2026 (general availability). Entra admin roles are required for policy management.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New usage reports for Microsoft Copilot with enterprise data protection
Summary: A new Microsoft Copilot usage report will be added to the Microsoft 365 admin center in mid-November 2024, providing insights into active usage and enterprise data protection. This report includes user activity metrics and trends, and will be available by default with no required admin action.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify and Microsoft SharePoint: New required footers will be automatically applied to email
Summary: New automatic footers will be added to emails sent from Microsoft Viva Amplify and SharePoint when sharing SharePoint News posts. These footers will include the customer logo, a Microsoft-generated statement, and a privacy statement link. Rollout begins early November 2024 and completes by mid-November. No admin action is required before the rollout. Organizations should update configurations and inform internal communicators.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: "Alert notifications" feature will retire starting in November 2024
Summary: The "Alert notifications" feature in Microsoft Defender for Identity will be retired starting mid-January 2025, with a new rollout timeline updated on November 13, 2024. Users should transition to using the Incident email notifications in Microsoft Defender XDR to manage notification rules.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center will support Tenant restriction v2
Summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center will soon support Tenant Restriction v2, enhancing security by limiting user access via external accounts. This feature, part of cross-tenant access settings, will be rolled out from mid-November to late December 2024 and will be off by default. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Secure Score: New Microsoft Defender for Identity recommendation
Summary: Microsoft Secure Score will add a new Defender for Identity recommendation, "Prevent Certificate Enrollment with arbitrary Application Policies (ESC15)", to improve security posture. Public Preview begins mid-November 2024, with General Availability starting late November 2024. No action is required for preparation.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to support Microsoft 365 Copilot, preventing sensitive data in prompts from being used or returned in responses. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability begins late March 2026. Admins can configure DLP policies via the Purview portal.

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online | Releasing Multi-Geo In-Region Routing
Summary: Multi-Geo In-Region Routing for Exchange Online allows routing inbound emails to specific geo-regions per accepted domain, with rollout starting October 2025. Disabled by default, it may affect Purview policies and requires Multi-Geo licenses. Admins should prepare by reviewing domains, permissions, and configurations.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Prevent screen capture (Premium feature)
Summary: Microsoft Teams Premium will introduce a "Prevent screen capture" feature by late November 2025, blocking screenshots and recordings on Windows desktop and Android devices to protect sensitive meeting content. It is off by default, enabled per meeting by organizers, and unsupported platforms join audio-only.

Title: Migration of Name Pronunciation and Pronoun Controls to the People Settings Section in Org Settings
Summary: Name Pronunciation and Pronoun controls in Microsoft 365 admin center will move to People settings under Org Settings by mid-December 2025. No new features or opt-in needed. Admins should update documentation and inform support teams about the new location.

Title: Microsoft Defender for O365: New email actions available in Advanced Hunting
Summary: Microsoft Defender for O365 now allows triggering new remediation actions—Submit to Microsoft, add to allow/block list, and initiate automated investigation—directly from the Advanced Hunting interface. This feature, rolled out since November 10, 2025, is enabled by default and supports improved threat response without policy changes.

Title: New customer onboarding for Google and Microsoft Teams calendar sync paused
Summary: Microsoft has paused new customer onboarding for calendar sync between Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams effective immediately. Existing setups continue to work, but new sync configurations cannot be initiated by organizations inactive in setup for 30 days. No action is currently required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Ask to join a shared channel with a channel link
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow in-tenant users to request joining a shared channel via a link, with channel owners deciding on the request. Rollout begins mid-June 2024 for Targeted Release and completes by late November 2024 for GCC High, DoD. No admin action required; users should be informed.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Unregistered users in an external network will not receive community emails
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will update to only send community emails to registered users. Previously, unregistered invited users could receive emails. Starting December 2024, only those who accept the invitation and complete registration will receive updates. Organizations should inform users and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Publisher will no longer be supported after October 2026
Summary: Microsoft Publisher will no longer be supported after October 2026. Users can continue to use it with its current functionality until then. Support for the perpetual version of Publisher will end in October 2026. No action is required at this time, but Microsoft is exploring modern ways to achieve common Publisher scenarios across other applications.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for Mac desktop: Retiring the admin preference to switch to legacy Outlook
Summary: Updated November 11, 2025: Based on customer feedback we have decided not to proceed with this change. Thank you for your feedback.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Configure connected agents for Researcher and other agents
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support connected agents, allowing one agent to query others for data, starting with Researcher in Q4 2025. Rolling out mid-November 2025 to February 2026, admins can manage connected agents, users can enable/disable them per conversation, and up to 10 connected agents are allowed.

Title: New support for HR and employee profile data in Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports enhanced HR and employee profile data connectors, including a BambooHR prebuilt connector and custom connectors via Microsoft Graph. Administrators can configure these to enrich people profiles, improving Copilot’s contextual responses across Microsoft 365 experiences. Public preview runs mid-May to mid-November 2025; general availability begins mid-November 2025.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Find and add company approved images with Brand Images
Summary: PowerPoint will add Brand Images, allowing users to browse and insert company-approved logos, icons, and photos from a centralized Organization Assets Library (OAL). Rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2025, the feature is on by default, requiring admins to set up and manage the OAL for brand compliance.

Title: Microsoft Teams: In-app survey feedback policies will be managed by default with Microsoft 365 Cloud Policy
Summary: Microsoft Teams for Android and iOS will switch from Teams-specific to Microsoft 365 Cloud Policy for in-app survey feedback management by late November 2025. This unifies policy management with other feedback types, requires no admin action before rollout, and keeps the feature on by default.

Title: Updates in computation of network metrics and cross-collaboration metrics in Viva Insights
Summary: Viva Insights' network metrics and cross-collaboration queries have been updated for better connection identification and data protection. Rollout starts mid-November 2024, with minor changes in query values expected. No action is required from organizations.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance Insightful Policy Performance - Public Preview
Summary: The Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance is introducing Insightful Policy Performance in public preview, providing real-time visibility into scanning progress and updates on policy conditions. The rollout is rescheduled from December 2023 to December 2024. This update is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 145793.

Title: Dynamics 365 Field Service - Summarize records with Copilot
Summary: We are announcing the Summarize records with Copilot feature for Dynamics 365 Field Service. This feature provides technicians with a quick summary of their work orders, outlining key details and other contextual information. This feature will reach general availability on December 16, 2024. How does this affect me? When you generate a summary with Copilot, the system uses the work order ID and your security profile to determine which relevant data to display by pulling contextual information di...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Increase in meeting passcodes length for added security
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing security by extending meeting passcodes to a minimum of 8 characters. Rollouts will start in early November 2024 and finish by late November, varying by availability zones. This change affects users joining with a Meeting ID and passcode, requiring no admin action.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Generative AI: Hub in public preview
Summary: The Microsoft Purview AI Hub, now known as Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management for AI (DSPM for AI), is generally available. It includes new capabilities and supports Microsoft 365 E3 and Copilot licenses, helping organizations secure data in AI applications. The hub features insights, data protection policies, and compliance controls. It will be visible in the Microsoft Purview portals with analytics, policies, and activity explorer tabs. Preparation involves reviewing the admin...

Title: Power Platform - General availability of solution-aware cloud flow sharing limits is now available
Summary: We are announcing the general availability of solution-aware cloud flow sharing limits to the Power Platform. You can now start to control how you want your makers to share their solution-aware cloud flows. Customers should have access to this control for their managed environments by December 13, 2024. How does this affect me? The control enables administrators to either enable or disable sharing. When sharing is disabled, this means that makers cannot share their flows with any individual or s...

Title: Upcoming changes to email service notification recipients
Summary: Message Center is the primary channel to receive updates about your Microsoft services. Occasionally, we will send email service notifications regarding upcoming changes that require customer action, planned maintenance, or other important announcements. To expand access and help you manage recipients in your organization, we will be implementing a new policy for receiving these transactional, email service notifications. How does this affect me? Previously, email service notifications were sent...

Title: Maintain accurate presence in Teams on the Web with new activity detection setting
Summary: Microsoft Teams on the web will introduce a new user-enabled setting to detect device activity beyond the Teams tab, improving presence accuracy. Rolling out December 2025 for Chrome v94+ and Edge v114+. No admin action needed; users must grant browser permission to enable it.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: Automatic replies collapsed by default in email thread
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically collapse automatic replies in email threads by default starting December 2025. Users can expand these replies if needed. This change applies to all users, requires no configuration, and does not affect message delivery or reply behavior.

Title: App Skills in Excel will be retired
Summary: App Skills in Excel will be retired starting December 2025, replaced by Agent Mode in Excel for a streamlined experience. All Microsoft 365 Copilot Excel users will lose App Skills access. No admin action is needed; users should explore Agent Mode and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Retirement of RBAC Application Impersonation in Exchange Online
Summary: The RBAC Application Impersonation role in Exchange Online is retiring, with the process starting in September 2024 and completion in February 2025. Applications must be updated to avoid disruption, using App Registration and Application permissions. For guidance, visit the provided links.

Title: New user analytics extended to Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Office in the Search
Summary: We are excited to announce that Microsoft Search Analytics reports in the Search & Intelligence Admin Center have been updated with improved user analytics! We have expanded coverage to almost all search applications, including Outlook, Teams, and Windows Search! Other improvements provide deeper insights and filtering capabilities for search adoption across search applications and user segments like geography, department, and occupation. The goal is to give you a good insight into adoption of s...

Title: Fix to respect Cloud Policy settings for Auto-create Loop workspaces for Teams meetings feature
Summary: The message details an update to Microsoft Teams, respecting Cloud Policy settings for the 'Auto-create Loop workspaces for Teams meetings' feature, now allowing control through Microsoft 365 Cloud Policy. It is available now, and organizations are advised to review their configurations.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Updated handling of PDFs with Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels for iOS and Android
Summary: Outlook's handling of PDFs with Purview Information Protection labels on iOS/Android is updated. Users will be prompted to open such PDFs in the Microsoft 365 app. Rollout starts early September 2024 and ends late November 2024. No admin action is needed, but user notification is advised.

Title: Microsoft Viva Learning: Learner Completion Record bulk export
Summary: The Microsoft Viva Learning's Learner Completion Record bulk export feature is being updated to allow downloads for multiple users using Microsoft 365 and security groups. Rollout begins early November 2024 and completes by mid-November. No admin action is required for the update.

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online: New fields for Exchange mailbox schema
Summary: Microsoft Exchange Online is rolling out new subfields 'ClientAppId' and 'APIId' under 'AppAccessContext' for better telemetry in Exchange APIs. Rollout begins early November 2024, with automatic updates and no required admin action. Post-rollout, admins should update workflows to accommodate these fields.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Teams: Update on new Microsoft Lists rollout

This change should not impact users following Microsoft's network guidance since April 2023. Users and admins need to recognize and prepare for the new domain.

Summary: Microsoft Edge for Business introduces Connected Feature Control (CFC) in Public Preview, allowing admins to centrally manage cloud-powered features like Translate and Compose based on compliance needs. Summary: Starting mid-June 2025, the Teams Meeting add-in in classic Outlook for Windows will suggest meeting options to organizers via a new Setup pane, enabling easier scheduling with optimized settings. The rollout completes by mid-November 2025, requires no admin action, and the feature is enabled by default.

Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon support silent test calls for IT admins to proactively check network readiness by running 60-second, background call simulations on specific subnets for Windows and Mac desktop clients. Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages now includes version history, allowing users to view and restore previous page versions, including manual, Copilot, or collaborative changes. This feature, enabled by default without needing a Copilot license, rolls out worldwide from October to November 2025 and requires no admin setup.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: floating Copilot button simplifies Copilot discovery
Summary: Starting October 15, 2025, OneDrive will roll out a floating Copilot button for Microsoft 365 Copilot users, enabling quick access to AI-powered file actions and contextual suggestions. The feature is enabled by default, requires no configuration, and aims to improve efficiency within the OneDrive web interface.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Custom Communication Compliance policy as IRM indicator
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon allow admins to use Communication Compliance policy alerts as indicators in IRM policies. This feature, rolling out from July to December 2025, enables integrated alert review without switching tools. No prior admin action is needed before rollout.

Title: Introducing Meeting Prep for Financial Services (Preview)
Summary: Meeting Prep for Financial Services is now in public preview, offering investment bankers a centralized app for meeting preparation. It integrates data from various sources with AI insights and is available now, with general availability starting early December 2024. Licensing includes Microsoft 365 E3/Business Basic and LSEG Workspace.

Title: Copilot Pages coming to Microsoft Copilot
Summary: Copilot Pages will be available in Microsoft Copilot for users with an Entra account and SharePoint license starting early November 2024. This feature allows for collaborative and persistent workspaces in Copilot chat. It will be enabled by default with admin controls for customization.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Top questions in your communities
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is introducing a 'Top questions' feature to display the most popular questions in a community over the last 90 days, aiding in finding relevant content. It will roll out from mid-November to late December 2024 and will be enabled by default. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Audit: Enable audit log search for content searches that target Microsoft SharePoint Online
Summary: Enable audit log search for SharePoint Online content searches in Microsoft Purview by following the provided instructions. This feature is now generally available and requires enabling 'SearchQueryInitiatedSharePoint' for users. No admin action is needed before the rollout, but reviewing configurations and updating documentation is advised.

Summary: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection will update to show consistent Data Loss Prevention policy tips across Word, Excel, PowerPoint for Windows, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive. Rollout starts early June 2024, with general availability by mid-December 2024. No admin action required before rollout. Documentation will be updated accordingly.

Summary: Message Center is the primary channel to receive updates about your Microsoft services. Title: Microsoft Teams | Enhance your Teams experience with new accent colors
Summary: The planned Microsoft Teams feature allowing users to select accent colors for interface personalization, initially set to roll out in November 2025, will not be released at this time. No admin action is needed, but users can be informed about the canceled update.

Title: Workplace Patterns Report in Viva Glint with Viva Insights integration
Summary: The Workplace Patterns Report in Viva Glint integrates Viva Insights workplace data with employee sentiment surveys, enabling HR analysts to uncover actionable insights through automated analytics, interactive visualizations, and role-based access. It will roll out globally from late November to mid-December 2025.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Updated user scoping features in policies
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will enhance user scoping in policies, allowing admins to select users, groups, and adaptive scopes for inclusion or exclusion. Rollout begins late June 2025 worldwide and October 2025 for government clouds, with no admin action needed before deployment.

Rollout begins mid-April 2025, with general availability worldwide by July 2025 and in government clouds by January 2026.

Summary: With the forward message feature, Microsoft Teams users will soon be able to send chat messages from one chat to another. Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity's Unified Sensor is now generally available, enabling identity protections on qualifying domain controllers via the existing Defender for Endpoint agent without extra installation. Activation requires Windows Server 2019+, specific updates, and licensing. It simplifies identity alerts and attack disruption with no downtime.

Title: Microsoft 365: Visual refresh of app icons
Summary: Microsoft 365 is updating app icons for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and others with a unified, symbol-led design reflecting Copilot integration. Rollout starts October 2025 across web, desktop, and mobile. This is a visual-only change with no impact on functionality or settings. No admin action required.

Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will introduce community settings for the Community Resources module and Files tab, with a rollout starting late October 2024 and completing by mid-November 2024. Summary: Classic Outlook will gain a Copilot side pane showing AI-generated summaries of search results from documents and Teams messages. Summary: Microsoft Exchange Online now supports inbound SMTP DANE with DNSSEC, enhancing email security. It's in General Availability since October 22, 2024. Summary: New Microsoft Teams apps and Copilot extensions will provide admins with security and certification information for compliance assessment. Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new feature allowing users to insert emojis by typing words surrounded by colons (e.g., :smile:). Rolling out from June 2025 to January 2026 across various regions, it requires no admin action and will be enabled by default on Windows and Mac desktops.

Title: Microsoft Lists app: New drag and drop feature
Summary: The Microsoft Lists app is introducing a drag and drop feature to reorder list items, with a rollout starting in August 2024 and completing by late October 2024. This feature will be available by default to all users. No admin action is required for the update.

Summary: SharePoint Online Tenant Rename is now generally available without site count limits, enabling domain name changes for all tenants starting October 16, 2025. Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce audio-only recording for meetings and calls starting early October 2025, allowing users to record just audio while keeping cameras on. This feature requires no admin setup, maintains current policies, and enhances privacy without compliance impact. No user action is needed.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the Assign option on the case form to work with unified routing to update presence and capacity of service representatives in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web: Optimized hover actions in the message list
Summary: Hover actions in the message list for new Outlook on Windows and web will move to the Sender/From column to save space and reduce mouse travel. A one-time shortcut will allow users to set hover actions. Rollout starts mid-July 2025, requiring no admin action but user notification is advised.

Summary: Microsoft Places will support Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) via Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra starting September 2025, enabling centralized and delegated management through built-in admin roles for Places, building, and desk administrators. This decentralizes management, reduces IT overhead, and aligns access with real-world roles.

Summary: Starting mid-November 2025, Viva Insights will disable Behavioral insights by default for new and some existing customers, focusing on Copilot and AI agent analytics. Admins can enable or disable Behavioral insights via VFAM or PowerShell. Behavioral insights provide deeper organizational work patterns but are separate from AI usage data.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management – Introduction of pay-as-you-go feature usage report
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management introduces a pay-as-you-go feature usage report by mid-February 2026, offering detailed billing insights by data source and activity. This default report helps admins optimize costs and policies without requiring setup, enhancing compliance visibility and access control via Entra ID.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Viva Amplify
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now available in Viva Amplify to improve authoring with AI. It's accessible without a Copilot license if you have a Viva Amplify license. Copilot offers rewriting, length adjustment, and tone setting features but is not available on SharePoint or mobile apps. No admin action is needed for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Copilot in Edge will support page summarization and user prompt suggestions
Summary: Starting early November 2024, Microsoft Copilot in Edge will reintroduce page summarization and contextual prompt suggestions, available for users signed in with a Microsoft Entra account or using Microsoft 365 Copilot in web mode. Rollout will be automatic, and admins can configure the feature.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Chat contextual info and Search
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating to include enhanced chat contextual information and search capabilities. Rollout begins late July 2024 for Targeted Release and will be globally available by mid-January 2025. This feature, which is on by default, allows users to access chat info such as People, Pinned messages, Shared files, and links, and search within chats. No admin action is required for the update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Refreshed view of all your teams and channels page
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a refreshed 'Your teams' and 'Manage Team > Channels' page for better navigation and management of teams and channels. Rollout begins early October 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-October for General Availability, with completion expected by late October 2024. No admin action required.

Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon release a feature to disable attendee email notifications for town halls and webinars, with updated rollout timelines provided. This feature is linked to Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 392826 and requires no admin action prior to rollout. Organizations can prepare by informing users and updating documentation.

Summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal is being updated to introduce a new schema to track Power Apps and Power Platform Connector activities. Summary: The PowerPoint QuickStarter feature will be retired between November 11, 2024, and January 14, 2025, for Office versions 2410 for Windows and 2411 for Mac. Organizations using it should prepare for its discontinuation.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to use your own encryption key for encrypting data at-rest for existing environments with flows in Power Automate. Title: Reminder: Support for the Word Mobile, Excel Mobile, and PowerPoint Mobile UWP applications ended on October 14, 2025
Summary: Support for Word Mobile, Excel Mobile, and PowerPoint Mobile UWP apps ended on October 14, 2025. Organizations should remove these apps to avoid security risks and switch to Microsoft 365 Copilot, web versions, or desktop apps. Use Microsoft Intune to identify devices running these apps.

Summary: We are announcing enhanced supervisor actions in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on November 14, 2025. How does this affect me? Summary: We are announcing the ability to filter out unwanted rows from your source data directly in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data. Title: Microsoft Viva: Pulse admins can manage Pulse notifications
Summary: Microsoft Viva: Pulse admins will soon manage notification settings, choosing delivery methods for users' Pulse surveys. Rollout begins late October and completes by late November 2024. This feature is on by default and is associated with Roadmap ID 408163. Admins should prepare by installing the Viva Pulse Teams app.

Title: New Outlook for Windows: Multi-account support for add-Ins and apps
Summary: New Outlook for Windows will soon support apps and add-ins for all accounts, with a dynamic interface reflecting the active account. Rollouts start late October 2024 for Targeted Release and late November 2024 for General Availability. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Export content (including Microsoft Loop) stored in SharePoint Embedded (SPE) containers
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint Online will soon allow admins to export content from SharePoint Embedded containers, including Microsoft Loop, using third-party tools with guest app permissions. Rollout begins mid-October 2024, with full availability expected by late October 2024. This update requires no admin action before rollout.

Title: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for macOS – Planned update to compatibility Office add-ins and ODBC drivers
Summary: The message details a planned update for Office on macOS, requiring Office add-ins and ODBC drivers to be codesigned with a valid Apple Developer ID. This change, expected in mid-November 2024, may affect workflows using unsigned dynamic libraries. Developers must ensure compliance, and admins should verify and prepare for this update.

Title: Microsoft 365 apps: Improved resharing experience
Summary: Microsoft 365 apps are introducing an improved resharing experience. Users can now copy view-only links directly from the Share dialog, and request file sharing from the owner if needed. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, with general availability by late October 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing CAPTCHA verification for anonymous meeting participants, with rollout starting late October 2024 and completion by mid-November 2024. Tenant Admins must enable this feature in the Teams Admin Center.

Title: Preview new Graph connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces an early preview of new Graph connectors, including GitHub, Google Drive, and others, with limited availability starting from October 2024. Sign-ups for the preview are open via a form or email. These connectors allow indexing of third-party content, enhancing search capabilities across Microsoft Search clients.

Summary: Microsoft ends Windows 10 support on October 14, 2025, stopping security updates and technical support. Microsoft Defender will still offer limited protection. To stay secure, upgrade to Windows 11 or use the Extended Security Update (ESU) program if upgrading isn’t immediately possible. Review compliance needs accordingly.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations – Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app new features
Summary: We are announcing new features for the Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app for Dynamics 365 Project Operations. These features will reach general availability on November 14, 2025. How does this affect me? The app now displays icons next to each expense category for faster selection and allows users to rename receipts directly in the app, making attachments easier to manage. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview AI Hub: Enhancements to Overview, Recommendations, Reports, and Policies pages
Summary: The Microsoft Purview AI Hub will soon be updated with new sections for Overview, Recommendations, Reports, and Policies, as well as an improved Activity Explorer. These changes will start rolling out in mid-October 2024 and are associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 415451. The update will be on by default with no admin action required.

Summary: The September 2024 Microsoft Entra update includes general availability releases, retirement of Azure AD Graph, security enhancements for Apple devices, MFA enforcement, and more. Details are communicated via blog, email, and release notes, organized by product for easy reference.

Summary: In November 2024, Microsoft will introduce the "Allow web search in Copilot" policy, enabling separate management of web searches in Microsoft 365 Copilot from other optional connected experiences. This policy allows for improved Copilot responses using Bing search service and can be configured at the user/group level.

Summary: The message details the global rollout of Microsoft SharePoint eSignature integration with Adobe Acrobat Sign and Docusign, eliminating the need for native SharePoint eSignature activation. It will begin in early November 2024 and complete by mid-November. Admins must enable this feature in the Microsoft admin center. The rollout is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 421194.

Title: Support for Office 2016 and Office 2019 will end October 14, 2025: Upgrade recommended
Summary: Office 2016 and Office 2019 support will end on October 14, 2025. It is recommended to upgrade to Microsoft 365 E3 or Office LTSC 2024 for continued updates and support. Resources like upgrade guidance, Microsoft FastTrack, and the Office End of Support Tech Community are available to assist with the transition.

Summary: Automatic uninstallation of classic Microsoft Teams for Windows will resume on October 21, 2024, affecting non-VDI and certain VDI environments. No action is required from users; this is for information only. For manual uninstallation, refer to the provided link. Non-persistent VDI environments are not affected.

Title: Retiring the “Refresh all on page” button in OneNote Meeting Details pane by end of 2025
Summary: The "Refresh all on page" button in OneNote's Meeting Details pane will be retired between November 15 and December 15, 2025. Users can update meeting info by selecting the meeting again from the right pane. No admin action is needed; notify users and update documentation accordingly.

Summary: Microsoft Teams group chat agents and bots will support Entra authentication starting November 3-6, 2025. Users without the Teams app or Entra consent receive a private prompt to install the app and grant permissions. This feature is enabled by default, requiring no admin action.

Title: Publishing new InfoPath Forms in SharePoint Online will not be allowed for inactive tenants in this December

Summary: The Microsoft 365 Mobile app now supports viewing PDFs with Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels in read-only mode, available globally. Organizations should inform users and update training materials accordingly.

Users should be informed of these changes.

Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is updating to support IPv6 in Tenant Allow/Block List, with a revised rollout timeline starting early October 2024. This update applies to customers with specific service plans and will allow admins to block or allow IPv6 addresses without submissions. Rollout requires no admin action prior to the update.

Title: Classic Microsoft Outlook for Windows: New reporting buttons integrated with Microsoft Defender for Office 365

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: New Microsoft Fabric risk indicators
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management's update to include new risk indicators for Microsoft Fabric in Power BI is postponed. Organizations are advised to prepare by opting into new indicators via the Microsoft Purview portal.

Summary: Outlook's update allows creating events by dragging emails into the Calendar icon. Rollout begins late October 2024 for Targeted Release and late November for General Availability, completing by late December 2024. The feature is available by default with no admin action required.

Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon support bulk upload for priority user groups. Summary: The new Outlook for Windows will soon feature auto-reading of emails with Windows Narrator, starting early November 2024. Summary: Outlook will soon prompt organizers to send meeting updates only to added or removed attendees. Rollout for General Availability will begin in late August 2024 and complete by late October 2024. No admin action is required for this update associated with Roadmap ID 394687.

Title: Microsoft Teams: In-meeting Error Messaging

Title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Improvements to threat protection capabilities
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will expand its dynamic threat detection model in November 2025, replacing legacy policies with more accurate, research-driven detections. Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: New usage intensity metrics available in admin center report
Summary: New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage intensity metrics will be available in the admin center report by late October 2025, showing prompt counts, daily trends, and active days at organization and user levels. Title: Manage SharePoint agents in Copilot Control System: View, block, or unblock agents used in Copilot Chat
Summary: Microsoft 365 admins can now manage SharePoint agents in Copilot Chat via a new Agents section in the Copilot Control System. They can view, block, or unblock agents starting late September 2025. This feature is enabled by default and only affects Copilot Chat.

Summary: Microsoft is retiring Viva Engage desktop notifications by mid-November 2025 to streamline notifications across Microsoft 365. Title: (Reminder) Delve retires December 16, 2024
Summary: Microsoft Delve will retire on December 16, 2024. Additional details and guidance can be found in the original announcement MC698136 and the provided support links. Organizations should update their documentation and training accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Mesh app on PC supports guest access for events
Summary: The Microsoft Mesh app on PC now supports guest access for events, allowing broader collaboration with external attendees. The rollout will begin in November 2024, with no admin action required. Mesh license is required for guests, with future updates to include Meta Quest and anonymous participants. Relevant licensing links are provided.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Host and attendee interaction improvements for multi-room Mesh events
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing interaction improvements for multi-room Mesh events, allowing attendees to see reactions across rooms and hosts to move between rooms. Rollout begins in November 2024, with updated timelines provided. This feature will be on by default with no admin action required. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 412078.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Updates to Microsoft built-in Sensitive Information Types (SITs)
Summary: Microsoft is updating five bundled EU Sensitive Information Types in Purview to improve detection accuracy by enhancing keywords and processors. The rollout began mid-September 2025, completing by mid-October 2025. No admin action is needed; existing policies will automatically benefit from improved detection.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center: Speed up app reviews with trust-based filters
Summary: Microsoft Teams Admin Center will add trust-based filters for app reviews, allowing admins to filter apps by security and compliance standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. This feature, rolling out October 2025, streamlines app evaluation without changing app enablement behavior.

Title: Public preview: New content explorer experience for cases in Insider Risk Management
Summary: A new content explorer for Insider Risk Management cases, featuring advanced filtering, grouping, document preview, customizable columns, and time zone selection, will roll out worldwide in public preview from early October to early November 2025. It applies to new cases only, with no changes to existing policies.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center: Expanded security and compliance info for more apps and agents
Summary: Starting late October 2025, Teams Admin Center will show expanded security and compliance data (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) for more apps, including those not Microsoft 365 certified, sourced from Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps. This feature is enabled by default with no user impact.

Title: Windows 11, version 25H2 is now available via feature updates
Summary: Windows 11 version 25H2 is available from September 30, 2025. Upgrading during October (a baseline month) keeps devices eligible for hotpatch updates; upgrading outside baseline months pauses hotpatching until the next baseline. Organizations should schedule upgrades accordingly to maintain hotpatch continuity.

Title: NEW Microsoft 365 companion apps: a suite designed to enhance productivity
Summary: Starting late October 2025, Microsoft 365 companion apps—People, Files, and Calendar—will auto-install on Windows 11 devices with Microsoft 365 apps, integrating Copilot for contextual AI assistance. Admins can opt out via Device Configuration. Apps enhance productivity by streamlining access to contacts, files, and meetings.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Share Teams apps and agents from their profile or the Teams side panel
Summary: Starting November 2025, users can share Microsoft Teams apps or agents from their profile or the side panel in Teams on desktop and web. No Microsoft 365 Copilot license is needed. The feature rolls out automatically, requiring no admin action, with user notification recommended.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage | Email sender domain migration from @yammer.com to @engage.mail.microsoft
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is updating its email sender domains from @yammer.com to @engage.mail.microsoft, starting September 2025 with completion by Q1 2026. A coexistence period will allow both domains. Admins should update rules referencing the old domains; no compliance issues identified.

Title: Retiring Power BI “Visualize the List” and “Visualize the Library” Features in SharePoint Online
Summary: Power BI’s legacy “Visualize the List” and “Visualize the Library” features in SharePoint Online will retire between mid-November and mid-December 2025. New reports via these features and access to existing ones will end. Users should switch to supported alternatives like Export to Power BI and Power BI Desktop.

Title: Executable name update for Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Windows
Summary: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Windows will change its executable name from Webviewhost.exe to M365Copilot.exe after late October 2025. The update is automatic for Microsoft Store users with auto-updates enabled. No functionality changes occur; update dependencies if needed.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Use data masking to protect customer data
Summary: We are announcing the ability to opt-in to protect your customers' sensitive data by enabling your customer service representatives to hide any personally identifiable information (PII) that customers inadvertently share in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 31, 2025. How does this affect me? When enabled, service representatives can select individual messages from the customer and redact them, so that the customer's PII isn't stored in your repo...

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - View previously closed persistent conversations
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable your site's visitors to review their previously closed conversations in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 31, 2025. How does this affect me? Title: Retirement of inline SVG images in Microsoft Outlook
Summary: Starting September 2025, Outlook for Web and new Outlook for Windows will stop displaying inline SVG images, showing blank spaces instead. This affects under 0.1% of images, improves security, and requires no user action. SVG attachments remain supported. Organizations should update documentation and inform users.

Title: Microsoft Project for the web and Project in Teams will retire and redirect to Planner for the web and Planner in Teams
Summary: Microsoft Project for the web and Project in Teams will retire by August 2025, redirecting users to Microsoft Planner for the web and Planner in Teams. Planner integrates To Do, Planner, and Project features, offering seamless migration and new capabilities. Users must migrate Roadmaps to Portfolios and update Teams tabs accordingly.

Title: Feature retirement: deploy Shifts to your frontline teams at scale in Teams Admin Center
Summary: The "Deploy Shifts to your frontline teams at scale" feature in Teams Admin Center will retire starting September 5, 2025. After this date, admins must manage Shifts via the Teams web or desktop apps. No admin action is required; the change happens automatically.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Broaden region coverage of voice channel
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the voice channel in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Government Community Cloud Moderate (GCC-M) regions in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 31, 2025 How does this affect me? The voice channel will be available in the UAE and GCC-M regions. In GCC-M, the voice channel will be available via Direct Routing. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook: New work location sharing options
Summary: The new Outlook update adds more options for work location sharing, including not sharing any information. Users and admins can configure these settings in Outlook or with PowerShell. Title: Microsoft Word: Researcher feature will retire starting late December 2024
Summary: The Researcher feature in Microsoft Word will be retired starting late December 2024, with full retirement by January 2025. This affects Word for Windows and Mac desktops. Microsoft suggests using Copilot as an alternative. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

Title: Product transitions to the cloud.microsoft domain – September 2024
Summary: The message details the transition of Microsoft products to the cloud.microsoft domain by September 2024, with some services already available. It advises admins to educate users, update organizational materials, ensure in-house apps are compatible, and verify network connections to *.cloud.microsoft are unblocked.

Title: Microsoft Forms: New data sync solution for Microsoft Excel for the web in Microsoft SharePoint Online and OneDrive
Summary: Microsoft Forms will soon introduce a new data sync solution for Excel on the web in SharePoint Online and OneDrive, replacing the old sync method. Rollout starts mid-October 2024 and should complete by mid-November 2024. This feature will be default and requires no admin action before rollout.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New self-service purchase and trial settings
Summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center is introducing new settings for Global admins to manage self-service trials and purchases. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, with completion by early October 2024. Admins can access these settings under Org Settings, with the MSCommerce PowerShell option remaining available.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Subscribe to notifications for followed topics
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will soon allow users to subscribe to notifications for followed topics, with notifications appearing on the bell icon. This feature will start rolling out in late September 2024 and is expected to be completed by early October 2024. It will be enabled by default.

Title: New support for historical data uploads in Organizational Data in Microsoft 365
Summary: Microsoft 365 now supports manual uploads of historical HR data in Organizational Data with an effective date toggle for accurate processing. This feature, rolling out late September to October 2025, enables correcting past errors and building user histories but requires admin activation and manual CSV uploads only.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio icon update

Title: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery - Metadata field enhancements in process reporting

These updates improve item-level insights, error traceability, and support automation. Admins should update workflows and documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Users can save chats and channel messages for later

Summary: Starting early August 2025, Microsoft 365 Copilot shifts to capacity-based access for some features. No admin action is needed; upgrades enable priority access.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for September 2024
Summary: The September 2024 Microsoft Intune Service Update has been released, updating your account to the latest build. You will notice the updated service release number in the Tenant Status blade. To prepare, review the new features on the Intune "What's new" page and the linked blogs for detailed information.

Title: Microsoft OneNote for Windows 10 retires October 14, 2025 (switch your users)
Summary: OneNote for Windows 10 will end support on October 14, 2025, and users should switch to OneNote for Windows. Migration guidance and support are provided, with additional OneNote team support available in October 2024. New user downloads will be restricted starting November 1, 2024.

Summary: Automatic updates for Teams Android Devices to Company Portal version 5.0.6152.0 are planned, starting mid-October 2024 until late December 2024. Title: Microsoft Fabric: New tenant settings for short-lived user-delegated SAS tokens (Preview)
Summary: The message details the live feature of short-lived user-delegated SAS tokens in Microsoft Fabric, with new tenant settings available in the Fabric Admin portal. Title: Microsoft Outlook: Simplified mobile app sign in
Summary: The planned update for Microsoft Outlook mobile app sign-in using QR codes, initially set for a Public Preview in mid-August 2024 and General Availability in mid-September 2024, has been postponed and will not proceed at this time. Microsoft apologizes for any inconvenience caused.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Design ideas in Viva Amplify
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify is introducing 'Design ideas' for authors to enhance sections in drafts and SharePoint distribution channels. Rollout begins late September and completes by mid-October 2024. This feature will be on by default for users with Authoring permissions. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Removing a recommendation to update Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft is updating the Microsoft Secure Score in Defender for Endpoint to better reflect security posture. This includes removing the recommendation SCID-84 for Local Admin password management. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, expected to complete by late October 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in Town Hall
Summary: The updated Microsoft Teams feature enables private chat for Town Hall organizers and presenters, including external ones, for collaboration before, during, and after events. Rollout begins mid-November 2024, completing by mid-January 2025. It will be available automatically, and organizers must define presenters for chat creation.

Title: Stay current with your OS to keep your Microsoft Teams desktop client supported
Summary: The message details the importance of keeping the OS updated for Microsoft Teams desktop client support, outlining the timelines when unsupported OS versions will receive notifications and eventually be blocked from using the client. It also provides links to the lifecycle policies and steps for preparation.

Title: Microsoft Teams: UDP Signaling Ports configuration change
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating UDP signaling ports for Calling and Meetings to enhance efficiency. The source ports will change from 49152-65535 to 50070-50089, with the destination UDP port remaining at 3478. Rollout begins early October 2024. Admins should allow the new UDP source ports to the specified destination ports.

Title: Specifying client ID and secret when creating an Azure ACS principal via AppRegNew.aspx will be removed
Summary: The option to specify client ID and secret when creating Azure ACS principals will be removed. Users must adopt the system-generated client ID and secret. This change will start in early October 2024 and end by early November 2024. No admin action is required for this automatic change. Azure ACS is retiring on April 2, 2026.

Title: SharePoint Online: New heading level options for web parts
Summary: SharePoint Online introduces new heading level options for web parts, aligning with Text web part default font sizes. Rollout begins April 2024, with completion by October 2024. Authors can set heading levels, defaulting to Heading 2. No admin action needed, but informing SharePoint authors is advised. Associated with MC670896 and Roadmap ID 387500.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Video tile re-sizing based on people count for Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will feature dynamic video tile resizing in Gallery view, based on participant count, to improve visibility. Rollout begins late September 2024, with completion by early October. The update is automatic, but admins can disable it via the EnableRoomPeopleCount XML setting. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 400706.

Summary: We are announcing the general availability of Sales Qualification Agent in Dynamics 365 Sales, which autonomously researches and engages leads, and hands off to sellers only those that have demonstrated purchase intent.
