Title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: Updates to data retention policy
Summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse's data retention policy is updated from 3 years to indefinite retention while the tenant has an active subscription. Data will be stored in Azure Cosmos DB starting October 2025. No action is required, and user workflows remain unchanged. Previously stored data in Microsoft Forms follows prior rules.

Title: Viva Engage: Export event posts
Summary: Viva Engage event organizers can export posts from the past 28 days as a .csv file, including content, status, source, timestamps, upvotes, and reactions. The feature, enabled by default across platforms, rolls out worldwide from September 29 to October 4, 2025, with tenant-level admin control to disable it.

Title: Microsoft Stream: Less storage space consumed for Stream videos in Microsoft 365 Suite
Summary: Microsoft Stream is modifying versioning to reduce storage space usage. Changes to chapters and transcripts will no longer create new versions, thus not increasing storage consumption. This update is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 395380 and will be implemented worldwide from mid-July to late August 2024.

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online | SMTP onboarding to App RBAC
Summary: Microsoft Exchange Online will enable admins to assign the SMTP.SendAsApp role to applications via App RBAC, allowing group-based or scoped mailbox access. This replaces manual per-mailbox permissions, simplifying OAuth SMTP client onboarding. Rollout begins November 2025, with no end-user impact. Prepare by planning group-based access and updating documentation.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Admin control to hide Teams call history in iOS native dialer
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce an admin setting to hide Teams call and meeting history from the native iOS dialer, enabled by default. Rolling out from October to December 2025 across regions, admins can toggle this in the Teams admin center to enhance privacy and user experience on iPhones and iPads.

Title: Microsoft Fabric: Upcoming tenant settings for OneLake diagnostic logs
Summary: Microsoft Fabric will introduce a tenant setting on October 28, 2025, allowing admins to control inclusion of user identifiers in OneLake diagnostic logs. By default, End User Identifiable Information is logged, but admins can opt out for privacy and compliance. This supports security, troubleshooting, and usage analytics.

Title: OneDrive folder sync selection dialog temporarily unavailable when using zh-CN language setting
Summary: OneDrive's folder sync selection dialog will be temporarily unavailable for users with the zh-CN language setting from September 29 to late October 2025 due to GB18030 compliance updates. Users should switch to zh-HK, zh-TW, or another language temporarily to maintain selective sync access.

Title: Microsoft Purview | New centralized Service health dashboard for Microsoft Purview
Summary: The new centralized Service health dashboard for Microsoft Purview, offering real-time status and issue submission for Purview, Microsoft 365, and Azure services, has been delayed. It will be enabled by default with no preparation needed, and administrators will be notified when it becomes available.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Upcoming Change to DLP Alert Settings
Summary: Starting September 26, 2025, Microsoft Purview will update DLP alert settings to remove "Generate Alert" from rules where corresponding Protection Alerts were disabled via PowerShell. To keep receiving alerts, admins must update and save rules in the portal or re-enable alerts using the Set-DlpComplianceRule cmdlet.

Title: Reporting labels retirement in Teams admin center
Summary: Starting September 15, 2025, Teams Admin Center's Reporting Labels feature will retire, replaced by a unified upload page for managing building and endpoint data for Call Analytics and Call Quality Dashboard. Rollout occurs September-October 2025, simplifying data management without compliance concerns. Existing CQD files transfer automatically.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales – Accelerate data entry using form fill assist toolbar
Summary: We are announcing the ability to extract key details, such as names, phone numbers, addresses, and company info from uploaded content, and intelligently map them to the right fields in the sales form in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on October 17, 2025. How does this affect me? As part of Copilot’s form fill assistance initiatives, the form fill assist toolbar supports the uploading of files, emails, and images, helping eliminate manual data entry. It extracts...

Title: Microsoft Teams | Know Your Customer (KYC) onboarding required for new phone number requests
Summary: Starting early August 2025, Teams admins must complete a one-time KYC onboarding in the Teams Admin Center by submitting business info and documents before provisioning new phone numbers. The process, taking up to two days, applies globally and does not affect existing numbers.

Title: Plan for Change: Windows enrollment will include quality updates during OOBE
Summary: The Windows enrollment will now include automatic quality updates during OOBE for devices with Windows 11, version 22H2 and higher. The update, expected in October, has been postponed. Organizations should plan for extra setup time and extend Temporary Access Passwords validity if used.

Title: Introducing Guest App Permission Management for SharePoint Admins
Summary: SharePoint Admins can soon manage guest app permissions using SharePoint Online Management Shell cmdlets. Updates to Get-SPOApplication and Set-SPOApplicationPermission will facilitate this. Rollout starts early October 2024 for Targeted Release, and mid-October 2024 for General Availability. Admins must download the latest SharePoint PowerShell version to prepare.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Oversharing popups enhancements on Microsoft Outlook Win32
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention on Outlook Win32 introduces two new predicates: 'Message contains' and 'Attachment contains' for client-side email evaluation. Rollout begins mid-April 2024, with standard release by late September 2024. No admin action needed; users can create or edit DLP Policies accordingly. Roadmap ID 376999.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows and web: Improvements to working hours and location
Summary: Microsoft Outlook is updating features related to working hours and location, with rollout timelines specified for various user groups. The updates include a revised daily location menu and integration of work location with Out of Office time. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Add location to your presence signal
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a feature to add a location to your presence signal, viewable from profile cards, one-on-one, and group chats. This will roll out in early to mid-November 2024, enhancing productivity and collaboration. Preparation involves reviewing the Microsoft Places deployment guide.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Cloud IntelliFrame now available on Teams Rooms for Android
Summary: Cloud IntelliFrame, an AI video enhancement feature, is now available on Teams Rooms for Android with a Teams Rooms Pro license starting mid-October 2025. Administrators must enable it manually via the Teams admin console, with no default activation or changes to existing policies.

Title: Microsoft 365: Organizational data ingestion - new updates
Summary: Microsoft 365 updates organizational data ingestion with enhanced attribute access, mapping, new connectors, and a new admin role. It unifies ingestion for Viva Insights and Viva Glint, supports parallel data sources, requires no new licenses except for Viva Insights/Glint features, and rolls out globally by early October 2025.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Users can set custom account descriptions
Summary: Users of New Outlook for Windows will soon be able to set custom account descriptions to better identify multiple accounts. The feature rolls out from late February 2025 (Targeted Release) to late September 2025 (General Availability) with no admin action required.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting September 23rd, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this l...

Title: Microsoft Lists: Mobile apps for iOS and Android will retire
Summary: Microsoft Lists mobile apps for iOS and Android will retire by mid-November 2025. Users should switch to the mobile browser experience, which remains supported. Existing data stays accessible via desktop or browser. No admin action is needed; users will be notified through in-app banners starting June 2025.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales – Find, filter, and sort using natural language with smart grid
Summary: We are announcing the find, filter, and sort using natural language with smart grid feature for Dynamics 365 Sales. With this feature users can find and filter leads and opportunities using natural language queries. This feature will reach general availability on October 24, 2025. How does this affect me? Users can filter records, search based on text, and sort records in a grid using natural language query. You can also see the criteria applied to filter the data and can easily cancel the filte...

Title: Microsoft Teams: New link in forwarded messages improves context and traceability
Summary: Forwarded messages in Microsoft Teams will now include a clickable link to the original message for better context and traceability. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out from mid-October to mid-November 2025 for all Windows and Mac desktop users, requiring no admin action.

Title: [Copilot Chat] Upload multiple reference images to create new images
Summary: Users of Copilot Chat in Microsoft 365 will soon be able to upload multiple reference images per session, enhancing image generation. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out globally in late September 2025 with no admin action required. Organizations may update support and documentation accordingly.

Title: Viva Engage: Mute a conversation from Teams for iOS
Summary: Viva Engage will allow network admins and corporate communicators to mute conversations directly in the Teams app on iOS and Android, removing muted threads from home feeds and email digests. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from early to mid-October 2025.

Title: Support Update for SharePoint Framework Field Customizers in Lists and Document Libraries
Summary: SharePoint no longer plans to retire Field Customizers but is evaluating it. Currently, no impact exists, but future changes may stop custom code rendering in lists and libraries. Transition to Column Formatting is recommended, with Command Set and Application Customizers still supported. Planning for transition is advised.

Title: Exchange Online: Update to bulk email filtering for enhanced accuracy
Summary: Exchange Online is updating bulk email filtering for better accuracy, factoring in intermediaries and enhancing BCL scores, especially when CAUTH is set to None. Rollout begins early October 2024, with completion by late October. Admins should review logs and prepare for changes in bulk email management.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Updates to "Turn off sharing recommendations" Cloud Policy
Summary: Upcoming updates to the "Turn off sharing recommendations" Cloud Policy will prevent users from sharing or editing folder permissions with individuals in Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows. Rollouts begin in October 2024, with no required admin action before the rollout.

Title: Reminder: Intune moving to support Android 10 and later for user-based management methods in October 2024
Summary: In October 2024, Intune will only support Android 10 and later for user-based management methods. Unsupported versions will not receive technical support, bug fixes, or guaranteed feature functionality. Organizations should prepare by updating helpdesk communications and configuring admin settings to warn or block users on older Android versions.

Title: Update: Rollout of the Microsoft Entra ID Free subscription
Summary: Microsoft is rolling out the no-cost Microsoft Entra ID Free subscription to track Entra tenant ownership via billing accounts. It will appear in Microsoft 365 and Azure portals starting October, requires no action, does not affect billing or functionality, and helps manage tenant ownership securely.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Volume ratio setting for meeting participants using language interpretation
Summary: Microsoft Teams introduces a volume ratio setting for meeting participants using language interpretation. Rollout begins November 2024 for various releases, with completion by early January 2025. Participants can adjust the original audio and interpretation volume after selecting a language. Organizers must enable this feature. Roadmap ID: 411569.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify and SharePoint News: Videos will play in Microsoft Outlook instead of web browser
Summary: Starting early July 2025 through late November 2025, videos embedded via Stream in Microsoft Viva Amplify and SharePoint News will play inline within Microsoft Outlook (Windows and web), eliminating the need to open a browser. This feature is enabled by default with no admin action required.

Title: Teams Admin Center: Control External Access by Domain for Specific Users and Groups
Summary: Microsoft Teams now allows admins to assign custom external access policies by user or group, enabling granular control over which external domains they can interact with. This feature, available via PowerShell during preview and later in the Teams admin center UI, supports five policy options for tailored external collaboration.

Title: Microsoft Word: Loop components released to Targeted Release customers have retired
Summary: The Loop components feature in Microsoft Word for the web, introduced to Targeted Release customers in December 2022, has been retired. Users can no longer insert new Loop components, but existing ones will work as usual. Loop components remain available in other apps and the Loop application.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Viva Engage question post update
Summary: The update introduces a two-part question post and code snippet formatting in Viva Engage, with a rollout from March to November 2024. Community admins can convert posts between discussions and questions, and users should update training materials accordingly. Microsoft 365 Roadmap IDs 376700 and 378778 are associated with these changes.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: User admin and License admin roles enabled to manage self-service license requests
Summary: User and License admin roles in the Microsoft 365 admin center can now manage self-service license requests. Rollout begins mid-September 2024 and completes by late September. Admins should learn the licensing process to prepare. No other permission changes for these roles.

Title: Retirement: Investigation priority score feature
Summary: The 'Investigation priority score' feature in Microsoft Defender is retiring, with the process starting in early November 2024 and ending late November 2024. Affected users should prepare by transitioning to the 'Entra risk score' feature, with resources provided for guidance.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Adding security to feedback policy checks across all user accounts
Summary: Microsoft Outlook is enhancing security by making feedback policy checks more restrictive across all user accounts. Eligibility for feedback submission will be based on the most restrictive policy value among a user's accounts. This change will start rolling out in late September 2024 for Targeted Release and in late October 2024 for General Availability. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Defender XDR services: Removing Defender for Identity recommendation from Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft is updating Microsoft Secure Score by removing a Defender for Identity recommendation to better reflect security posture. The removal will not affect Secure Scores and requires no admin action. Notification to users and documentation updates are suggested. Rollout will occur mid to late September 2024.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Select camera and audio devices in pre-join and during meetings on iPad
Summary: Microsoft Teams on iPad now lets users select external audio and video devices from the pre-join screen and during meetings. This feature, enabled by default since September 2025, improves meeting flexibility without needing iPad settings changes. No admin action is required.

Title: Legacy TLS cipher suites will be deprecated in M365 services on October 20, 2025
Summary: Microsoft 365 will deprecate legacy TLS cipher suites lacking forward secrecy on October 20, 2025, supporting only specified TLS 1.3 and 1.2 cipher suites. Organizations must update systems and configurations to maintain connectivity and security compliance.

Title: Teams app versions 1.12 and earlier will no longer appear in Microsoft 365 admin center
Summary: Teams apps version 1.12 and earlier will be removed from the Microsoft 365 admin center's Integrated apps view starting late August 2025, completing by late September. These apps remain fully manageable in the Teams admin center, with no impact on user experience or compliance. No action is required.

Title: Outlook | Save an Event as a Draft
Summary: Starting July 2025, Outlook will let users save meetings with attendees as drafts, marked with “[Draft]” on the calendar. This feature, available by default on mobile, allows more flexible event planning. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Email notifications for service health issues available in multiple languages
Summary: Starting mid-July to early October 2025, Microsoft 365 service health email notifications for issues requiring action will be sent in admins' preferred languages (72 supported). This improves accessibility and is enabled by default, with translation for Microsoft-side incidents planned for a future release.

Title: Microsoft Teams: FAQs about town halls and Teams Live Events
Summary: The message provides FAQs about Microsoft Teams town halls and Teams Live Events, clarifying that Teams Live Events will not retire this year and no new retirement date is set. It details the maintenance of TLE while addressing feature gaps with town halls and the transition of TLE scheduling to Teams 2.1 by December 2024. Major updates will focus on town halls, and the Microsoft 365 Roadmap will reflect feature releases.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Voting and archiving questions in Teams Q&A
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating to allow voting on questions and archiving in Q&A for meeting organizers and co-organizers. Rollout begins late September 2024, completing by mid-October. Organizers can prioritize questions by upvotes and archive irrelevant ones. Preparation involves notifying organizers and referring to updated documentation.

Title: Power Automate – Use natural language and AI to create a flow in Teams
Summary: We are announcing the use of natural language and AI to create a flow in Teams feature. This feature allows you to use natural language to create a flow from scratch when the Workflows app in Teams does not have a template that supports your specific scenario. This feature will begin rolling out on September 30, 2024, and will be fully available by the end of October 2024. How does this affect me? When enabled, this feature will allow you to type in a prompt to describe what you want the flow to...

Title: Changes coming to the Copilot experience for Windows
Summary: The Copilot experience for Windows is updating to include enterprise data protection at no extra cost and will be accessed via the Microsoft 365 app. Changes begin with a preview release on September 24, 2024, and a security update on October 8, 2024, for Windows 11, followed by Windows 10. Organizations should prepare by adjusting their settings and pinning the Microsoft 365 app if needed.

Title: ActiveX will be disabled by default in Microsoft Office 2024
Summary: ActiveX will be disabled by default in Office 2024, affecting Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio. This change occurs in October 2024 for Office 2024 and begins in April 2025 for Microsoft 365 apps. Users can re-enable ActiveX by adjusting Trust Center Settings, the registry, or group policy settings.

Title: New: Custom site inclusion for SharePoint Site Lifecycle Management (SLM) policies
Summary: SharePoint Site Lifecycle Management now supports custom site inclusion via CSV upload of up to 10,000 URLs for precise policy enforcement. The inactivity period setting moved to the Configuration page. This feature is available worldwide by default, requiring no extra setup. Admins should prepare CSV files and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Paid public preview of Inline Protection of Sensitive Text transmitted in Edge for Business
Summary: Starting October 31, 2025, Microsoft Purview's inline protection of sensitive text in Edge for Business will require a paid public preview with pay-as-you-go billing via the In Transit Protection meter. Organizations must link an Azure subscription or lose this protection for unmanaged cloud apps.

Title: Expanding Microsoft 365 Copilot Search admin experience to AI admin role
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Search admin experience is expanding to AI Admin and Global Reader roles, allowing designated admins to manage or view Copilot Search settings. This rollout begins late September 2025, is enabled by default for eligible tenants, and access is controlled via Microsoft Entra ID.

Title: Library experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce a new Library experience by mid-October 2025, consolidating Copilot-generated images and Pages into one section. The Pages menu will be removed, with no admin action needed. Library is enabled by default for users with Copilot chat enabled.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Extending Copilot Chat to Microsoft 365 apps
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is being rolled out across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook on multiple platforms starting mid-2025. It respects user state, requires no admin action unless pinning is disabled, and does not change data processing or AI capabilities.

Title: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery cmdlet connectivity change
Summary: Starting September 26, 2025, eDiscovery cmdlets require Exchange Online PowerShell v3.9.0+ with the -EnableSearchOnlySession flag in Connect-IPPSSession. This change affects specific cmdlets but not the Purview portal and remains incompatible with Certificate-Based Authentication. Update scripts accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Modernized Private Content Mode
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage updates Private Content Mode, allowing Verified and Engage admins to view and moderate conversations in private communities without membership by toggling this feature in the Engage Admin Center. It supports moderation actions, persists until disabled, and includes audit logging and compliance considerations. Rollout begins mid-September 2025.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Interactive agents for meetings and calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce interactive agents in meetings and calls, allowing private and group interactions with session-supported agents built on Microsoft Copilot. The rollout is delayed, requires Microsoft 365 licenses, and will be automatic with no admin action needed. Admins can pre-pin agents for easier access.

Title: Power Apps - Process maps as a part of your plan
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use process maps as a part of your plan in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on October 17, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature update allows the Plan designer in Power Apps to generate a representation of your business process, in addition to the requirements, data, solution architecture, and process diagram. The process map captures the activities, events, and decisions for the process, and can be edited with the usage of the proc...

Title: Outlook Web Access and new Outlook: ‘Mobile devices’ settings page to be removed
Summary: Starting October 6, 2025, the ‘Mobile devices’ settings page in Outlook Web Access and new Outlook will be removed by November 6, 2025. Users must manage devices via Microsoft Intune, the My Account portal, or native iOS/Android tools. No admin action is required; inform users and update documentation.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting September 16th, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this l...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced query suggestions when searching for people
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon introduce enhanced people query suggestions for more efficient searches, rolling out in October 2024. This feature, which is on by default, will help users recall information related to frequently interacted individuals. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Change to shared folder experience
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive is updating its shared folder experience. Users will now access shared folders via the People view in their own OneDrive, organized by the sharer, starting mid-September 2024. This change requires no admin action but users should be informed. More details are on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 395378.

Title: Transition to Teams Town Hall from Teams Live Events
Summary: Teams Town Hall now matches Teams Live Events in features, offering enhanced controls and attendee experiences. Users are encouraged to transition to Town Hall, as it supports large-scale virtual events and will replace Live Events in the future. Enable IT policies to prepare for this change.

Title: Education Customers: Enhance your LMS with the power of Microsoft 365
Summary: Microsoft 365 LTI, a unified integration for LMS platforms like Canvas and Moodle, will be generally available worldwide on September 15, 2025. It streamlines access to Microsoft 365 tools within LMS, replaces retired Teams LTI tools, and requires admin deployment and communication for a smooth transition.

Title: Reminder - Support for Office 2016, Office 2019, and additional apps will end on October 14, 2025
Summary: Support for Office 2016, Office 2019, Visio 2016/2019, Project 2016/2019, and related apps ends October 14, 2025. After this, no updates or support will be provided, risking security, compliance, and performance. Upgrading to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Configure your Citrix VDI environments for SlimCore-based optimization
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports SlimCore-based optimization for Citrix VDI, offering better performance and new features. Admins must update Citrix Studio policies to whitelist virtual channels (MSTEAMS, MSTEAM1, MSTEAM2) and deploy the Citrix Plugin. WebRTC optimization will be deprecated in the future.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: New recommendations for Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity will add new Secure Score improvement actions by late 2025 to better identify identity risks. These include identifying privileged service accounts, removing stale AD accounts, and disabling Entra Seamless SSO. No admin action is needed, but review configurations and notify security teams.

Title: Manager insights now in Viva Insights web app, with new team view for Copilot Dashboard
Summary: The Viva Insights web app will become the central hub for manager insights, featuring a team-scoped Copilot Dashboard, additional tailored reports, delegation support, and analyst-published reports. This replaces manager capabilities in the Viva Insights Teams app, rolling out worldwide from mid-September to early October 2025.

Title: Microsoft Viva: AI-generated audio briefings for SharePoint news in Viva Connections
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections will offer AI-generated audio briefings for SharePoint news, playable with controls like play, pause, and speed adjustment. Available from August 28, 2025, this feature requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and supports hands-free news consumption on Teams, Surface, and web.

Title: Microsoft Entra | Streamlined Same-Device Number Matching and First Run Experience (FRX) in Microsoft Authenticator
Summary: Microsoft Authenticator will streamline same-device sign-ins by removing number entry, requiring only a Yes/No confirmation, and improve onboarding by prioritizing Microsoft Entra accounts and highlighting QR code scanning. Rollout begins late September to mid-October 2025, with no admin action needed.

Title: Manage agent permissions directly in Microsoft Admin Center (MAC)
Summary: Microsoft Admin Center will enable admins to manage agent permissions directly with a unified view of consents and risk levels. Global Admin consent allows AI Admin Role to deploy agents. Rollout begins late September 2025, improving efficiency, transparency, and introducing automation for low-risk agents.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Updated Page Analytics
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint Page Analytics for News posts will be upgraded starting late September 2025, adding long-term data (365 days), distribution channel breakdowns, new metrics (Reactions, Promotions), data export, audience calculation, chart image copying, and a modern design. No admin action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Voice isolation will be available for macOS desktops
Summary: Voice isolation feature for Microsoft Teams will be available on macOS desktops starting early October 2024, enhancing call clarity by suppressing background noise. Admins must enable specific policies for use. Rollout will be automatic, and users can enroll their voice profiles now in preparation.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Changes to Viva Insights metrics and default report pages for leaders
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights is updating its metrics and report pages with a new API for better performance, affecting design and content. Changes include new rounding rules for time-based metrics and a shift to a four-week average for metric reports. Rollout starts late September 2024, with completion by late October 2024. Organizations should review the impact and update documentation.

Title: Microsoft Copilot to update to enterprise data protection
Summary: Microsoft Copilot will update next month to include enterprise data protection for users with an Entra account. It will feature a new ad-free interface, with no changes for other Copilot experiences in Microsoft 365 apps. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, with no action needed for automatic redirection.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Public preview of policy deletion enhancement
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon have a policy deletion enhancement allowing admins to delete all associated alerts and users in scope when deleting a policy. No action is needed to enable this feature. The update will roll out late July 2024 to late August 2024 for public preview and mid-September 2024 to late September 2024 for general availability worldwide. The solution can be accessed in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Learn more about creating and managing insid...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Videos in town halls will display without cropping
Summary: Microsoft Teams updates will ensure videos in town halls are displayed in a "fit to frame" view without cropping, centered for attendees. Rollout begins mid-August 2024, with completion by late September 2024. This feature is default and requires no admin action, but users should be informed.

Title: User settings usability improved with a new "Account" settings category in Outlook on the web
Summary: Outlook on the web has a new "Account" settings category, improving user settings usability. The rollout begins late September 2024 for Targeted Release and late October for General Availability, with completion expected by late November 2024. Organizations may need to update training and documentation.

Title: Service health and Message center: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps consolidation
Summary: Microsoft is consolidating 'Microsoft 365 Defender for Cloud Apps' communications under 'Microsoft Defender XDR' in Service health and Message center by September 2024. Organizations should update training and documentation, and configure email preferences to include 'Microsoft Defender XDR'.

Title: Take action: Enable multifactor authentication for your tenant before October 15, 2024
Summary: Enable multifactor authentication (MFA) for your tenant by October 15, 2024, to access Microsoft Azure portal, Microsoft Entra admin center, and Microsoft Intune admin center. Postponement is possible, but without MFA, admin sign-in will prompt MFA registration.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Adding search to settings in the Outlook for Android app
Summary: Outlook for Android is adding a search feature within Settings, with rollout starting early August 2024 and completion by late September 2024. This feature is available by default and requires no admin action, but users may be informed of the update.

Title: eSignature: Free text field support in Word
Summary: Microsoft Word's eSignature feature will support free text fields starting October 2025, allowing users to collect custom signer information. This feature is on by default for tenants with eSignature enabled, requires no admin changes, and has no impact unless eSignature is active.

Title: New filtering capability for SharePoint Embedded containers using sensitivity labels
Summary: SharePoint Embedded will introduce a new default filtering feature by sensitivity labels for containers, rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2025. Admins can better organize containers without impacting user workflows. Organizations should review label taxonomies and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Membership management of SharePoint Embedded containers through PowerShell
Summary: New PowerShell cmdlets for managing SharePoint Embedded container membership will roll out worldwide from late September to October 2025. Administrators can add, update, or remove users via PowerShell without using the SharePoint Admin Center. Update your PowerShell module and inform your team to prepare.

Title: Update Principal owner of a SharePoint Embedded user-owned container through SPAC and PowerShell
Summary: SharePoint Embedded will allow admins to update the principal owner of user-owned containers via the SharePoint Admin Center or PowerShell starting late September 2025. This helps manage ownership during user or team changes, requires no opt-in on SPAC, and needs PowerShell updates. No compliance issues noted.

Title: New SharePoint assessment and dashboard to streamline site governance and Copilot readiness
Summary: The updated SharePoint Content Management Assessment (CMA) launches October 2025, offering admins a unified dashboard to evaluate site health, permissions, and lifecycle readiness. It automates governance tasks, enhances Copilot preparation, requires specific licenses, and stores data per SharePoint residency rules.

Title: Outlook Mobile : Copilot Chat overlay coming to iOS and Android
Summary: Outlook Mobile will roll out a context-aware Copilot Chat overlay for iOS and Android from late September 2025 to early March 2026. It enables users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses to interact with AI while using email, calendar, and contacts, providing personalized, on-screen contextual assistance. No action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Purview | DLP - Enable Diagnostics for Compliance Admin, Security Admin, and Org Management roles
Summary: Microsoft Purview Diagnostics access is expanding from Global Administrators to include Compliance, Security, and Organization Management roles. Rollout starts October 2025 (preview) and February 2026 (general availability). This enhances diagnostic capabilities without needing Global Admin rights and is enabled by default. No preparation needed.

Title: Microsoft Whiteboard: Azure to OneDrive migration progress update
Summary: Microsoft Whiteboard storage is migrating from Azure to OneDrive, enhancing security and compliance. Migration began in February 2024, completed tenant-wide by August 2025, with Azure storage deprecated by February 2026. Users must complete migration by then to retain access; admins can monitor progress via PowerShell.

Title: Data Loss Prevention for endpoints - support for two new predicates
Summary: The update introduces two new predicates for Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention on endpoints, enhancing policy conditions for detecting specific document properties and names. The rollout timeline has been updated, now beginning in late April and completing by late September 2024. Users should prepare by visiting the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Adding Search to settings in the Outlook for iOS app
Summary: Outlook for iOS will soon enable users to search within Settings, with rollout starting early August 2024 and completion by late September 2024. This feature will be on by default and requires no admin action prior to rollout. Organizations should inform users and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Contact deduplication
Summary: Outlook is updating to automatically hide duplicate contacts, with rollouts starting late August 2024 and ending mid-October 2024. This affects Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows, while other versions will show all contacts. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed.

Title: SharePoint Online: Enhancements to Text web part
Summary: New enhancements to SharePoint Online's Text web part include custom font colors, paragraph styles, spacing options, line spacing, quote styles, and table column/row highlighting. Rollout begins early September 2024, with no admin action required. Users should be informed of these updates.

Title: Service health and Message center: Azure Information Protection consolidation
Summary: Azure Information Protection communications will be consolidated under Microsoft Purview in Service Health and Message Center by September 2024. Organizations should update training and documentation, and configure email preferences to include Microsoft Purview for related notifications.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: New prompt to confirm deletion of shared items and updated prompt for local mass item deletions
Summary: OneDrive is introducing a new confirmation prompt for deleting shared items and an updated prompt for mass local deletions, with rollout starting mid-September 2024. Admins can set policies to manage these prompts, which are enabled by default. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Defender XDR: Simplified DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) setup for enhanced domain protection
Summary: Microsoft Defender XDR is introducing a simplified DKIM setup for better domain protection, with a rollout from mid-June to late September 2024. The update includes easier DKIM activation during domain registration and a redesigned DKIM page for improved information visibility. No action is required for preparation.

Title: Microsoft Purview | New eDiscovery Hold reports
Summary: To ensure the best customer experience we have decided not to proceed with the rollout of this change at this time. We will communicate via Message center when we are ready to proceed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and thank you for your patience.

Title: Conditional access policy enforcement for Office Scripts
Summary: Updated September 12, 2023: We have updated the content below with additional information. SharePoint and OneDrive conditional access policies for unmanaged devices will start to be enforced for Office Scripts files. This means that users on unmanaged devices will have their access to Office Scripts functionality restricted based on policies you have enabled in your tenant. When this will happen: We will be turning enforcement on in late September and start rolling out an updated error message f...

Title: Stream live events replacement service
Summary: Updated September 12, 2023: To ensure organizations have time to make necessary changes we are updating the timing of this change from September 15, 2023, to January 31, 2024. This is an important message for customers who use Stream (Classic) or Yammer to create and host Stream live events. Microsoft will retire the Stream live events service on January 31, 2024. Microsoft Teams live events, with encoder support, will become your new platform to host and run live events. For several years Micro...

Title: Hard delete action now removes calendar entries from malicious meeting invite emails
Summary: Hard Delete now removes calendar entries from malicious meeting invites, closing a security gap by fully eradicating threats from inboxes and calendars. This update rolls out worldwide in September 2025 and GCC regions in October 2025, is on by default, and requires no user action.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity | Detections improvements to reduce noise and improve accuracy
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity will update several detections from late September to mid-October 2025 to reduce false positives and improve accuracy, lowering alert noise without requiring configuration changes. Admins should review alert volumes post-rollout and inform their security teams accordingly.

Title: Updated Microsoft Defender Antivirus AVSignatureDue policy limit
Summary: Starting September 2025, Microsoft Defender Antivirus will require the AVSignatureDue policy minimum to be 2 days (up from 1 day) to prevent false alerts. Organizations with settings below 2 days should update their configuration before rollout completes in mid-October 2025.

Title: Quarantine experience update in Microsoft Defender and Exchange Online: Restore temporarily deleted items
Summary: The update to Microsoft Defender and Exchange Online quarantine will allow users to view and restore temporarily deleted messages via a new filter and restore option. The release has been delayed, no configuration is needed, and permanently deleted messages remain inaccessible. Users should be informed and documentation updated.

Title: Important Update: Teams Meeting Join URL Validation
Summary: Microsoft Teams will validate meeting join URLs starting September 30, 2025, to prevent altered or rewritten links from blocking access, affecting users of the old Teams calendar app. The new calendar app redirects safely without blocking. No admin action is needed for Safe Links users; third-party URL rewriting must exclude Teams links.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Introducing custom fonts
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint introduces custom fonts in the new Brand center, enabling organizations to express their brand creatively on SharePoint and Viva Connections sites. Rollout began in April 2024, with general availability expected by mid-October 2024. This feature supports various web parts and is available by default.

Title: Updating conversation actions on Microsoft Outlook for iOS
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for iOS is updating conversation actions, moving them to a bottom bar and allowing customization. Rollout starts in early July 2024 and ends in late September 2024. Organizations should inform users and update documentation. iOS non-supporting organizations can ignore this update. Roadmap ID: 398983.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New meeting option to control permissions for admitting participants from lobby
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new meeting option allowing organizers to control who can admit participants from the lobby, with a rollout timeline updated for September to October 2024. This update aims to address current issues with meeting management permissions. No specific action is needed to prepare for this update.

Title: New Outlook for Desktop and web: Users can scope search suggestions to specific entities
Summary: Outlook for Desktop and web will introduce search filters such as All, Mail, Files, Teams, and People. The rollout begins mid-August 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-September 2024 for General Availability, completing by mid-October 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Moving file and conversation settings to the Viva Engage admin center
Summary: Microsoft Viva is transferring file and conversation settings from the Yammer admin center to the Viva Engage admin center. Rollout starts late October 2024, with completion by mid-November 2024, enhancing performance without disrupting current functions. Admins will manage file upload permissions, GIFs, URL metadata, message translation, and private messages. No action is needed before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Sidebar visibility changes
Summary: The Microsoft Edge sidebar will be off by default for non-active and new users, but can be re-enabled in settings. Active users will see no change. Administrators can use the HubsSidebarEnabled policy to manage this. The update rolls out in late September to early October 2024.

Title: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame Video Feed on Teams mobile
Summary: Cloud IntelliFrame, enhancing visibility in Teams meetings, is now available on Teams mobile for iOS and Android, following its desktop availability. It will roll out worldwide mid to late November 2024, requiring no action for preparation but suggesting user notification. Roadmap ID: 415250.

Title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Enhancements to the device onboarding page
Summary: The message details enhancements to the Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) device onboarding page, including the ability to search by IP address, a new 'Valid user' filter, exclusion of non-DLP supported devices like Android, and new properties in the export report. Rollout begins mid-July 2024 for Public Preview and early August 2024 for General Availability. No admin action required. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 393934.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Compliance portal: Enhanced policy conditions for Communication Compliance
Summary: The message details the upcoming enhancements to policy conditions in Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance, including precise detection, custom logic, and testing capabilities. Rollout begins late April 2024 for Public Preview and late May 2024 for General Availability, with completion expected by mid-September 2024. Users are advised to prepare and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview DLP and Edge for Business: Automated blocking of unmanaged GenAI apps in unprotected browsers
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now automates blocking of unmanaged GenAI apps in Edge for Business, removing the need for separate Edge configuration policies. Rollout begins mid-October 2025. Admins should update or disable old policies to use this automation, enhancing data protection and policy enforcement.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Remote log collection in Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enable admins to remotely collect diagnostic logs from users' Windows and Mac clients via the Teams Admin Center starting mid-July 2025. This seamless process aids troubleshooting without user disruption. Admin roles must be authorized, and compliance with data handling and privacy considerations is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: town hall organizers, co-organizers, presenters can join the event to preview as attendee
Summary: Microsoft Teams town hall organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can soon preview events as attendees from different platforms. This feature rolls out from late May to October 2025, requires no admin action, and disables select features in attendee view without affecting the overall event experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Manage voice and face recognition for rooms (MTR-W/MTRA) via device settings
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms (Windows 4.19+, Android 3.6+) will have new admin UI for managing voice and face recognition, replacing PowerShell configuration. Voice recognition defaults to off. Rollout starts mid-October 2025. Enrollment requires user consent and is completed on-device. Surface Hub and Teams displays are not supported.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service – Use Assign option for cases to update capacity, presence
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the Assign option on the case form to work with unified routing to update presence and capacity of service representatives in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on October 10, 2025. How does this affect me? Title: Microsoft Teams: Users can add multiple emoji reactions to each chat or channel message
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to add multiple emoji reactions, including custom ones, to a single message starting mid-2025. Up to 20 reactions per user per message are supported, with reactions shown by popularity. The feature rolls out automatically with no admin action needed.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys - Automate scalable journey creation with the journey API
Summary: We are announcing the ability to automate journey creation by using templates, existing segments, and messages in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. This feature will reach general availability on October 10, 2025. How does this affect me? The real-time journeys API gives you the flexibility to automate the journey creation process. You can systematically generate a series of journeys and workflows by using existing segments and messages. Examples:Create multiple versions of a journey in...

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Message Warnings for Messages with Malicious URLs in Teams
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce message warnings in Microsoft Teams for messages containing URLs flagged as Spam, Phish, or Malware. Starting with a public preview in September 2025 and general availability in November 2025, warnings will appear for both recipients and senders, enabled by default and manageable via Teams Admin Center.

Title: Contact Unification across Outlook and Teams
Summary: Starting December 2024, Teams and Outlook will have a unified contact experience for Entra ID accounts, syncing contacts and edits across both apps. Migration began in January 2024, with completion expected by September 2025. Organizations should update documentation and advise users to back up contacts if needed.

Title: Microsoft Viva | New Microsoft Graph APIs for Viva Engage role management
Summary: Microsoft is releasing new Viva Engage role management APIs in Microsoft Graph (beta) for IT admins to automate and manage roles like Corporate Communicator and Network Administrator. Rollout begins late September 2025, enhancing programmatic control without changing the current UI. No immediate action required.

Title: Stream video recordings in Outlook
Summary: Microsoft 365 is introducing the ability to record and insert Stream video recordings in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows. The rollout timeline has been updated to begin in late October 2024 and complete by late November 2024. A new policy will control this feature.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Education grid view refresh
Summary: Microsoft Teams for Education has updated the grid view, allowing direct access to assignments and classwork. This feature is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 412934 and will be globally available from mid to late October 2024. No admin action is required for this automatic update.

Title: The new Microsoft Planner for the web
Summary: The new Microsoft Planner for the web integrates features from Microsoft To Do, Planner, Project, and Copilot for a comprehensive task management solution. Rollout begins early October 2024, with full availability by late January 2025. Some features will be unavailable at launch but will return by early 2025. A Microsoft 365 license is required.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for all channels
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting September 10th, 2024 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delive...

Title: We're making some changes to Office Scripts admin settings and controls
Summary: Starting October 27, 2025, Office Scripts settings for Excel will move from the Microsoft 365 admin center to the Microsoft 365 Cloud Policy service. Admins must manage three specific settings there; if unchanged, they default to enabled. No compliance issues identified; review and reconfigure as needed.

Title: Reminder: End of Support for Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel Preview on September 9, 2025
Summary: The Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel Preview for Microsoft 365 Apps ends support on September 9, 2025, with the August 2025 update as the last. Admins must transition devices to Monthly Enterprise or Current Channel, as updates will cease and no automatic changes will occur.

Title: Additional Domain Whitelisting Required for Microsoft Whiteboard
Summary: Organizations using explicit domain whitelisting for Microsoft Whiteboard must immediately add whiteboard.svc.cloud.microsoft to their firewall rules to avoid service disruptions, as Whiteboard now operates under the cloud.microsoft domain. No action is needed if *.cloud.microsoft is already whitelisted.

Title: Coming soon: Multitasking improvements in Microsoft Fabric
Summary: Microsoft Fabric will introduce multitasking improvements in early September 2025, including horizontal tabs, multiple open workspaces with color coding, an Object Explorer, and a raised open item limit. These changes enhance workflow efficiency and apply only to Fabric, not Power BI. No action is needed now.

Title: Action Required: Update firewall configurations to include new network endpoints
Summary: By December 2, 2025, update firewall allowlists to include Azure Front Door IP addresses or the service tag "AzureFrontDoor.MicrosoftSecurity" for Microsoft Intune and Basic Mobility and Security for Microsoft 365. Do not remove existing endpoints; add new ranges from the provided Azure IP range files.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention:  New inline protection controls for AI apps in Microsoft Edge for Business
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will add inline protection in Microsoft Edge for Business to prevent sensitive data leaks when interacting with AI apps like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and DeepSeek. Rolling out May to November 2025, admins can configure policies but no action is needed before rollout.

Title: Viva Engage: Public discussions now available in Workplace Search and Copilot Search
Summary: Viva Engage public discussion posts will appear in Microsoft 365 search results on Office.com, SharePoint.com, and Copilot Search starting late November 2025. No admin action is needed, content visibility respects user access, and a Copilot license is required for Copilot Search. Inform users accordingly.

Title: Outlook for iOS: Minimum system requirements updated to iOS 18 and above
Summary: Outlook for iOS will require iOS 18 or later starting late September 2025, dropping support for iOS 17 and earlier. Users on unsupported versions may face syncing issues. iPadOS 17 and watchOS 10 support will also end. Organizations should notify users to upgrade devices accordingly.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys - Simplify forms by filtering choices based on previous answers
Summary: We are announcing the ability to simplify forms by filtering choices based on previous answers in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. This feature will reach general availability on September 1, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to set up a relationship between two lookup fields in the Customer Insights - Journeys form editor. Title: Microsoft Edge: AI-powered History search now available
Summary: Microsoft Edge will roll out an AI-powered History search feature from late September to late October 2025, enabling semantic search of browsing history using an on-device model. It is Windows desktop only, controlled by a toggle and admin policy, with data processed locally and not sent to Microsoft.

Title: New Fabric Tenant Setting: “Set alert” Button Visibility for Power BI Users
Summary: A new Microsoft Fabric tenant setting will make the “Set alert” button visible to all Power BI web users, enabling them to create Fabric Activator alerts if permitted. Rollout starts September 14, 2025, with default enablement by October 13, 2025. Admins can manage this setting beforehand.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New records in Streaming API and Sentinel EmailEvents table
Summary: Starting early October 2025, Microsoft Defender for Office 365's Streaming API and Sentinel EmailEvents table will store both current and historical email verdicts and locations, showing multiple records per email. Admins should update queries and dashboards accordingly, using KQL's arg_max to retrieve the latest records.

Title: Manage interest is being replaced by Manage People Skills by December 31, 2025
Summary: The Manage interest feature in Viva Learning will be retired and replaced by Manage People Skills by December 31, 2025. Existing interest data will be deleted, and admins should enable and prepare for Manage People Skills before the transition. No compliance issues are identified.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Export download with pre-authorized link support
Summary: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium) will support pre-authorized and non pre-authorized export download links starting mid-September 2025, enhancing download reliability and control. Pre-authorized links enable faster downloads; non pre-authorized require re-authentication for restricted environments. Admins should review policies and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Additional document processing rule actions for Microsoft SharePoint libraries
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint libraries will gain new document processing rule actions—copy file to, move file to, and set content type—rolling out from late August to mid-September 2025. These enable automated file management based on metadata for users with edit permissions. Users should prepare by informing teams and reviewing existing rules.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to prevent duplicate emails to shared email addresses in Dynamics 365 Commerce. This feature will reach general availability on September 24, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature enables email deduplication, ensuring that even if your data has multiple contacts with the same email address, your message will only be sent once to your customers. Title: Power Apps - Create offline profiles in the maker studio for Canvas apps
Summary: We are announcing the ability to create offline profiles in the maker studio for Canvas apps in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature allows makers to create offline profiles for canvas mobile apps without needing to switch between Power Apps Studio and the Power Platform admin center. Title: Power Apps - Manage your source code for canvas apps
Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage your source code for canvas apps in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature update allows you to view the underlying code to understand app functionality and manage source control. With this feature, you no longer need to use Power Platform CLI to convert a '.msapp' file into source code files. Title: Microsoft 365 admin center will support continuous access evaluation (CAE)
Summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center will implement continuous access evaluation (CAE) in September 2024, enabling near real-time session termination or reauthentication and enforcing policy changes without waiting for token expiration. This rollout requires no admin action and offers benefits like mitigating insider threats, preventing unauthorized access, and removing user access swiftly.

Title: Exchange Properties Limits addition
Summary: Thank you for your feedback. We are going to provide a new Message center post shortly with more details to help you understand and act on this change. We apologize for the inconvenience, and you can safely disregard this message.

Title: Simultaneous role-specific Teams Town hall and Webinar views in Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: Teams Rooms on Windows (Teams Rooms Pro) will support simultaneous presenter and attendee views for Town halls and Webinars in the same room, with attendees seeing a clean attendee view and presenters having full control via the room console. Rollout begins October 2025.

Title: Dynamic video tile resizing based on occupancy count from Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Teams Rooms on Android will dynamically resize video tiles in Gallery view based on room occupancy, matching the Windows experience. One person results in equal tile size to remote participants; multiple people enlarge the tile. The feature, using AI-based people count, is enabled by default from October 2025, with admin controls to disable it.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Updated sender email address for channel guest invitations
Summary: Microsoft Teams will update the sender email for channel guest invitations from noreply@microsoft.com to no-reply@teams.mail.microsoft between September and October 2025. This automatic change improves email delivery, requires no user action, and may need updates to email filtering or allow lists.

Title: Retirement of Outlook Lite app
Summary: The Outlook Lite app will retire starting October 6, 2025, blocking new installs and requiring users to switch to the Outlook Mobile app, which offers enhanced features, security, and Microsoft 365 integration. No manual data migration is needed, and admins have control via Entra ID.

Title: Microsoft Purview |eDiscovery - Graph APIs for Standard eDiscovery
Summary: Microsoft is introducing Microsoft Graph APIs for Standard eDiscovery licenses, enabling automation of case, search, hold, data source, and export management. Public preview starts September 2025; general availability in November 2025. APIs require Purview pay-as-you-go billing, with 50GB free monthly and $10/GB thereafter.

Title: Outlook for Web adds “Get diagnostics” option under Help tab
Summary: Outlook for Web will add a "Get diagnostics" option under the Help tab by late October 2025, enabling users to send diagnostic data to Microsoft Support. The feature is enabled by default, manageable by admins via cloud policy, and aims to streamline support and troubleshooting.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention: User based alert aggregation
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces opt-in User-Based Alert Aggregation, consolidating alerts by user within a set time window to improve security triage. Rolling out from September to November 2025, admins can enable it in the compliance portal to group rule match events per user, enhancing investigation efficiency.

Title: Viva Engage – New admin toggle to manage Move conversation feature
Summary: Viva Engage will add an admin toggle (rolling out October 2025) to control the Move conversation feature. By default, all users can move conversations; turning the toggle off restricts this to specific roles like admins and corporate communicators. No action is needed unless restriction is desired.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention - UX improvements to the DLP Alerts in Purview Portal
Summary: Microsoft Purview Portal's DLP Alerts page now offers a unified, faster view with event details accessible in one click, four new columns for enhanced context, and improved performance. Rollout starts late September 2025, requiring no admin preparation and supporting up to 50 events per alert on the main page.

Title: Azure Information Protection: Enable multifactor authentication for your Azure tenant by October 1, 2025
Summary: Microsoft will enforce multifactor authentication (MFA) for all Azure resource management actions starting October 1, 2025, with a postponement option until July 2026. Users must enable MFA, update Azure CLI/PowerShell, and can apply Azure Policy to assess impact. Gallatin customers are advised to implement MFA without enforcement.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Android Open Source Project (AOSP) - Device Management auto updates
Summary: Microsoft Teams Android devices will auto-update firmware to migrate to Intune AOSP device management from mid-May to early October 2025. Updates cannot be paused and follow phased rollout. Organizations must complete prerequisites to avoid device sign-outs during migration. No further delays will be allowed.

Title: Update: Microsoft Purview compliance portal | Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigation integration (preview)
Summary: Microsoft Purview will integrate Insider Risk Management (IRM) with Data Security Investigation (DSI) in preview by mid-July 2025, enabling admins to launch AI-powered, in-depth data investigations directly from IRM cases. General availability is expected by late November 2025, streamlining risk assessment and response.

Title: Outlook: Report junk + block or unsubscribe in one same action
Summary: Starting mid-July to late September 2025, Outlook will let users report junk emails and unsubscribe in one step if supported by the sender, reducing blocked senders and simplifying inbox management. The feature is on by default, with no admin action needed.

Title: (Update) Microsoft Outlook: Open attachments in desktop apps from the new Outlook for Windows
Summary: The new Outlook for Windows update allows users to open attachments directly in desktop apps by double-clicking. Rollout begins early September 2024, completing early October 2024. The feature streamlines opening attachments, and no admin action is required for the update. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 401123 is associated with this update.

Title: Purview compliance portal: Advanced trainable classifiers to detect workplace safety scenarios
Summary: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance introduces advanced classifiers for detecting workplace safety violations in over 100 languages, available worldwide from late August to early September 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: (Reminder) Microsoft 365 admin center: Admins can no longer receive user passwords in email as of August 30, 2024
Summary: Starting August 30, 2024, Microsoft 365 admin center will retire the 'Send password in email' feature. Admins should use the 'Print' option for secure sharing of user account details. This update is a reminder from an earlier announcement and no action is required from admins.

Summary: We are announcing a refresh to the header and navigation of model-driven apps in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on October 1, 2025. How does this affect me? Title: Action Required: Update firewall configurations to include new Intune network endpoints
Summary: By December 2, 2025, update firewall rules to include new Azure Front Door IP ranges (tagged “AzureFrontDoor.MicrosoftSecurity”) for Microsoft Intune. This ensures uninterrupted device and app management connectivity. Keep existing Intune endpoints and notify your IT/network team to implement these changes.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Sender email address update for Microsoft Teams Data Loss Prevention Generate Incident Report emails
Summary: Microsoft is updating the sender email address for Teams Data Loss Prevention Generate Incident Report emails. Starting June 2, 2025, emails will come from either the old or new address, switching fully to no-reply@teams.mail.microsoft.com by June 20, 2025. Organizations should adjust related systems accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Action Required – Update Conditional Access Policies for Azure DevOps Sign-ins
Summary: Microsoft Entra will stop applying Conditional Access policies via Azure Resource Manager for Azure DevOps sign-ins starting September 2, 2025, fully enforced by September 18. Organizations must update policies to explicitly include Azure DevOps (App ID: 499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798) to maintain secure access.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Offline mode process rename
Summary: Microsoft is renaming the offline mode background process in OneDrive and Lists, changing process and task names and updating the icon. The rollout starts late August 2025, completing by late September. Organizations should update custom tools and inform IT teams to avoid issues; no compliance concerns noted.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal | Audit: New Cloud Policy service audit logs for policy changes
Summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal will soon integrate with the Cloud Policy service to log policy changes, with the rollout now rescheduled from mid-June to early December 2024, and completion by late December 2024. This update is linked to Roadmap ID 394280.

Title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: New Pulse templates, Conversations in Pulse reports, eDiscovery and Microsoft 365 Audit support
Summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse will introduce new templates, enable conversations in Pulse reports, and offer eDiscovery and Microsoft 365 Audit support. These updates are available in Public Preview and will roll out in early September 2024. Features will be enabled by default with no admin action needed.

Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Entra ID FIDO2 provisioning APIs
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID introduces FIDO2 provisioning APIs in public preview, enabling pre-provisioning of security keys for users, simplifying onboarding, and ensuring phishing-resistant authentication. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, with completion by late September. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: View attachments to invitations created in Microsoft Outlook
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow viewing attachments in Teams calendar for invitations created in Outlook. Rollout begins in July 2024, with full availability by mid-September 2024. No admin action needed, but informing users is advised. This update is associated with Roadmap ID 91163.

Title: Admin policy to migrate users from classic Outlook to new Outlook for Windows
Summary: Microsoft has updated the Admin-Controlled Migration to New Outlook policy, allowing IT admins to migrate users from classic to new Outlook for Windows. The migration involves a three-step process to encourage users to switch, with prerequisites and settings detailed for policy implementation. Rollout begins early August 2024, completing by mid-September 2024.

Title: Updates to natural language-based search in Microsoft 365
Summary: Microsoft 365 is updating its search feature, phasing out some Natural Language-Based Search support by late September 2024. Users will need to rely more on keyword-based searches across various Microsoft 365 products. Tools like search filters will help users transition to this new method.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Set up classic Outlook accounts and settings in new Outlook for Windows automatically
Summary: Starting October 2025, Outlook will automatically set up classic Outlook Exchange Online accounts and settings in the new Outlook for Windows in the background, if conditions are met. This feature is on by default, preserves existing settings, and can be managed or disabled by admins via policy.

Title: Purview Information Protection - Support for Cross Cloud Protected Files
Summary: Microsoft Purview Information Protection will support sharing sensitivity-labeled files across Microsoft 365 clouds (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, 21Vianet). Public preview starts mid-August 2025; general availability by late October 2025. The feature is off by default and requires admin configuration with Entra ID group controls.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Alert experience enhancements for faster triage
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enhance alert experience by consolidating related signals into richer alerts, reducing alert fatigue while preserving detection and workflows. Rollout starts mid-September 2025, requires no configuration changes, and may affect automation and alert metrics tracking. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Plan for Change: Resource explorer pane will be renamed to Device inventory
Summary: The Resource explorer pane in Intune will be renamed to Device inventory in the September (2509) release to better reflect its purpose. This is a UI change only, with no impact on functionality or data. Update documentation and inform IT admins as needed.

Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting September 3rd, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. Title: Meeting Search in MS Teams Desktop
Summary: Microsoft Teams Desktop will enhance meeting search by allowing users to find meetings by title or participant, join meetings, view recaps, RSVP, and access related chats and files. Rolling out August–September 2025, these features are enabled by default with no admin action required.

Title: Teams Rooms on Windows: Support for facilitator agent in scheduled and ad hoc meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will support a Facilitator Agent in meetings, providing AI-generated notes, chat interactions, and an agenda timer on the front-of-room display. Public preview runs from March to September 2025; general availability from October to November 2025. No user action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Regional Settings Separation
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce Regional Settings Separation by mid-August 2025, allowing users to independently set UI language, date, and time formats in Teams, separate from their OS settings. No admin action is needed; users can customize settings in Teams Desktop Client under Language and regional formats.

Title: Teams Town hall screen management privileges in Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: Teams Rooms on Windows with Teams Rooms Pro can now be assigned as co-organizers or presenters in Teams Town Halls, allowing them to start/end events, control attendee views, and promote presenters. This rollout begins late June 2025 and aims to improve large-scale event management.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Send messages to attendees in the meeting lobby with Lobby chat
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow meeting organizers to send one-way messages to attendees in the meeting lobby via Lobby chat, improving communication before meetings start. This feature is on by default, controllable by admins in the Teams admin center, and will roll out from June to September 2025.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Preview changes before making them visible to attendees with "Manage what attendees see"
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce "Manage what attendees see" with an "On with preview" option for town halls, allowing organizers to preview changes before attendees see them. Rolling out July–September 2025, it applies to Windows desktop, Mac desktop, and web, enhancing polished event delivery without immediate attendee view changes.

Title: Exchange Online: New Groups experience default update in Outlook on the web and new Outlook for windows
Summary: The new Groups experience in Outlook will become the default in early October 2024, with rollout completion by late November 2024. Users will access Groups via the navigation bar, and the old experience will be unavailable. The update includes a central destination for group activities and additional features like recommended actions and recent files. Preparation involves user notification and documentation updates.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Customize live captions on mobile for improved accessibility
Summary: Microsoft Teams mobile now allows users to customize live captions by adjusting font color, background color, and caption height for better readability. These settings sync across devices, persist across sessions, and respect mobile accessibility preferences. The feature rolls out from September to November 2025 and requires no admin action.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Tenant rename General Availability (GA) for tenants with up to 500K sites
Summary: SharePoint Online Tenant Rename is now generally available for tenants with up to 500K sites, allowing domain name changes during rebranding or mergers. It ensures high reliability, business continuity, and compatibility with Microsoft 365 apps, but excludes vanity domains, Multi-Geo, and tenants over 500K sites.

Title: Retirement of "Add to existing remediation" option in Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Summary: Starting October 1, 2025, Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will retire the "Add to existing remediation" option due to low usage. Users must switch to "Create new remediation." No admin action is needed, but users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly. Other functionalities remain unaffected.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to fill forms faster with smart paste in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on October 1, 2025. How does this affect me? Title: Dynamics 365 Field Service - Tailor Copilot chat experience with Copilot Studio

Global administrators need to activate the Brand center app, with steps varying based on current tenant configuration.

Title: Enable smart tagging for eSigned documents in SharePoint
