Summary: Starting September 15, 2025, the Microsoft 365 Copilot iPhone app will offer file previews and Copilot Chat for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files but will no longer support editing; users must open standalone apps for editing. Similar updates will follow for iPad. No admin action is required, but user communication is recommended.

Title: DLP - Adding matched attachment details in Activity Explorer for Data Loss Prevention rules in Exchange
Summary: To ensure the optimal experience for our customers, we have decided not to proceed with the rollout at this time. We will communicate via Message center when we are ready to proceed. Thank you for your patience.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Required approval for Viva Amplify
Summary: The new 'Required approval' feature in Microsoft Viva Amplify ensures content undergoes review before publishing. It's an optional setting found under 'Campaign settings'. Rollout begins late August 2024, with no admin action needed but users should be informed. Viva Amplify on mobile is excluded.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Microsoft Purview AI Hub prompts and responses
Summary: The Microsoft Purview AI Hub will display prompts and responses from Copilot for Microsoft 365 in Activity explorer. Public Preview begins in late August, with full rollout in November 2024. Users need the Content Explorer Content Viewer role to access this feature, and some known issues are documented. Preparation involves role assignment and reviewing documentation.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for August 2024
Summary: The Microsoft Intune Service Update for August 2024 has been applied to your account. Check the Tenant Status blade for the new service release number and explore the changes. Prepare by reviewing the "What's new" page and related blogs for detailed feature information.

Title: Upcoming Retirement of Sub-Domains Feature in Defender for Cloud Apps – Cloud Discovery
Summary: The sub-domains feature in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps – Cloud Discovery will be retired starting September 22, 2025, and fully deprecated by December 31, 2025, due to low usage. No admin action is needed, but sub-domain insights will no longer be available after deprecation.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Refreshed credential enrollment and management UX
Summary: Microsoft Entra will roll out a refreshed credential enrollment and management user experience in early November 2025, improving usability and accessibility without changing functionality. No action is required, but informing help desk teams is recommended to ease the transition. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Microsoft Viva : New Posts tab added to Communications dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Viva is adding a new Posts tab to the Communications dashboard, allowing users to manage drafts, scheduled, and published posts, filter by ownership, and create posts directly. Rolling out mid-September to October 2025, it’s on by default with no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: New recommendations added to Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft Secure Score will add new improvement actions based on Microsoft Defender for Identity recommendations, rolling out from mid-August to late October 2025. These include removing inactive service accounts and discovered passwords. No admin action is needed; updates appear if a Defender for Identity sensor is deployed.

Title: [Reminder] Microsoft Team: Review and update Tenant Federation setting to block external access with trial-only tenants
Summary: Microsoft Teams has introduced a new admin control to block external access with Teams trial-only tenants. This setting, which defaults to 'Blocked', aims to protect against malicious activities. Admins can review and update this setting using PowerShell commands. General availability of this feature started on August 15, 2024.

Title: Plan for Change: New design for Intune Company Portal app for Windows
Summary: In late September 2024, the Intune Company Portal app for Windows will receive a new design, enhancing user experience without altering functionality. Organizations should review the blog and update documentation as needed. A preview is available for testing.

Title: Deploy new Microsoft Teams with Microsoft 365 apps
Summary: Updated August 23, 2023: The opt-out control is now available. Thank you for your patience. Starting in September 2023, we will begin including new Microsoft Teams as part of the new and existing installations of Microsoft 365 apps for Windows depending on the schedule provided in this post. Currently, users can install the new Teams by using the Try the new Teams toggle switch in classic Teams or having administrators bulk deploy directly to the computers in their organization. Read MC533687 an...

Title: Retirement of web-based “Share to Teams” experience from Outlook
Summary: The web-based "Share to Teams" feature in Outlook will retire between September 22 and October 3, 2025. Users without the Teams desktop app will be prompted to install it, while those with the app continue sharing via Teams. No admin action is required, but user notification is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows touch boards: Browser support with Microsoft Edge
Summary: Teams Rooms on Windows touch boards will support Microsoft Edge in private browsing mode, allowing secure web access during and outside meetings. This feature, off by default and requiring a Teams Rooms Pro license, rolls out from September to October 2025 and offers admin controls for session management and browser settings.

Title: Microsoft Loop – Microsoft 365 Groups for Managing New Loop workspaces
Summary: The ability to create shared Loop workspaces managed by Microsoft 365 Groups launched in April 2025, canceling related prior work. From late September to October 2025, users can choose existing Microsoft 365 Groups to govern new Loop workspaces, with no preparation needed from admins.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Video clips recording limit increased from 1 minute to 5 minutes
Summary: Microsoft Teams is increasing video clip recording limits from 1 to 5 minutes, rolling out worldwide from late May to early September 2025. GCC and DoD rollouts start mid-September 2025. No admin action is needed; disabled clips remain unaffected.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New organizer controls for in-meeting management
Summary: Microsoft Teams introduces Organizer Controls in the meeting toolbar, consolidating management features into one menu for improved usability and security. Rolling out from August to October 2025, it changes access to existing features without requiring admin action. Teams Premium users gain Prevent Copy of Chat under Advanced Protection.

Title: Information Barrier support in Microsoft Planner
Summary: Microsoft Planner will support Information Barriers starting September 2025, restricting plan sharing and visibility to authorized groups only. This feature, enabled by default for tenants with Information Barriers, enhances compliance and data protection but is unavailable on mobile apps or browsers. No user action is needed to enable it.

Title: Feature Retirement: Tonal Rewrite in Outlook Web Access (OWA)
Summary: The Tonal Rewrite feature in Outlook Web Access will retire on September 15, 2025. Users will transition to using Copilot in Outlook for advanced, context-aware rewriting and tone adjustments, requiring no admin action. This change enhances writing flexibility and efficiency with AI-powered tools.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Stream Playlist card on Viva Connections Dashboard
Summary: The update allows adding a Stream Playlist card to the Viva Connections Dashboard, displaying videos for users to view. It's linked with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 402190 and will be generally available worldwide from mid to late August 2024. No admin action is required for rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Enhancements to potential high-impact user detections
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is introducing enhancements for detecting potential high-impact users, including improved accessibility and detailed reasons for detections on the Alerts page. These updates are associated with Roadmap IDs 156016 and 171720, and will roll out between late August and early September 2024. The feature is on by default and requires no action to enable.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook: New Get diagnostics feature for users to submit logs to Microsoft Support during an interaction
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook will feature a 'Get diagnostics' option to submit logs to Microsoft Support. Rolling out late August to late September 2024, it will be available in the Help tab and is initially off by default. Admins can enable it using Cloud Policy. No action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded search options for 1:1 chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon introduce expanded search options for 1:1 chats, allowing users to search content related to a person across Teams. This feature will be available on Windows, Mac, and the web, starting mid-August 2024 and completing by late August 2024. It will be enabled by default.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Automatically configure accounts with new policy
Summary: A new Microsoft Outlook for Windows policy will automatically configure accounts using the Active Directory Primary SMTP address. This feature, detailed on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 396729, will start rolling out in mid-September 2024 and is expected to complete by early October 2024. Admins can manage this policy through the Microsoft Intune admin center. The default policy state is off, and no admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: (Update) Microsoft Outlook: Scheduling Assistant updates
Summary: The Scheduling Assistant in Microsoft Outlook is being updated for better readability, with improved grid lines, an Availability view, a combined Availability bar, updated time zone behavior, and the addition of a Send button. Rollout begins late August 2024, completing by late September 2024. No admin action is required.

Title: Update to Viva Learning - SAP SuccessFactors integration configuration process
Summary: The Viva Learning - SAP SuccessFactors integration process is being updated to improve the admin setup experience. The rollout will begin in late August 2024 and is expected to complete by mid-September 2024. The update consolidates configuration steps, automates data collection and updates, and requires no immediate action but suggests preparing updated training and documentation.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Shifts app: Users must enable reminders for upcoming shifts and clocking in/out (Android users)
Summary: Android users of Microsoft Teams Shifts app must enable reminders for shifts and clocking in/out immediately due to API changes. A pop-up will guide users to enable this in the OS settings, with an alternative option available in the Shifts settings page.

Title: Unlock success with our New Campaign Goals Feature: Set, Track, Achieve!
Summary: The new Campaign Goals feature in Viva Amplify allows users to set, track, and achieve specific goals for campaigns, integrated with the unique viewer metric. Rolling out from late August to late September 2024, it provides detailed reports and insights, although currently not available on mobile iOS & Android apps.

Title: OneNote for Windows 10 End of Support
Summary: OneNote for Windows 10 will end support on October 14, 2025, becoming read-only. Users can no longer edit, create, or sync notes. Transition to OneNote on Windows (Microsoft 365) is recommended for continued productivity, security, and features, with migration guides and support available.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for August 2025
Summary: The Microsoft Intune August 2025 update includes a new service build with changes visible in the Tenant Status blade. Users should review the latest features on the What's new 2508 blog and stay informed through the Intune service updates and related blogs.

Title: Power Apps – Manage public system views with security role
Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage access to public system views using security roles in Power Apps. This feature reached general availability on August 15, 2025. How does this affect me? With this feature, admins can manage which system views are shown on table form lists based on a user's security role assignment. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness and no action is required. If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Manage access to public...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Countdown timer for Teams Meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a countdown timer for scheduled meetings, allowing participants to set timers up to 100 minutes with visual and audio alerts. Rolling out mid-June to October 2025, it requires no admin action and helps keep meetings on schedule. Not available for instant meetings or webinars.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Priority content support for risky AI usage
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will enhance the Risky AI usage policy to support priority content, allowing alerts only for sensitive content involvement. Public preview starts mid-July 2025; general availability begins mid-September 2025. No admin action is needed before rollout; review policies to define priority content.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service & Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Set up microphone connection on representative sign-in
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable service representative's microphones to be connected prior to calls beginning in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature is currently available in preview. How does this affect me? This option helps reduce latency and improve call connection times, which creates a smoother experience for both service representatives and customers. What action do I need to take? To enable the microphone to be connected to the app, perform the following steps in Copilot Se...

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: New Banner web part (updated title area) in Pages and News
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint Online is introducing a new Banner web part for Pages and News, allowing users to remove or add multiple banners to a page. Targeted Release begins late June 2024, with General Availability starting early July 2024. The update includes new Banner layouts and affects page templates and title synchronization. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Changes to in-app feedback experience and feedback policy (Teams Desktop and Teams for web)
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating the in-app feedback experience and policy for Desktop and Web versions. A new Feedback option will be added to the Settings menu, and Teams will switch to Microsoft 365 feedback policies. Rollout begins late August 2024, with completion expected by late September 2024. Admins should review and update feedback policies accordingly.

Title: Outlook: External tag in profile cards
Summary: Outlook will add a visual indicator on profile cards to identify external email participants, enhancing security and reducing accidental data sharing. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from mid to late September 2025. No preparation is needed, but user communication is recommended.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: new service listing in Service health and Message center
Summary: Microsoft 365 is introducing a new service listing, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, in Service health and Message center to improve communication visibility for Copilot Chat users. It will roll out worldwide by September 2025, requires no action, and does not affect service functionality.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive for Business | Updated order of Shortcut and Sync commands
Summary: Microsoft is updating OneDrive for Business to place the "Add Shortcut to OneDrive" command before "Sync" for better usability. The rollout starts late August 2025, completing by mid-September. No action is needed, but update documentation and inform support teams accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Updated Copilot Chat interface with new conversation view
Summary: The Outlook Copilot Chat interface is updated with the navigation pane moved from right to left, aligning with other Microsoft 365 apps. It includes access to agents, conversation history, and a new All Conversations page. The rollout begins mid-August 2025, requires no admin action, and aims to improve usability.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify: New banner web part and updated title area
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify is introducing a new Banner web part and updates to the title area, allowing for more layout options and the ability to remove the title area. Rollout begins mid-August 2024 with full availability by mid-September 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Loop components in Microsoft OneNote
Summary: Loop components will be available in Microsoft OneNote, enhancing collaboration and productivity. Rollout for OneNote Web starts early April 2024, and for the Desktop App, early June 2024. Users can insert Loop components for real-time collaboration. Admins should update policies and documentation to prepare. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 379968 is associated with this update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New file image previews in messages
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon introduce file image previews in chats and channels, enhancing content interaction. This feature allows users to see a small preview of attached files like images, PowerPoint, or PDFs. Rollouts begin in June 2024, with different completion dates for various user groups. No admin action is needed before the rollout.

Title: Power Automate – Use CyberArk credentials in desktop flow connections
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use CyberArk credentials in Power Automate desktop flow connections. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2024. How does this affect me? Your users will be able to leverage secrets stored in CyberArk (using the Central Credential Provider) to connect to Windows sessions on desktop flow machines. Secrets are not stored in Power Automate but are retrieved during runtime. This feature supports rotating passwords without the need to update th...

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting August 19th, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this late...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out your core apps into a new window.
Summary: Starting November 2025, Microsoft Teams will allow users to pop out core apps like Chat and Teams into separate windows for improved productivity. The rollout requires no admin action, and organizations may update training accordingly. The update timeline was recently revised.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Sales Qualification Agent is now fully autonomous
Summary: We are announcing that the Sales Qualification Agent for Dynamics 365 Sales is now fully autonomous. This updated feature is currently being rolled out to all regions and is anticipated to be available globally by August 31, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature is designed to assist your sales team qualify leads faster and with more confidence. AI-Powered Lead Research: The agent will autonomously research leads by combining your CRM data with public web sources as well as custom knowledg...

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management cumulative exfiltration tuning
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is introducing cumulative exfiltration tuning to reduce alert noise by not scoring previously detected activities. This update will be globally available from mid to late August 2024 and requires no admin action. It is enabled by default and accessible via the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Title: Viva Amplify: Reports displaying count and percentage
Summary: Viva Amplify updates now show the count of viewers instead of the percentage for publications sent to large audiences, like an entire organization. This change, associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 407862, aims to provide clearer data points and will be available from 8/28. Users can still toggle to view percentages for the whole organization if needed. Admins should update training materials accordingly.

Title: Viva Amplify: Reactions card
Summary: Viva Amplify introduces a Reactions card to track and display readers' responses to publications, with a time horizon feature for detailed insights. It's part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 407862, rolling out from late August to September 2024. Organizations should update training materials to prepare.

Title: Viva Amplify: UTC toggle
Summary: Viva Amplify introduces a UTC toggle feature to align time zones for campaign members, aiding in consistent data understanding. It will roll out from late August to late September 2024. The toggle affects all timeline graphs in reports and indicates when UTC is used. Preparation includes user notification and training material updates. Roadmap ID: 407862.

Title: Viva Amplify: User signals Graphs
Summary: Viva Amplify introduces new line graph visualizations for unique viewers and promotions with historical data up to 12 months. Users can customize graphs by publishing endpoint and use "Copy as image" functionality. Rollout begins late August 2024, with completion by late September 2024. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 407862.

Title: Viva Amplify: Export report data
Summary: Viva Amplify now offers three export options: 'Copy as image' for single card snapshots, 'Export to CSV' for full data analysis, and 'Export to PowerPoint' for presentation-ready slides. These features will roll out from late August to September 2024. Admins should prepare users accordingly.

Title: Interact with SharePoint content in Teams channels using agents
Summary: SharePoint agents in Microsoft Teams Channels enable users to access and summarize SharePoint content via @mentions without leaving Teams. Rolling out globally from late August to mid-September 2025, this feature is on by default, requires no admin changes, and supports existing governance and compliance controls.

Title: Workspace-level workload assignment in Microsoft Fabric
Summary: Microsoft Fabric will allow Workspace Admins to assign workloads directly at the workspace level starting mid-September 2025, simplifying onboarding without capacity-level settings. This feature is enabled by default but can be disabled by admins. Entra ID consent remains required for security and compliance.

Title: Deception feature in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will be retired from public preview
Summary: The Deception feature in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will be retired from public preview by October 31, 2025. New onboarding stops August 18, 2025; existing decoys and UI elements will be removed. No admin action is needed, but informing stakeholders and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity alerts transitioning to XDR-based detection platform
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity classic alerts will transition to the XDR detection platform on September 18, 2025, improving detection accuracy and performance. Users must update workflows with new Detector IDs and reconfigure alert exclusions using XDR Alert Tuning rules.

Title: Microsoft Viva - Viva Glint: Export Team Summary report in Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides
Summary: Viva Glint's Team Summary report will soon export directly to editable PowerPoint slides, enabling faster, customizable presentations with improved layout and reliability. Rollout starts mid-September 2025. The screenshot export remains for custom templates. No admin action needed; inform users about the new feature.

Title: Streaming API support for Data Security tables in Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting
Summary: Microsoft Defender XDR will support Streaming API for DataSecurityEvents and DataSecurityBehaviors tables starting late August 2025, enabling real-time insider risk alert data delivery via event hubs. This push-based feature is off by default, requires setup, and allows integration with external platforms while offering admin control through Entra ID.

Title: Copilot Chat usage in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote now included in Copilot Analytics
Summary: Copilot Chat usage in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote is now included in Microsoft 365 admin center and Viva Insights reports, enhancing Copilot Analytics. Updates will reflect user activity across these apps, improving adoption tracking and AI adoption scores with future enhancements planned.

Title: Fix update: Enforcement of Admin Settings in Fabric Public API and CI/CD
Summary: Starting September 15, 2025, Microsoft Fabric will enforce tenant and capacity-level admin settings to block creation of specified Fabric items via public APIs, Git integration, and deployment pipelines. Existing items remain unaffected. Admins should review settings to align with policies before enforcement begins.

Title: Planned maintenance: Cloud Voicemail is migrating to a new infrastructure
Summary: Microsoft is migrating the Cloud Voicemail service to new infrastructure from mid-August to late September 2025. Tenants who allowlist specific IPs for Cloud Voicemail may face connectivity issues. If problems occur, users should contact Microsoft support for assistance.

Title: Updated: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: New secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
Summary: The rollout of Microsoft Purview's Priority Cleanup feature, allowing admins to bypass legal holds and retention policies for permanent deletion in Exchange, is delayed from early February to late February 2025. It requires multiple approvals, specific roles, and supports policy simulation for secure data lifecycle management.

Title: Backfilling Microsoft Graph Connector Entitlement to 50M items
Summary: Microsoft 365 and Office 365 subscriptions will soon include a new service plan, Graph Connectors Search with Index, offering a 50 million item index limit per tenant at no extra cost. Rollout begins mid-September 2024. Subscribers should review Microsoft Graph connectors resources to prepare.

Title: Loop app increased availability; by-default enablement for additional tenants
Summary: Loop is a new app that enables your teams to think, plan, and create together like never before. We are continuing to make Loop available in stages to an increased set of customers, aiming to make it easier to enable the Loop app in your organization. In an increased number of tenants: Microsoft 365 subscriptions listed below are being backfilled with a new service plan: the Loop app with workspaces. Customers using the Loop app in preview who do not have a subscription in the list below will co...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Quick Links Card on Viva Connections Dashboard
Summary: The update allows organizations to add a Quick Links Card to the Viva Connections Dashboard for easy access to important links. It started rolling out in August 2024 and will be available by default with no admin action required.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New usage intensity and host apps metrics available in Copilot Chat usage report
Summary: New Microsoft 365 admin center metrics track Copilot Chat usage intensity and app-specific engagement for users without Copilot licenses across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Available worldwide from mid-August 2025, these daily-updated metrics enhance adoption reporting and impact existing custom reports.

Title: Live events using Microsoft Teams town hall in Viva Engage
Summary: Microsoft is rolling out an enhanced Teams town hall experience in Viva Engage for live events starting September 2025. Community admins can choose between the new Teams town hall and legacy live events, offering higher-quality, large-scale event broadcasting with no required admin configuration.

Title: Engage Storyline and post enhancements: cover photos, drafts, AMAs, and more
Summary: Viva Engage Storyline enhancements launching late September to October 2025 include cover photos, featured posts, post drafting and scheduling, AMA sessions, and delegate posting. These default-on features improve personalization, planning, interaction, and communication engagement without requiring admin action.

Title: Gen AI capabilities in the Create module of Microsoft 365 Copilot app coming to all Copilot Chat users
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Create module now offers generative AI image and visual content creation to all Copilot Chat users without a license, with standard access and existing admin controls applying. Video, survey, and brand kit features remain restricted. Rollout began mid-August for desktop, with mobile following in October 2025.

Title: Microsoft Teams | New in Admin Center: Self-Serve Fixes for Porting Rejections
Summary: Microsoft Teams Admin Center will roll out a self-service feature by late August 2025 allowing Teams Phone admins to fix and resubmit certain rejected porting orders without contacting support. Notifications and prompts guide admins through corrections using the existing porting wizard. Complex cases still require Microsoft support.

Title: "Investigation priority score increase" Policy to be retired
Summary: The "Investigation priority score increase" policy in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will be retired between June and September 2024 due to high false positives and limited value. Administrators should use the Advanced Hunting query as an alternative.

Title: Cloud Discovery anomaly detection policy to be retired
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the "Cloud Discovery anomaly detection" policy from Defender for Cloud Apps due to high false positives. Rollout begins late June 2024 and ends late September 2024. Affected users should switch to "App discovery policy" and set filters as needed.

Title: Microsoft Word: Certain Dynamic Data Exchange features will be removed in April 2025
Summary: Microsoft Word will fully remove certain Dynamic Data Exchange features in April 2025, affecting organizations using the specific registry key. No admin action is required, but users should be notified and documentation updated.

Title: Plan for Change: Intune moving to support iOS/iPadOS 16 and higher later this year
Summary: Microsoft Intune will soon require iOS/iPadOS 16 or higher after the release of iOS/iPadOS 18. Organizations managing iOS/iPadOS devices should check Intune reporting to identify affected devices and users, and use Intune controls to manage OS versions. Apple User Enrollment with Company Portal support is ending.

Title: Microsoft Defender XDR: Enhancing email remediation with Sender’s copy clean-up features
Summary: Microsoft Defender XDR is introducing Sender's copy clean-up features to enhance email remediation. This includes integration with Soft delete, wide support across platforms, and an undo capability. It applies to intra-organization and outbound emails, with a rollout expected from end of May to early September 2024. Admins will have improved management of Sent items with no action required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Simplifying the personal app design at the top of the screen
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new simplified design for personal apps on desktop and web clients, moving the 'About' tab and utility actions to a three-dot menu. This change, associated with Roadmap ID 396166, will start rolling out in mid-July 2024 and is expected to complete by late August 2024. It aims to reduce clutter and complexity. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Attach files from Microsoft SharePoint sites in the mobile app
Summary: The Teams mobile app will soon allow users to browse, select, and attach files from SharePoint Sites to chats or channel conversations. This feature is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 395375 and will roll out in early to late August 2024 without requiring admin configuration.

Title: Take action: Enable multifactor authentication for your tenant before October 15, 2024
Summary: Enable multifactor authentication (MFA) for your tenant by October 15, 2024, to access Microsoft Azure portal, Microsoft Entra admin center, and Microsoft Intune admin center. Set up MFA early or apply to postpone the enforcement date if necessary. Without MFA, admin access will be restricted.

Title: Power BI Cognitive Services and Azure Machine Learning features retiring; transition to Fabric AI services
Summary: Power BI is retiring Cognitive Services and Azure Machine Learning features between August 11 and September 15, 2025. New model creation is disabled from August 11; existing models refresh until September 15, after which support ends. Users should transition to Fabric AI services and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Copilot: filter chat history for easier context recall
Summary: Microsoft Copilot will add a chat history filtering feature starting late August 2025, enabling users to quickly find relevant past conversations. The feature is on by default, requires no admin setup, and aims to improve navigation and context recall in Copilot chats.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New Multi-admin notifications for Microsoft 365 Backup
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup will introduce Multi-admin notifications starting late August 2025, allowing centralized email alerts for key backup events to designated admins. Users can configure notification lists by admin roles or custom groups. No action is needed before rollout, but configuration is required to activate notifications.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive and Microsoft SharePoint: Use the table of contents in a PDF to navigate
Summary: Starting mid-July to mid-September 2025, OneDrive and SharePoint Online will display a PDF's table of contents for easy navigation. Users can jump to sections directly, with the feature enabled by default and no admin action needed. Some users may see it earlier.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive: New PDF compression feature
Summary: Microsoft is rolling out a new PDF compression feature in OneDrive and SharePoint starting July 2025, allowing users to reduce PDF file sizes with three compression levels. The feature is automatic, supports files under 300 MB, and maintains visual quality using lossy compression and chroma subsampling.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Ability to Disagree with admin submissions analysis
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 now lets admins dispute submission results directly in the portal to flag false positives or negatives, improving detection accuracy without support tickets. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from late August to late September 2025.

Title: Streamlining SMS campaign approvals in Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams Calling Plans SMS now offers self-service campaign rejection handling, a proactive Microsoft validation layer, and clearer status updates like "Customer Update Pending." Admins can view rejection reasons, resubmit campaigns up to four times, and manage approvals directly in the Teams Admin Center, improving transparency and efficiency.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Experience enhancements to IRM alert workflow
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management alert workflow is enhanced to improve usability by reducing clutter and maximizing visual space. Updates include default opening of Activity Explorer, relocated alert details and actions, and adjustable panels. Rollout begins September 2025, enabled by default for licensed tenants, with no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: New data protection in Microsoft Edge for Business on unmanaged devices
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will integrate with Microsoft Edge for Business on unmanaged Windows and Mac devices to protect data shared with Entra-managed cloud apps. Public preview starts late May 2025; general availability begins late August 2025. Admins can configure policies to block or audit sensitive data activities.

Title: New Tenant-level Service Plan in Viva Suite SKU
Summary: Microsoft is introducing a new tenant-level service plan, Insights by MyAnalytics Backend, starting late September 2025 to support existing user-level MyAnalytics plans. It will appear in the admin center as enabled but non-assignable, with no changes to user features, SKUs, or compliance requirements.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations – Enable contract line default financial dimensions for expenses
Summary: We are announcing the ability to apply dimension defaulting configuration rules to automatically get financial dimensions from contract lines or the related project for expense lines in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 12, 2025. How does this affect me? This capability builds on the existing Enable flexibility when determining financial dimension defaults (For both resource-based/non-stocked scenarios) feature. When enabled, environments...

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Enhanced Metadata Scanning for Images in Exchange DLP
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP will enhance data protection by scanning sensitive data in image metadata when OCR is unavailable. Rolling out worldwide from mid-July to late September 2025, this feature activates automatically without admin action, expanding DLP coverage and potentially affecting compliance reporting.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Annotate PDFs with text boxes
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive introduces a feature for annotating PDFs with text boxes, rolling out late June to late August 2024. Users can edit PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint by opening the file and using the 'Edit' and 'Add Text' commands. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Updated behavior for "OpenLinks" app configuration keys for Android/iOS
Summary: Microsoft Outlook's behavior for "OpenLinks" app configuration keys on Android/iOS is updated. Two keys control hyperlink behavior, with changes rolling out in mid-September 2024. Documentation will be updated to reflect the new functionality, and organizations may need to review their configurations.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for all channels
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting August 13th, 2024 (PST). Title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Public preview of policy wizard enhancements
Summary: After further consideration, we have decided to not move forward with the rollout at this time. We will communicate via Message center when we are ready to proceed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Improvements to the "Manage what attendees see" feature
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the "Manage what attendees see" feature with new intuitive controls for a simpler event production and professional attendee viewing experience. This update is already available for Targeted Release and will roll out globally from late August to early September 2024. The update will apply automatically, with no admin action needed, but users should be informed and documentation updated. A test session is recommended to familiarize with the new controls.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows and the web: Use the Ctrl Y shortcut to jump to a folder
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook update allows users to quickly navigate to folders using the Ctrl+Y shortcut and typing the folder name. This feature is rolling out from late July to mid-September 2024 and will be on by default. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Graph API is generally available in v1.0 to manage username, group names, and site names
Summary: The message details the general availability of Microsoft Graph API v1.0 for managing names and the upcoming release of two APIs for updating and getting admin report settings. Rollout starts early August 2024, with completion by mid-August. Global admins can change name display settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center. No action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams | External Audio and Camera Device Selection on iPads
Summary: Microsoft Teams on iPad now allows muting external audio devices and switching cameras via a long press on the camera icon. These features, rolling out now and enabled by default, enhance meeting control without requiring admin setup. Users should update their Teams app to access them.

Title: Outlook for iOS and Android: Send button relocated to reduce accidental sends
Summary: The Send button in Outlook mobile (iOS and Android) will move from the bottom toolbar to the top header in the compose view to reduce accidental sends. This change, rolling out from September 2025 to March 2026, is enabled by default and does not affect desktop or web clients.

Title: [Copilot Extensibility] Admins can manage ownerless Copilot agents with new lifecycle controls
Summary: Admins will gain lifecycle controls to identify, review, delete, or block ownerless Copilot agents created by departed users, improving security and governance. The feature rolls out globally from late August to mid-September 2025, with owner assignment for agents coming in October. No prior configuration is needed.

Title: Microsoft Places: Graph API support for directory objects
Summary: Microsoft Graph API now supports full CRUD operations for Microsoft Places directory objects, enabling programmatic management of buildings, floors, rooms, and desks. Available worldwide, this update helps organizations integrate and maintain location data efficiently, especially when using third-party systems. No immediate impact by default.

Title: Microsoft Teams: First run experience and prompting users to release previous reservations
Summary: Starting mid-August 2025, Microsoft Teams will notify users with multiple desk reservations to release previous ones and introduce a first run experience explaining these notifications. This applies to bookable desks and desk pools, requires no admin action, and is available to all users, with cancellation features for Teams Premium users.

Title: Whiteboard: existing Azure board migration to ODB storage
Summary: The migration of existing Whiteboards from Azure to OneDrive storage began in December 2024 and will complete by late August 2025. Users must launch Whiteboard clients to trigger migration, which improves features, performance, and security. Admins can monitor migration status via PowerShell. No delay is possible.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Post expenses on the expense report posting date
Summary: We are announcing the ability to post expenses on the expense report posting date instead of the transaction date in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 12, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature provides a parameter (Enable posting of expenses on posting date) that, when enabled, allows businesses to post expense transactions on the posting date instead of the expense transaction date. What action do I need to take? This message is for...

Title: OneDrive: Prompt for permitted users to sign in to OneDrive app with personal Microsoft account
Summary: Starting mid-July 2025, OneDrive will prompt users on corporate Windows devices to sign in to the app with their personal Microsoft account if already signed in on the device. This prompt does not merge files or accounts and can be disabled by administrators via policy.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Edit per diem transaction date, exchange rate in expense management
Summary: We are announcing the ability to edit transaction dates and exchange rates for per diem expenses to improve flexibility and accuracy in expense reporting, in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 12, 2025. How does this affect me? This capability will enable users to manually edit the transaction date for per diem expenses. The modified information will be utilized in subsequent expense-related calculations and postings. Currently, the expense...

Title: Modern SharePoint: New Template gallery and 50+ out-of-the-box page templates
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint will introduce a centralized Template gallery with 50+ new out-of-the-box page templates to streamline content creation and enhance visual consistency. Rolling out mid-June to late September 2025, this feature requires no admin action but users should be informed to maximize its benefits.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable number sequences in expense management
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable number sequences in expense management in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 12, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature will introduce a new tab on the expense management parameters page, allowing users to assign number sequences directly. Additionally, users will be able to manage number sequences within the module itself, rather than having to access and modify the number sequence master. What...

Title: Microsoft Outlook for Android: Updated conversation actions
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for Android will move conversation actions from the top right to a customizable toolbar at the bottom of the reading pane, rolling out from July to early September 2025. This change improves consistency and requires no admin action, but user notification is recommended.

Title: Emoji Reactions Workflows in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enable triggering workflows via emoji reactions using the Workflows app, streamlining task automation. Available from late July 2025, this feature requires the Workflows app enabled and not blocked by DLP policies. Admins should review settings and raise user awareness to prepare.

Title: Plan for Change: Intune moving to support macOS 14 and higher later this year
Summary: Intune will support macOS 14 (Sonoma) and later after macOS Tahoe 26 release this year. Existing devices on macOS 13.x or below remain enrolled but new enrollments require macOS 14+. Organizations should identify and upgrade devices running older macOS versions to maintain support.

Title: Plan for Change: Intune moving to support iOS/iPadOS 17 and higher later this year
Summary: Microsoft Intune will require iOS/iPadOS 17 or higher after Apple's iOS/iPadOS 26 release later this year. Organizations should check device compatibility and Intune reports to identify affected devices. Userless devices via Automated Device Enrollment have specific OS version requirements. Use Intune controls to manage OS versions.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails with sensitivity labels
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will soon restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails labeled with sensitivity starting January 1, 2025. The feature rolls out June to September 2025, requires no Copilot license, and allows admins to create or extend DLP policies via the Purview portal automatically.

Title: Power Automate - Debug desktop flows using step over and step out
Summary: We are announcing the ability to debug desktop flows using step over and step out in Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on September 10, 2025. How does this affect me? Users can enable this feature from the Tools menu while in the designer within Power Automate for desktop. Once enabled, new buttons for the following functionality will appear in the debugger toolbar.Step over: This allows users to skip sub-flows without entering them so they can focus on the main logic...

Title: New feature in Microsoft Viva Pulse to enable delegation
Summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse will introduce delegation starting mid-August 2025, allowing users to assign delegates to manage Pulse surveys on their behalf. Delegates can create, send, and view surveys and reports but cannot access confidential conversations or share reports. Admins can control delegation settings centrally.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: New setting to auto-advance to the next message
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android is introducing a new setting for automatically advancing to the next email after actions like delete or archive, instead of going back to the message list. Rollout begins mid-August 2024 for iOS and late October 2024 for Android. Users must enable this feature in Settings.

Title: Reminder: Two Admin Audit Log cmdlets retire in September 2024
Summary: Two Admin Audit Log cmdlets, `Search-AdminAuditLog` and `New-AdminAuditLog`, will retire on September 15, 2024. It's recommended to use `Search-UnifiedAuditLog` instead. Details on retirement and migration are available on the Microsoft Community Hub.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Introducing Bulk Senders Insight to optimize bulk email management for enterprises
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces Bulk Senders Insight, a tool to optimize bulk email management. It helps admins fine-tune bulk email policies by simulating the optimal bulk complaint level and identifying potential issues. Rollout begins mid-August 2024 with no admin action required before then.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: document processing models will no longer process files if the service is not enabled for the site
Summary: SharePoint document models will only process files on enabled sites post-September 2024 rollout. Before, models processed files even if the site was disabled. Changes apply automatically; no admin action needed before rollout. Ensure Syntex service is enabled on sites where processing should continue.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Connections news notifications on desktop and web
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections news notifications will be available on Teams desktop and web, mirroring the functionality on Teams mobile. Users can adjust notification settings at the app and individual levels. The rollout begins early June 2024, with no admin action required. For more information, users can visit the Viva Connections mobile News notifications page.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: New page range setting for prebuilt and structured models in Microsoft Syntex
Summary: Microsoft Syntex will soon allow setting a page range for processing larger files with several pages in prebuilt, structured, and freeform models. This feature will roll out from mid-August to early September 2024, requiring no admin action prior to rollout. Users can adjust settings from the Model settings panel.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights: Delegate access to Microsoft Copilot Dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights will soon allow leaders to delegate access to their Copilot Dashboard to designated individuals within their company. This feature will enable delegates to view insights and make informed decisions, without seeing the leader's personal insights. It will be available on various platforms and is associated with Roadmap ID 398976. Rollout begins mid-July 2024. Admins can manage access with policies, and the feature is enabled by default. Organizations should prepare by revie...

Title: Microsoft SharePoint document libraries: Improved Version history controls | Preview opt-in
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint is updating version history controls, adding new automatic and manual version limits to help admins manage version storage efficiently. Public Preview starts in May 2024, with General Availability in September 2024. Admins should prepare by reviewing updated documentation and can opt-in for the preview using SharePoint Online Management PowerShell cmdlet. The message includes links for further guidance and feedback.

Title: Viva: Viva Insights home & nav refresh, employee engagement report & Pulse recommended action for leaders
Summary: The Viva Insights home and navigation will be updated to emphasize reports, with new features like employee engagement reports and Pulse surveys. Rollout starts late June 2024, completing by late August. No action is required for the update, which applies to Viva Insights subscribers.

Title: Purview | Insider Risk Management: Exfiltration of business sensitive data to free public domain emails
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is introducing a feature to detect exfiltration of sensitive data to free public domain emails, with a public preview in mid-May 2024 and general availability in late June 2024. The update enhances email insight alerts and adds new domain detection for better security incident prevention.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Extended directory retires starting July 22, 2024
Summary: The Extended directory preview feature in Microsoft Teams will be retired from July 22, 2024, to July 31, 2024, due to low usage. Users are advised to use Teams connect chat with external access instead. No admin action is required for this change.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: RSVP improvements in event context menu
Summary: Outlook is updating the event context menu to make RSVP options more accessible, with responses applicable to individual events or entire series. Rollout starts in June 2024 for Targeted Release and in July 2024 for General Availability. No admin action needed, but users should be informed.

Title: Microsoft Word: “Transform to Web Page” feature retiring September 30, 2025
Summary: The "Transform to Web Page" feature in Microsoft Word will retire on September 30, 2025. Users should switch to the "Start from a Document" flow in Microsoft Sway for creating web content. No admin action is needed, but users should be notified and documentation updated.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Specify who can manage the screen in town halls
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Who has control of production tools" option for town halls, letting organizers assign who can manage the screen, start, and end the event. Rolling out May to August 2025, this feature restricts control to designated users and is available without a Teams Premium license.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Updated network setup requirements for immersive spaces
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating to a unified backend infrastructure for immersive spaces, simplifying network setup. Rollouts begin mid-August 2024, with full availability by late September 2024. Organizations will need fewer endpoint and firewall configurations, and users won't need to consent to Mesh's terms for spatial audio. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID:  Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) application migration wizard is GA
Summary: The AD FS application migration wizard for Microsoft Entra ID is now generally available, providing a guided experience for migrating AD FS relying party applications. Rollout begins mid-August 2024, with completion expected by late August. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Attacker in the Middle detection alert in ID Protection is GA
Summary: The Attacker in the Middle detection feature will be generally available in Microsoft Entra ID Protection by late August 2024, enhancing security by identifying compromised user accounts. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Device-based Conditional Access to M365/Azure resources on Red Hat Enterprise Linux is GA
Summary: Device-based Conditional Access for Microsoft 365 and Azure on Red Hat Enterprise Linux is going GA in mid to late August 2024. It brings Entra ID registration, Conditional Access policies, SSO, Intune compliance, and support for Red Hat RPM packages. No admin action is required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft Word: The Acronyms feature will retire September 2024
Summary: The Acronyms feature in Microsoft Word will retire on September 11, 2024, affecting Word for Windows and on the web. Users are advised to use alternative options like Microsoft Search, SharePoint.com, Bing for Work, or Copilot in Word for decoding acronyms.

Title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 – Delete stub, unlicensed, and removed Microsoft Entra group users feature is now available
Summary: Starting August 8, 2024, the Delete stub, unlicensed, and removed Microsoft Entra group users feature will be generally available. How does this affect me? Previously, stub users, unlicensed, or removed Microsoft Entra group users couldn't be deleted from a Dataverse environment. These types of users remained in a Dataverse environment with a disabled status and were unable to log into the environment. You can now delete these users with the disabled status in your environment to comply with pri...

Title: Power Automate – Mark input parameters in manual trigger with new options announcement
Summary: We are announcing the mark input parameters in manual trigger with new options feature for Power Automate. With this feature, makers can mark parameters in manual trigger as either optional, dropdown, or multi-select. This feature will reach general availability on September 15, 2024. How does this affect me? After this update, makers can mark any input parameter in manual trigger in modern designer as optional, multi-select, or dropdown. What do I need to do to prepare? This message is for awar...

Title: Power Automate – Create and edit expressions with Copilot announcement
Summary: We are announcing the create and edit expressions with Copilot feature for Power Automate. With this feature, makers can create, edit, and fix their Power Automate expressions by invoking Copilot. This feature will reach general availability on September 15, 2024. How does this affect me? Makers can create complex expressions or edit their existing expressions simply by submitting natural language prompts to Copilot in Power Automate. What do I need to do to prepare? This message is for awarenes...

Title: Legacy Microsoft SharePoint Invitation Manager settings have retired
Summary: The message informs that the Legacy SharePoint Invitation Manager settings have been retired, with the specific setting for guests to sign in with the invited account no longer appearing. The SharePoint Invitation Manager's retirement doesn't change product behavior. It recommends using the 'Anyone' link sharing setting and provides a link for configuring external sharing. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Amplify video templates
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify introduces new video templates for videocentric publications. These include Starter, Training, Recap, and Message templates. Rollout begins early August 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-August 2024 for General Availability. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: New admin policy controls for video creation and distribution in Microsoft Clipchamp and Microsoft Stream
Summary: New admin controls in Microsoft Clipchamp and Stream allow management of video creation and distribution via five policy settings, including AI text-to-speech, webcam/screen recording, local downloads, and Clipchamp Premium upgrades. Policies enforce compliance by hiding or disabling related UI elements. Audio recording control is delayed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Dedicated download option for tracking all registrations in Webinar
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a dedicated download option to track all webinar registrants, enhancing visibility and reporting. Available by default from August to mid-September 2025, it requires no user impact or preparation. No compliance issues are identified.

Title: Microsoft Graph Metered API Update
Summary: Starting August 25, 2025, certain Teams APIs in Microsoft Graph will no longer incur metered charges. No client changes are needed, and final billing will follow the normal schedule. This update applies globally and does not affect SharePoint and OneDrive assignSensitivityLabel APIs or prioritization products.

Title: GPT-5—OpenAI’s latest generative-AI system—is now available in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: GPT-5 is now available in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio, offering dynamic model selection for faster or deeper responses. Users with a Copilot license get priority access via a toggle in Copilot Chat. No admin action is needed, but informing users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows and Outlook for the web: Jump to a message in the message list
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for Windows and web will soon let users type text to jump to messages in the list based on sorting (e.g., sender, date, category). Rolling out late May to August 2025, this feature is on by default and requires no admin action. Users should be informed accordingly.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online eSignature for Microsoft Word
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint Online now supports requesting eSignatures directly from Word documents without converting to PDF first. Rolling out globally from late May to August 2025, users must enable SharePoint’s native eSignature service and apply a group policy to access this feature via the Word Desktop Insert ribbon.

Title: Microsoft 365 apps | New Trust Center settings to block insecure file open protocols
Summary: Microsoft 365 apps will block insecure file open protocols like FPRPC by default starting version 2508, with new Trust Center settings to manage these protocols. Admins can control settings via Group Policy or Cloud Policy service. Changes apply only to Microsoft 365 apps for Windows, not Teams.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | View recent activity in Word with Dynamic Document Snapshot
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word introduces an Activity tab showing recent comments and edits, with filters by time. Rolling out globally from late July to August 2025, it enhances collaboration by summarizing document changes. The feature is on by default, requiring no user action.

Title: Microsoft Purview | ​Retirement of the classic eDiscovery (Premium) experience
Summary: The classic eDiscovery (Premium) experience in Microsoft Purview will retire on August 31, 2025, replaced by the unified Cases section. Users must transition to the new eDiscovery experience to avoid disruption, update documentation, and prepare for enhanced capabilities.

Title: Simplifying Microsoft 365 Copilot app web experiences
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat web access is being simplified by consolidating entry points from copilot.cloud.microsoft to m365.cloud.microsoft/chat, reducing user confusion. The change starts mid-September with automatic redirection, requires no admin action, and does not affect data processing or AI capabilities.

Title: Microsoft Edge:  Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat entry point in Microsoft Edge for Business
Summary: Microsoft Edge for Business will add two Microsoft 365 Copilot entry points: a context menu for page summaries and Find on Page integration, rolling out by August 2025. Features are on by default, respect DLP policies, and enable new AI-driven browser interactions without requiring admin action before rollout.

Title: Create, Delete, Rename, and Move Folders in Outlook for iOS and Android
Summary: Starting early June 2025, Outlook on iOS and Android will allow users to create, rename, move, delete, and reorder folders easily via the Edit icon in the sidebar, with drag-and-drop support. The rollout requires no admin action but user notification is recommended.

Title: Introduction of secure workflow to bypass retention/legal holds on OneDrive and SharePoint
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will introduce a secure workflow allowing admins to bypass retention/legal holds to delete OneDrive and SharePoint content early. This requires specific admin roles, includes audit features, and is planned for public preview in September 2025 and general availability in November 2025.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting August 5th, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this lates...

Title: Copilot in the Microsoft Edge mobile application is being retired for Entra ID users
Summary: The Copilot feature in the Microsoft Edge mobile app for Entra ID users will be retired with version 128 in late August 2024. Users should use the Microsoft 365 mobile app for work and web chat instead. No action is required, but informing users is recommended.

Title: Compose in the Microsoft Edge sidebar is being retired
Summary: The Compose feature in Microsoft Edge for Business sidebar will be retired in late August, 2024, affecting users with an Entra ID. No action is required, but informing users is suggested.

Title: Sentence-Level Rewrite Suggestions Deprecation in Microsoft Word
Summary: The Rewrite Suggestions feature in Microsoft Word will be deprecated after October 1, 2025, and replaced by the more advanced Copilot experience, offering context-aware rewriting, prompt-based editing, and iterative refinement. Users are encouraged to transition to Copilot's Auto-Rewrite for enhanced writing assistance.

Title: Microsoft To Do ending support for iOS 16 and macOS 12
Summary: Microsoft To Do will stop supporting iOS 16 and macOS 12 starting late August to mid-September 2025. Updates will require iOS 17 or macOS 13 and later. Users on older versions won't receive updates, potentially affecting app performance and security. Organizations should encourage OS upgrades and update device policies.

Title: Microsoft Clipchamp video hub start page update
Summary: Microsoft Clipchamp is updating its video hub start page to a streamlined, AI-enhanced experience for video creation, discovery, and consumption. Rollout begins late August 2025, with no URL or functionality changes. Users will see a banner guiding them to the new hub; no admin action is required.

Title: New Copilot setting for pinning the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to the Windows Taskbar
Summary: A new setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center allows admins to pin the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to the Windows taskbar for easier access. This setting, off by default, applies to Intune-managed Windows 10 and 11 devices. It will roll out starting at the end of July.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Chat now supports new file types in search grounding
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now supports additional file types like CAD, ZIP, and MP4 for search grounding, enhancing response relevance. The rollout begins early August 2025, with no user interface changes. Users must have eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses; the feature is enabled by default.

Title: Microsoft Fabric: Workspace inbound/outbound access protection will be available by default (preview)
Summary: Microsoft Fabric will preview Workspace-level private links and Outbound access protection starting late August 2025. Tenant admins can enable these features for workspace admins to secure inbound and outbound network access, reducing unauthorized access and data exfiltration risks. Review and adjust settings post-release.

Title: Teams Discover feed Service migration
Summary: The Teams Discover Feed backend is migrating from People Prediction Service to Substrate Search Service Recommendations starting June 18, 2025, with PPS deprecated by August 2025. There is no user impact, but devices must run specified minimum client versions to ensure compatibility. No compliance issues noted.

Title: SharePoint: OneDrive and SharePoint – Protect PDF with password
Summary: Starting July 2025, OneDrive and SharePoint will let users password-protect PDFs with open passwords (to restrict access) and owner passwords (to set permissions like printing or editing). The feature saves a new protected copy without overwriting the original, requiring no admin action for rollout.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Outlook on the web: Using the Alt key to access key tips
Summary: Outlook will soon allow using the Alt key for key tips. The rollout starts mid-August 2024, completing by late August for worldwide users, and from mid-September to mid-September for GCC, GCC High, DoD. No admin action is required, but user notification is advised. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 403109.

Title: Microsoft Viva Goals: Zapier integration retires September 2024
Summary: The Microsoft Viva Goals integration with Zapier is retiring in September 2024, affecting workflow automation. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed and documentation updated.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Mobile App: Bottom tabs removal and default land to Chat
Summary: Starting early August, Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will remove bottom tab navigation, making Copilot Chat the default for users with access and pinning. Other features move to the hamburger menu. Chat history will be expanded by default. iOS updates begin in August, Android follows. Admins can manage pinning settings.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Mobile App: Removal of Apps section
Summary: Starting early August 2025, the Apps section will be removed from the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app's hamburger menu on iOS and Android. Users can still access apps via desktop, web, or dedicated mobile apps. The update is automatic, requires no admin action, and does not affect permissions.

Title: Outlook: Draft with Copilot Highlight & Rewrite in classic Outlook for Windows
Summary: Outlook's Draft with Copilot feature will be available in late June 2025 for Public Preview and late July 2025 for General Availability. This feature allows users to improve email drafts by highlighting sections and using Copilot to iterate on the text. No preparation is needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support real-time Interpreter agent for up to nine languages, enabling multilingual meetings with voice simulation. Available late August 2026, it requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, includes 20 hours of interpretation monthly, and offers admin controls via Teams meeting policies. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, enabling authorized users to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups dynamically based on dashboard data. The feature rolls out from mid-August to late September 2026, is enabled by default, and can be managed by admins.

Title: SharePoint Pages: Flexible Section Authoring Improvements
Summary: SharePoint Pages will enhance Flexible Sections with visual and persistent layout guides, easier resizing, and the ability to convert standard sections without losing content. These improvements, rolling out worldwide in August 2026, aim to simplify page authoring and ensure consistent layouts across devices. No admin action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual meeting recaps support personalized recap translation
Summary: Microsoft Teams will personalize meeting recaps by displaying them initially in each participant's selected translation or interpretation language, with an option to change languages afterward. This enhances multilingual collaboration and accessibility. The feature rolls out globally from August 2026 and requires no admin action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view in mid-August 2026, aligning it with Windows. Updates include consistent participant tile ratios, video prioritization, stable gallery behavior, and new admin controls. No action is required before rollout; admins can configure settings post-update.

Title: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
Summary: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Migrate to Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy by September 2026 to avoid disruption. Rollout begins August 2026 worldwide; check tenant settings and follow migration guidance.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a meeting" feature starting August 2026, allowing users to report suspicious or malicious activity during meetings. Reports help security teams investigate threats via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center. The feature is enabled by default, with administrative controls and data collection for security investigations.

Title: Use OneDrive-stored user-defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot for Mac will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, allowing users to upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file. These skills appear in Copilot's Skills menu and can be managed individually via a new Manage Skills pane. Rollout starts late July 2026.

Title: Use OneDrive stored user defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (web)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot on the web will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, visible only to the user. Users can upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file and manage skills via a new interface. Rollout starts late July 2026, requiring no admin action but recommending governance and training updates.

Title: Copilot Notebooks: Suggested artifacts for faster content creation
Summary: Copilot Notebooks will proactively suggest relevant Word, Excel, and PowerPoint artifacts based on notebook content and Microsoft 365 context, enhancing content creation without extra prompts. Available by default from late August 2026, no admin setup is needed. Future support will include PDFs and Pages.

Title: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
Summary: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for file paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. Rollout starts mid-August 2026, requiring no admin action but reducing support tickets and troubleshooting time.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
Summary: Microsoft Edge’s upgraded Copilot new tab page integrates Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, web search, and work content into one experience with enhanced chat, compose features, work cards, and a refreshed design. It requires a Copilot license and can be enabled by admins via policy, rolling out from mid-August to mid-September 2026.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: Branded footer customization
Summary: Starting August 2026, admins can add their organization's logo as a branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to confirm a trusted environment. This feature is off by default, requires admin setup in the Microsoft 365 admin center, and applies organization-wide using the default theme logo.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts early September 2026, completing by end of October. Users can enable, disable, or reorder these sections; no admin action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Planner: Task details side pane experience
Summary: Microsoft Planner will introduce a task details side pane by mid-August 2026, allowing users to view and edit tasks without leaving their main view. This feature, enabled by default on web and Teams, supports key task fields, remembers user preferences, and requires no admin action.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Unified data access messages in Microsoft 365 Copilot

Summary: To maintain Calendar functionality in Microsoft Teams mobile on iOS and Android, users must update to the latest Teams app by early October 2026. Older versions will lose calendar access. Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Access your organization's brand templates in PowerPoint
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint will enable users with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) on Windows to access organizational brand templates directly from Backstage starting late August 2026. Summary: Shared and delegate mailbox scheduling for events lets delegates organize events on behalf of leaders using shared or delegated mailboxes, sending invitations from trusted organizational identities. Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing shared display mode and enhanced peripheral detection for BYOD meeting spaces to improve meeting join experience and privacy. Rollout begins late July 2026.
