Title: Microsoft Teams: RTMP-In port and domain changes required
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until December 31, 2026. The feature release is currently paused.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
Summary: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. It includes readiness validation, reporting, and compliance controls. Rollout begins mid-September 2026 (public preview) and late October 2026 (worldwide). No GUI; admin-driven process.

Title: Updates to custom scripting in sites and Classic Publishing site creation
Summary: Starting September 15, 2025, SharePoint Online will disable custom scripting by default on classic publishing sites, block creation of new classic publishing sites, and prevent publishing feature activation. New settings allow site property bag updates without enabling custom scripting. Temporary opt-outs via PowerShell are available until March 15, 2026.

Title: Action required: Retirement of EWS-based Personal Bookings controls (Microsoft Bookings)
Summary: Microsoft is retiring EWS-based controls for Personal Bookings in Microsoft Bookings on August 5, 2026. After that, access will be managed only via OWA Mailbox Policy settings. Administrators must migrate existing EWS configurations to OWA policies before this date to maintain control.

Title: Custom templates in Microsoft Planner
Summary: Microsoft Planner will introduce custom templates in July 2026, enabling users to convert plans into reusable templates shared within Microsoft 365 Groups. This standardizes workflows, improves consistency, and accelerates project creation. Templates include tasks and details, reset progress when reused, and require no admin setup.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Orchestrate conversation distribution with AI-powered playbooks
Summary: We are announcing the ability to orchestrate conversation distribution with AI-powered playbooks in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on August 28, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature actively monitors conversations and automatically takes actions based on playbooks defined using natural language. You can configure playbooks per scenario through guided templates that keep instructions focused and reliable. Built-in validation catches conflicts befo...

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Expiration required for Recommended test mode
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity will require a 60-day expiration period when enabling Recommended test mode starting late July 2025. Admins must manually set this expiration, which limits test duration and restores original alert thresholds after expiry, affecting alerting and integrations but not users directly.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Use Azure Communication Service-based SMS Mobile Numbers
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use Azure Communication Service-based SMS mobile numbers in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on August 1, 2025. How does this affect me? With this feature, Dynamics 365 Contact Center admins can now engage with customers in Australia, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Ireland, Latvia, Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, and the United Kingdom. This feature enables admins to configure the following settings: Provisioning of SMS mobile nu...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service – Set Timer to Wrap Up Cases in Seconds
Summary: We are announcing the ability to set the timer to wrap up cases in seconds in Dynamics 365 Customer Services. This feature will reach general availability on August 30, 2025. How does this affect me? With this feature, you can now set the wrap-up timer in seconds. This feature boosts agent efficiency and cuts down on idle time by giving contact centers precise control over post-conversation workflows. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness and no action is required. If you...

Title: Microsoft Teams: New threaded conversation layout option for channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new threaded conversation layout for channels, enabling side conversations without cluttering the main chat. Rolling out from June to August 2025 across all platforms, users can switch layouts or create new threaded channels, enhancing collaboration and topic-specific discussions.

Title: Meeting Search in MS Teams Desktop
Summary: Microsoft Teams Desktop will not proceed with the planned meeting search update at this time. The update aimed to enhance meeting search and actions via the search bar, but no changes will be made now, and users need not take any action.

Title: Microsoft 365 Backup is now generally available
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup will soon be available, enabling quick restoration of OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online data after cyberattacks. It's accessible in the Microsoft admin center, requires a Microsoft Azure subscription, and will roll out from July 31st to mid-August 2024. No admin action is needed for the rollout.

Title: Rewrite in Microsoft Edge
Summary: Microsoft Edge introduced a new feature, Rewrite, which aids in editing text. It's enabled by default with commercial data protection for eligible users. No action is needed, but policies are available to manage this feature's allowance or restriction. Apologies were made for any confusion caused by its rollout.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Admins can no longer receive user passwords in email as of August 30, 2024
Summary: Starting August 30, 2024, the 'Send password in email' feature will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Admins should use the 'Print' option to securely share user account details. No action is required from admins for this change.

Title: Upload or add a custom skill with Copilot in PowerPoint (Web)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot users can upload and create personal custom skills directly within PowerPoint (Web), stored in their OneDrive for tailored use. This feature, rolling out worldwide from late July to early August 2026, requires no admin action but may need internal process updates.

Title: Add and upload your custom skills to OneDrive from within PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot on Mac will let users create, upload, and manage personal custom skills directly within the app, saving them to their OneDrive for personal use. This feature rolls out worldwide from late July to early August 2026, requiring no immediate admin action.

Title: Microsoft Whiteboard: Retirement of legacy whiteboards and transition to OneDrive-backed whiteboards
Summary: Microsoft Whiteboard is retiring legacy whiteboards and the standalone app by September 2026. Enterprise users must migrate legacy whiteboards to OneDrive-backed versions before August 22, 2026. After September 5, legacy whiteboards will be deleted permanently, and the standalone app will be deprecated by September 14.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Participant Detail audit records will be available in all participating (non-organizer) tenants
Summary: Starting late August 2026, Microsoft Teams will share Meeting Participant Detail audit records with all participating tenants for their own users in cross-tenant meetings, enhancing audit visibility while maintaining data boundaries. No action is required, but admins may review audit processes accordingly.

Title: Follow up to IT1431577: Recommended update KB5101684 Preview for Windows devices
Summary: The message recommends installing the Windows cumulative update KB5101684 Preview to fully remediate the issue from IT1431577. This update provides a client fix and platform improvements. Organizations should deploy this update following their usual update and validation procedures.

Title: Add and upload your custom skills to OneDrive from within PowerPoint Copilot (Desktop)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot users can now create, upload, and manage personal custom skills directly within PowerPoint, with these skills saved to their OneDrive for individual use. This feature rolls out globally from late July to early August 2026 and requires no immediate admin action.

Title: Microsoft Planner: Start date and due date are no longer constrained
Summary: Microsoft Planner now allows start dates and due dates to be set independently, removing the previous constraint that due dates must follow start dates. This update, rolling out mid-July to mid-August 2026, affects all Planner users and may require updates to apps or workflows relying on automatic date adjustments.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting notes now available for instant meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports meeting notes for instant meetings via Loop components, enabling collaborative agendas, notes, and task creation synced with Planner and To Do. Rollout occurs April to August 2026 across environments. Notes appear in a side pane and Recap tab, with default company shareable links unless set otherwise. No admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced peripheral data in Pro Management portal reports for BYOD spaces
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing peripheral health reporting in the Pro Management portal for BYOD rooms and desks, enabling admins to detect device issues proactively. Room reports require a Teams Shared Devices license; desk reports are in public preview. Rollout begins late June 2026, completing by early August.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to open message links in a new window on desktop (Windows and Mac) starting July 2026, enhancing multitasking by viewing linked content side by side. The feature is enabled by default, requires no policy changes, and no user action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics – Manager role license requirement update for team views
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights Copilot Analytics will remove the Viva Insights license requirement for managers to access team views starting mid-July 2026. Eligible managers and delegates will gain access based on admin settings, enabling broader adoption without immediate action required from organizations.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Automatically display automapped calendars
Summary: Starting late May to mid-August 2026, users will automatically see automapped calendars when switching between classic and new Outlook for Windows. This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and improves calendar access previously unavailable during toggling. Notify users and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Change in accessing additional agents in Excel
Summary: Starting August 2026, Excel users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses can access additional Copilot agents via the "…" menu in the header. The chat-only Copilot experience remains unchanged. No admin action is needed, but support teams should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams introduces a Facilitator feature with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) that detects knowledge gaps in meetings, performs web searches, and posts relevant answers in chat to improve productivity. It requires manual enabling, supports standard meetings, and includes admin controls for configuration and compliance.

Title: Microsoft new Outlook for Windows and Outlook for the web: Changing how to disable/enable
Summary: Microsoft updated guidance on disabling Outlook for the web without affecting Outlook for Windows. Admins can use Conditional Access policies to block Outlook for the web while keeping Outlook for Windows enabled. No policy changes or preparation are needed; updated support articles provide detailed instructions.

Title: Dynamics 365 Marketing – The public IP addresses of Dynamics 365 Marketing service are updating
Summary: The public IP addresses of Dynamics 365 Marketing services in all regions are being updated. These new IPs are already available for allowlisting, and Dynamics 365 Marketing services will begin using them beginning August 4, 2025. How does this affect me? If you use custom analytics, as detailed in Prepare for analytic reporting with Power BI, and restrict access to your storage accounts by firewall rules using IP addresses, you will be affected by the change. If your custom analytics meet these...

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Retirement of role-to-skill mapping files in People Skills
Summary: Starting August 22, 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will retire role-to-skill mapping files in People Skills. Skills inferencing will no longer use these files but will continue identifying custom skills automatically. No action or migration is needed; administrators should update documentation and inform relevant staff.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Optimizations for passkey registration experience
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID is optimizing passkey registration via Registration Campaign, Authentication Strengths, and My Sign-Ins to improve compliance with passkey policies and prioritize local device passkeys. These changes, rolling out in late August 2026, require no user interface changes or action from organizations.

Title: Viva Engage: New Recent feed in Home
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is adding a new Recent feed in Home for a chronological view of content from followed communities, people, and priority communications, complementing the existing For you feed. This update rolls out worldwide from early to late August 2026, requires no admin action, and preserves user preferences across platforms.

Title: Microsoft 365 Admin agent is now generally available for all admins
Summary: The Microsoft 365 Admin agent is now generally available for all Microsoft Entra built-in administrators, offering AI-powered natural language management across Microsoft 365 admin center and Copilot Chat. It respects role-based access controls, requires admin approval for changes, and can be restricted or monitored via admin center settings.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center - Usage reports: Agent usage (preview)
Summary: A new Microsoft 365 admin center usage report for Copilot Chat agents is in preview, showing active users, agents, usage details, and segmentation by license and creator type. It replaces the previous report, covers up to 30 days, and will roll out globally by end of July 2026 with no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Policy recommendation panel in IRM
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will introduce a policy recommendation panel by late 2026 to identify gaps and suggest policies for insider risk protection. Enabled by default, it uses analytics and AI to enhance coverage without changing existing workflows. No action is required, but reviewing recommendations is advised.

Title: Microsoft Teams: AI meeting recap without transcript to meet compliance policies
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out an AI meeting recap feature that generates summaries without saving transcripts or recordings, supporting compliance policies. Available from October 2026 for M365 Copilot users, admins control AI settings tenant-wide, and organizers can enable or disable recaps before or during meetings.

Title: MDO Encrypted email attachment protection
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce an opt-in Safe Attachments policy to quarantine emails with password-protected attachments that cannot be scanned. Administrators can control release, users can self-release with passwords, and the feature supports various file types. Rollout begins August 2026 worldwide.

Title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Remove image background from videos
Summary: Microsoft Clipchamp will soon allow users to make image backgrounds transparent in videos without losing quality. This feature will be available to all users, with rollouts starting late July 2024 and completing by mid-August 2024. No admin action is required for the update.

Title: Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Microsoft 365 Groups scoping in Teams DLP policy extend protection to 1:1/n chats
Summary: Microsoft 365 Groups in Teams DLP policy will now automatically include 1:1 and group chats for protection, without needing to add users or groups manually, except when using OCR. Rollout begins late August 2024, with completion by late September 2024. Admins should review their Teams DLP policies in preparation.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention for endpoint: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for Mac devices
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention for Mac devices will now include OCR to detect sensitive content in images. Public Preview starts mid-May 2024, with General Availability in early June 2024. Users with specific roles can configure OCR settings in the Purview compliance portal. Charges apply for OCR usage.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: New content pane for Pages and News
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing a new content pane for Pages and News, enhancing tools for authors with features like distribution channel selection and audience selection. It will start rolling out in July 2024, with no admin action required for the update.

Title: Purview compliance portal | eDiscovery: Compliance boundary cmdlet tool to manage compliance boundary property
Summary: The message details an upcoming feature in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal: a new cmdlet, 'Invoke-ComplianceSecurityFilterAction', for managing compliance boundary properties for mailboxes and sites. It is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap IDs 397091 and 398451, with rollout starting early August 2024 and completing by late August 2024. The feature will simplify compliance management and is off by default. Organizations are advised to review the cmdlet documentation and prepare compl...

Title: Power Automate – View a Power Automate visual in a Power BI report announcement
Summary: We are announcing the general availability of the View a Power Automate visual in a Power BI report feature. How does this affect me? When enabled, this will allow your users to embed and run a flow from a PowerBI report or dashboard. What do I need to do to prepare? This message is for awareness and no action is required. If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Create a Power Automate visual for Power BI.

Title: Microsoft Places Management web portal
Summary: Microsoft is launching the Microsoft Places Management web portal in August 2025, replacing PowerShell scripts with a user-friendly interface for managing buildings, floors, rooms, and desks. Accessible to specific admin roles by default, it offers hierarchical views, filtering, and editing based on permissions, with no setup needed.

Title: Support for different modes for desks
Summary: Microsoft Places will support four desk modes—Unavailable, Assigned, Reservable, and Drop-in—allowing admins to better manage desk availability. Rollout begins mid-August 2025. Admins should review and update desk configurations, documentation, and communicate changes using PowerShell or the new Places Management portal.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New filters and sorting for attendance reports
Summary: Microsoft Teams attendance reports will gain new filters to set minimum attendee counts and enhanced sorting by date and time, improving report efficiency. The update rolls out worldwide on August 18, 2025, and for GCCH/DoD on August 31, 2025, available by default on Windows and macOS with no action needed.

Title: Project Manager Agent – SP site grounding
Summary: The Project Manager agent in Planner will preview a feature using encrypted SharePoint files for improved task creation and execution. New Plans enable this by default; existing Plans require manual activation. Tasks from encrypted files become unencrypted for export. Rollout starts late July 2025, completing late August 2025.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Collection Policies: Scope classifiers and activity
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces collection policies for granular control over data signals collected on Windows endpoints, enhancing targeted discovery without enforcement actions. This affects multiple Purview solutions and requires enabling DLP Always audit. Rollout begins late July for Gov Clouds, with no immediate impact until configured.

Title: Microsoft Intune In Development for August 2025 is now available
Summary: The Microsoft Intune In Development page for August 2025 has been updated with upcoming features to help organizations prepare. IT staff and helpdesk should be informed, and user guidance updated as needed. Changes will begin appearing within the next month or later releases.

Title: Power Apps – Generative Pages feature available for preview
Summary: We are announcing the public preview of Generative Pages. This new capability allows admins to simplify the app design process for model-drive apps using AI. This feature began rolling out to North America on July 22, 2025, and will become available in other regions at a later date. How does this affect me? Generative Pages enable makers to describe their page needs in natural language and generate fully structured pages automatically. The system uses AI to produce React code that powers both th...

Title: Microsoft Viva: A new reactions design in Viva Engage
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage planned a new interactive reactions design across web, Teams, Outlook apps, and emails. However, rollout is paused after review. No changes to reaction icons or data handling. The update requires no admin action, and user notification is recommended. General availability will be announced later.

Title: Updates to SharePoint video sharing
Summary: SharePoint now auto-generates secure sharing links for videos on pages or news posts, improving accessibility for users without site access. New dialogs offer control over creating shareable links or copying videos. The feature is on by default, rolling out from mid-July to early August 2025.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for July 2025
Summary: The Microsoft Intune service update for July 2025 is now live with a new service build. The release number will appear in the Tenant Status blade. Users should review the latest features and updates on the Intune What's New and service update blogs to prepare.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for July 2024
Summary: The Microsoft Intune Service Update for July 2024 has been released, updating your account to the latest build. You'll notice the update in the Tenant Status blade soon. Prepare by reviewing the new features in the latest Intune What's New 2407(July) Blog and the Microsoft Intune Service Updates Blog.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Intelligent recap integration
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook will integrate an AI-powered Intelligent recap feature from Microsoft Teams, allowing users to access AI-generated meeting notes and tasks directly from the Outlook calendar. This feature is available for new Outlook for Windows and the web, with full access depending on license status. Rollout begins mid-August 2024.

Title: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
Summary: Microsoft 365 will default-display 11 profile card properties (e.g., Division, Role, Employee number) when populated, starting late August 2026. Admins can review and hide properties via Microsoft Graph API before rollout. Visibility remains manageable post-rollout through the admin center.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management triage agent summaries available in Microsoft Defender
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management triage agent summaries will appear in Microsoft Defender alerts, providing AI-generated insights to streamline investigations. This feature rolls out from mid-August to December 2026, enabling easier alert review without changing existing configurations. No action is needed if prerequisites are met.

Title: Microsoft Purview Data loss prevention: debug tools activity now visible in managed app rules
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now visibly shows developer tools protection in managed app rules for Microsoft Edge for Business, improving admin transparency without changing enforcement. This update rolls out worldwide from mid-August to early September 2026. No user impact or required action; admins should update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Export files as PDF
Summary: The planned OneDrive "Export as PDF" feature, allowing users to convert Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to PDF within OneDrive, will not be rolled out at this time. It requires appropriate permissions and IRM settings, and will be enabled by default when available.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Agent catalog available in the App Store in Teams, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Outlook
Summary: Microsoft is rolling out enhanced agent discovery in the App Store for Teams, Microsoft 365, and Outlook by late July 2025. Users can view all organizational agents regardless of Copilot license, but installation depends on eligibility. No admin action is needed; admins can manage agent access via Microsoft 365 admin center.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Platform migration for enhanced data storage and performance
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is migrating its data platform to improve performance, scalability, and data consistency across investigation and hunting tools. Phase 1 completed in June 2025; Phase 2 targets December 2025. Users may see slight data delays or brief loading issues, but no admin action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Browser access will be enabled by default for all Android users
Summary: Microsoft Entra will enable browser access by default for all Android users, retiring the "Enable Browser Access" feature in Microsoft Authenticator and Company Portal apps. This hardware-bound device registration change requires no admin action and will roll out automatically worldwide. Organizations not using Android can ignore this update.

Title: Outlook for iOS and Android | Browse conversation files
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android now features a "Browse Files" button in conversation threads (with "Newest on Top" view) to quickly access all classic attachments. This mobile-only feature rolled out worldwide in July 2025, requires no admin setup, and excludes OneDrive or SharePoint links.

Title: Power Automate – Use undo and redo while you build cloud flows in the designer announcement
Summary: We are announcing the Use undo and redo while you build cloud flows in the designer feature. This feature allows you to build flows with Copilot, or experiment knowing that you can undo any of your actions. This feature will reach general availability on August 25, 2024. How does this affect me? When enabled, this feature will allow you to undo a change you make to your flow manually or through Copilot. If you change your mind and want to return it to your flow, you can use redo to bring back th...

Title: Power Automate – Select instead of type email addresses in Outlook and Teams announcement
Summary: We are announcing the select instead of type email addresses in Outlook and Teams feature. This feature allows you to choose from email suggestions as you are typing email address in Outlook and Teams action 'To' field. This feature will reach general availability on August 5, 2024. How does this affect me? When enabled, this feature allows you to choose from suggestions as you are typing email address in Outlook and Teams action 'To' field. What do I need to do to prepare? This message is for a...

Title: Power Automate – View two action properties panes simultaneously announcement
Summary: We are announcing the view two action properties panes simultaneously feature. This feature allows you to view two action properties panes simultaneously, facilitating copying and moving values, comparing the properties across two actions, and taking a screenshot of the flow. This feature will reach general availability on September 1, 2024. How does this affect me? When enabled, this feature will allow you to pin an action properties pane, which allows you to open another action pane side-by-si...

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Capture voice notes in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app introduces a Record feature to capture voice notes and conversations, providing AI-generated transcripts and summaries in Copilot Chat. Available from late August 2026, recordings are stored in OneDrive with enterprise-grade security and compliance, governed by existing Microsoft 365 policies.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Join by code requires owner approval for private teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will require owner approval for users joining private teams via join codes starting late August 2026. Users can still generate and enter codes, but owners must approve requests. Public teams remain unaffected. No admin action is needed, but owners should be informed and monitor requests.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Passwordless password change in My Sign-Ins
Summary: Microsoft Entra will enable passwordless users to change their passwords via My Sign-Ins using strong credentials like passkeys or Windows Hello, without knowing the current password or using SSPR. This feature, disabled by default, requires admin activation and will roll out globally in late October 2026.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Insert signature images from OneDrive
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will allow users to insert signature images directly from OneDrive starting late August 2026. This feature, enabled by default, enhances signature editing without changing existing signatures or OneDrive experience and requires no admin setup. No action is needed, but informing support staff is recommended.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Information regarding the end of support for Customer Intent Agent in Voice
Summary: On July 17, 2026, the Customer Intent Agent in Voice feature in Dynamics 365 Contact Center reached end of support. How does this affect me? Voice interactions that previously relied on this feature for AI-driven customer intent detection will no longer benefit from its capabilities, and no new data will be generated by this feature following the end-of-support date. What action do I need to take? We have developed the Realtime Voice capability of the Customer Assist Agent, which is our recommen...

Title: Viva Engage: Community feeds improvements
Summary: Viva Engage communities will default to viewing conversations by recent posts instead of recent activity starting September 2026. The new view is optional, on by default, includes unread indicators in all feeds, and preserves user preferences across communities. No action or compliance changes are needed.

Title: Power Apps - Entity scoping in global search
Summary: We are announcing entity scoping in global search in Power Apps. This feature will reach public preview on August 7, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, users can now scope global search results by table in model-driven apps, allowing for narrowing of results to one or more relevant tables as needed. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Power Apps - Multi Select in Grid column filtering
Summary: We are announcing Multi Select in Grid column filtering in Power Apps. This feature will reach public preview on August 7, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, users can now filter records using fields that support multiple selected values in model-driven apps. When a list includes this type of field, users can apply filters based on one or more values to refine the records shown. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys - Enable advanced personalization using simple formulas
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable advanced personalization using simple formulas to modify text, dates, and numbers in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. This feature will reach public preview on August 7, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to enhance personalization by transforming data directly within your messages using PowerFx expressions. Standardize customer names, format dates and numbers for different regions, and perform simple calculations such as day...

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting July 22nd, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Drag and drop files between accounts as attachments
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will allow users to drag and drop emails and files as attachments between personal or enterprise accounts, starting mid-August 2025 for Targeted Release and mid-October 2025 for General Availability. This requires the ItemsToOtherAccountsEnabled setting in OwaMailboxPolicy.

Title: Microsoft Fabric: Removing default contributor access for Workspace Identity
Summary: Microsoft Fabric will remove default Contributor access from Workspace Identities starting late July 2025 to enhance security. Existing and new Workspace Identities will no longer have this access by default. Admins can manually assign roles via RBAC. No action is required before rollout, but review current configurations.

Title: Microsoft Viva Connections: New Engage card in Connections dashboard
Summary: Microsoft paused the rollout of the new "Stay Engaged" Engage feed card in the Viva Connections dashboard. When available, it allows users to interact with Viva Engage feeds via Teams. The card auto-adds in default dashboards if Viva Engage is enabled; configured dashboards require manual addition by editors.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Updated submission results in ThreatSubmissionAPI
Summary: The message details updates to Microsoft Defender for Office 365's ThreatSubmissionAPI, enhancing submission results for better clarity and actionability. These updates apply to email, Teams messages, attachments, URLs, and user reports. The API remains in beta, with a global release date to be announced. Rollout starts early August 2024. Users should check their API setup for necessary changes.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Users will now be notified when their admin unblocks a requested app
Summary: Microsoft Teams users will be notified when an admin unblocks a requested app, with the rollout timeline updated to mid-July through late August 2024. This change requires no admin action and is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 389151.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Approvals Graph APIs public preview
Summary: The Microsoft Teams feature update offers a public preview of Approvals Graph APIs in the Approvals app, enabling developers to create and manage approvals programmatically. The rollout begins late July 2024 and completes by late August 2024, with no admin action required. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 393926.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Blanket custom retention policies which apply to all Audit recordTypes
Summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal is updating custom retention policies for all Audit recordTypes. The rollout includes enhancements to the Share-in-Meeting control, allowing users to share content to future Teams meetings and combining it with the Share to Teams dialog. Developers can opt into these features, which will be available on Teams for Windows, the web, and Mac. Rollout timelines have been updated, with Public Developer Preview in early June, Targeted Release in late August, and...

Title: Outlook Mobile: New in-app Contact editor
Summary: Outlook Mobile is rolling out a new Contact editor, replacing the device's native editor. This will allow organizations to enforce Intune policies related to contact creation and editing, and reduce the dependency on Contact Syncing. The rollout will happen automatically by late July 2024, with no admin action required. Users may want to update their documentation and review their existing Intune policies.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: New recommendations for Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity will introduce new recommendations to Microsoft Secure Score, enhancing security posture accuracy. These recommendations include Azure SSO account configurations and actions for Microsoft Entra Connect accounts. Rollout starts mid-August 2024, completing by mid-September 2024, with no admin action required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Graph Connector: Connection statistics for Admins
Summary: The message discusses the introduction of Connection statistics for admins in Microsoft Graph Connector, providing insights into crawled and indexed items. It will be available in Public Preview and General Availability from late June to late July 2024. No preparation is needed for this update.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Split view in Month view
Summary: Outlook will introduce a Split view in Month view for multiple calendars, starting early June 2024 and completing by early August 2024. This feature will be available by default and requires no admin action, but users should be informed of the change.

Title: Microsoft Purview portal: Enhanced global Search
Summary: The Microsoft Purview portal will soon introduce an enhanced global Search feature, allowing users to search for organizational profiles, including names, email addresses, role groups, and admin units. This update, associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap IDs 396570 and 396571, will start rolling out in mid-July 2024 and is expected to complete by early October 2024. No admin action is required for this automatic rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Reverting single capturing group enforcement for custom SIT regex
Summary: Microsoft Purview is reverting the enforcement of the single capturing group limit for custom Sensitive Information Type regexes, allowing multiple top-level capturing groups again. This change, effective late July 2026, requires no immediate action but recommends reviewing and updating regexes to a single capturing group where possible.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting July 22nd, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this latest...

Title: Microsoft Viva: New support for branded themes and typography in Viva Amplify
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify now supports custom themes and fonts from SharePoint’s Brand Center, enabling branded, consistent communications across channels. Default SharePoint themes apply automatically, with options to override. Custom fonts require deployment via endpoint management. Rollout begins mid-July 2025, with no tenant-level disable controls.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive: Apply watermark to PDFs
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint will soon allow users to add text or image watermarks to PDFs, with options for customization and positioning. The rollout will start in late June 2025 and complete by late July 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: New Delegation feature
Summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse will introduce a new delegation feature in mid-August 2025, allowing users to assign delegates to manage Pulse surveys on their behalf. This feature supports roles like executive assistants and chiefs of staff. Delegation is enabled by default and can be managed at various levels. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Copilot: Access SharePoint agents in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
Summary: Access recently used SharePoint agents directly within the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, starting mid-September 2025. This feature aims to reduce context switching and improve productivity. Admins can manage agents by deleting the corresponding .agent files. Update training materials and review SharePoint agent management practices.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft 365 Copilot view in Data Security Posture Management for AI
Summary: Microsoft Purview will include a page in Data Security Posture Management for AI to show protection capabilities and usage for Microsoft 365 Copilot. This feature will roll out in mid-2025, with public preview in June and general availability in July. No admin action is required.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook and Outlook for the web: Admin setting for inheriting a S/MIME signature on reply
Summary: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows desktop will support an admin setting to define S/MIME signature inheritance in replies, rolling out from late July to late August 2025. The setting, NoSignOnReply, can be configured to inherit or not inherit S/MIME signatures. This change does not apply to Outlook for Web. No admin action is required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Download town hall and webinar Q&As to CSV
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow town hall and webinar organizers to download Q&A sessions as CSV files. This feature will be globally available from mid-August to early September 2024 and will be accessible by default on Teams for Desktop on PC and Mac. Organizers can access the report under the 'Reports' section after the event. No admin action is required for this rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify: Updated authoring options in the content pane
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify is updating authoring options, consolidating features into the content pane, and enhancing navigation. Rollout starts end of July 2024, with completion by late August 2024. No admin action needed; users should be informed and training updated.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify: Updated authoring for distribution channels (Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Outlook)
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify is updating its authoring experience for Outlook and Teams distribution channels, aiming for a consistent and improved editor interface. This includes faster load times and a unified audience selection process. Rollout starts early August 2024 and should complete by late August 2024.

Title: Outlook: Choose how many days of emails sync to your iOS or Android device for offline usage
Summary: Outlook now allows users to select the number of days to sync emails for offline access on iOS or Android devices. Refer to MC798682 for updates. Emails and attachments are stored as cache, and users cannot choose the storage location. This change offers users more control and offline access flexibility. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID: 189809. Organizations should update training accordingly, with a current 90-day sync limit.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Introducing slash commands in the compose box
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing new slash commands for composing messages and navigating Teams, with a rollout starting mid-May 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-June 2024 for General Availability. No admin action is required, but informing users is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting details displayed on pre-join screen
Summary: Microsoft Teams for Windows and Mac will display meeting details such as the title, start and end time, and number of participants on the pre-join screen for in-tenant participants. The rollout will begin in late April 2024 and will not require any admin action. External guests will not see these details.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Access work, school, and personal accounts in a single desktop app
Summary: Starting in April 2024, Microsoft Teams desktop app on Windows and Mac will allow users to access any type of Teams account (work, school, or personal) and admins can control their users' sign-in capabilities with group policies. Users will be able to add and access their additional accounts in the upper right corner of Teams by selecting their profile picture. Teams personal account users can connect and collaborate with the people and groups in their life through Communities in Teams by adding...

Title: New Microsoft Outlook: New Search filters
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook will introduce search filters such as All, Mail, Files, Teams, and People, with a rollout timeline updated to mid-August through mid-October 2024. This feature will be available by default for new Outlook for Desktop and the web users. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams devices: Cancel device operations through the Teams admin center
Summary: Soon, Microsoft Teams device admins will be able to cancel device operations from the Teams admin center. This feature will be available for Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Phones, Displays, and Panels, providing greater control over devices. Rollout will occur from early July to mid-September 2024.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify: Access to most recent templates
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify is updating template access. User-created templates will appear in the first three positions on the campaign overview page, with the most recent template first. Additional templates can be managed under 'View all templates.' Rollout began mid-June 2024 and will complete by early August2024. This update is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 398978.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Manage Do Not Disturb presence status when screen sharing
Summary: The update introduces a user setting in Microsoft Teams to prevent automatic Do Not Disturb (DND) activation during screen sharing, providing flexibility to receive notifications while presenting. Rollout begins June 2024, not available to GCC customers yet. No admin action required, but user notification is advised. Roadmap ID 393228.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Offline support for mail actions and compose
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will introduce offline capabilities, allowing users to view mail, calendar events, and contacts, as well as perform key email actions and compose new emails without an internet connection. This feature will start rolling out in late June 2024 and is expected to complete by late July 2024. Users can adjust offline settings, and no action is required to prepare for this rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Message reactions in right-click menu
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to react to messages directly from the right-click menu. This feature will be available in Teams for web and desktop, starting with a Public Preview in early June 2024 and General Availability in mid-June 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Power Automate – New Excel actions in Power Automate for desktop announcement
Summary: We are announcing new Excel actions in Power Automate for desktop. Starting on July 23, 2024, the actions pane will include the following dedicated Excel actions:Copy Excel worksheetRead formula from ExcelGet table range from Excel worksheetAuto fill cells in Excel worksheetAppend cells in Excel worksheetLookup range in Excel worksheetSet color of cells in Excel worksheetHow does this affect me? These actions provide new capabilities empowering makers to enhance their desktop flows involving Exc...

Title: Outlook for Mac: Paragraph options for composing emails
Summary: Outlook for Mac will introduce enhanced paragraph formatting options, including a new Paragraph Options pane for precise alignment, indentation, and spacing control. The update, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from mid to late July 2026, improving email composition without requiring user action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Recap app consolidates meeting recaps in one place
Summary: The Microsoft Teams Recap app centralizes meeting recaps with recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries, improving productivity. Available from early July 2026, it supports filtering, audio/video recaps, and 30-day browsing. AI features require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license; the app is pre-installed but not pinned by default.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Test microphone and speaker before joining a meeting
Summary: Microsoft Teams will add a default feature allowing users to test their microphone and speaker on the pre-join screen before meetings, reducing audio issues. Rollout begins May 2026, completing by August 2026 across all environments. No admin action is required, but internal updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enhance Direct Guest Join media quality, supporting up to 16 videos in a 4×4 grid and improved simulcast streaming for Zoom, Google Meet, and Cisco devices. Rollout starts mid-May 2026, completes by early August, enabled by default with no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots attempting to join meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. This feature, rolling out mid-2026, includes new admin policies for managing bots and aims to enhance meeting security and compliance.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window, reducing disruption. Rollout begins May 2025 (Targeted Release) and completes by August 2026 (GCC High, DoD). No admin action is needed; user notification is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
Summary: Microsoft Purview’s Data Security Investigations now includes endpoint DLP events as a queryable source, enabling admins to analyze related files automatically. Rollout begins June 2026 (preview) and August 2026 (general availability). No user impact; admins can prepare by reviewing and updating workflows accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine action for SharePoint and OneDrive
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a File Quarantine action for SharePoint and OneDrive, isolating files that violate policies in an admin-controlled site with a tombstone file replacing the original. Rolling out from mid-April to July 2026, it requires admin configuration and manual file restoration.

Title: Copilot Notebooks now supports Markdown (.md) files as grounding sources
Summary: Copilot Notebooks now support Markdown (.md) files as reference sources, enabling grounding in technical docs without conversion. This feature, rolling out worldwide by early August 2026, requires no admin setup, respects existing permissions, and enhances Copilot’s response relevance using Markdown content. No user action is needed.

Title: M365 and Microsoft Teams: Unified management of app and agent availability in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
Summary: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers to ensure consistent settings. The rollout starts September 2025 and completes by September 2026 in phases, enabling synchronized management and installation of apps from either admin center.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Governance for built-in agents in the Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams now offers a dedicated governance experience in the Teams admin center to manage built-in agents like Channel Agent, Facilitator, and Copilot Agent separately from traditional apps. This improves admin control, policy precision, and AI governance, with rollout completed by mid-July 2026.

Title: Planner tab support for Shared and Private Channels in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Planner tabs will be available in Microsoft Teams Shared and Private channels starting late August 2026, allowing users to create or add plans within these channels. Only basic plans are supported initially, with no admin setup needed. Planner inherits channel permissions and stores data in the channel’s SharePoint.

Title: Auto upgrade of shared calendars from legacy MAPI model to modern REST model
Summary: Microsoft is auto-upgrading shared calendars in Outlook and Exchange Online from the legacy MAPI model to a modern REST model, improving sync reliability and performance. The seamless, server-side rollout begins August 2026 for GCC High/DoD tenants, requires no user action, preserves permissions, and excludes events older than one year.

Title: New Outlook for Windows and Web: Outlook Newsletters – General Availability begins for Targeted Release
Summary: Outlook Newsletters, enabling users to create recurring internal email updates, moves to General Availability in mid-2025 with default opt-out activation. Admins can control access via Set-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet. Organizations should review policies and prepare support teams for this new communication feature.

Title: Power Apps – Agent builder in Power Apps
Summary: We are announcing the ability to create custom AI agents by using existing knowledge, logic, and actions in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on August 15, 2025. How does this affect me? Agent builder in Power Apps gives you a fast and convenient way to bring your apps into the agentic era by building agents directly within Power Apps Studio with a streamlined Copilot Studio experience. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness and no action is required....

Title: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling for Microsoft Azure Storage and Azure SQL
Summary: Auto-labeling for Microsoft Azure Storage and Azure SQL has paused its GA release. It allows extending sensitivity labels to various Azure and non-M365 data sources via auto-labeling policies. Public preview was planned for July 2025. Admins can configure labeling by default; some older labeling methods will be deprecated.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
Summary: Microsoft Purview extends data loss prevention to the network layer via integration with Entra Internet Access, enabling inspection and protection of sensitive data in AI interactions and cloud services. It supports policy enforcement, alerts, and auditing, with rollout from July to October 2026, affecting Purview, Entra, and Defender administrators.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New Events templates with "Optimize for large audience" and policy-based behavior
Summary: Microsoft Teams is adding an "Optimize for large audience" option in new Events templates to support events over 1,000 attendees with a town hall experience, respecting CsTeamsEventsPolicy settings. Rollout begins early June 2026, with no action required unless policy adjustments are needed.

Title: Notebooks in the M365 Copilot App
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce Notebooks in early August 2026, enabling users with a Copilot license to organize chats, content, and references in a persistent workspace synced with OneNote. Existing OneNote Notebooks remain unchanged, and no admin action is required.

Title: PowerPoint for the web: One‑click “Review Presentation” and “Visualize Slide” Copilot skills in the ribbon
Summary: PowerPoint for the web introduces one-click Copilot buttons—“Review Presentation” and “Visualize Slide”—in the ribbon to enhance presentation quality and visual storytelling. Rolling out worldwide by early July 2026, these features require Copilot licensing and image generation enabled by admins, with no additional user setup needed.

Title: Power Apps - Use streamlined header and navigation for better viewing
Summary: We are announcing the release of the streamlined header and navigation experience for app shell, form pages, and view pages within the Power Apps website. This feature will reach general availability on August 15, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature includes a refreshed header and navigation experience across the app shell, form pages, and view pages. This update improves visual clarity, reduces vertical space usage, and aligns with modern Microsoft 365 design patterns. This refreshed ex...

Title: Surveys agent retirement and transition to Copilot in Microsoft Forms
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. Existing surveys and conversation history remain accessible, with no licensing changes or admin actions required. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Known issue affecting screen sharing on macOS
Summary: Microsoft Teams on macOS (versions earlier than Tahoe 26.4) has a known screen sharing issue causing blank screens, interruptions, or failures. In-product guidance will roll out by mid-August 2026. Users should update macOS to 26.4 or later or enable "Use Mac OS native sharing" in Teams settings.

Title: Web content setting in Microsoft 365 Copilot expands across Copilot experiences and moves to Settings
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Web content setting moves to Settings for consistent control across Copilot and Copilot Chat in Work and Web experiences. Rolling out mid-July 2026, it offers persistent user preferences, respects admin policies, requires no action, and expands user control where web search is allowed.

Title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels to identify in-room participants by name and show contact cards for remote attendees, enhancing hybrid meetings. The feature rolls out worldwide in September 2026, requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, and uses enrolled voice and face recognition, enabling automatic labeling with admin controls.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Configure organization policy link for blocked Copilot Chat users
Summary: Starting July 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will let admins add a custom policy link for users blocked from Copilot Chat, providing organization-specific guidance. This feature is optional, configurable via the admin center, and does not change existing access policies. No action is required.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Self-service password reset CAPTCHA protection updated
Summary: Microsoft Entra is replacing legacy CAPTCHA in self-service password reset with backend throttling and behavior-based abuse detection to enhance security and accessibility. The rollout starts early August 2026, requires no user or admin action, and maintains current password reset functionality without introducing new controls.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive OneDrive and SharePoint files to Microsoft 365 Archive. Archived content remains compliant and discoverable but is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, requiring admin configuration.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Domain exclusion for web grounding
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now offers Domain Exclusion, allowing admins to exclude up to 1,000 domains from web grounding to ensure responses align with organizational policies. Available worldwide from mid-July 2026, this feature requires admin configuration and affects Copilot web grounding scenarios.

Title: Classic Outlook: Retirement of people card expanded view
Summary: The retirement of the people card expanded view in Classic Outlook is paused. When implemented, only the standard contact card will be available, removing features like local time and "works with." Users needing those features should use Outlook on the web or New Outlook. No admin action is required.

Title: (Update)Microsoft Entra ID: General Availability of passkey profiles and migration for existing Passkeys (FIDO2) tenants
Summary: Starting March 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will GA passkey profiles and synced passkeys for tenants with Passkeys (FIDO2) enabled. Existing configurations migrate to a Default passkey profile with a new passkeyType property. Automatic migration and registration campaign updates roll out regionally through October 2026.

Title: General Availability: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows
Summary: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows will be generally available from late April 2026, enabling phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in on Windows devices without explicit opt-in. This supports corporate, personal, and shared devices, with admin controls via Authentication Methods policies and Conditional Access. No action is needed unless blocking is desired.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone)
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) will add a Copilot chat pane with a Summary feature in OneNote Mobile on iPhone, enabling users to generate summaries and ask questions about notes. Rollout starts mid-August 2026, with existing Copilot policies applying; no admin action is required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Business justification for Copilot license requests
Summary: Microsoft rolled back the planned feature requiring business justifications for Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests. Users and admins will not see or use this justification field, and existing license request workflows remain unchanged with no impact on policies or user experience.

Title: End of support for OneDrive sync app on Windows 10 21H2 and earlier
Summary: Microsoft will end OneDrive sync app updates on Windows 10 version 21H2 and earlier starting August 15, 2026. Devices on 22H2 or later will continue receiving updates through October 10, 2028. Organizations should upgrade affected devices and inform users that OneDrive web access remains available.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Q&A in Read Aloud enables real-time voice interactions
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Read Aloud now supports real-time voice Q&A for en-US users starting February 2026, enhancing accessibility and comprehension. This interactive feature requires a Copilot license, is enabled by default, and allows users to toggle between classic and new experiences without admin changes.

Title: GA Rollout for Microsoft Edge management service in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Summary: The Microsoft Edge management service, a new, dedicated and simplified management experience for Microsoft Edge in the Microsoft 365 admin center, is rolling out now for general availability. This tool allows IT admins to manage group policies and extensions with a simplified, intuitive UI. Admins can set policies through toggles and drop-down menus instead of the complexity of configuring JSON values, which helps reduce errors. This solution is another option for managing Edge that lives alongs...

Title: Changes to Topics in Viva Engage
Summary: In February 2024, Viva Engage will simplify its topics model and retire integration with Viva Topics. Premium and management experiences will be removed, but users can still create, edit, and follow topics. Rollout begins August 2024, with all migrations completed by April 2025.

Title: Configuration Change - Microsoft Edge Supported Hardware Requirements
Summary: The message informs that Microsoft Edge will change its hardware requirements, no longer supporting devices without SSE3 starting from version 128. This change will take effect by the end of August 2024, and affected users will need to upgrade their devices to continue receiving updates.

Title: Headspace will no longer be available through Viva Insights
Summary: Headspace content will be removed from Viva Insights on July 25th, 2024, affecting all entry points and experiences. Organizations should prepare by disabling Headspace via PowerShell, assessing the impact, and updating documentation. Breathing exercises will still be available in-app.

Title: Microsoft Teams: External USB Webcams are now supported in Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports external USB webcams for meetings on Apple iPads with iPadOS 17. Rollout will begin late June 2024 and complete by early July 2024. No admin action is required for this update. Users should connect the external webcam before joining a meeting.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Hide presenters, translators, moderators or staff from webinar event page
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow webinar organizers to add individuals with presenter privileges without displaying them on the event page, supporting roles like translators and moderators. This feature will be available on Teams for Windows and the web, rolling out from early August to early September 2024.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android apps: Copy attachments that are not links
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android will soon allow users to copy and paste non-linked attachments directly without saving to device or cloud storage. This feature will roll out from mid-June 2025 to late July 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Autoplay videos in Engage (Muted)
Summary: Videos in Engage will autoplay on mute with captions enabled by default starting late July 2025. Users can enable sound with a click. This update aims to improve content discoverability and engagement. Admins can manage this feature in the Engage admin settings. No action is required unless disabling autoplay.

Title: Microsoft 365 Upcoming Secure by Default Settings Changes
Summary: Microsoft 365 will update default settings to enhance security by blocking legacy authentication protocols and requiring admin consent for third-party app access. Changes start mid-July 2025 and complete by August 2025. Organizations should assess configurations, notify stakeholders, update documentation, and configure the Admin Consent workflow.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: We will disable collection of local administrators' group members (using SAM-R)
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity will disable the remote collection of local administrators' group members using SAM-R queries starting early May 2025. This change will impact the ability to map potential lateral movement paths. No admin action is required unless NTLM is disabled and you need the feature reenabled.

Title: Apps for the web: Grid view for tasks in Microsoft To Do web version and To Do inside Microsoft Outlook
Summary: Users will see tasks in a grid view in Microsoft To Do on the web and within Microsoft Outlook. The rollout starts in late April 2024 and completes by early August 2025. No action is needed, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Self-nomination as a community expert in Viva Engage communities
Summary: Self-nomination for community experts in Viva Engage will be available from early to late July 2025. Members can request to become experts via a new link, and admins can review and manage these requests. Admins can also disable the self-nomination feature if desired. No tenant-level action is required.

Title: Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Outlook
Summary: Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Outlook are delayed. Targeted Release is now planned for late May 2025, and General Availability for early June 2025. Agents will appear in the right-side panel of Outlook, allowing customization. Admins can manage these agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Self-service purchase notifications
Summary: Starting July 2024, Microsoft 365 admins will receive notifications for self-service purchases made by users. This feature provides awareness, actionable insights, and is on by default. Admins can manage or cancel subscriptions and should familiarize themselves with the self-service purchase FAQ and policy. Rollout completes by late August 2024. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Retirement of SharePoint One-Time Passcode (SPO OTP) and transition to Microsoft Entra B2B
Summary: SharePoint One-Time Passcode (SPO OTP) authentication retires in October 2026, transitioning external sharing and authentication to Microsoft Entra B2B. New external sharing uses Entra B2B from May 2026. External users need guest accounts for access; admins should prepare by updating policies and managing guest accounts accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention- DLP to restrict processing external emails in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
Summary: Microsoft Purview is adding a new DLP policy control to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external or untrusted domains. This feature, off by default, will roll out from June 2026 (preview) to early 2027 (general availability) and requires admin configuration.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: AIR Investigation Experience Improvements
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365's AIR experience will add a manual refresh button, replacing auto-refresh, and simplify investigation names by removing email subjects and UPNs. These changes improve performance, reduce network activity, and support data minimization. No admin action is required, but SOC workflows and documentation should be updated.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP will integrate with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability by September 2026. Admins can create granular policies to prevent data leaks to unmanaged cloud apps, managed via Purview and Defender.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is unifying classic alerts and AI-assisted triage into a single alert queue, integrating agent insights directly into the investigation workflow. This improves efficiency, retires Alert Spotlight, and maintains privacy controls. Both experiences remain available for 60 days during transition, with rollout completing by mid-October 2026.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Summarize text columns and generate categories with Copilot
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel will automatically analyze unstructured text columns to generate categories and tags, aiding data analysis like survey responses. Rolling out worldwide mid to late July 2026, it requires no setup, affects licensed users, and maintains existing data compliance and controls.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Collaborate with Copilot while drafting email
Summary: Microsoft Outlook will integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot into the email compose experience by mid-July 2026, enabling licensed users to create and edit emails with AI assistance in real time across multiple platforms. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and maintains existing policies.

Title: Find your group sites faster with the new My Sites tab in OneDrive for iOS
Summary: OneDrive for iOS will add a new My Sites tab by mid-July 2026, showing all group-connected SharePoint sites users own or belong to. This enables easier access to team content without searching or recent activity, with no admin action or permission changes required.

Title: Copilot in Excel: Brand Kit skill
Summary: Copilot in Excel introduces a Brand kit skill that applies organizational branding from Microsoft 365 Brand Center to workbook tables and charts, ensuring consistent, professional reports. Rolling out worldwide from mid-July to mid-August 2026, it requires no action and enhances presentation without altering data.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts and cases
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is enhancing alerts and cases with note-taking capabilities for better investigator collaboration and auditability. Users can add notes, and system-generated notes will track investigation events. Expanded user details and integrated Entra ID profiles improve context. Rollout begins late June 2026.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Meeting Insight is retiring
Summary: Microsoft is retiring Outlook's Meeting Insights by early September 2026, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot's meeting preparation features for licensed users. Meeting Insights will be removed across platforms, with no action required but recommended communication, documentation updates, and user training. No compliance issues noted.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive will allow administrators to exclude specific folders (e.g., node_modules, PowerShell modules) from syncing, keeping them local to devices. This feature, off by default, rolls out worldwide in August 2026, improves storage efficiency, and is managed via Group Policy with no user control over exclusions.

Title: Teams frontline mobile onboarding guide retirement
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the Frontline Teams Personal Device Onboarding Wizard by late August 2026. Frontline workers will use existing Microsoft Teams, Entra ID, Intune, and Authenticator onboarding methods. No changes to security controls are needed. Organizations should update documentation and training accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced file filtering in channel Shared tabs
Summary: Microsoft Teams now offers enhanced file filtering in the channel Shared tab, allowing users to filter files by type and media content in both All Documents and In Messages views. This update improves file discovery without requiring admin action and is available worldwide.

Title: Announcing Public Preview of Project Manager agent in Shared Premium Plans
Summary: Project Manager agent (PMA) is now available in all shared premium plans to enhance planning and execution. Key updates include broader availability, new chat entry point, and improved admin controls. Rollout begins in August 2025. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required for full access. No compliance considerations identified.

Title: Important Notice: TLS Deprecation for Fabric Platform
Summary: Support for TLS 1.1 on the Fabric Platform ends on July 31, 2025. Ensure all connections use TLS 1.2 or later to avoid service interruptions. Review and update your systems and verify compliance. For more details, refer to the provided blog post and support links.

Title: Important Update to the Get-FederationInformation Cmdlet in Exchange Online
Summary: To enhance security, the `Get-FederationInformation` cmdlet in Exchange Online will now only return domain information explicitly passed as a parameter. This update, affecting scripts and tools, will roll out from late June 2025 to late August 2025. Review and update any automation accordingly. More details are available in the official blog post.

Title: Text Prediction turned off by default in Outlook
Summary: Text Prediction will be turned off by default in Outlook starting July 1, 2025. This affects New Outlook for Windows, Outlook on the web, and new users on Outlook for iOS and Android. Users can manually re-enable it in settings. Admins should inform users about this change.

Title: Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Role-based Copilot offerings 2025 release wave 2 plans available now!
Summary: On July 16, 2025, we published the 2025 wave 2 plans for Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, and Role-based Copilot offerings which is a compilation of new capabilities that will be released between October 2025 through March 2026. The new features and enhancements provide you with significant capabilities to help transform your business using our applications. What actions do I need to take? You can use the Release planner to view and manage release plans across all active release waves in...

Title: Microsoft Forms now supports live data sync to Microsoft Excel with more functionality
Summary: Microsoft Forms now offers a live data sync feature to Excel, with automatic updates and coauthor support. This applies to Excel for the web and will be fully available by late July 2024, supporting both group forms and individual forms created in Excel for the web. No admin action is required for rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: Updates to Privacy controls
Summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse is updating privacy controls, adding a new 'Minimum number of recipients' control. This allows separate management of minimum recipients and responses required for feedback visibility. Rollout begins mid-August 2024, with no admin action needed before then. Preparation involves deciding on control settings and updating documentation.

Title: Basic Authentication retirement in Microsoft 365 Apps
Summary: Microsoft 365 Apps are disabling server sign-in prompts using Basic authentication in Office Apps. We are making this change because basic authentication is a legacy authentication method that sends a username and password with each request. As a result, an attacker can access these credentials and use them to access resources. Continued use of Basic Authentication is a big security concern, so we have decided to deprecate it from all tenants. We will retire this feature in Office Apps version 2...

Title: Outlook Mobile: Follow a meeting option
Summary: Outlook Mobile will add a "Follow" RSVP option for meetings with two or more participants starting early August 2026. It prompts organizers to record meetings and send updates to followers. The feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and changes the RSVP menu layout.

Title: New Outlook for Windows becomes available for GCC High and DoD
Summary: New Outlook for Windows will be available in GCC High and DoD environments starting Public Preview July 30, 2026, with general rollout from September to December 2026. It remains off by default and opt-in, allowing admins control via policies and registry keys. Migration from COM to web add-ins is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Passkeys by default and retirement of Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication
Summary: Microsoft Entra will make passkeys the default authentication method starting September 1, 2026, retiring Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication by February 1, 2027. Customers must configure telecom providers for SMS/voice via the Microsoft Security Store or face disruptions. Passkeys offer stronger, phishing-resistant security at no extra cost.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
