Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with customizable options for mentions and threads. Rollout is delayed to late 2026 across environments. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to reduce notification noise.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Distinguish invites among Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer emails
Summary: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites based on participant roles (Attendee, Presenter, Co-organizer). Organizers receive emails explaining roles. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by late October 2026, with no admin action needed. Users should be notified and documentation updated accordingly.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Teams owned opportunities to be researched by Sales Opportunity Agent
Summary: We are announcing the ability to utilize the Sales Opportunity Agent to research opportunities owned by specific Owner teams in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? As a seller, you will be able to see Sales Opportunity Agent research results for opportunities owned by Owner teams. As an admin, you can select a selection of criteria that encompasses opportunities that are not owned by individuals but rather owned by Owner tea...

Title: Power Automate - Visualize desktop flows with flow chart view
Summary: We are announcing the ability to visualize desktop flows with flow chart view in Power Automate. This feature will be available in public preview on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to switch between the existing linear action list and a visual flow chart view while editing desktop flows. The flow chart view will display actions as connected nodes, making branching, dependencies, and execution paths easier to understand. Users will also be able to rearrange actions by d...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Next Best Actions with Customer Intent Agent
Summary: We are announcing the ability to select the next best actions (NBA) with Customer Intent Agent In Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This new feature allows customer service representatives (CSRs) to navigate to the Copilot pane and perform a suite of actions powered by Copilot in one click. This list of actions includes but is not limited to: Drafting emails. Updating knowledge articles and case notes. This feat...

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Manage exchange rate variances in cash advance transactions
Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage exchange rate variances in cash advance transactions in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will be available in public preview on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to detect, calculate, and post realized foreign exchange rate variances when cash advances are issued in one currency and settled in another currency or on a different date. This feature will: Base cash advance settlements on the transaction currency. Calculat...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Join Bar
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new meeting join banner for users who RSVP “Yes” or “Tentative.” The banner allows direct joining of live meetings and shows the count of active meetings with a “View More” option. Rollout is scheduled for mid to late July 2025. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights: New Viva Learning Culture report
Summary: The new Viva Learning Culture Report in Microsoft Viva Insights provides business leaders with insights into employee engagement with learning content. It includes metrics on learning usage, culture, and content played, visualized in Power BI. Premium tenants with specific licenses can access this feature, rolling out from mid-June to early July 2025.

Title: New Startup Boost task from Microsoft Office installer for Office applications
Summary: Microsoft Office is introducing a new Startup Boost task to enhance performance and load-time for Office applications, starting with Word. The rollout begins in late June 2025 and completes by late September 2025. Startup Boost is optional, can be disabled, and requires specific system resources to function effectively. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator agent real-time notes in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon feature a Facilitator agent that takes real-time notes during meetings, allowing for seamless co-authoring and collaboration. This feature, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, will be available globally from mid to late September 2025. Admins can control its availability, and it includes security and compliance measures through Microsoft Purview.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting July 15th, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this latest...

Title: Power Automate – Trigger attended desktop flows in picture-in-picture mode
Summary: We are announcing new functionality to trigger desktop flows in a picture-in-picture window via the Power Automate console or cloud flow. How does this affect me? Users can trigger attended desktop flows in a picture-in-picture window through new options available in the Power Automate console. This enables users to work on their desktop undisturbed while the desktop flow runs in parallel within a virtual window that replicates their desktop. Additionally, users can Trigger a desktop flow from a...

Title: Dynamics 365 and Power Platform – 2024 release wave 2 plans available now
Summary: On July 16, 2024, we published the 2024 release wave 2 plans for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, which is a compilation of new capabilities that will be released between October 2024 through March 2025. The new features and enhancements provide you with significant capabilities to help transform your business using our applications. How does this affect me? You can use the release planner to view and manage release plans across all active release waves in a unified and interactive interface, wi...

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New Actions feature in Experience insights (preview)
Summary: The new 'Actions' feature in Experience insights (preview) in the Microsoft 365 admin center will enable tracking and measuring the impact of user engagement actions. It will be accessible to certain admin roles and is set to roll out from late July to late September 2024. No action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Additional file types to filter your lists of files
Summary: OneDrive on the web will have new file type filters in July 2024, including OneNote, Microsoft Lists, Videos, Loop, Photos, Whiteboard, and PowerBI. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Windows device configuration templates created before July 15 will be migrated
Summary: Device configuration templates for Windows created before July 15 will be migrated to a new settings platform. This migration will not affect the profiles' enforcement or configured values. Post-migration, some templates will only be configurable within the Settings catalog, and a new policy editing experience will be introduced. Users utilizing Microsoft Graph API should update to new graph endpoints. No further action is required.

Title: Intune moving to support Android 10 and later for user-based management methods in October 2024
Summary: In October 2024, Intune will only support Android 10 and later for user-based management methods. Devices on Android 9 or earlier will not receive technical support, bug fixes, or guaranteed feature functionality. Admins should prepare by updating support statements and configuring relevant policies.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center - New "After Conversation Work" presence for representatives in wrap-up
Summary: We are introducing the "After Conversation Work" status to the presence feature in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature enhancement will be available starting July 15, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables supervisors to clearly distinguish representatives who are performing after-conversation (wrap-up) work from those who are otherwise Busy or in Do Not Disturb using two new custom presences available in the Copilot Service admin center. Thes...

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Restricted access control for sites enforced across Microsoft 365 search
Summary: Restricted Access Control (RAC) for SharePoint and OneDrive sites will be enforced across Microsoft 365 search, limiting search results to content users can access. This update, rolling out in late July 2026, applies automatically to existing and new RAC-enabled sites without changing RAC configurations.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Enhanced user profile in Insider Risk Management alerts
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management alerts will display enhanced user profiles with additional Entra attributes and risk signals within the alert workflow, improving investigation efficiency while maintaining privacy protections. The update rolls out from June to October 2026, requiring no immediate action but recommended review and communication.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
Summary: Microsoft Teams is adding call delegation enhancements: delegators can lock active calls to block delegate participation and enable warning tones notifying when delegates join or resume calls. These features improve privacy and transparency during calls, rolling out worldwide from August to September 2026. No immediate admin action needed.

Title: Retirement notice: Instances policy location in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the Instances policy location in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention on January 6, 2027. Organizations must migrate existing policies to new dedicated application locations for supported non-Microsoft apps like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce before this date to ensure continued enforcement and support.

Title: Retirement of -Credential parameter when connecting to Exchange Online PowerShell
Summary: Microsoft will retire the -Credential parameter in Exchange Online PowerShell cmdlets starting December 2026, requiring organizations to migrate scripts to modern authentication methods like MFA, app-only, or managed identity authentication to avoid disruptions. This enhances security by eliminating legacy authentication.

Title: Microsoft Edge enforces screen capture restrictions for sensitivity-labeled PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint
Summary: Microsoft Edge will enforce screen capture restrictions on sensitivity-labeled PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint web viewers starting August 2026, aligning with Microsoft Purview Information Protection policies. This blocks screenshots for PDFs without copy permission, affecting organizations using these labels and requiring user communication and policy review.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Custom recording and transcription notifications now available for 1:1 calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports custom recording and transcription notifications for 1:1 calls, extending existing meeting capabilities. This ensures consistent consent messaging across communications without new admin setup. Rollout begins August 2026 for most environments; mobile clients are not yet supported. No policy changes are required.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize Power BI reports
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights will allow eligible users to create, customize, and save supported Power BI reports, including adjusting periods, filters, visuals, and layouts. This feature, available from August to September 2026, maintains existing security controls and can be managed via Viva Feature Access Management.

Title: Power Automate - Automate PowerPoint presentations in desktop flows
Summary: We are announcing the ability to automate PowerPoint presentations in desktop flows in Power Automate. This feature will be available in public preview on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, users will be able to use Power Automate for desktop actions to interact with PowerPoint files directly within desktop flows. Users will be able to launch PowerPoint, create and update presentations by adding slides, and save changes as part of automated workflows. This will allow pres...

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for all channels
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting July 14th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required....

Title: Hotpatching is now available for 64-bit Arm architecture
Summary: Hotpatching is now available for Windows 11, version 24H2 Arm64 devices, allowing security updates without restarts. Organizations benefit from faster compliance, no downtime, smaller update payloads, and enterprise-grade control. Prerequisites include disabling Compiled Hybrid PE (CHPE) via policy or registry key. For more details, review the provided links.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New town hall event access policy
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating its town hall event access policy. Admins can now control who can attend town halls with the new `TownhallEventAttendeeAccess` setting. The rollout will occur from mid to late June 2025. The default setting is `Everyone`, but it can be changed using Microsoft PowerShell. More details are available [here](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/roadmap?filters=&searchterms=483250).

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows is GA on August 1, 2024
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will be generally available on August 1, 2024, for commercial accounts, with no automatic changes for current users. Organizations can control its availability and are encouraged to plan for migration. Support and resources are provided for the transition from classic to the new Outlook.

Title: Power Automate – Use credentials in desktop flow connections feature is now available
Summary: We are announcing that the use credentials in desktop flow connections feature is now available. How does this affect me? Users will be able to utilize credentials from Azure Key Vault in desktop flow connections. This feature also supports the use of rotating passwords without having to update flow connections. This enables desktop flows to keep running successfully even when the administrator changes the password. What do I need to do to prepare? To utilize this feature, admins will need to co...

Title: OpenAI models will soon be available as a subprocessor in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: OpenAI models, including GPT-5.6, will be available as a subprocessor in Microsoft 365 Copilot starting July 9, 2026, initially disabled by default and auto-enabled on July 24, 2026, unless admins opt out. This allows faster AI updates with enterprise-grade security and compliance.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Faster policy sync (2 hours to 30 minutes)
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy sync time will improve from 2 hours to 30 minutes, enabling faster enforcement across Microsoft 365 services. The update rolls out worldwide starting end of August 2026, requires no admin action, and is enabled by default without changing existing workflows.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Restricted content discovery enhancements for Copilot and Microsoft 365 search
Summary: Microsoft is enhancing SharePoint's Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) to prevent content from RCD-enabled sites appearing in Copilot and Microsoft 365 search, improving data control and compliance. Changes roll out worldwide in late July 2026, requiring no immediate action but recommending policy reviews and user communication.

Title: Microsoft Forms automated email sender domain is changing
Summary: Microsoft Forms will change its automated email sender from maccount@microsoft.com to no-reply@forms.mail.microsoft starting mid-August 2026. Admins should update mail flow rules and safe sender lists accordingly. GCC environments get this update from early September 2026. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Network best practices for Teams town halls and live events with third‑party providers
Summary: To prevent streaming issues in Teams town halls and live events, review network settings, especially if using third-party secure web gateways, proxies, or traffic inspection. Optimize policies for real-time media, validate endpoint allowlists, configure VPN split-tunnel properly, test events, and prepare support teams. Updates ongoing.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Insights for Copilot and AI app interactions
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will provide new AI-driven insights on Copilot and AI app usage, helping admins improve retention policies and data security. Public preview starts late August 2026, with general availability by mid-October. No immediate action is required, but admins can prepare by reviewing insights and updating governance.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Purview Information Protection | Classifier Simulation Mode (Health Monitoring)
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces Classifier Simulation Mode, allowing admins to test custom classifiers on production data before publishing. Available from late 2026, it offers health insights and monitoring in the compliance portal to optimize classifier performance and reduce false positives, with optional simulation and automatic disabling of inefficient classifiers.

Title: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
Summary: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to auto-assign open shifts based on availability, time off, and scheduling rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to end of July 2026, the feature is optional, reviewable before publishing, and controlled by existing scheduling permissions.

Title: Support for disabling file previews in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a user-level setting to disable file previews, enabled by default. Rollout starts early June 2026, completing by July end. No admin action is needed; users can toggle previews per client under Settings > Files and links. Storage and permissions remain unchanged.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter disabled by default for live captions
Summary: Microsoft Teams will disable the profanity filter by default for live captions starting mid-June 2026, improving caption accuracy and accessibility. Users can enable or disable the filter anytime. No admin action is required, but informing support teams and users is recommended. Existing user settings remain unchanged.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items while using unread only mode
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out by July 2026 a feature allowing users in unread only mode to quickly access read chats via an eye icon, improving navigation without changing filters. This is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and aims to enhance user experience.

Title: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will preserve interactive @mentions, shared contacts, and supported tags during copy and paste when valid in the destination, falling back to plain text if not. This update, rolling out May to July 2026, improves message consistency without requiring admin action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
Summary: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, highlighting buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and remaining BYOD rooms. Rolling out mid-June to end July 2026, this feature helps IT admins optimize room technology and improve user experience, enabled by default for eligible licenses.

Title: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
Summary: Microsoft Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to improve live event reliability by automatically switching to a secondary stream if the primary fails. This feature, rolling out April to July 2026, requires no action and does not affect attendees. Organizers can enable it via Production tools.

Title: Events in Meet app – Introducing a redesigned, unified Events experience in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams is redesigning the Meet app into a unified Events app, streamlining creation, discovery, and management of webinars, town halls, and custom events. Rollout begins late February 2026 with general availability by end of July 2026. No admin action needed; existing meetings and policies remain unchanged.

Title: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention – Block external domain or user access for SharePoint and OneDrive
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP will enable blocking external SharePoint and OneDrive access by domain or email, enhancing data protection. Rolling out from late May to July 2026, admins can configure policies to block or allow specific external users, with block rules taking precedence. This feature requires admin setup.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Power Automate integration with records management
Summary: Microsoft Purview Records Management will integrate with Power Automate starting January 2027, enabling admins to run custom workflows when retention-labeled items expire. This feature, not enabled by default, allows automated post-retention actions across Microsoft 365 services without changing existing retention settings. No immediate action required.

Title: Measure Copilot sentiment in the Copilot Dashboard with Viva Pulse
Summary: Viva Pulse survey results will be integrated into the Copilot Dashboard by August 2026, providing detailed insights like open-text responses and heatmaps. This enables admins and leaders to better measure Copilot adoption and impact with enhanced reporting, enabled by default and requiring no workflow changes.

Title: Take actions with Viva Pulse after Viva Glint engagement surveys is now GA!
Summary: Viva Pulse now integrates with Viva Glint, allowing managers to take targeted actions after Glint engagement surveys. This feature is available to Viva Glint customers with eligible licenses and must be enabled by a Glint admin. It helps maintain engagement momentum by recommending Pulse questions based on Glint survey results. Learn more [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/pulse/viva-integrations/take-actions-after-glint-survey).

Title: Enhanced eDiscovery Premium APIs
Summary: Enhanced eDiscovery Premium APIs are being upgraded from Beta to V1, introducing new parameters and export structures to improve search accuracy and streamline workflows. The rollout will be completed by late August 2025. Admins and developers using these APIs must review the updated documentation and communicate changes to relevant teams.

Title: Microsoft Security Copilot in Intune is now generally available with new ways to explore and act on your Intune data
Summary: Microsoft Security Copilot in Intune is now generally available, providing AI-driven capabilities to manage and protect endpoints. IT admins can use natural language to troubleshoot, create reports, and take actions. To use the new Explorer page, enable Security Copilot as an Azure owner or contributor and Intune administrator.

Title: Create charts on pages with AI in SharePoint
Summary: SharePoint will introduce an AI-assisted Charts web part for page authors to create interactive charts using plain-language prompts. Rollout starts late May 2026, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license. The feature is enabled by default, with no required action for organizations.

Title: Viva Engage: Email updates for frontline users without an active Exchange mailbox
Summary: Starting end of August 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to frontline users with F1 and F3 licenses who lack active Exchange mailboxes, reducing email system load and improving delivery reliability. Notifications via Teams remain unaffected. No action is required, but review licensing and notification strategies.

Title: Neutral-themed SharePoint UI in page editing and property panes
Summary: SharePoint page editing tools will adopt a neutral-themed UI, using standard colors instead of site branding, to improve clarity, accessibility, and consistency across light/dark modes. This change, rolling out from July to September 2026, requires no admin action but may affect custom or third-party web part visuals.

Title: Viva Glint: Copilot-enhanced topic assignment for employee feedback comments
Summary: Microsoft Viva Glint will introduce Copilot-enhanced topic assignment for employee feedback, adding five new topics to improve insights. Controlled by the existing VFAM toggle, it launches worldwide in late July 2026, affecting Viva Glint users and administrators, with recommendations to review governance and update processes accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Clearer Copilot availability in multi-account experiences
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will update the Copilot button to clearly show availability in multi-account views if any account supports Copilot chat, hiding it in unsupported single-account views. This UI change, rolling out July 2026, does not affect licensing, eligibility, or features. No action required.

Title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud update – simplified channel management (public preview)
Summary: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update introduces simplified profile and channel management using Microsoft Entra ID groups, combining profile assignment and channel selection in one step. Rollout begins May 2026 (public preview) with general availability by late July 2026. No user impact; admins should update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Analytics: Data export public preview for Copilot metrics in the Copilot dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Copilot Analytics now offers a default-on, de-identified data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. Available from early December 2025 (public preview) and August 2026 (general availability), it enables export of weekly user-level Copilot usage metrics for analysis and licensing optimization.

Title: Power BI integration with Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Starting mid-June 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will answer user questions using Power BI data for Frontier-enrolled customers, respecting existing permissions. The feature is enabled by default, requires Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium and Power BI licenses, and can be disabled by admins via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updated handling of entity inserts in the Copilot Chat input box
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat will update entity insertion so entity names no longer appear as text in the chat input box, creating cleaner prompts. This change rolls out worldwide from late May to mid-July 2026, is enabled by default, and requires no admin action.

Title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention default protection controls for Exchange Online when classification fails
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP for Exchange Online introduces a tenant-level opt-in feature to detect classification failures like timeouts and throttling. This enhances visibility and compliance by expanding existing conditions and adding a new DocumentScanFailures condition. Rollout begins mid-July 2026 with no impact unless enabled.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable time zone independent behavior on Time Entry Grid
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable time zone independent behavior on Time Entry Grid in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on July 24, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, admins can now enable time zone independent behavior for the Time Entry Grid, ensuring that time entries are displayed against the same calendar date regardless of a user's time zone. This helps organizations with globally distributed teams maintain a consistent view...

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Configure Maximum Daily Time Entry Duration
Summary: We are announcing the ability to configure maximum daily time entry duration in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on July 24, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, admins can configure the maximum time that can be logged for time entry. This configuration can be applied from the Parameters page and will be checked each time a new time entry is created or modified. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action i...

Title: Physical badging Connector new sample power shell script
Summary: Microsoft has updated the Microsoft Purview Physical Badging Connector to enhance security. Organizations using this connector must download and apply a new PowerShell script by June 30, 2025, to maintain functionality. Separate scripts are available for Commercial, GCC, GCCH, and DoD environments. No UI or workflow changes are expected.

Title: Missed Activity Emails for Teams Will Now Come from a Unified Domain
Summary: Missed activity emails for Microsoft Teams will now come from ‘no-reply@teams.mail.microsoft’ instead of ‘noreply@*email.teams.microsoft.com’. This change aims for a consistent and secure email experience and will roll out in July 2025. No action is required from users or admins.

Title: What's new in Microsoft Entra - June 2024
Summary: The June 2024 updates for Microsoft Entra include general availability releases for Entra ID and changes like Azure AD Graph Retirement. Security enhancements for Apple devices and updates for Entra ID affecting old Windows builds are also featured. For a detailed summary, refer to the provided links.

Title: New: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Removing a recommendation to update Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft is updating the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to better reflect security posture by removing the recommendation in SCID-2051. The rollout begins in mid-July 2024 and completes by mid-August 2024, requiring no admin action but suggesting user notification and documentation updates.

Title: Plan for Change: Microsoft Intune ending support for User Enrollment with Company Portal for iOS/iPadOS
Summary: Microsoft Intune will stop supporting User Enrollment with Company Portal for iOS/iPadOS after the release of iOS/iPadOS 18. Existing devices remain unaffected, but new enrollments won't be supported. Alternatives like account driven User Enrollment or web-based device enrollment are recommended.

Title: OneDrive for the web: Document library views now available in OneDrive
Summary: OneDrive for the web will enable users to access, switch, create, and manage SharePoint document library views directly within OneDrive starting July 2026. This feature, enabled by default, improves productivity by streamlining document organization without changing data or permissions. No action is required.

Title: Thumbnail view for PDFs is available in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web
Summary: OneDrive and SharePoint on the web will add a default-enabled thumbnail view in the PDF viewer by mid-August 2026, allowing users to visually browse and jump to PDF pages easily. No admin action or changes to permissions are required; organizations should update training and inform users.

Title: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
Summary: OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will soon allow users with editing rights to annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs directly on mobile, maintaining encryption and label protection. The feature rolls out globally from mid to late August 2026, requires no admin action, and enhances mobile productivity without compromising security.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Stricter external access controls for federated chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams introduces two new PowerShell controls to enforce stricter external access and mutual federation policies in federated group chats, enhancing admin control and reducing exposure to unapproved external organizations. These controls are disabled by default and roll out worldwide from July to September 2026.

Title: Create, view, and edit Markdown files in OneDrive mobile
Summary: OneDrive mobile apps for iOS and Android will support creating, viewing, and editing Markdown (.md) files starting mid-July 2026. This feature, enabled by default, aligns mobile with web experience, requires no admin action, and allows users to work with Markdown files without downloading them.

Title: Support for the “Get Diagnostics” feature visibility option within M365 Cloud Policy Service for Outlook Mobile and Mac
Summary: Microsoft is extending the Microsoft 365 Cloud Policy Service setting for the "Get Diagnostics" feature to Outlook for iOS, Android, and Mac by September 2026, allowing admins centralized control over diagnostic log collection, storage, and sharing to support enterprise governance and workflows.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Improved restore experience for Authenticator passkeys on iOS
Summary: Microsoft Entra improves the Microsoft Authenticator passkey restore experience on iOS with a clearer, guided flow for device migration, available worldwide in August 2026. It affects iOS users with iCloud backups, is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and no action is needed.

Title: Introducing cross-tenant message recall in Exchange Online
Summary: Exchange Online will support cross-tenant message recall, allowing trusted external Microsoft 365 tenants to recall messages sent to your users. This feature, disabled by default, can be enabled and managed by admins via PowerShell with an allow list of tenant IDs. Rollout starts mid-August 2026.

Title: Introducing Auto-Attendant Call Flow Visualizer in Teams Admin Center
Summary: The Teams Admin Center now includes a Call Flow Visualizer for Auto Attendants and Teams Phone agents, offering an interactive, tree-like view of call routing to simplify management and troubleshooting. It is enabled by default, requires no action, and rolled out globally by late June 2026.

Title: M365 Copilot usage reports – updated reporting experience, faster refresh, and more Copilot usage metrics in Graph API
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports will refresh faster (48 hours), change the default reporting window to 28 days, and separate agent metrics into a dedicated report. Expanded metrics, including user-level data, will be available via Microsoft Graph API. Updates roll out worldwide by late July 2026 with no admin action needed.

Title: Clearer RSVP selection in Outlook Mobile
Summary: Outlook Mobile will visually highlight users' RSVP responses (Yes, Maybe, No) to meeting invites, improving clarity. The rollout begins August 2026 and completes by end of August. It affects all iOS and Android users, is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and does not impact other Outlook clients.

Title: Planner is now available in Outlook and Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Microsoft Planner is now integrated directly into Outlook (web and new Windows version) and Microsoft 365 Copilot, enabling users to manage tasks alongside email and calendar. The rollout begins late July 2026, is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and respects existing permissions and policies.

Title: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
Summary: SharePoint will add AI citations analytics by August 2026, showing how documents and pages are referenced by Microsoft Copilot and AI agents. Features include citation metrics in site usage, page analytics, and file statistics, available by default without admin action, requiring appropriate Copilot licenses.

Title: Pin AppBar from Hamburger context menu
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce the ability to pin the AppBar from the hamburger context menu, enhancing layout customization. This feature will be available worldwide from late July 2025, affecting all users without requiring admin configuration. No compliance issues are identified, and informing helpdesk staff is recommended.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Viva Engage discussion posts added to grounding sources
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now includes Viva Engage discussion posts from public communities and Storylines as grounding sources, enhancing contextually relevant responses. This feature, rolling out from June to August 2025, requires no admin action and does not include private content. Review Viva Engage configurations and notify relevant parties.

Title: Microsoft 365 Suite: The new Microsoft Purview portal entering general availability
Summary: Please refer to MC807798 (published July 2, 2024) moving forward for this feature change. This message will be removed from Message center.

Title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Enhanced privacy control: Limiting PII data access in Activity Explorer
Summary: The update limits access to certain PII data in Activity Explorer to admins with the 'Data Classification Content Viewer' role. It affects viewing source information and SIT context. Rollout begins early June 2024, with Public Preview and General Availability phases. Admins must be assigned the proper role to retain access.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Pre-pin meeting apps for users
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating app setup policies to allow admins to pre-pin and pre-install meeting apps for users, extending the functionality beyond personal apps and message extensions. The rollout timeline has been updated, with completion expected by mid-July 2024 worldwide and early August 2024 for GCC, GCC High, DoD. No action is required for preparation.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Connections now available on the web
Summary: Microsoft Viva: Connections is now available on the web with the same functionalities as in Teams. It will start rolling out mid-May 2024 for Targeted Release and will be generally available by mid-July 2024. No action is needed to use it on the web.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Apps now supported in group chats with external users
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support apps in group chats with external users starting mid-May 2024. The rollout includes Teams for web, desktop, and mobile. Group chat hosts can add apps, but external users can't manage them. Existing access policies will apply, and organizations can opt out if desired.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage and Microsoft Yammer: update on web domain migration release date
Summary: The email sender domain will not start in June 2024 as previously announced. We will send a new notice via message center with 30-days' notice before we start changing the email sender domain later in 2024. If you took action to change or update your email configuration based on the previous communication, then that should remain largely valid. We encourage you to review changes when any updated notice is received.

Title: Microsoft Teams: In‑meeting toggle to turn Meeting AI on or off
Summary: Microsoft Teams will add an in-meeting toggle for licensed organizers and presenters to turn Meeting AI (Copilot, Facilitator, recap) on or off during live meetings, respecting tenant policies. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to existing compliance or meeting options. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Migration tool in Unified Catalog to migrate classic glossary terms
Summary: Microsoft Purview's built-in migration tool for moving classic glossary terms to Unified Catalog rollout is paused. Data Governance Admins can migrate terms, templates, and relationships or switch to Unified Catalog terms, making classic terms read-only. Migration planning and documentation will be provided when available.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Retirement of Custom Controls in Conditional Access and migration to External MFA
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID is retiring Custom Controls in Conditional Access by May 2027, replacing them with External MFA for standardized third-party MFA integration. Administrators must migrate policies by September 2026, updating Conditional Access to use External MFA to ensure continued support and security.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Prompt injection protection for email
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces prompt injection protection to detect and block malicious email content targeting AI assistants. High confidence threats are auto-quarantined. Available to Plan 2 and Microsoft 365 E5 users, enabled by default from early July 2026. No action required; review workflows and inform teams.

Title: Update Exchange Web Services (EWS) allow list configuration for calendar
Summary: Microsoft is updating Exchange Web Services (EWS) allow/block list configurations to support Teams mobile calendar changes starting August 2026. Admins must review and update EWS policies to include or exclude specific Teams user agents to avoid calendar disruptions. No end-user changes are needed; action is required before rollout.

Title: Set and edit your work location from your Outlook Mobile calendar
Summary: Starting mid-July 2026, Outlook Mobile users can set and edit their work location directly from the calendar, enhancing hybrid work visibility and collaboration. This feature applies to all users on iOS and Android, requires no action, and will be enabled by default.

Title: Dynamics 365 Finance - Unified e‑invoicing integration framework
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the new unified e-invoicing integration framework feature that simplifies and accelerates integration development for Microsoft, partners, and customers in Dynamics 365 Finance. This feature will reach general availability on August 8, 2026. How does this affect me? The unified extensible e-invoicing integration framework extends the existing Electronic Invoicing service by introducing: A unified outbound and inbound document model (based on international sta...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - WEM in M365 Copilot for CSRs and Supervisors
Summary: We are announcing Dynamics 365 Workforce Management (WEM) in M365 Copilot for customer service representatives and supervisors in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on July 20, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, Dynamics 365 Workforce Management now integrates directly with Microsoft 365 Copilot through the Model Context Protocol, bringing scheduling and request management into the surfaces your teams already use every day. Contact center s...

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Manage users through Microsoft Entra security groups
Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage users through Microsoft Entra security groups in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on July 24, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to manage access by linking Microsoft Entra security groups to Microsoft Entra ID Security Group teams in Dataverse and assigning security roles at the team level. Users added to or removed from the linked security groups will automatically gain or lose the assigned roles, i...

Title: Microsoft Entra: System-preferred authentication now applies to first-factor authentication
Summary: Microsoft Entra now applies system-preferred authentication to first-factor sign-in for tenants in the Microsoft managed state, selecting the most secure registered method. Rollout starts late June 2026. Tenants can keep or change this setting and should update user guidance accordingly.

Title: Microsoft 365: Enrich profile cards with custom properties from third-party systems
Summary: Starting September 2026, Microsoft 365 admins can add up to 10 custom properties from external systems to profile cards via Microsoft Graph People connectors. This feature is off by default and requires configuration in the admin center. Properties appear in Outlook Web contact info and future updates will support SAP SuccessFactors and Workday.

Title: Viva Engage: Agents in Viva Engage communities Public Preview
Summary: Viva Engage community agents are in Public Preview, allowing admins to add AI agents that draft answers using community and SharePoint content. Tagging by members is coming soon. Admins can configure grounding sources and answer posting settings. General Availability starts September 2026, with the feature on by default.

Title: Microsoft Viva: GitHub Copilot spend and usage insights in Copilot Analytics
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights will introduce GitHub Copilot spend and usage insights for eligible managers, Insights Analysts, and Global Administrators. Disabled by default during Public Preview starting July 2026, it helps organizations monitor Copilot adoption and credit use, with access controlled by existing privacy and role settings.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Diagnostics now in the Purview compliance portal
Summary: Microsoft Purview is launching a new diagnostics feature for Data Loss Prevention in the compliance portal. Public preview starts in December 2024, with general availability in April 2025 for Worldwide and July 2025 for GCC, GCCHigh, and DoD. No admin action is required; the feature will be on by default.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Enhancing page load performance
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is enhancing page load performance to address user feedback on latency issues. Phase 1 will roll out from late March 2025 to December 2025, focusing on optimizing Submission, Quarantine, Threat Explorer, Email Entity, and Policy Configuration pages. No disruptions or admin actions are required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party chat and meeting keyboard shortcut support
Summary: Users can now use third-party chat and meeting keyboard shortcuts in Microsoft Teams by selecting a layout in the settings. The rollout will start in May 2025 for targeted release and in July 2025 for general availability. No admin action is required, but notifying users is recommended.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for all channels
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting July 9th, 2024 (PST). Title: Exchange Online will prevent creation of duplicate Dynamic Distribution Groups
Summary: Exchange Online will block creation of exact duplicate Dynamic Distribution Groups starting late July 2026 to improve reliability and reduce redundancy. Existing DDGs remain unaffected. Administrators should update scripts to handle duplicate errors and review current DDGs. No action is needed for most organizations.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks: Support for TXT and RTF files as notebook references
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks will support TXT and RTF files as reference sources starting early July 2026, enabling users to include more text-based content for AI analysis and insights. This enhancement requires no action, maintains existing security policies, and expands Copilot’s data processing capabilities.

Title: OneDrive transitions to the cloud.microsoft domain
Summary: OneDrive is transitioning to the onedrive.cloud.microsoft domain starting late July 2026, with both old and new URLs working side by side indefinitely. There are no changes to file access or APIs, but admins should review custom solutions relying on URL patterns. No immediate action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Flexible targeting of Storyline Announcements
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements, allowing leaders to tailor messages using organizational attributes, groups, or individuals. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability is in November 2026. Premium licensing is required; no admin action needed for rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Apps now supported in Private Channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports apps in Private Channels, allowing bots, tabs, and message extensions to be added per channel with new governance controls. This feature is generally available, requires developer updates for custom apps, and includes admin management and compliance considerations.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Privileges and role-based access
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use role-based access for agents and customer service representatives using Microsoft Entra ID within Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on July 24, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, admins can link a Microsoft Entra security group to a Dataverse team of the type Microsoft Entra ID Security Group and assign the required security roles once at the team level, such as Basic User, Customer Service Representative...

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Enable Automatic CRM Record Linking and Suggested Updates for Accounts, Contacts, and Leads
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable Automatic CRM Record Linking and Suggested Updates for Accounts, Contacts, and Leads in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on August 7, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables AI-powered data enrichment that helps you keep related CRM records accurate by automatically surfacing relevant insights from seller conversations. With this enhancement, you get record-level intelligence that: Detects accounts, contacts, and...

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for all channels
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting July 8th, 2025 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Net...

Title: Improved backup and restore experience for Microsoft Authenticator on iOS
Summary: Starting September 2025, Microsoft Authenticator on iOS will use iCloud and iCloud Keychain for backup and restore, eliminating the need for a Microsoft personal account. This update simplifies setup on new devices, with automatic backup of account names and third-party TOTP credentials. No admin action is required.

Title: PowerPoint: Deprecation of Reuse Slides Button in Ribbon
Summary: PowerPoint is retiring the Reuse Slide feature from the Ribbon by July 31, 2025. Users can reuse slides by copying and pasting between presentations or duplicating presentations. No admin action is required, but users should be informed and internal documentation updated.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Enhancements to global exclusions in IRM settings
Summary: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management is enhancing global exclusions to reduce alert noise. The rollout for public preview began in mid-April 2025, with general availability starting early June 2025. Admins should update exclusion settings in IRM to optimize these features, which include keyword and file path exclusions.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Update on community muting for admins
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will update the community muting feature for admins, affecting visibility of conversations for dynamically added members in Home Feed and digest emails. The rollout is automatic, starting and completing mid-July 2024, with no required admin action before the rollout. Users should be notified.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Import navigational links from Microsoft SharePoint into Resources in Viva Connections
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections will soon allow users with editing permissions to import SharePoint navigational links directly into the Resources section. This feature will be available on desktop and includes a preview option before saving. Rollout starts early July 2024, with no admin action required for the update.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Choose custom images as icons for resources in Viva Connections
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections will soon allow users with editing permissions to personalize the Resources section with custom image icons. Rollout begins early July 2024, completing by mid-July, and requires no admin action. Users should consider which images to use for customization.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: How to ensure/manage background syncing on macOS
Summary: OneDrive for macOS is updating to streamline background syncing. The OpenAtLogin plist setting will be replaced by macOS System Setting Login Item, managed through a configuration profile. Rollout begins early July 2024, with completion by late July. Admins should review and deploy the Background Services configuration profile.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New layout for sharing content in Teams events
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new Speaker focused layout for Teams events, prioritizing presenter video alongside shared content to enhance engagement. This update, enabled by default, rolls out globally from August to September 2026 for Teams Enterprise users, with no admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights: Is Active filter no longer applied by default in new Advanced Insights queries
Summary: Starting August 2026, Microsoft Viva Insights Advanced Insights will no longer apply the Is Active filter by default in new Custom Query – Person queries. Analysts must select it explicitly. Copilot-only queries disable this filter. Existing queries remain unchanged but users should migrate to new templates.

Title: SharePoint button web part: Add custom Copilot in SharePoint prompts or start Power Automate flows
Summary: The SharePoint Button web part will support launching custom Copilot prompts or Power Automate flows, enhancing productivity and automation. Available from late July 2026, it affects SharePoint page owners, Copilot-licensed users, and flow-authorized users, with no admin action required. Existing buttons remain unchanged.

Title: Configurable recovery window for Microsoft 365 Backup
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup now allows admins to configure recovery windows from 3 months to 2 years, replacing the fixed 1-year default. This enhances flexibility for compliance and cost management. The feature rolls out worldwide in late July 2026, requires manual configuration, and may permanently delete data outside the set window after a grace period.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will add AI-generated intelligent summaries by mid-August 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. The feature is on by default, requires no configuration, and includes suggested prompts. No user impact or compliance issues are expected.

Title: Exchange Online: Retirement of legacy TLS versions for POP and IMAP connections
Summary: Exchange Online will retire legacy TLS versions (1.0 and 1.1) for POP3 and IMAP4 connections from August 1 to December 31, 2026. Connections must use TLS 1.2 or later; older versions will fail. Organizations should ensure all email clients and applications support TLS 1.2+ and update legacy systems accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders like AppData during egress actions starting mid-September 2026. Admins must update anti-malware, review excluded paths, extend policies, and educate users. Audit mode logs actions; block mode enforces restrictions.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports a pre‑curated file extension list
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now uses a pre-curated list of supported, scannable file extensions for policy configuration, improving accuracy and enforcement consistency. Free-form entry is removed; unsupported extensions must be managed via a specific feature. Rollout begins mid-September 2026, with no change to existing protections unless policies are edited.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Scope Just-in-time audit by user or group
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now requires admins to explicitly configure which users or groups are audited under Just-in-time protection, enhancing control and reducing unnecessary audit noise. The rollout begins mid-September 2026, with updated settings to manage audit scope and activity logging in Activity explorer.

Title: Upcoming change to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Advanced Hunting: removal of SMB signature data
Summary: Starting July 13, 2026, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will remove SMB signature inspection events from Advanced Hunting to improve performance. Queries using these events will stop working; users should update them to filter SMB traffic by port 445 in DeviceNetworkEvents before July 1, 2026.

Title: Microsoft OneNote: Copilot notebook available in OneNote on Mac
Summary: Microsoft is rolling out Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace in OneNote for Mac, starting early August 2026. It requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, is enabled by default without admin controls, and helps users organize and analyze notes using generative AI. No action is required from admins.

Title: Roadmap information for Microsoft Copilot Studio and agents transitioning to the Microsoft 365 Roadmap
Summary: Starting July 2, 2026, Microsoft Copilot Studio and agent roadmap updates will move from Release Planner to the Microsoft 365 Roadmap for unified tracking. Release Planner links will redirect automatically, but some custom planning features will be discontinued. No immediate action is required.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Notebooks: Introducing Infographics
Summary: Microsoft Copilot Notebooks introduces Infographics, enabling users to create visual summaries from notebook content with grounded references. Public preview starts late May 2026, general availability in early July 2026. The feature is enabled by default, respects existing policies, requires no action, and enhances communication without disrupting workflows.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection - Content Explorer: Unscanned data and Classification History summary metrics
Summary: Microsoft Purview Content Explorer will add summary metrics showing unscanned files and classification history trends, helping admins monitor data classification. The feature rolls out from July to November 2026, is enabled by default, requires no action, and does not change existing data processing.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New experience when users minimize the meeting window
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating the minimized meeting window to allow key actions like raising hands and sending reactions without reopening the full window. Users can choose between expanded or compact views. The rollout paused as of July 7, 2026, with no impact on screen sharing or admin settings.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New search experience for cloud files in the file attach picker
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enable search for cloud files directly in the attach file picker, improving quick sharing in chats and channels. Rollout starts June 2026, completing by late July. Users see only files they have access to, with no changes to permissions. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Quick Share for images
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Quick Share option for images, enabling faster sharing and copying of image links within chats, channels, and shared tabs. Rollout starts June 2026, with existing permissions maintained, no new admin controls, and the feature enabled by default. No user action required.

Title: New file download manager in Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out a new file download manager starting June 2026, featuring auto-dismissing download notifications after about 4 seconds and easy access to downloaded files. The update is enabled by default, affects all users globally, and requires no action but may need helpdesk notification.

Title: Keyboard shortcut dialog has search functionality
Summary: Microsoft Teams is adding search functionality to the Keyboard shortcuts dialog, enabling users to find shortcuts by action name or key combination. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from early June to late July 2026, improving shortcut discoverability and customization without affecting existing workflows.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, enhancing in-room participant experience. Presenters retain full control via the console. The feature requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, is enabled by default, and needs no user action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for PowerPoint, Excel, and Word files
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out a standardized preview experience for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files by late July 2026, improving load times and reliability. PowerPoint and Excel previews are on iOS and Android; Word preview is iOS only. The feature is enabled by default with no admin action needed.

Title: Queues app on Microsoft Teams mobile
Summary: The Queues app in Microsoft Teams mobile (iOS and Android) will allow calling representatives and supervisors to manage call queues, view queue details, and call history on the go. Rollout begins mid-May 2026, completing by end of July, enabled by default for licensed Teams Phone and Premium users.

Title: Microsoft Teams introduces efficiency mode to improve app responsiveness
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out Efficiency Mode by late May 2026 to improve performance on hardware-constrained devices. Enabled by default, it adjusts video resolution and app behavior to enhance responsiveness. Users can opt out via settings. The rollout completes by end of July 2026.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, allowing improved, low-latency streaming with automatic failover alongside existing RTMP. No user impact; admins must enable SRT in meeting policies and update event production accordingly.

Title: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
Summary: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place. This feature, rolling out from late August to late September 2026, supports automated or manual task creation via Facilitator and requires Teams, Planner, and Loop enabled in the tenant.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
Summary: Microsoft Teams is migrating private channels to use group mailboxes, increasing limits to 1000 channels per team and 5000 members per channel, and enabling meetings in private channels. Migration runs from October 2025 to April 2026. Admins must remediate ownerless channels by July 2026 or risk deletion. Compliance policies must be updated to apply at the team group level.

Title: Change to taskbar pinning behavior for M365 Copilot and companion apps
Summary: Starting mid-July 2026, Microsoft 365 admin center taskbar pinning will only manage the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, excluding companion apps (Files, Calendar, People). Existing companion app pins remain unchanged. Organizations needing companion app pinning should use Microsoft Intune policies instead. No action required if only Copilot is pinned.

Title: Completed: Conditional Access enforcement update for policies with resource exclusions
Summary: Conditional Access enforcement update completed in your tenant The rollout of the Conditional Access enforcement update for policies targeting All resources with resource exclusions has now been completed in your tenant. As previously communicated, this update improves enforcement consistency for certain authentication flows as part of Microsoft's Secure Future Initiative. Title: Change meeting organizer via PowerShell cmdlet in Exchange Online
Summary: A new PowerShell cmdlet in Exchange Online will let admins change meeting organizers without recreating meetings. Rollout starts late June 2026, completing by August 2026. The new organizer gains full control; internal attendees’ calendars update silently, while external attendees must reaccept. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: New integration with Adaptive protection
Summary: Microsoft Purview is introducing a public preview of Adaptive protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management, automatically retaining deleted content from elevated risk users for 120 days. Rollout begins late June 2024, with general availability in late October 2026. Admins enable it via the Purview compliance portal.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Organization evaluation score for apps and agents
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a centralized evaluation experience for apps and agents, providing admins with an automatic evaluation score and detailed reports based on defined trust requirements. Rollout begins late February 2026 (preview) and late September 2026 (general availability). The feature is enabled by default with no required admin action.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Modify and override submitted evaluations
Summary: We are announcing the ability to modify and override submitted evaluations in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature has reached general availability. How does this affect me? This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or...

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales – Copy opportunities for repeat deals
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the copy opportunity feature to start a new one in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on August 5, 2026. How does this affect me? With the copy opportunity feature, you can duplicate an existing opportunity to quickly create a new one. The new opportunity retains key customer, deal, product, stakeholder, and custom-field information from the source opportunity, including hidden custom fields. Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Bullseye routing with User groups
Summary: We are announcing Bullseye routing with User groups in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on July 17, 2026. How does this affect me? Title: Microsoft Planner: eDiscovery support for Microsoft Planner
Summary: eDiscovery support for Microsoft Planner, including search and legal holds, will be generally available in early July 2024. This feature allows admins to search and hold Planner tasks, comments, and attachments in Purview, but only for tenants created before October 2022. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Publish to Power BI retires starting August 19, 2024
Summary: The "Publish to Power BI" feature in Microsoft Excel will retire on August 19, 2024. Users should transition to the Power BI service for publishing needs. The Power BI service offers additional capabilities not found in Excel's publishing feature, and this change will not affect existing workbooks. Users must upload workbooks to Power BI from OneDrive or SharePoint.

Title: Microsoft 365 apps now support OpenDocument Format 1.4
Summary: Microsoft 365 apps now support OpenDocument Format 1.4, saving ODF files in this format by default and adding features already in Open Office XML. General availability began in May 2024, with Office LTSC 2024 Preview support in June 2024. Details at the provided link.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Apply shapes to images
Summary: SharePoint Online will soon introduce a feature allowing users to apply shapes like square, circle, triangle, hexagon, pebble, and teardrop to images in Image and Text web parts. Rollout begins late June 2024 and ends late July 2024. No admin action is needed before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: “Remove-SPOExternalUser” retires starting July 29, 2024
Summary: The "Remove-SPOExternalUser" PowerShell cmdlet for SharePoint Online will retire on July 29, 2024. Users should transition to the "Remove-AzureADUser" cmdlet and update workflows to avoid disruption. Further details and guidance are available at Microsoft Learn.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New added feature called the Take action wizard in Threat Explorer.
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 has introduced a new feature called Take action wizard in Threat Explorer, allowing execution of multiple response actions simultaneously. This enhancement aids in efficient threat remediation, supporting actions like email purging, inline submissions, and Tenant level block actions for up to 100 messages. Rollout began in mid-April 2024 and will complete by late June 2024. Users need the Search and Purge role to perform email purge actions.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: New search UI for contacts and global address list
Summary: Outlook for Mac will introduce a new search UI for contacts and the global address list, starting late June 2024, with no preparation needed. This update is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 397093.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: New feedback button
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint Online is introducing a feedback button for users to submit compliments, problems, or suggestions about SharePoint features and functionality. The feedback icon will be visible on SharePoint sites and Microsoft will review all feedback submitted by customers to improve products and troubleshoot product issues. Feedback collection is on by default, but can be turned off using the Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365 in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. The rollout is exp...

Title: Optimize for Video setting for screensharing
Summary: Microsoft Teams will provide manual settings to optimize screen sharing for video clips by reducing lag and improving the quality of video playback when sharing video clips in Teams meetings. The rollout will begin in early May 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-June 2024 for Worldwide. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Update to only show site results at a tenant root site when in the "site search" scope
Summary: Starting from mid-June 2024, SharePoint Online will only show site results from the tenant root site when in the "site search" scope. This update will not affect the search experience if the root site is set as a hub, set as a Viva Connections home site, or configured to show hub or tenant wide results by default. If you want to continue to get all results when searching from the root site, you can configure the default search scope at the root site to show tenant wide results.

Title: New Microsoft Defender Antivirus services on Windows Devices
Summary: Microsoft Defender Antivirus on Windows 10 and Windows 11 will be shipping with a new service called Microsoft Defender Core service. The rollout will occur in stages, starting with a preview in November 2023 and worldwide rollout in April 2024. To prepare, users need to update the Platform Update to the latest version and allow specific URLs. If using an Application Control application or running a 3rd party AV and/or EDR, add the Microsoft Defender Core Service process to the allowed list.

Title: Microsoft Edge for Business: Customize organizational branding using the Microsoft Edge management service
Summary: Late March 2024, admins can customize organizational branding assets onto Edge for Business through the Microsoft Edge management service. This branding can help users differentiate between multiple profiles and browser windows. Admins can control, preview, and customize the organization name, accent color, logo, and Edge for Business taskbar icon overlay. Default branding can be enabled through policies. Preview for this new feature began on March 21, 2024, and is expected to complete within a...

Title: Microsoft Purview enforcing one capturing group limit for custom sensitive information types
Summary: Microsoft Purview will enforce a limit of one capturing group per regular expression in custom Sensitive Information Types by early July 2026. Admins must update existing SITs with multiple capturing groups to comply, or creation and updates will be blocked, affecting DLP policy functionality.

Title: New in Catalog Management: Create custom group of sites
Summary: SharePoint Advanced Management now allows creating custom site groups via CSV uploads, site properties, and Microsoft Entra ID attributes to improve governance and reporting. Rolling out worldwide June–July 2026, it affects SharePoint and Microsoft 365 admins with no required user changes or migrations.

Title: Adaptive Scopes in Microsoft Purview – Support for Multivalued Attributes in “Not Equals” Queries
Summary: Adaptive Scopes in Microsoft Purview will now fully evaluate “not equals” conditions across all values in multivalued attributes. This update, rolling out from mid-July to early August 2025, may change scope behavior and policy application. Review existing scopes, monitor impacts, and communicate with stakeholders. More details at the provided link.

Title: Reminder: Action Required: Update OneNote to Ensure Seamless and Secure Sync
Summary: Update OneNote to the latest version to ensure seamless and secure sync due to infrastructure upgrades completed in June 2025. Users on older versions may experience sync issues. Refer to the Microsoft Support article for troubleshooting. All OneNote platforms are affected. Contact Microsoft support for further assistance.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Confidence level filtering in Content Explorer Cmdlet
Summary: Microsoft is enhancing the Export-ContentExplorerData PowerShell cmdlet to include confidence level information and a new filtering parameter. This update, rolling out from late July to late August 2025, helps admins better target and analyze sensitive data.
