Teams phone devices should be updated with the latest application from the Teams admin center. Rollout will happen automatically by the specified date with no admin action required.

Title: Plan for Change: Migrate classic Conditional Access policies
Summary: Azure AD Graph is retiring, and admins must migrate classic Conditional Access policies to Microsoft Graph by June 30, 2024. Failure to migrate will prevent new device enrollment and compliance via the Company Portal and Intune apps across various platforms.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: New Embedded Admin role impact
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing a new SharePoint Embedded Administrator role to manage SharePoint Embedded Applications and containers. Global Administrators can continue to create and manage SharePoint Embedded applications until mid-March 2024, after which only Global Administrators or SharePoint Embedded Administrators will be authorized to execute cmdlets. The rollout will begin in early March 2024 and complete by late March 2024 for Public Preview and mid-April 2024 to late May 2024 for...

Title: Microsoft Lists: New forms experience
Summary: Microsoft Lists is introducing an updated forms experience that allows list owners and collaborators to collect information on their lists with updated Lists forms. Forms can be created quickly and shared with a link, and all submitted responses appear immediately as new list items that list collaborators can see and refine. The new feature will roll out in mid-March 2024 for targeted release and late March 2024 for Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, and DoD. The message provides instructions for form cr...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights leader deep-dive reports focus on customer, business operations, and agility
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights will release two new leader reports focusing on new hire onboarding and external focus. The rollout will begin in late March 2024 and complete by late May 2024. Leaders must review and assess the impact on their organization and update documentation as needed.

Title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Remove pauses and silences in your videos
Summary: Clipchamp's new AI feature, silence removal, automatically deletes pauses over 3 seconds in videos and is free in preview. Rollout begins early July 2024, completing by late July. No admin action needed for rollout. Details: Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 383137.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Updated Lists in Team Sites, Lists progressive web app (PWA), and Teams
Summary: The update for Microsoft SharePoint Lists enhances performance and adds features like ratings, direct image uploads, real-time collaboration visibility, and view switching. Rollout begins in February 2024, with completion by June 2024. No preparation is needed, but informing users is suggested. Lists with certain configurations will not be updated yet.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Authentication strength improvements to support passkeys
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID will improve authentication strength to support passkeys stored on devices. Users will see new registration options in My Security Info. The rollout will begin in mid-May 2024 and is expected to complete by early August 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this change, but you may want to update relevant documentation.

Title: eDiscovery Premium-Enhancements to eDiscovery experience for Microsoft Forms content
Summary: Microsoft Forms content can now be searched in eDiscovery Premium, allowing admins to better manage tasks that require eDiscovery capabilities. The rollout will begin mid-December 2023 and complete by late December 2023 for preview, and late April 2024 for Worldwide. Appropriate licensing and permissions are required. No additional action is needed to prepare for this feature.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Direct Media Connection cmdlet
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new feature called Direct Media Connection in April 2024. Admins can choose to involve a relay or media processor between meetings and 1:1 calls. Direct Media Connection is a user-level policy that admins can set as a tenant default or configure for specific individuals in their tenant. The rollout will happen automatically, and no admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Set New Ringtones in Teams Mobile
Summary: Microsoft Teams Mobile (iOS and Android) will soon allow users to customize ringtones for different types of calls, including forwarded and delegated calls. This feature will be available from early to mid-June 2025. Users can find these settings under Teams Settings > Calling > Choose a ringtone.

Title: Default XMLA configuration for Fabric and Power BI capacities changes to Read/Write
Summary: Starting June 9, 2025, Fabric and Power BI capacities will default to XMLA read/write operations. This change aids semantic model owners and co-authors with write permissions using XMLA-based tools. Capacity admins can switch XMLA Endpoint to read-only if needed.

Title: Call Waiting Beep Enabled on Desktop and Mobile
Summary: Call Waiting Beep, a feature providing a tone for incoming calls during active calls, will be available on Desktop and Mobile. Rollout starts early June 2025 and completes mid-June 2025. Users must enable it in Teams Settings on Desktop, while it's default on Mobile. Update training and documentation accordingly.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Use integration troubleshooting for modern projects feature
Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable new scenarios to save time troubleshooting errors and reviewing configuration errors, system errors, and other potential issues that otherwise would be buried in logs or overlooked in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on June 6, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature grants customers the ability to identify and resolve dual-write sync issues specifically related to vendor invoices and expenses. It provides d...

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online: Introducing ActorInfoString in Exchange Online audit logs
Summary: Microsoft Exchange Online is introducing a new audit log field, ActorInfoString, to improve audit log accuracy and visibility. Rolling out in late May 2025, this field records the true user agent responsible for each event, aiding security and compliance. No action is required before rollout; existing data remains unchanged.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Add CVI (Cloud Video Interop) coordinates to town hall and webinar invitations
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow meeting organizers to add Cloud Video Interop (CVI) coordinates to town hall and webinar invitations, enabling non-Teams users to join via third-party devices. The rollout starts mid-May 2025, with completion by late June 2025. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Improved options for sharing apps or agents in chat
Summary: Improved options for sharing links to apps or agents in Microsoft Teams chat will roll out from late May 2025 to late June 2025. This update includes new preview cards with user ratings and clear actions. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Join town halls using dial-in options and join codes
Summary: Presenters and organizers can now join Microsoft Teams town halls using dial-in options and join codes, but this feature is not available for attendees. The rollout will begin mid-May 2025 and complete by late June 2025, depending on the release phase. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Bi-directional calendar syncing between Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams
Summary: Businesses using Google Workspace can now enable bidirectional calendar syncing with Microsoft Teams via the Admin app. This feature, rolling out from late May to late June 2025, supports all calendar events and requires proactive enablement by administrators. Up to 50,000 users per tenant can be synced.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Join as attendees in Microsoft events from Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with a Pro license can now join Microsoft events as attendees. This feature will roll out from late May 2025 to mid-September 2025, depending on the environment. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Retirement of Office 365 connectors from SharePoint Online Webparts
Summary: Office 365 connectors will be retired from SharePoint Online Webparts due to limited use. New connections cannot be created after June 15, 2024, and existing connections cannot be updated or managed after August 1, 2024. Organizations should update training and documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft 365 for the web: Add-in device permission prompt for camera, microphone, and geolocation on Edge and Chrome
Summary: Starting May 16, 2024, Microsoft will require add-in developers to prompt users for device permissions on Edge and Chrome for the web versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. A Device Permission API will be available to facilitate this change. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Classic Outlook for Windows: User-initiated insights with Copilot
Summary: Classic Outlook for Windows will add User Initiated Insights with Copilot, letting users highlight email text to get contextual AI-generated insights. Rolling out May-June 2026, the feature is on by default for eligible users, integrates into Outlook without add-ins, and follows existing Microsoft 365 security policies.

Title: Department billing for Microsoft 365 Backup
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup now supports department billing, allowing admins to create up to 50 billing policies by department, geography, or unit, with delegated control via RBAC. Available to new customers from mid-May 2026; existing customers will get it later this year with no immediate changes.

Title: PowerPoint for Windows: Create a presentation with Copilot directly from PowerPoint Home
Summary: PowerPoint for Windows will enable users with a Copilot license to create presentations directly from PowerPoint Home in the File menu, starting late May 2026. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and helps users quickly draft presentations using Copilot.

Title: PowerPoint for Mac: Create a presentation with Copilot directly from PowerPoint Home
Summary: PowerPoint for Mac will enable users with a Microsoft Copilot license to create presentations directly from PowerPoint Home in the File menu, starting late May 2026. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to streamline the workflow from idea to draft.

Title: Copilot in SharePoint will start rolling out to all tenants as an opt-out preview starting in mid-June 2026
Summary: Copilot in SharePoint will roll out as an opt-out preview starting mid-June 2026 for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users. It enables AI-powered content creation and management via a chat interface, respects user permissions, and offers admin controls for tenant or site-level opt-in/out and customization.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Planner Agent rename and rollout to premium and basic plans
Summary: Starting mid-March 2026, the Project Manager agent in Microsoft Planner will be renamed Planner Agent, aligning with Microsoft 365 Copilot branding. It will be available to Copilot-licensed users in group-based Planner premium and basic plans, with no functional changes. Rollout completes by May 2026; no admin action required.

Title: Purview Communication Compliance: Temporary delays in processing due to planned infrastructure migration
Summary: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance is undergoing an infrastructure upgrade from January 5 to June 15, 2026, causing temporary processing delays, intermittent errors, outdated report data, and reduced responsiveness. No data loss will occur. Admins should inform teams; no action is required.

Title: Power Automate - Generate process maps for multi-flow automations
Summary: We are launching process maps in Power Automate to manage flow dependencies, visualize parent-child flows, and enhance automation log observability. This feature will be generally available on May 19, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature grants you to be able to view and manage all flow dependencies involved in your multi-flow process. Parent/child cloud flows and desktop flows are visualized through the process map management experience. End-to-end observability through a process-centric...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app to add Monitor, Whisper, Barge, and Takeover
Summary: Microsoft Teams Queues app will add Monitor, Whisper, Barge, and Takeover features for private coaching. Rollout starts early April 2025 and completes by late May 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Share files faster in Chat and channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to share files from Chat conversations, Chat Shared tabs, or channel posts with fewer clicks while maintaining permissions. The rollout begins in April 2025 and completes by June 2025. No admin action is needed, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Real-Time Text (RTT) in Teams meetings and calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing Real-Time Text (RTT) for meetings and calls on desktop and mobile, enhancing accessibility for users who are deaf, hard of hearing, neurodiverse, or have speech-related disabilities. The rollout starts in May for most users, with specific dates for different regions. No admin action is required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Post project cost for the procurement category upon product receipt
Summary: We are announcing the ability to record project costs when the purchase product receipt is posted for procurement categories in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on June 6, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature generates the sales amount and corresponding financial transactions, enabling users to issue project invoices without needing to wait for the supplier's purchase invoice. It also adds the following functionality to Dynamics 365 Project Ope...

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations- Project cost for service items and procurement categories with item requirements
Summary: We are releasing the ability to streamline project costing for service items and procurement categories when used with item requirements in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on June 6, 2025. How does this affect me? This feature aims to resolve key challenges associated with using service items in Project Operations when the item requirement feature is enabled: It enhances project cost calculations for service, non-stocked items, or procurement categor...

Title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps experience in Defender XDR
Summary: The Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps experience is now generally available in Defender XDR, with auto-redirection enabled by default. Starting June 16th, 2024, there will be no opt-out option. Rollouts began in November 2023 and will complete by early June 2024. Organizations should prepare by moving operations to the Defender XDR portal.

Title: Resolving issues for users remaining on classic Teams
Summary: The message outlines steps for administrators to transition users from classic Teams to new Teams, including updating operating systems, resolving policy restrictions, addressing software blocks, and updating Teams client versions. It applies to various customer types and includes a checklist and resources for assistance.

Title: Retirement of the Microsoft Graph meeting registration beta APIs
Summary: The Microsoft Graph meeting registration beta APIs will be retired, and data will stop returning on September 30th, 2024. Organizations using these APIs must update to the new Microsoft Graph webinar APIs and webhooks by May 2024. New webinar APIs will be available in beta to assist with the transition.

Title: Disablement of Symmetric keys for Microsoft Entra first-party applications Service Principals
Summary: Symmetric keys for Microsoft Entra first-party applications' Service Principals will be disabled to enhance security. Organizations must switch to Asymmetric keys by June 15, 2024, to avoid authentication failures. Preparation involves replacing Symmetric with Asymmetric keys as detailed in the provided link.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Unlock Workforce Engagement capabilities with Customer Service Enterprise license
Summary: We are announcing the ability to unlock Workforce Engagement capabilities with the Customer Service Enterprise license in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on May 29, 2026. How does this affect me? Workforce Engagement capabilities are now included in the Dynamics 365 Customer Service Enterprise license, removing the prior dependency on higher-tier stock-keeping unit (SKU) subscriptions. These new engagement capabilities include: Workforce Management (WF...

Title: Microsoft 365 Backup management through SharePoint Admin Center
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup management for SharePoint and OneDrive will be integrated into the SharePoint Admin Center by mid-May 2026. This centralizes backup configuration without changing user experience or data handling. No action is required, but admins should update documentation and inform teams.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Update to ResultCount parameter in the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet
Summary: Microsoft Purview updates the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet's ResultCount parameter to show a running count of results in real time, adding a new boolean property, AuditSearchRequestMetadata.moreRecordsAvailable, to indicate if more records remain. This improves query progress visibility and affects scripts relying on ResultCount as a final total.

Title: Microsoft Loop – User Accessible Recycle Bin for Loop workspaces
Summary: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with adding a user-accessible recycle bin for Loop workspaces, which would have allowed owners to restore deleted workspaces. No action is needed from users, and the change will not be implemented at this time.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: New guided diagnostics experience for DLP
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a new guided diagnostics experience with Security Copilot insights to help admins troubleshoot and optimize policies. Available mid-May 2026 (preview) and early August 2026 (GA), it enhances visibility into policy evaluation without changing enforcement or user workflows. No action required.

Title: SharePoint News web part: New Filmstrip layout and multi-site news support
Summary: SharePoint News web part introduces a new "Filmstrip" layout for visually prominent news display and expands multi-site news aggregation to GCC, GCC High, and DoD environments. Rollout begins May 2026, affecting SharePoint editors and site owners with no required action but recommended communication and documentation updates.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to personalize opportunity research in Sales Close Agent in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach public preview on May 29, 2026. How does this affect me? Summary: We are announcing the ability to debug flows using variable default values in Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on June 15, 2026. How does this affect me? Summary: We are announcing the ability to export object-centric process mining data to the Microsoft Fabric semantic model in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on May 31, 2026. This feature enables direct publishing of object-centric process mining (OCPM) results into Microsoft Fabric semantic models, making process intelligence data available throughout the Microsoft analytics ecosystem. Summary: We are announcing the ability to use Microsoft Fabric OneLake as a data source. This feature will reach public preview on May 29, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables users to bring customer data directly from Microsoft Fabric OneLake. Users can explore and select customer data stored in OneLake for processing in Customer Insights - Data. Summary: We are announcing the ability to get lead research and next best actions in Sales Home in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach public preview on June 1, 2026. How does this affect me? Summary: We are announcing the ability to ingest data in a normalized data structure format for process mining in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on May 31, 2026. Summary: We are announcing the ability to build better forms with integrated Power Apps in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on May 29, 2026. How does this affect me? Title: Power Automate - Restore accidentally deleted flows
Summary: We are announcing the ability to restore accidentally deleted flows in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on June 1, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature allows flow owners, co-owners, and environment administrators to recover deleted flows quickly and easily within a set timeframe (21 days after deletion), eliminating the need to contact customer support for assistance. Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Manage intraday operations with AI agent (preview)
Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage intraday operations with AI agent in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will be available for preview on May 29, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to use Intraday Agent to monitor queue volumes and service representative adherence in real time, detect deviations from forecasts or schedules, and take automated corrective actions. Intraday Agent will provide proactive alerts, reforecast demand, and adjust staffing activities such as...

Summary: We are announcing the ability to schedule desktop flows directly in Power Automate without requiring a cloud flow as an intermediary trigger. This feature will reach public preview on May 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature introduces a streamlined scheduling experience in Power Automate. Key capabilities include: Users can create schedules directly for desktop flows without needing a cloud flow as an intermediary trigger. Title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-AI app selection for Generative AI apps indicators
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will enable admins to select specific Generative AI apps for monitoring insider risk signals, improving relevance and cost efficiency. The feature rolls out May–June 2026, applies to Copilot and enterprise AI apps, and requires no user workflow changes. Admins can configure settings post-rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Dashboard web part will be available for all sites
Summary: The dashboard layout web part in Microsoft SharePoint will be available for all sites, including Team and Communication sites, starting late May 2025. This feature will be on by default and requires no action, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended. More details are on Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 486832.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Audit search: New filters will be available
Summary: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with the new audit search filters in Microsoft Purview at this time. The update included four new fields: Id, UserType, UserKey, and ClientIP. They will communicate further via the Message center when ready to proceed. No admin action is required.

Title: MDE Mobile: Open Wi-Fi and Certificate Detections will be logged as Events
Summary: The update to Microsoft Defender for Mobile will log open Wi-Fi and suspicious certificate detections as events instead of alerts starting late May 2025. This change aims to reduce alert fatigue and improve triage efficiency. No action is required from admins, and current security settings remain unchanged. GCC organizations can disregard this message.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced compliance and security in voicemail messages
Summary: Microsoft has postponed the rollout of enhanced compliance and security features for voicemail messages in Microsoft Exchange to late May 2025. The updates include changes to the "From" field to comply with RFC 6854 and the addition of "Unverified" and "External" tags for messages from external PSTN calls and federated tenants. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced compliance in voicemail messages
Summary: The rollout of RFC compliance changes for Microsoft Teams voicemail messages has been postponed to May 2025. Voicemails will now be sent from noreply@skype.voicemail.microsoft.com to meet RFC 6854 standards. The rollout will complete by mid-June 2025 for most users and late June 2025 for GCCH and DoD.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Expanded eligibility for Python in Excel
Summary: Microsoft Excel's Python feature will be available to more users by late June 2025. Initially for Office 365 E3/E5, it will expand to Office 365 E1, Business Basic, and F3. Users can add Python formulas securely in Excel. Premium compute options are available through add-on licenses, with self-service purchase options.

Title: Microsoft Teams for iOS/Android: Walkie Talkie app will move to the three-dot menu if users separate chats and channels
Summary: The Walkie Talkie app in Microsoft Teams for iOS/Android will move to the three-dot menu if users separate chats and channels. Admins can create a custom app policy to keep it on the app bar. This change will roll out in May 2025. Users can combine chats and channels to retain the app on the app bar.

Summary: Update: Release of this feature has been postponed, we will announce a new date in the future. We are announcing the monitor work item lifecycle in Application Insights feature for Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature integrates Dynamics 365 Contact Center with Application Insights, giving organizations self-service access to monitor operational telemetry. How does this affect me? Work item lifecycles will be accessible to organizations through Application Insights, allowing them to monitor...

Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting May 13th, 2025 (PST). Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting May 14th, 2024 (PST). Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention - Enrich Defender alerts Graph API with DLP event data
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP event details will be integrated into Microsoft Graph Security APIs alongside Defender alerts, simplifying correlation, reporting, and SIEM integration. Public preview starts late May 2026; general availability begins late June 2026. This affects admins using these APIs for DLP-related alert data.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Mobile App: Capability to drive awareness via Notifications on M365 Admin Center
Summary: Microsoft 365 Admin Center now lets IT admins notify users about the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app via targeted notifications, guiding them to a secure, approved download. This admin-initiated feature helps reduce use of non-sanctioned AI apps and supports compliance with existing security controls.

Title: Microsoft Teams: External domains anomalies report
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out the External domains anomalies report by late May 2026, enabling admins to detect unusual external communication patterns. The report, in the Teams admin center, highlights anomalies and offers a block option. Admins can enable alerts for proactive notifications; no action is needed to access it.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Retirement of IDCRL authentication protocol and enforcement of OpenID Connect and OAuth protocols
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the legacy IDCRL authentication protocol in SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business by May 1, 2026, enforcing modern protocols OpenID Connect and OAuth. Legacy authentication will be blocked starting February 16, 2026, with temporary re-enablement until April 30, 2026. Organizations must migrate promptly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Participants Can Request Collaborative Annotation Sessions
Summary: Microsoft Teams now allows meeting participants on Windows and macOS apps to request collaborative annotation during screen sharing, subject to presenter approval. Organizers can control who can start annotations via a new meeting option. Rollout begins May 2026, with no admin action required.

Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Monthly Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting May 13th, 2026 (PST). Title: Microsoft Power BI: Tenant setting changes for Microsoft Azure Maps in Power BI
Summary: Admins will have updated tenant settings for Azure Maps in Power BI, split into three controls. The update requires Power BI Desktop April 2025 version or later. Rollout begins mid-June 2025. Notify admins and users, review configurations, and use endpoint management to check Power BI Desktop versions.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Slide Control for PowerPoint presenters
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a Slide Control feature for PowerPoint presentations, allowing presenters to share control of slides in meetings and events. The rollout will occur from July to September 2025, varying by release type. The feature will be enabled for internal users and disabled for external users.

Title: Upcoming changes to Defender for Identity activities and alerts in Defender for Cloud Apps experiences
Summary: Defender for Identity activities and alerts will be retired from Defender for Cloud Apps by late May 2025. All data and functionality will be available through Microsoft Defender XDR. Organizations should update their resources and create new custom detections in Advanced Hunting.

Title: Microsoft Purview Content Explorer and Data Explorer: Data Classification List Viewer role required for data access
Summary: Microsoft Purview Content Explorer and Data Explorer will enforce the Data Classification List Viewer role for accessing classified data starting May 2026. Admins must assign this role to users needing access, ensuring consistent role-based access without new permissions or configuration changes.

Title: Improving Activity Explorer load performance with updated default time range
Summary: Activity Explorer in Microsoft Purview will default to a 1-day time range instead of 7 days starting May 2026 to improve load performance. Users can still view up to 30 days via filters. No data retention or query capabilities change. No action is required, but inform users of the update.

Title: Action required: Upgrade macOS 13 devices to maintain Teams desktop access
Summary: Microsoft Teams will stop desktop client updates for macOS 13 starting May 2026, with upgrade notifications in June and blocking access by mid-July. Users must upgrade macOS or use Teams on the web. Organizations should identify affected devices, plan upgrades, and prepare users and support teams accordingly.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Admins can manage agents at scale with bulk lifecycle actions
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports bulk lifecycle management of agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing admins to perform on-demand bulk actions like installing and reassigning agents to improve governance and reduce manual tasks. Rule-based automation is planned for a future update.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks in the OneNote mobile app (iOS)
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks on OneNote mobile (iOS), combining audio transcription, image capture, and typed notes in one session. Available now in preview, general rollout begins late May 2026. It requires Microsoft 365 Copilot and SharePoint or OneDrive licenses.

Title: Outlook: Support for recommended and automatically applied sensitivity labels in Outlook for iOS and Android
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will support recommended and automatic sensitivity labels during email composition starting mid-April 2026, aligning with Microsoft Purview Information Protection policies. This feature is on by default for organizations with existing labeling policies and requires no changes to current Purview configurations.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Organization data types will retire
Summary: Microsoft Excel will retire the Organization data types feature on July 31, 2025, due to low usage and high costs. Users are advised to use the "Get Data > From Power BI" import feature or an add-in for custom entities. This change affects all Excel platforms, but existing data will be preserved without refresh capability. Bing data types remain supported.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: New “Enterprise AI apps” option in collection policies (Preview)
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing a new "Enterprise AI apps" category in collection policies, available in public preview from mid-May to early June 2025. This feature requires an Azure subscription and an E5 license. Organizations must update their policies to continue ingesting data from AI apps like ChatGPT Enterprise. Further details and preparation steps are provided in the message.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center highlights additional security and compliance information available for apps
Summary: Microsoft Teams admin center now includes security and compliance information for apps directly in the app detail pages. Admins can view data security assessments, vulnerability scans, and certification statuses. Notifications and tutorials will guide admins to these features, which will roll out from late February 2025 to early July 2025. No action is required.

Title: Power Automate - Fix save errors in your cloud or agent flow with Copilot
Summary: We are announcing the ability to fix save errors in your cloud or agent flow with Copilot in Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on June 6, 2025. How does this affect me? You can now receive assistance from Copilot when you encounter a cloud or agent flow save error. If an error occurs, an 'Assist me' button will appear in the message bar. Select it to open the Copilot pane, where Copilot can review your flow and error details, and deliver clear, step-by-step guidance to...

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Centralized admin role management from the Engage admin center
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is launching centralized admin role management in mid-May 2025, simplifying role assignments and management. This update, part of phasing out the legacy Yammer admin center, will enhance visibility and governance. The new experience will be available in the Engage admin center and will be on by default. No prior admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhancing the default experience for frontline workers
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the default experience for frontline workers by making it easier to connect with their organization and introducing more intuitive app names. Changes include renaming the Connections app to 'Home' and adding the Engage app to default pinned apps. Rollout begins mid-April 2025 and completes by late May 2025.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New "Tag mentions" filter for the Activity feed
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new "Tag mentions" filter in the Activity feed to help users see their tag mentions in chats and channel messages. The rollout will start in February 2025 and complete by May 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: HTML formatting now supported for Message center posts synced to Planner
Summary: Starting May 13, 2026, Message center posts synced to Planner will support HTML formatting, improving readability with rich text, links, and images. This update, enabled by default, ensures consistent display between Message center and Planner without requiring any action from admins. Existing synced items will update over time.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows (Teams Rooms Pro only)
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows (Pro only) will support Miracast for wireless content sharing, rolling out from mid-May to late May 2026. The feature is off by default, enabled via IT admin portal, requires Miracast-compatible laptops, and has no impact unless activated by admins.

Title: Microsoft Loop – Admin Usage Reports
Summary: Microsoft decided not to proceed with the planned Microsoft Loop admin usage reports. Loop usage can still be monitored through existing Microsoft 365 admin usage dashboards. No action is required from administrators, and the change will not be implemented at this time.

Title: Microsoft Teams Copilot without transcription becomes default for meetings - conversation history now persists
Summary: Microsoft Teams Copilot's default mode would switch to no transcription with persistent conversation history, but this change is currently not proceeding. Affected tenants must manually enable transcription for post-meeting queries. Admins can adjust policies to retain current behavior; tenants updated after June 2024 are unaffected.

Title: Microsoft Loop – Require Existing Microsoft 365 Group for New Loop workspaces
Summary: A new Microsoft 365 Cloud Policy will block tenant-owned Loop workspace creation, requiring workspaces to be created only through existing Microsoft 365 Groups in Teams channels. This rollout begins late April 2026, aiming to align workspace management with existing governance but may limit some user scenarios.

Title: Updated UI for Copilot Chat entry point in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apps
Summary: Microsoft 365 is updating Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint with a new Dynamic Action Button on the canvas, contextual prompts, and improved keyboard/screen reader access. Rollout starts December 2025, completing by May 2026. No admin action required unless changing pin settings for Copilot Chat.

Title: OneDrive: Simplified file transfer for departing employees
Summary: OneDrive is enhancing file management for departing employees with improved notifications, filtering, and bulk transfers that preserve sharing. Rollout starts mid-October 2025, completing by May 2026. Managers automatically gain access to deleted accounts’ files, with streamlined transfer steps and consolidated collaborator alerts.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service- Estimate AI credits for agents from forecasted demand
Summary: We are announcing the ability to estimate AI credits for agents from forecasted demand in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on May 20, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables workforce planners to translate forecasted service demand into AI credit requirements within Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center. To move from demand forecast to credit estimation: Step 1: As a supervisor, log in to the Copilot Service Workspace and create a...

Title: Microsoft Power Automate - Automate administrator-level desktop applications in unattended runs
Summary: We are announcing the ability to automate administrator-level desktop applications in unattended runs in Microsoft Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on May 18, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables support for automating desktop applications that require administrator rights when running desktop flows in unattended mode. By configuring a registry setting, you can extend unattended automation to interact with applications that require elevated permissions....

Title: Microsoft Teams Phone Mobile: New "Call my phone" feature
Summary: Teams Phone Mobile is introducing a "Call my phone" feature to transfer calls from the Teams app to a cell phone dialer seamlessly using the Audio Conferencing Subscription service. It's for individual calls only and will be available after updates in June and July 2024. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Data Lifecycle Management | Enable deletion of non-empty folders under Retention policy in SharePoint and OneDrive
Summary: The new feature allows users to delete non-empty folders under a Retention policy in SharePoint and OneDrive, ensuring they remain deleted after syncing with OneDrive for Business. It will roll out in early May 2024 and is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 394689. Preparation involves getting started with Data Lifecycle Management in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality reports for Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) rooms in the Pro Management portal
Summary: Admins can now access detailed call quality reports for BYOD rooms in the Pro Management portal, requiring a Teams Shared Devices license. This feature will be available globally in June 2025. It helps diagnose network, audio, and video issues, improving meeting room experiences and reducing complaints.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Resize Teams windows
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to resize the main window, chat window, and meeting stage to 360px or 502px wide, down from 720px, without losing functionality. This update, enhancing accessibility and multitasking, will roll out from late January to late May 2025. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft 365: Dynamic rules for Microsoft 365 Backup to simplify backup management at scale
Summary: Dynamic rules for Microsoft 365 Backup, released in April 2025, automate backup policies based on distribution lists and security group memberships. This feature, now generally available, reduces manual effort and ensures up-to-date protection. No additional configuration is needed, but review your groups for accuracy. Learn more [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/backup/backup-view-edit-policies?view=o365-worldwide&tabs=sharepoint).

Title: Microsoft Edge: New location for Edge profile in the toolbar
Summary: Microsoft Edge will move the user Profile label to the toolbar to increase tab visibility. This change will roll out in May 2025 with Edge version 136. The Profile label will become a minimized icon on the right side of the toolbar. No admin action is required, but user notification is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Add a Loop workspace tab to standard channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow adding a Loop workspace tab to standard channels for real-time collaboration. The rollout begins mid-May 2025 for targeted release and late May 2025 for general availability. Users can create, manage, and share content within Teams, adhering to Microsoft 365 compliance standards. No admin action is required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Upload phone numbers in bulk for direct routing
Summary: We are announcing the ability to upload your existing phone numbers in bulk for direct routing in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on May 30, 2025. How does this affect me? When integrating existing telephony infrastructure with Dynamics 365 Contact Center through Azure Communication Services direct routing, customers can bulk import their existing phone numbers. A template is generated in the Contact Center admin center, under the advance settings in the...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced capabilities for spotlight in Viva Connections!
Summary: Viva Connections is enhancing spotlight capabilities, providing more control over content display with 11 slots. Pinned items will be shown first, followed by dynamic SharePoint news. The desktop experience will blend prioritized content with news updates. Rollouts begin mid-May 2024, with new customization settings introduced. Preparation involves generating news and selecting content sources for spotlight.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Unified settings and policies management in Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams admin center is introducing a unified settings and policies management experience, consolidating them in one place for easier administration. Rollout begins in June 2024, with options to opt-in or opt-out until mandatory adoption by the end of September 2024. No changes to existing settings and policies are required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Avatars wardrobe updates available soon
Summary: New professional wardrobe styles for avatars are coming to Microsoft Teams, with a rollout expected to complete by mid-May 2024. This update will be available for various Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 licenses and will require no admin action prior to rollout. Users can customize their avatars in the Avatars for Teams app. Some may experience color changes in their avatar's outerwear, which can be easily customized.

Title: New search folders supported in new Outlook for Windows and web
Summary: New Outlook for Windows and web introduces two search folders: 'Categorized Mail' and 'Mail from Specific People,' to improve search functionality. Rollout starts mid-June 2024, completing early July 2024. Users must manually create these folders to use the new features. More information is available on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 386903 and Microsoft Support.

Title: Sway: Changes in Video/Audio upload for new content.
Summary: Starting early June 2024, Sway authors can no longer upload new video and audio files but must embed them instead. Previously uploaded media will still work. Users should familiarize themselves with the embedding feature to prepare for this change.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Easier discoverability of Workflows templates
Summary: In Microsoft Teams, Workflow cards in chats or channels will now show the template used, with a rollout starting in June 2024 and completing in November 2024. A footer link will be added for direct template access, except for certain custom or non-Teams connector workflows.

Title: Updates to SharePoint home sites
Summary: SharePoint home sites are being updated with simplified setup, new Resources and Announcements web parts, and enhanced customization for the renamed Viva Connections app, now called the SharePoint app in Teams. Rollout begins May 2026, with no changes to existing branding or data permissions.

Title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: View AI interaction messages for anonymized users
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will let analysts view AI prompt and response messages linked to insider risk indicators, even with user anonymization enabled. This enhances investigation context while maintaining privacy, role-based access, and audit controls. Rollout begins May 2026 with no user impact or required action.

Title: Lock-free coauthoring in Microsoft Word
Summary: Lock-free coauthoring in Microsoft Word allows multiple users to edit the same paragraph simultaneously, enhancing real-time collaboration. It will roll out globally from mid-May to early June 2026, enabling the feature by default without admin action. Older versions fallback to existing coauthoring; no changes to permissions or storage.

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online: Upcoming secure-by-default changes for Exchange APIs
Summary: Starting June 2026, Microsoft will update the default user consent policy for Microsoft Graph to require admin consent for additional Exchange-related permissions. Users cannot grant consent for these unless apps are approved in the Mail client policy. Existing consents and custom policies remain unaffected.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention support Microsoft Teams call logs
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will support retention and deletion policies for Microsoft Teams call logs starting late April 2026. Compliance admins can manage Teams call logs to meet regulatory requirements, with no impact on user calling experience. Organizations should review and update retention policies accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Chat with anyone with an email address
Summary: The feature allowing Teams users to chat with anyone via email without requiring recipients to have a Teams account was planned but is not being released at this time. It was available in targeted preview for small and medium businesses but is now paused, with no general availability announced.

Title: Microsoft Power Automate - Compare flow versions
Summary: We are announcing the ability to compare flow versions in Microsoft Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on May 15, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to view two versions of a desktop flow side by side to identify changes. The comparison will highlight added, modified, and deleted actions with color indicators. Users will also see differences in variables, UI elements, images, and can expand steps to review detailed modifications. This will help users trou...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Users can join town hall and webinars using Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) codes
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow organizers and presenters to join town halls, webinars, and structured meetings using PSTN codes. This feature will roll out from mid-May to early June 2025. No admin action is required, but organizations should review configurations and notify users.

Title: (Highlight) Microsoft 365 Copilot app: Updates for unlicensed Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (Wave 2 Spring release)
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot app's Wave 2 Spring release updates for unlicensed users include a refreshed navigation pane, simplified Copilot Chat experience, and an Agent Store. The rollout begins mid-May 2025 for targeted release and late May 2025 for general availability. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams Events: Attendees and presenters no longer receive an email when an attendee list is updated
Summary: Attendees and presenters in Microsoft Teams events will no longer receive emails when the attendee list is updated. This change will roll out from late May 2025 to late June 2025, requiring no admin action. Notify users and update documentation as needed.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat available in Teams and Outlook
Summary: The Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, previously Microsoft Copilot, will be available in Teams and Outlook for Entra account users starting late January 2025, with the rollout completing by mid-March. It will be automatically pinned for licensed users, and others can pin it manually or add it from the Store. Admins have control over the pinning settings.

Title: Microsoft Defender XDR services: Deploy the New Defender for Identity sensor on Microsoft Entra Connect servers
Summary: Deploy the new Defender for Identity sensor on Microsoft Entra Connect servers. The classic sensor is now available, enhancing visibility and security for hybrid identity environments. This update is available globally, and organizations should install the sensor for comprehensive monitoring and threat detection. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Improvements to SharePoint files/folders deletion indicators
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon update indicators for SharePoint files/folders deletion, including items moved to the recycle bin. Rollout begins late May 2024, with public preview and general availability phases. No action needed, but indicator thresholds may require adjustments. Details are on Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 388734.

Title: Microsoft Viva Connections app: Search your intranet in Microsoft Teams on iOS and Android tablets
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections app will soon allow iOS and Android tablet users to search their intranet in the app in Teams. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout. We have made the decision not to proceed with this change at this time. We will communicate via Message center when we are ready to proceed.

Title: Microsoft Teams Connect chat - Extended Directory
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing enhancements to Teams Connect for chats with the Teams Connect chat extended directory. IT admins can create an external directory of known external collaborators using their phone numbers, making it easier for users to search external users by name, view a company curated profile, and assign an organization manager for these external partners. Title: Microsoft Teams Events eDiscovery and legal hold support via Microsoft Purview for compliance needs
Summary: Microsoft Teams Events eDiscovery and legal hold support will be available via Microsoft Purview for compliance needs starting from mid-January 2025. Tenant admins can use Purview instead of SharePoint. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Microsoft Office 365: enhanced clarity in submission results
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is updating submission results for enhanced clarity. Administrators will see improved results for submissions, including emails, Teams messages, attachments, URLs, and user reports. The updates will be available via the submission experience and API, linked with Roadmap ID 389856. Rollout begins mid-April 2024. No action is needed from users.

Title: Purview Communication Compliance: Reduce detect-to-investigation time from 24 hours to 1 hour for Viva Engage
Summary: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance will release a feature that reduces detection-to-investigation time from 24 hours to 1 hour for Microsoft Viva Engage private messages and community conversations. This feature will help organizations detect policy violations and ensure user-level privacy. No action is needed from users to prepare for this rollout. The feature will be available for public preview from mid-March 2024 and for general availability from mid-May 2024. Access to the Communica...

Title: Data Loss Prevention - Enriched Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alert email notifications for DLP admins
Summary: Microsoft 365 is updating the Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alert email notifications for DLP admins. The enriched alert email notifications will now include additional context such as alert ID, policy details, device details, and more. This will help admins quickly assess the priority of an alert and determine the next steps before navigating to the Microsoft Purview DLP alerts page or Microsoft 365 Defender DLP alerts page. The rollout will begin in mid-April 2024 and is expected to complete by l...

Title: Profile Card in Teams Mobile
Summary: The rollout of new Profile Cards in Teams Mobile has been updated. Targeted Release will begin in late November 2023 and General Availability will start in early January 2024, completing by late June 2024. These cards allow users to access information and express themselves on Teams Mobile. Organizations may need to update training and documentation.

Title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Public preview of recommended actions for finetuning policies
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is rolling out a public preview of recommended actions for fine-tuning policies. The rollout will begin mid-May 2024 and is expected to be complete by mid-June 2024. No action is required for this update, and the new recommended actions will be accessible through the Recommended Actions page. The solution can be accessed in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Communication Compliance: Contextual Summaries with Copilot for Security
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Communication Compliance will introduce contextual summaries of policy matches in Copilot for Security. This feature will help investigators identify potentially risky content and understand the meaning of the content with just one click. Public preview will begin in early April 2024 and general availability worldwide will begin in early May 2024. Users must have a Copilot for Security license and proper permissions to use this feature. Microsoft Purview Communication Complia...

Title: Self-service purchase and trials of the Microsoft Clipchamp Premium add-on SKU
Summary: Microsoft Clipchamp Premium add-on SKU will allow users to start a trial or purchase with their credit card. The rollout will begin late June 2024 for targeted release and mid-July 2024 for standard release. Users will be charged for the license after the 30-day free trial. Organizations can disable self-service trials and purchases by running an Administrative PowerShell script.

Title: Stream Mobile App Retirement
Summary: The Stream mobile apps will retire on July 1, 2024. Users should switch to the OneDrive and Microsoft 365 mobile apps. Videos with block download policy can only be played online after this date. For preparation and alternatives, visit the provided link. Email for user statistics.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Draggable Presenter Toolbar when screensharing
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new draggable Presenter Toolbar for screensharing, offering presenters more control and customization. It will roll out in stages from early June to late July 2024, with no preparatory action required for organizations. Presenters can reposition the toolbar and it will collapse when not in use.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Adaptive Protection integration will be generally available
Summary: The integration of Adaptive Protection with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will be generally available soon, requiring an E5 Compliance license. Organizations previously using Adaptive Protection with certain add-ons will need to upgrade to maintain access after a 180-day grace period. Rollout begins in June 2024.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Improved Custom Trainable Classifier now in Public Preview
Summary: Microsoft Purview's improved Custom Trainable Classifier is now in Public Preview, offering faster training, simpler sample gathering, automatic testing, and clearer creation flow. It supports English files and will replace the existing feature, with full rollout by late June 2024. Unpublished classifiers will be unavailable; users should publish them to retain.

Summary: We have identified that you have activated early access to the Entra Group control for model-driven app in-app skills in Power Apps and/or Dynamics 365 Apps. On May 21, 2026, we will switch this feature to a new underlying service in preparation for general availability. How does this affect me? This service switch is not expected to have any impact on your users or your existing configuration. Title: Microsoft Entra: Upcoming changes to federatedTokenValidationPolicy default settings
Summary: Microsoft Entra will enforce stricter federatedTokenValidationPolicy by default starting mid-August 2026, blocking federated sign-ins when internalDomainFederation doesn't match the user's UPN domain. This affects tenants with federated domains configured before December 2025 and aims to enhance security against cross-domain sign-in risks.

Title: New Feature: Account Manager in Outlook for Windows
Summary: Outlook for Windows will introduce a new Account Manager by mid-May 2026, showing profile pictures, enabling account switching, and providing quick access to account details. The feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aims to enhance user productivity with a familiar experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Catch up in Teams mobile
Summary: Microsoft Teams mobile will introduce a new "Catch up" view in early 2026, summarizing @mentions, replies, and chats in a card-based layout with swipe actions for quick triage. It is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to help users manage important messages efficiently.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: New chat-first design for the Copilot mobile app
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app is updating to a new chat-first design with a modern interface and streamlined navigation, rolling out mid-May to late August 2026 on iOS and Android. The update is automatic, requires no admin action, and maintains existing workflows.

Title: SharePoint agents trial usage data now available in Microsoft Admin Center
Summary: Admins can now check SharePoint Agents trial usage data in the Copilot Admin Center. This feature is available to all qualifying tenants. Admins can view month-over-month usage and access data via PowerShell. Consider updating your training and documentation. More details are available in the provided link.

Title: Microsoft Defender: Updates to Export Quarantine Message cmdlet
Summary: Microsoft Defender is updating the `Export-QuarantineMessage` cmdlet to include a new `-PasswordV2` parameter for plain text passwords, replacing the old `-Password` parameter. This rollout will occur from late April 2025 to late May 2025 and requires no admin action. Notify users and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Allow usage for custom apps to show in the Developer Portal for Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft 365 admin center will introduce a new setting, "App usage for custom apps," allowing enterprise developers to view app analytics in the Developer Portal for Microsoft Teams. This feature will be rolled out from mid-April to mid-May 2025. By default, the setting will be disabled and requires manual enabling.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Updates to the Teams system tray icon and menu
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating its system tray icon and menu for Windows desktop to simplify use and reduce steps for routine tasks. The rollout will occur from early March to late May 2025. Changes include displaying current presence status and merging personal and work account icons. No user action is required.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: New recommendations for Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft is updating Microsoft Secure Score improvement actions for Defender for Identity, including new posture recommendations. Rollout starts mid-March 2025, with general availability by late May 2025. No admin action is required, but organizations should review their configurations and notify admins.

Title: Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint: Update to Office Add-ins Store policy for minor users
Summary: Users of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint on Windows desktops and the web will soon access an updated Office Add-ins Store. Minor users will no longer be permanently blocked from getting add-ins. The rollout begins in January 2025 and completes by mid-June 2025. Review configurations and notify users accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Search: New Content source filters in All vertical
Summary: Microsoft Search is introducing new content source filters in the All vertical, with a rollout timeline updated to begin in April 2024 for SharePoint Online and Microsoft365.com, and mid-May 2024 for Bing. No action is needed for preparation, but customization options are available for Graph Connector content sources. Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 383953.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Minimize the compose window to multitask in the Outlook app
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android will soon allow users to minimize draft emails and access them from the message list or calendar view. This feature will roll out from early January 2025 to late May 2025. No admin action is required, but users should be informed and documentation updated.

Title: SharePoint Pages Flexible Sections
Summary: Flexible sections in SharePoint allow dynamic resizing and movement of web parts, enabling customized page designs. New section templates combine flexible and column-based sections. Rollout starts early February 2025 for Targeted Release and late March 2025 for General Availability. Notify users and update training materials accordingly.

Title: Teams meeting templates: Fundamentals and security upgrade
Summary: Microsoft is upgrading Teams meeting templates backend for better security, requiring supported Teams and Outlook versions by June 30, 2026. Meeting templates function remains unchanged but need Teams Premium license. Users must update to specified minimum versions; no admin action needed. Communicate changes and ensure app restarts for updates.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage projects that require inventoried products in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on June 5, 2026. Summary: We are announcing the ability to configure inline actions on transaction line items in Store Commerce in Dynamics 365 Commerce. This feature will reach general availability on June 5, 2026. Summary: We are announcing the ability to create and run test cases for subflows, included in an upcoming test suite enhancement for Power Automate desktop. Title: Microsoft Teams: Live chat will be renamed to Customer Connect
Summary: Microsoft Teams' Live chat will be renamed to Customer Connect starting mid-May 2026, completing by end of May. This is a name change only; functionality, settings, and data handling remain unchanged. Existing teams won't be renamed, but new ones post-change will use Customer Connect. No action required.

Title: Assign participants to breakout rooms using CSV import in Microsoft Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support CSV import for breakout room assignments starting mid-May 2026, allowing organizers to bulk-create rooms and pre-assign participants. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and existing controls remain. Inform organizers and update training materials accordingly.

Title: Resources to get started with hotpatch updates for Windows 11, version 24H2
Summary: Hotpatch updates for Windows 11, version 24H2, are available, with the first update for enterprises coming in May 2025. Resources and prerequisites for implementation are provided, including device requirements and enrollment instructions. These updates aim to enhance security while minimizing disruptions.

Title: Additional breakdown metrics by app for Copilot Chat in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat standalone report
Summary: Additional breakdown metrics by app for Copilot Chat in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat standalone report will be available starting early May 2025. The update includes active users and last activity dates for apps like Copilot.cloud.microsoft, Teams, and Outlook. Adjust custom reports to incorporate these new metrics.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to create a plan from an existing solution in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on May 29, 2025. How does this affect me? Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot assisted hours update in Microsoft Copilot dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Viva is updating the Copilot Dashboard to provide a detailed breakdown of Copilot assisted hours for Viva or Viva Insights subscribers. The update, which requires no admin action, will start rolling out in early May 2024 and complete by mid-May 2024. Users should be informed of this change.

Title: Track notifications delivery for Storyline Announcements in Viva Engage
Summary: A new Notifications Delivery Tracker for Storyline Announcements in Viva Engage will launch worldwide in mid-May 2026, providing real-time delivery status across email, Teams, Viva Engage, and mobile push. It enhances visibility in Conversation Analytics without changing publishing workflows or compliance data.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing optical character recognition (OCR) support
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations will add OCR support by mid-2026, enabling automatic text extraction from images to enhance detection of sensitive information. Title: Change Optics report for Exchange Online begins public preview
Summary: The Change Optics report for Exchange Online is in public preview, providing administrators visibility into email traffic affected by upcoming transport changes. It identifies onmicrosoft.com external traffic and Direct Send traffic, is enabled by default, requires no preparation, and does not impact mail flow or users.

Summary: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance is introducing custom tags to give investigators flexibility in using tags that fit their organization's needs. Rollout will begin early March 2024 and complete by mid-May 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout. Investigators can leverage custom tags to leave meaningful information for each policy match and help other investigators understand the status of a message. Title: Teams Rooms sign-in failures after password reset from Pro Management Portal
Summary: Password resets via Teams Pro Management Portal may cause Teams Rooms devices to fail sign-in due to a forced password change prompt they cannot complete, leaving devices in a CannotSignIn state. Avoid resetting these passwords in PMP and manually remediate affected devices if needed.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Copilot account switcher in the Outlook side pane
Summary: Microsoft is adding a Copilot account switcher in the new Outlook for Windows side pane, allowing users with multiple Copilot-enabled accounts to switch accounts within supported experiences. Rollout starts late April 2026, with no impact on single-account users and no required action.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Use Service Operations Agent to simplify setup tasks
Summary: We are announcing Service Operations Agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on April 24, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature allows administrators to set up channels, routing, queues, AI agents, voice configurations, Teams Phone extensibility, and knowledge sources through a single guided assistant.
