Title: Chat visibility in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
Summary: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app will no longer use the "Pin Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat" setting to control chat visibility for unlicensed users. Blocked users see Chat in navigation but remain restricted, while ineligible users won’t see Chat and get a pop-up if accessing it directly. Rollout is late Jan–Mar 2026. No admin action required.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Podcast voice interactions make audio experiences conversational
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will enable real-time voice interactions in podcasts starting April 2, 2026, initially for en-US. This feature allows users to ask questions during audio overviews, enhancing engagement without admin changes. It will be on by default for eligible users with Copilot licenses.

Summary: We will soon update the Work feed experience on the new tab page in Microsoft Edge. The Work feed requires a Microsoft 365 Business or Enterprise license. This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 483505. Summary: Due to ongoing security hardening of Microsoft Purview services, the Microsoft Purview Audit Management Activity API will be hosted on a new set of IP addresses which will have a new service tag. Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Gain policy insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot for Security
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Security in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) now includes Policy Insights, helping admins understand and manage DLP policies. The rollout for general availability is rescheduled to late April 2025. This feature is not available for US government cloud customers. Admins can prepare by acquiring Security Computer Units (SCUs).

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New Exchange Web Services Usage report
Summary: New Exchange Web Services (EWS) usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center by late April 2025. It provides insights into third-party applications using EWS, detailing specific actions and call volumes. No admin action is required before the rollout. See Roadmap ID 469510 for more details.

Summary: The Microsoft Teams desktop client on Microsoft Windows will enhance its default noise suppression mode for all headset users. This improvement will filter out background noise more effectively by identifying and suppressing noises detected far away from the microphone. Summary: Microsoft Graph offers a unified API endpoint for accessing data from multiple Microsoft cloud services in a single response. The Audit Search Graph API allows our customers to programmatically access the new async Audit Search experience, which also provides improved reliability and search completeness. Summary: You can now use the Teams button across personal peripheral devices without having to manually select a specific device in the Teams devices settings. This provides a more seamless experience navigating across multiple certified for Microsoft Teams personal peripheral USB devices (with a wire or a dongle) connected to the same host device (such as your laptop). Summary: Coming soon: Users can create images using natural language to visualize concepts and ideas in the flow of work in iOS/Android mobile apps for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Outlook. Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updated Copilot Notebooks overview page experience
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks will have a redesigned Overview page with AI-generated summaries, key insights, suggested actions, and improved layout. Rolling out from April to May 2026, it will be enabled by default without admin changes, respecting existing permissions. No user action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview: DLP diagnostics enabled for all roles with DLP policy access
Summary: Microsoft Purview is updating permissions so all roles with DLP policy view access can also run diagnostics, enhancing troubleshooting and visibility without changing enforcement. This rollout begins late April 2026 and affects various admin and compliance roles. No action is required from organizations.

Title: Microsoft Viva Glint: AI-generated survey insights with Copilot highlights
Summary: Microsoft Viva Glint will add AI-generated Copilot highlights to survey reports starting April 20, 2026, providing structured summaries of key insights automatically for licensed users. No extra configuration or Microsoft 365 Copilot license is needed, and existing permissions and privacy settings remain unchanged.

Title: Retirement of the Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel option in the Office Customization Tool
Summary: The Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel option will be retired from the Office Customization Tool starting April 15, 2026, completing by April 20, 2026. Existing configurations remain unchanged, but new deployments will only offer Current Channel and Monthly Enterprise Channel options. No admin action is required.

Title: Simplifying agent management with Agent 365
Summary: Starting May 1, 2026, Microsoft is retiring the Agent registry and Agent collections blades in the Microsoft Entra admin center. Agent 365 will be the unified platform for agent management, with a new API replacing the existing one. No immediate admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Security Store now available to discover DLP integrations
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates the Microsoft Security Store, enabling admins to discover, purchase, and manage partner security integrations directly within Purview. Rollout begins late March 2026, completing by mid-April. The feature is enabled by default with no impact on existing policies or users unless integrations are activated.

Summary: On May 8, 2025, the Draft well-written input text with Copilot preview feature will have reached end of support. How does this affect me? After May 8, 2025, the feature will be removed, and end users will no longer be able to draft text using Copilot in canvas apps. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness and no action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft PowerShell cmdlet to allow federation with specific trial tenant domains
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new PowerShell setting, `-AllowedTrialTenantDomains`, to customize federation with specific trial tenant domains while maintaining a default block on all trial-only tenants. This setting will be available in early April 2025. No immediate admin action is required.

Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating the existing Tasks by Planner and To Do app to the new Microsoft Planner app, which will maintain all existing app functionality and add new options and features to help users be more productive. The new app will start rolling out in late March 2024 and expect to complete by early May 2024. Summary: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel (Preview) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting April 9th, 2024 (PST). Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Security Posture Management for AI Fabric integration in data risk assessment
Summary: Microsoft Purview DSPM (preview) will add a Fabric tab for Data Risk Assessment to detect and manage oversharing of sensitive data in Microsoft Fabric workspaces. Rolling out mid-April to early May 2026, admins must enable scanning and can then view and secure Fabric artifacts like dashboards and reports.

Title: SharePoint Advanced Management: Delegate management of Restricted Access Control (RAC) to site admins
Summary: SharePoint now allows delegation of Restricted Access Control (RAC) management to site admins, requiring justification for changes. This feature, needing a premium license, is off by default and can be enabled by SharePoint admins to reduce overhead while maintaining security and auditability. Rollout completes by April 2026.

Title: AI Admin role has permissions to manage Copilot agents
Summary: AI Admin role now has permissions to manage Copilot agents, previously requiring Global Admin privileges. This change will roll out in late March 2025. AI Admins can view, publish, reject, block, and update agents but cannot consent for permissions. They should familiarize themselves with the integrated app page.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Chat usage report improvements
Summary: Microsoft is updating the Microsoft Copilot Chat usage report to include active users from Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.cloud.microsoft. The rollout will start in early April 2025. Metrics like active users and last activity date in the admin center may change. Users should revise custom reports accordingly.

Summary: We are adding two new email indicators to Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Sending email with attachments to free public domains: This alerts when business-sensitive data is potentially leaked from a work email account to a free public domain email, potentially leading to a data security incident. Summary: With this update, Microsoft Purview will start supporting collection policies. Collection policies allow customers to scope classification (SITs - Sensitive Information Types) and activities for scoped users. Summary: Potential connection failures with the Call Quality Power BI connector. We’ve detected a problem where some customers are unable to successfully connect to the Call Quality Dashboard (CQD) using the Microsoft Call Quality Power BI connector due to an outdated connector file. Title: Microsoft OneDrive and Microsoft SharePoint: New annotation layout and tools for editing PDFs
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint will soon feature a new PDF annotation layout with tools in a single row, including a pixel-by-pixel eraser. The rollout begins early April 2025 and completes by early May 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended. More details at Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 483156.

Summary: We are launching the AI summary for call quality management feature for Omnichannel for Customer Service. This feature allows you to use AI to read closed conversations and voicemails to provide conversation summaries and other insights. This feature will reach general availability on April 17, 2025. Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Add approvals to any document library
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint will soon introduce approvals for document libraries, following the previous update for lists. Rollout starts late January 2025 for Targeted Release and early March for General Availability, with completion expected by late April 2025. Users can enable/disable approvals and manage them through SharePoint Online or Teams.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Updated "More information required" user interface during authentication method registration
Summary: Microsoft Entra will update the "More information required" user interface during authentication method registration starting late April 2025, completing by late May 2025. The update will happen automatically with no admin action required. Notify users and update documentation as needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Access other apps and websites while using annotations
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the annotations feature to allow interaction with apps and websites during screen-sharing sessions without ending the annotation. Rollout begins early May 2024, with completion by late May. No admin action needed; users should be informed of the update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Smarter auto suggestions to help you search faster
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce smarter, personalized Autosuggest in search by mid-April 2026, showing clearer suggestions for people, channels, and chats to improve search speed and relevance. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and enhances user experience without affecting data storage or permissions.

Title: Power Apps - Microsoft 365 Copilot will be available in model-driven apps
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-drive apps in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on April 15, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to use copilot as an assistant to help understand and interact with your model-driven app data using natural language. Title: Improved OneDrive sync experience for macOS users
Summary: The OneDrive Activity Center on macOS is redesigned for a cleaner, intuitive sync experience, rolling out globally from April to May 2026. It aligns with macOS conventions, improves accessibility, and requires no admin action. Users get clearer sync status and easier issue resolution.

Title: Viva Engage: Feature conversations to all network members
Summary: Featured conversations in public Viva Engage communities can now be promoted to all network members or just community members, while private community features remain member-only. This rollout begins late April 2026, requires no admin action, and maintains existing permissions and moderation rules.

Title: New features coming to Copilot Notebooks for Frontier users
Summary: New features for Copilot Notebooks in M365 Copilot apps will roll out from November 2025 to March 2026, enhancing navigation, personalization, and AI capabilities. Updates include a streamlined interface, personalized suggestions, an overview page, and expanded reference types. No admin action is needed; features enable by default.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Copilot new tab page
Summary: Microsoft Edge for Business is introducing a Copilot-inspired new tab page combining search, chat, and work content in one box. Rollout starts mid-November 2025 (public preview) and general availability in May 2026. Admins can enable it via Edge Management; users must opt in. No default changes occur automatically.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent feature updates
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating Channel Agent features by mid-April 2026, enhancing welcome messages, user control over agent creation, scheduling, member additions, and channel messaging. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required. No action needed unless in Targeted Release; admins should enable and inform helpdesk staff.

Title: Microsoft Teams on Windows: Annotate content while sharing a single window
Summary: Microsoft Teams on Windows will enable annotation on a single shared application window, enhancing focused collaboration and privacy. Rollout starts early March 2026, completing by mid-April. Presenters and participants can annotate, with the feature enabled by default and no admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New Drafts quick view
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Drafts quick view feature by mid-April 2026, allowing desktop users to easily find, edit, and send unsent draft messages. The feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aims to improve productivity. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Flexible layout for Teams meetings with resizable divider
Summary: Teams meetings will have a new flexible layout with a resizable divider to adjust space between shared content and participant videos. Users can swap positions and customize views, including spotlighted and pinned videos. Rolling out January to April 2026, enabled by default with no admin setup needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Flexible layout for meetings with resizable divider
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a flexible meeting layout with a resizable divider to adjust shared content and video gallery space. Rolling out mid-April 2026, it supports spotlighted speakers, pinned videos, and Speaker View. Enabled by default, no admin action is needed; update training and support materials accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Security Investigations introduces new soft purge mitigation action
Summary: Microsoft Purview compliance portal's Data Security Investigations now includes a soft purge mitigation action, enabling admins to delete sensitive items recoverably during investigations. This feature, rolled out in early April 2026, requires no configuration, preserves existing policies, and does not affect user workflows.

Summary: The Microsoft 365 network connectivity test for Microsoft 365 Copilot is rolling out worldwide to general availability. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is not required to use this feature. Title: Top domain mail flow report in Exchange Online is retiring
Summary: The Top domain mail flow report in Exchange Online's Exchange admin center will retire on July 6, 2026. After this, it will be inaccessible, requiring admins to adopt alternative reporting methods. No other mail flow reports or mail delivery behaviors are affected. Prepare by updating documentation and validating new workflows.

Title: Workweek view for Outlook on iOS and iPad
Summary: Outlook for iOS and iPad will add a Workweek calendar view by mid-May 2026, allowing users to focus on their workdays. iPad users can select it anytime; iPhone users in landscape mode. Users can customize days shown. No admin action is needed to enable this feature.

Title: Upcoming change: Retirement of noise suppression capability for OneDrive and SharePoint video
Summary: Microsoft will retire the noise suppression option for video playback in OneDrive and SharePoint between July and August 2026. This change affects only the playback experience; video files remain unchanged. No admin action is required, though updating documentation and notifying helpdesk is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Outlook Mobile adds support for DLP policy tips and enforcement
Summary: Microsoft Outlook Mobile will support DLP policy tips and enforcement with new features like custom dialogs, attachment scanning, and Intune controls (default OFF). External recipient rule validation is temporarily removed. Organizations should test rules and train users before enabling DLP on mobile devices.

Title: New policy to add watermarks to content generated or altered by using AI in Microsoft 365
Summary: Microsoft 365 will offer a policy to add visual or audio watermarks to AI-generated or altered video and audio content, available mid-April 2026 via Cloud Policy. This enhances transparency and requires organizations to enable the policy; image watermarking will be user-controlled starting February 2026.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New tenant federation setting to block all subdomains of domains in blocklist
Summary: Microsoft Teams has a new setting to block all subdomains of domains in the federation Block list. This setting is disabled by default and can be enabled using a PowerShell cmdlet. It affects new communications and existing chats with users from blocked subdomains. Rollout began mid-March 2024.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center: Deploy frontline teams with flexible membership
Summary: Admins will soon be able to deploy location-based frontline teams with automatic membership management and multiple team owners in the Microsoft Teams admin center. The rollout begins mid-October 2024 and completes by late April 2025. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New policy for voice and face enrollment defaulting to 'On'
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new policy for voice and face enrollment, defaulting to 'On' for enhanced meeting features. Rollout begins early October 2024, with the policy enabled in March 2025. Admins have until mid-January 2025 to adjust settings. The csTeamsAIPolicy will replace csTeamsMeetingPolicy, offering separate EnrollFace and EnrollVoice settings.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New policy for voice and face enrollment will default to "On" (configure now)
Summary: The new Microsoft Teams policy, effective mid-March 2025, will enable voice and face enrollment by default, offering enhanced meeting features. Admins should configure settings now using new PowerShell cmdlets and inform users of changes. Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required for full functionality.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Stream Custom Agent and Bot Responses
Summary: Custom engine agents and Teams bots can now stream responses like Microsoft Copilot, providing real-time updates and incremental response delivery. Rollout starts mid-November 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-December 2024 for General Availability, completing by late April 2025. Update training and documentation as needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant-wide policy for permission to download meeting transcription
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new tenant-wide policy to restrict permissions for downloading meeting transcripts stored in OneDrive. Admins can exempt specific security groups. Rollout starts in June 2024 and varies by release type, completing by April 2025. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: SharePoint Online: Updates to Microsoft Lists forms
Summary: SharePoint Online is updating Microsoft Lists forms to include new features such as notifications, form scheduling, conditional branching, quick form creation, and additional field-type support. The rollout begins in January 2025 for Targeted Release and mid-February 2025 for General Availability, completing by late April 2025. No admin action is required.

Title: Announcing updated settings in Microsoft Outlook for iOS
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for iOS Settings page is being updated in mid-March 2024. The update will only change the placement of various settings within the Settings page, with no changes to the functionality of these settings. Notable changes include Help & Feedback moving to the bottom of the Settings page and merging of storage accounts with their associated mail account. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Copy email as attachment is coming
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for Windows will soon allow users to copy an email and attach it to a new email. The rollout will begin in mid-April 2024 and is expected to complete by mid-May 2024. Users can now send longer emails as attachments instead of copying and pasting the entire thread. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout, but users should be notified of the change.

Title: Microsoft Stream: Add a hyperlink or text callout to a video at specific times
Summary: Microsoft Stream will allow users to add annotations, including hyperlinks and text callouts, to videos at specific times to make them more interactive. The feature will roll out in mid-January 2024 for targeted release and in mid-April 2024 for general availability. No action is required from users at this time.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: OneDrive for Business opens in Outlook on the web
Summary: OneDrive for Business will now open within Outlook on the web for a seamless experience, with a rollout timeline updated to late July through late August 2024 for all environments. No action is required for preparation, but informing users and updating documentation is suggested. This update is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 369520.

Title: Microsoft Copilot in Intune is available in Public Preview
Summary: Microsoft Copilot in Intune is now in public preview, offering AI insights for quicker issue resolution and optimized policy settings. It assists with policy management and device troubleshooting. Preparation involves learning about Microsoft Copilot for Security and starting with Copilot for Security and Copilot in Intune. Early Access customers must transition after six months.

Title: Update to Copilot navigation pane chat history filtering
Summary: Chat history in the Copilot navigation pane will be filtered by the current Copilot experience, with an option to view all chats. This change, rolling out April-May 2026, affects all Microsoft 365 users, requires no admin action, and does not impact data storage or compliance.

Title: OneDrive and SharePoint: Undo and Redo for PDF annotations on OneDrive for web
Summary: Undo and Redo support for PDF annotations in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web will roll out worldwide in April 2026. Users can undo/redo ink, highlights, and text via keyboard shortcuts or toolbar buttons. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and improves annotation editing.

Title: OneDrive: Files deleted from the cloud will no longer appear in the local Recycle Bin or Trash
Summary: Starting May 2026, files deleted from OneDrive cloud won't appear in local Recycle Bin or Trash but can be recovered from the OneDrive or SharePoint web recycle bin. Local deletes remain unchanged. No admin action needed; users should be informed about the new recovery process.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint DLP expands protection to Copilot  PC Recall snapshots
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will support Copilot+ PCs by protecting Windows Recall snapshots from capturing sensitive content. Admins can create custom policies for these devices, with rollout starting April 2026. The feature is off by default and requires coordination with Intune and policy updates.

Title: Outlook for Android and iOS: Support for shareable links beautification and permissions in meeting description
Summary: Outlook for Android and iOS will automatically beautify shareable links in meeting descriptions starting mid-April 2026. Users can view and update link permissions directly, and Outlook will alert if attendees lack access. This feature is enabled by default with no admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Honor Windows “Do not disturb” setting
Summary: Microsoft Teams on Windows 11+ will offer an opt-in toggle to suppress Teams toast notifications when Windows "Do not disturb" is enabled, starting May 2026. This feature respects existing Windows DND settings, affects only Windows 11 or later, and requires no admin action.

Title: Viva Engage: At-Mentions & Replies notifications improvements
Summary: Viva Engage will roll out smarter At-Mention and Reply notifications starting April 2026, sending alerts via the user's most engaged channel to reduce notification fatigue. Secondary alerts occur if unopened within an hour. No admin action is needed, but user communication is recommended. Existing preferences remain respected.

Title: New meeting response option: decline and propose a new time in Outlook Mobile
Summary: Outlook Mobile will add a "Decline and Propose a New Time" option for meeting responses, allowing users to decline while suggesting an alternative time. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid-April to mid-May 2026, is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and respects existing policies.

Title: New option to keep or delete meeting invitations after responding
Summary: Outlook Mobile will add a user-controlled setting to keep or delete meeting invitations after responding, aligning with Outlook on the web and new Outlook. Rolling out mid-April to mid-May 2026 worldwide, no admin action is needed, and the setting roams across platforms per user account.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: We will remove the "EnableHoldTheFile" group policy
Summary: Microsoft will remove the "EnableHoldTheFile" group policy for OneDrive in May 2025. Users will be able to choose how to handle file conflicts. Admins should review configurations and notify users. No admin action is required. More details are available on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 429875.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: The Enable OCSI for Tenants group policy is being removed
Summary: Microsoft is removing the `EnableAllOcsiClients` OneDrive group policy in May 2025. This change will enable features like autosave, real-time collaboration, and version history in Office documents. No admin action is required, but organizations should notify users and update documentation accordingly. More details are available on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 429874.

Title: SharePoint Online: Table toolbar
Summary: SharePoint Online introduces a new Table toolbar for enhanced table functionality, including merge, split, and layout adjustments. Available in SharePoint and Viva Amplify, the rollout began mid-April 2025 and will complete by mid-May 2025. No admin action is required; notify users and update documentation.

Title: Simplify UX flow to enable Together Mode
Summary: Together Mode in Microsoft 365 will have a simplified UX flow, rolling out from mid-February to mid-June 2025. The update enhances transparency and ease of use without changing the function. Organizations should update their training and documentation accordingly. More details are available on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 470427.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Enhanced alert and user investigation with Microsoft Copilot for Security
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management now includes enhanced alert and user investigation with Microsoft Copilot for Security. The rollout timeline has been updated, with public preview in August 2024 and general availability in June 2025. Users need a Copilot for Security license and proper permissions. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: New scenario-based policy templates
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is introducing two new quick policy templates for Crown jewel protection and Email exfiltration, available from late November 2024 (Public Preview) and late February 2025 (General Availability). Existing quick policies for Data leak and Data theft will remain. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Review and update work hours and location in the My Day pane
Summary: Microsoft is rolling back the feature to review and update work hours and location in the My Day pane in Outlook until further notice. Users can still update this information in Outlook Settings. The rollout will happen automatically, and users should be informed about this change.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: New Microsoft Graph connectors for the chat experience and more
Summary: New Microsoft Graph Connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat are now available, enhancing access to business content across various platforms like Guru, GitLab, Asana, 15Five, Miro, Trello, Zendesk, SmartSheet, and Seismic. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: Generate a summary for Pulse reports using Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse will use Microsoft 365 Copilot to generate summaries for Pulse reports, aiding authors in quickly understanding the feedback. This feature, available across various platforms, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot or Viva Pulse license. The rollout will complete by late April 2025, with no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Edge management service: opt in to email notifications for extension requests
Summary: IT admins can soon opt in to receive email notifications for Microsoft Edge extension installation requests, with frequency options. This feature is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 382635 and will be available from late March to late April 2024. Admins must enable this feature in the EMS configuration profile.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Copilot for Security capabilities
Summary: Microsoft Purview's integration with Copilot for Security will improve security incident investigations starting early April 2024, offering enhanced visibility and user risk context, with no admin action required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Microsoft Copilot for Security Alert summary
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon include Microsoft Copilot for Security to summarize alerts and expedite data security investigations. Public preview begins in April 2024, with general availability in May. Users need Copilot for Security licenses and specific permissions to use this feature.

Title: Promote channel creation
Summary: Microsoft 365 is promoting channel creation by elevating the channel creation option to the top, making it easier for users to create channels. This will reduce team proliferation and difficulty in managing teams. End-users will be able to create channels in a channel of their choice, and they need to pick the right team they want to host channels in. The rollout will begin in early January 2024 and is expected to complete by mid-April 2024.

Title: Simpler and quicker creation of teams and channels
Summary: Microsoft 365 is updating the team and channel creation process to make it simpler and faster. Users will be able to create teams and channels from the top "+" button, with the option to create a team from a template or group and choose the privacy/sensitivity of the team. The "create channel" option will be elevated to the top to reduce team proliferation. Title: Microsoft Stream: Add a survey, poll, or quiz to a video at specific times
Summary: Microsoft Stream will allow users to add surveys, polls, or quizzes to videos at specific times, making them interactive and engaging. The feature will roll out in early December 2023 for targeted release and late April 2024 for general availability. No action is required to prepare.

Title: Changes in file open behavior in classic Teams.
Summary: Changes to file open behavior in classic Teams will occur from late February to late March 2024. Shared channel files will open in the browser, while OneNote files will temporarily open in the browser. Some Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files pinned as tabs will be read-only. Users should upgrade to new Teams or 1.6.00.34970 and above versions of classic Teams.

Title: Microsoft Secure Score: Removing a recommendation from Microsoft Defender for Identity
Summary: Microsoft is updating Secure Score actions for Defender for Identity, removing the recommendation to disable 'password never expires' for domain accounts. Title: Microsoft Viva Engage | Email sender domain migration from @yammer.com to @engage.mail.microsoft
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage email sender domains have migrated from @yammer.com to @engage.mail.microsoft (and @eu.engage.mail.microsoft for Europe) as of March 31, 2026. Summary: Microsoft Viva introduces a centralized exclusion list in Viva Feature Access Management, allowing admins to exclude specific users or groups from sharing Viva Insights data with Viva Glint. Summary: OneDrive for iOS and iPadOS will offer secure in-app preview of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without downloading, respecting existing Microsoft 365 security and compliance policies. Summary: We are announcing the ability to analyze processes using object-centric process mining in Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on May 1, 2026. Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Get integrated inbound and outbound calling with Sales Hub dialer
Summary: We are announcing the ability to get integrated inbound and outbound calling with Sales Hub dialer in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on May 1, 2026. Summary: Viva Connections in the Teams mobile app will update from a three-tab layout to pill-based navigation in April 2026, improving usability without changing functionality. The update is automatic and requires no user action, though informing helpdesk and updating documentation is recommended. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Microsoft Loop: Retirement of Copilot‑generated Recaps
Summary: Microsoft Loop will retire Copilot-generated Recaps by late May 2026, removing AI-generated recap creation but retaining manual recap editing. This change is default, irreversible, affects all tenants, and does not impact other Copilot features. No admin action is needed; update training and support as desired.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to get queue availability data from customer service representative availability APIs in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is retiring private unlisted communities in external networks by January 2025. Users can no longer create or participate in these communities. Title: Coming soon: Collapsible navigation and favorites in the Intune admin center
Summary: The Intune admin center will soon update to include collapsible navigation menus and a favorites feature. Starting May 1, 2024, admins can customize their experience by collapsing menu sections and favoriting pages. No action is needed, just awareness of the upcoming changes.

Summary: Users can control their activity feed by clicking on the ellipsis from the activity card. No preparation is required, but updating training and documentation may be considered.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard for Viva Insights licensed customers
Summary: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard for Viva Insights licensed customers will offer additional insights combining usage metrics with collaboration and sentiment data. It will provide granular views on adoption, usage patterns, and ROI. Rollout begins in April 2024, with completion by May 2024. Users can create custom reports and view metrics by organizational attributes. Preparation involves reviewing access management and learning about dashboard metrics.

Title: Join meetings and make calls via Teams Mobile on Android Auto
Summary: Teams Mobile on Android Auto now allows joining meetings via calendar and making calls with speed dial or call history. Rollout began late February 2024 and will complete by early April 2024. Feature requires Android U and is not yet supported on Xiaomi devices or Work Profiles. No preparation needed for the update. Roadmap ID 375701.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Reordering registration form questions for webinars
Summary: Microsoft Teams has updated the webinar registration process, allowing organizers to reorder form questions after adding them. The rollout will be completed by early April 2024. No preparation is needed for this change, but informing users and updating documentation may be beneficial.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Improved readability for Authentication Methods Policy Update audit logs
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID audit logs for Authentication Methods Policy updates will now show only changed properties with old and new values, improving readability. Rollout begins April 2026 worldwide. No changes to event names or policy enforcement. Organizations using automated log processing should review related logic.

Title: Outlook for iOS: New attachment actions and updates to previewer experience
Summary: Outlook for iOS will update attachment actions and previewer experience worldwide from late April to mid-May 2026. New actions include "Preview" and "Send a copy," with renamed actions for consistency. Changes apply by default to all users; no action is required, but user notification is optional.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium): Choose your AI model when editing presentations in PowerPoint
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) in PowerPoint will let users choose AI models, including OpenAI and Anthropic’s Claude, when editing presentations. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from April to May 2026, maintaining existing security and compliance controls with admin options to disable Anthropic.

Title: New enrollment dashboard and data deletion controls in Teams Admin Center
Summary: A new voice and face enrollment dashboard with data deletion controls will roll out in Teams Admin Center from mid-March to mid-April 2026. Admins can view and permanently delete enrollment data, requiring users to re-enroll for AI features. No changes to default enrollment or policies.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: New role for downloading original file evidence for Endpoint
Summary: A new RBAC role, Data Classification Content Download, will be added to Microsoft Purview DLP, allowing admins to download endpoint-related evidence files. This role will be available in specific built-in role groups. The rollout will occur from mid-March to late April 2025. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Notifications will be batched in the Notifications pane
Summary: Notifications in Microsoft Outlook for Windows and Outlook for the web will be batched in the Notifications pane. The rollout starts in December 2024 for Targeted Release and February 2025 for General Availability. Users can access batched notifications via the bell icon. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Simplifying the default pinning configuration
Summary: Microsoft is simplifying the default pinning configuration for Copilot Chat in Microsoft 365 apps, impacting users without a Copilot license. The default will change from prompting users to pin to automatically pinning Copilot Chat. This rollout begins May 1, 2025. Users can unpin Copilot Chat if desired.

Title: Microsoft Copilot: New user control for web searches
Summary: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with the new user control for web searches in Microsoft Copilot at this time. Users would have been able to enable or disable web searches via a control in the three-dot menu, but this change is currently on hold.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Downgrade or remove sensitivity label
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon capture sensitivity label changes (downgrade or remove) on OneDrive, Azure Information Protection, and endpoints. The rollout starts mid-November 2024 for Public Preview and early April 2025 for General Availability. No action is required; the feature will be enabled by default.

Title: Plan for Change: Intune Service Administrator role will be required for device limit restrictions
Summary: Starting mid-May 2025, the Intune Service Administrator role will be required to configure device limit enrollment restrictions. Admins without this role will have read-only access. Review and update RBAC assignments to ensure proper permissions.

Summary: We are announcing the Manage business rules for omnichannel agents feature for Power Apps. Title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Support continues after Log Analytics Agent retires on August 31, 2024
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will continue to be supported after the retirement of Log Analytics Agent on August 31, 2024. No immediate action is required, but it is recommended to upgrade to the latest available agent and versions will cease to function as of October 1, 2024. Notify admins and update documentation as appropriate. Learn more through provided links.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now supports file creation and modification date conditions for SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling admins to create more precise DLP and auto-labeling policies. This feature, rolling out April 2026, is configurable by admins and improves lifecycle-based data governance without impacting users by default.

Title: Microsoft Secure Score: New recommendation for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Summary: Microsoft Secure Score will add a new recommendation to block outbound traffic from mshta.exe in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, starting public preview in late March 2026. This reduces risk from attacks using mshta.exe, requires admin action to enable, and impacts compliance monitoring and data access.

Summary: Microsoft Teams will retire its legacy third-party meeting and call control APIs on June 30, 2026, removing external hardware/app control of meeting functions in the desktop client. Native Teams controls and supported integration models remain unaffected. Organizations should review and notify users of this change.

Summary: The SharePoint Document Libraries and Lists filter pane is updated for faster, more flexible filtering with expand/collapse sections and all filterable fields shown by default. Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will introduce an Adaptive Front-of-Room Experience for Town Halls, requiring a Teams Rooms Pro license. Summary: We are announcing the ability to connect Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse data to AI-powered sales research in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon add a control to the meeting presenter toolbar, allowing presenters to access the meeting chat while sharing a screen. Summary: Microsoft Teams will enable automatic file and Loop component sharing in external 1:1, group, and meeting chats, improving collaboration. Guests can share files from their own OneDrive or SharePoint. IT admins can disable automatic sharing via policy. Rollout starts late October 2025, and completed late March 2026.

Summary: We are introducing consent-based recording in Dynamics 365 Contact Center to enhance trust, ensure regulatory compliance, and reduce risk during customer voice interactions. This feature captures explicit customer consent at the start of calls with voice agents. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. How does this affect me? Summary: Starting mid-February 2026, the Microsoft 365 apps for Mac suite installer will include a shim for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, enabling users to download the full Copilot app. Deployment options and preparation steps are provided, with rollout completing by mid-May 2026. Existing installations remain unaffected.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the SMS channel to engage with customers proactively in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. Summary: We are announcing the ability to find, filter, and sort records using natural language queries directly within smart grid through Copilot Search in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. How does this affect me? Users in Dynamics 365 Sales will be able to use natural language queries in Copilot Search to quickly locate and refine records within smart grids. Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Record task progress from the tasks grid
Summary: We are announcing the ability to mark a task as complete from the grid view in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on March 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature allows users to mark a task as complete from the grid view. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is required. If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Record task progress from the tasks grid in Project Operations.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot PSTN audio announcements
Summary: Microsoft Teams now provides audio announcements to PSTN participants when Copilot processes their audio in Copilot Only mode. This rollout is complete worldwide except GCCH and DoD (late June 2026). No admin action is needed; users may hear notifications when Copilot starts or stops processing audio.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to enable configurable timescale settings on assignments view in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature allows users to enable configurable timescale settings on assignments view and eliminate repetitive manual adjustments. Summary: We are announcing support for Lookup and Currency on custom columns in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to add Lookup and Currency data type fields as enterprise task custom columns. You can surface relational and financial data directly in the task grid, eliminating the need for task form customizations. Summary: We are announcing the ability for users to use your Infobip SMS account directly in Contact Center to streamline how you connect with customers in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables Contact Center administrators to add Infobip as a third-party SMS provider, allowing users to send and receive SMS and MMS messages through Infobip connections. Summary: We are announcing the ability to boost data-driven decision making using Visualize with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2026. How does this affect me? As part of Copilot's productivity capabilities, smart charts enable sellers to generate real-time visualizations directly within their workflow. Summary: We are announcing the Repair flow automation errors feature for Power Automate. This feature uses Copilot to find and repair automation errors by identifying the required UI elements on the screen. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2025. How does this affect me? Once allowed, this feature uses Copilot to locate elements on the screen at the execution time. The repaired selector is used in future executions. Self-healing refers to the case that a UI element cannot be found...

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for March 2024
Summary: The message announces the latest Microsoft Intune Service Update for March 2024, with changes to be seen in the Tenant Status blade of the Intune console soon. Users can learn more about the update by clicking on the provided links.

Title: Upgrading Teams webinar users to new version
Summary: Microsoft Teams will replace the 'Add registrations to meetings' feature with the new 'Webinar' meeting type. The change will take effect on June 30th, 2024. Teams Admins will not be able to assign the "-AllowMeetingRegistration" to any new users, and Teams users with this policy will not be able to create any new 'meetings with registration' post-June 30th, 2024. Users can create webinars using the new 'Webinar' meeting type, and may update their internal documentation accordingly. Detailed doc...

Title: Manage Distribution Groups URL update in Microsoft Outlook on the web points to the new Microsoft Exchange Admin Center
Summary: The URL to manage distribution groups in Microsoft Outlook on the web will be updated to point to the new Exchange Admin Center. The old URL will continue to work until mid-2024. Non-admin users will be redirected to the new Exchange Admin Center. The update will happen automatically in early April 2024 and users are advised to refer to the article on managing Distribution Groups for more details.

Title: Test Base for Microsoft 365 will transition to end-of-life (EOL) on May 31, 2024
Summary: Test Base for Microsoft 365 will reach end-of-life on May 31, 2024. Customers will receive instructions on how to complete the offboarding process to prevent disruption to their business. All customer data will be permanently deleted after May 31, 2024. For more information, review the Test Base FAQ and End-of-life Announcement.

Title: Product transitions to the cloud.microsoft domain - March 2024
Summary: Microsoft products and scenarios are now available at the cloud.microsoft domain, in parallel with the previous domains. The previous domains will be redirected to cloud.microsoft in the coming months. Users will be redirected to applications under cloud.microsoft domains gradually and automatically. No specific user action is required.

Title: Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for Endpoint: Retiring the 'Document name matches patterns' condition
Summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for Endpoint will retire the 'Document name matches patterns' condition due to performance concerns. The rollout will occur from mid-May to mid-June 2025. Organizations should migrate to the 'Document name contains words or phrases' condition. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Policy sync status on Purview portal
Summary: The Policy Sync Status feature in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal allows solution admins to see the sync status of policies directly from the Policies and Reports pages. It applies to various policy types and will be available in Public Preview in mid-April 2025 and General Availability in mid-May 2025. No prerequisites are required.

Summary: Microsoft Edge management service is rolling out enterprise secure AI controls for preview, allowing IT admins to configure AI-related policies in one single page, enhancing security for their users and devices. This feature is expected to be complete by early December 2023 for preview and will begin rolling out in mid-March 2024 for standard release. Title: Microsoft Teams | new Teams is now part of Teams Rooms on Microsoft Windows
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will receive an update in mid-April 2024 that will automatically replace the existing Teams Rooms application with the new Teams app. The update will provide up to two times faster performance while using 50 percent less memory. No end user education or notification is required. There is no action needed to prepare for this change.

Summary: Microsoft Teams is expanding the scope of the Get-CsOnlineUser cmdlet and Teams Admin Center's Manage Users Page to include all unlicensed users. The changes will roll out in late April 2024 and will affect the Teams admin center's Manage Users Page and the Get-CsOnlineUser cmdlet in Teams PowerShell Module. Title: Microsoft Teams Phone devices: Enable call forwarding directly from the device's Home screen
Summary: Microsoft Teams certified phone devices will soon allow users to enable call forwarding directly from the device's Home screen. Admins can enable call forwarding through Teams admin center or on the Teams phone device. Users should ensure their Teams phone devices are updated with the latest application to access the new feature. Rollout will begin in early May 2024 and complete by late May 2024 for worldwide GCC, and late June 2024 to late July 2024 for GCC High. If your organization does not u...

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Granular trigger throttling
Summary: After further review we have decided not to proceed with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will roll out a public preview of granular trigger throttling limits from late October 2024 to late January 2025. The update introduces limits to manage noisy triggers and enhance policy health warnings. No action is needed, but admins should be notified. Further details are available in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Title: Updated: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows and web: Delegates can create new categories for the account owner's Calendar
Summary: Delegates in the new Microsoft Outlook for Windows and web can create and apply categories for the account owner's Calendar. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for Targeted Release and mid-February 2025 for General Availability, completing by mid-April 2025. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Embed support for Teams town hall
Summary: Microsoft Teams now supports embedding town hall events in websites, allowing attendees to watch and engage with features like Q&A, captions, and reactions. The rollout starts in November 2024 for targeted release and December 2024 for general availability. Organizers can use embed codes from the town hall scheduling template.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Wired headset support for the Walkie Talkie app for iOS
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon support wired headsets for the Walkie Talkie app on iOS, enabling hands-free and push-to-talk modes. The rollout will occur from early to mid-March 2025, requiring no admin action. Organizations should notify users and update documentation. More details are available on the Microsoft Learn website.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: New naming convention for folder shortcuts
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive will introduce a new naming convention for folder shortcuts starting late June 2025, completing by mid-July 2025. New shortcuts will include the site or owner's name for better identification. Existing shortcuts remain unchanged. This update applies across OneDrive web, mobile apps, File Explorer, Mac Finder, and Microsoft Teams. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Semantic search support for in-app Searches
Summary: Microsoft Viva Learning is transitioning to an intent-based search, enhancing search results by understanding user intent. The rollout will occur from mid to late March 2025. This update impacts various Viva Learning features and requires content curators to enrich content attributes for better search accuracy. More details are available in Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 479749.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for web and Windows: Organize and reorder folders
Summary: New Microsoft Outlook for web and Windows will import folder order from classic Outlook. Rollout begins late November 2024 for Targeted Release, January 2025 for General Availability, and early February 2025 for GCC. Users can customize folder order via the new Outlook ribbon. No admin action required.

Title: Exposure Management Recommendations Retirement
Summary: Certain SSPM recommendations will be retired from Exposure Management in the Defender portal to ensure accurate security posture representation. The rollout will occur from mid-February to mid-April 2025. No action is required from organizations, and security scores will be updated accordingly.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Manage SharePoint pages using the left navigation pane
Summary: SharePoint Online users can now manage pages using the left navigation pane, create new pages, navigate to recently edited sites, and duplicate existing pages. The rollout began in March 2025 and will complete by April 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Copilot entry point changes in Word and handoff to Agent in chat
Summary: Copilot entry points in Word are updated to unify access and introduce Word Agent in the chat pane as the primary interface. Rollout begins early April 2026 worldwide and October 2026 for GCC/DoD. No admin changes required; users see consolidated and contextual entry points for a consistent experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Code block line numbers and improved keyboard accessibility
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enhance the code block experience by adding default line numbers, improved keyboard navigation, consistent language selection, and collaborative editing with Loop components. Rolling out from early to late May 2026, these features require no admin action and improve accessibility and developer collaboration.

Title: Targeted file and folder restores in Microsoft 365 Backup
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup now supports granular restore, allowing admins to browse, search, and restore individual files or folders from SharePoint and OneDrive restore points. This feature, launching early in March 2026, reduces recovery time and is available to tenants with Microsoft 365 Backup enabled.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Posture Reports are now generally available
Summary: Microsoft Purview Posture Reports are now generally available, providing admins unified, near-real-time insights into Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention. Reports auto-refresh hourly, appear by default in the Purview portal, and require no user action. Rollout begins early February 2026 and completes mid-February 2026.

Title: Power Apps - Information regarding the end of support for Filter, sort, and search galleries with Copilot (preview)
Summary: On April 26, 2025, the Filter, sort, and search galleries with Copilot (preview) feature will have reached end of support. How does this affect me? This feature will no longer be available to users. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness and no action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Amplify: New "average time spent per user" graph in reporting
Summary: Microsoft Viva Amplify is introducing a new "average time spent per user" graph in reporting, available mid-April to late April 2025. This metric will provide insights into user engagement at the campaign and publication levels, supported by SharePoint and Outlook channels. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: New Insider Risk Management reporting capabilities
Summary: Microsoft Purview's new Insider Risk Management reporting capabilities have been delayed. The rollout for public preview is now scheduled for December 2024, and general availability is set for May 2025. The new features include a central location for reports, with operational reports for alerts and cases accessible by admins, analysts, or investigators. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Drive Microsoft Teams adoption with organizational messages
Summary: Microsoft Teams users can now receive organizational messages to drive adoption of Teams features. The feature will be rolled out from late March 2024 to mid-April 2024. Admins can configure a templatized organizational message in the Adoption Score Meetings category in the Microsoft 365 admin center. The feature will recommend users to use interactive features during Teams meetings. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights delegate access for leaders
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights now allows leaders to delegate access to their organization insights to other individuals in their company. Delegated access will allow designated delegates to view organization insights and make data-driven decisions. This feature will be available for public preview in early April 2024 and for general availability worldwide in mid-April 2024. No action is needed to enable this feature, and leaders can use this capability at their discretion.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Improved view of service health issue details
Summary: Microsoft 365 admin center is introducing an updated version of the service health issue details screen, which will reduce duplicated text and improve formatting for quicker access to information. The rollout will take place from mid-February to mid-April 2024. No action is required to prepare for this change.

Title: SharePoint: User experience and Image Coherence in SharePoint Online (SPO)
Summary: SharePoint Online (SPO) will improve user experience by displaying the same profile image across all Microsoft 365 apps. This will impact users without an Exchange license or using Delve for uploading images. The change will roll out from early October 2023 to late June 2024. Users are not required to take any action. SPO admins will need to upload user profile images via MAC Admin Centre or AAD admin center. Users should use the “Universal Me” control or Delve to upload profile images.

Title: SharePoint eSignature electronic signature service
Summary: Microsoft's SharePoint eSignature service allows users to request eSignatures on PDF documents via SharePoint online. The service will be rolled out to the US in late November 2023 and completed by late June 2024, with other regions following in 2024. Organizations can prepare by reading the Admin support documentation and specifying a billing region other than WestUS. The service incurs a charge per request.

Title: Microsoft Outlook mobile for iOS and Android toolbar updates
Summary: Microsoft Outlook mobile for iOS and Android will update the Compose toolbar to allow for more user customization. Users will be able to reorder items on the toolbar and see an update to the default ordering of toolbar items. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management and Records Management – Microsoft Graph APIs for extensibility
Summary: Microsoft is introducing three new APIs for retention labels, events, and event types in the Microsoft Graph beta environment. These APIs can be used by compliance admins and developers to manage retention labels in Data Lifecycle and Records Management solutions. Rollout will begin in late March 2023 and is expected to be complete by late April 2024. Organizations are recommended to use the new Graph APIs instead of using PowerShell cmdlets. Title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic Updates for the Teams app on Android-based Teams Devices
Summary: Microsoft Teams app on Android-based Teams devices will start receiving automatic updates, in addition to firmware, starting from late October 2023 and is expected to be complete by early April 2024. Administrators can manage these updates using update phases and can temporarily pause auto-updates. Before this change takes effect, administrators should ensure that their devices are assigned the Update Phase of their choice.

Title: New Feature in Teams Admin Center to Communicate with Third-Party App Publishers via Teams
Summary: Teams Admin Center will soon have a 'Click-to-Chat' feature enabling private group chats with a limited set of third-party Teams app publishers. Admins can communicate directly with app publishers to assess whether an app will meet their business needs. Rollout will begin late November and will complete by early April 2024. No action is required if external communications are already enabled.

Title: Microsoft Teams - Teams app on Teams Rooms on Android and paired Touch Consoles to be updated in sync
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android and their paired touch consoles will be updated in sync, reducing efforts for admins and keeping devices on the same version for a streamlined Teams experience. The feature will roll out from early December 2023 to early April 2024. Admins can track update status from the 'History' section in the device page. No preparation is required, and the feature will only impact organizations with MTRoA devices in their inventory.

Title: Microsoft Teams: User experience improvements for Multi-Tenant Organization (MTO) users
Summary: Microsoft Teams is releasing user experience improvements for Multi-Tenant Organization (MTO) users. These improvements include a richer profile for users from other MTO tenants, the ability to perform a name-based search for users from other MTO tenants, and the removal of 1:1 chat split across multiple threads.
