Title: Audio and video flyout and settings in Teams meetings
Summary: Teams meetings now have updated audio and video flyouts and settings, allowing users to efficiently manage their audio and video settings during meetings. Mac users may experience an issue with device selection, but a temporary workaround is available. The rollout will begin in late January 2024 and complete by early April 2024. Users can access the feature in three ways, and organizations may want to update their internal documentation to inform users of the new feature.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Improved View Switcher for Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android Update 3 (2023) includes an improved view switcher and front of room display controls. The updated interface provides more control of the front of room display during a meeting and enables customizations. The rollout will begin in late February 2024 and end by mid-March 2024. Users should be notified about the new experience and training and documentation should be updated as appropriate.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Task publishing: Schedule recurring lists and several top requests
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon have a new task publishing experience, which includes recurring task lists, training and policy task lists, form completion requirements, and approval completion requirements. These features will be enabled as part of the rollout of the new Planner experience, which is expected to begin early April 2024 for targeted release and mid-April 2024 for standard release. No additional action is needed to prepare for this rollout.

Title: Preview the new Microsoft Teams Windows client
Summary: Today we’re starting to roll out the preview of the new Microsoft Teams desktop app for Windows. The new Microsoft Teams desktop app is built on a foundation of speed, performance, and flexibility—saving you time and helping your organization work together more efficiently. How will this benefit my organization: Our goal for the new Teams app is to make it twice as fast while using half the system resources. We aren’t done optimizing the performance of new Teams, but we are already seeing common...

Title: New M365 group creation and editing in My Groups
Summary: Microsoft 365 group creation and editing in My Groups will be enhanced by late March 2026, allowing owners to configure usage guidelines, email aliases, sensitivity labels, Exchange settings, and security options. The update improves control and clarity without impacting existing groups or requiring admin setup.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of CAPTCHA for meeting join
Summary: Microsoft Teams will retire CAPTCHA for meeting joins by August 2026, replacing it with a default-on bot detection feature that requires organizer approval for bots. This ensures continuous bot protection without join friction. Tenant admins and organizers should review new policies but no immediate action is needed.

Title: Viva Engage: Community membership and experts management in iOS and Android for Engage and Engage app in Teams
Summary: Viva Engage is adding community membership and expert role management, plus verified-answer marking, to its iOS and Android apps (standalone and in Teams). These mobile features, rolling out March–April 2026, enable admins and experts to moderate and manage communities consistently without desktop access.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Device Health Reporting Dashboard
Summary: The Device Health Reporting Dashboard in Microsoft Purview offers admins a consolidated view of Endpoint DLP device health, policy sync status, activity, and Defender versions. Rolling out from May to June 2026, it enables quick issue diagnosis with no user impact and is enabled by default for eligible tenants.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Restrict Access action for semantic models in Microsoft Fabric (preview)
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now allows restricting access to Microsoft Fabric semantic models and lakehouses. Public preview began in November 2024 for semantic models and April 2025 for lakehouses. General availability is expected by late November 2026. Admins can configure policies to block or restrict access to sensitive data automatically.

Title: Microsoft 365: Modern Access Request and Access Denied web page
Summary: Microsoft 365 will roll out a redesigned Access Request and Access Denied page in May 2026, featuring modern visuals, animations, and clearer messaging for OneDrive and SharePoint users. No admin policy changes; the update is automatic. Organizations should inform support staff and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Viva Pulse – Admin Export all tenant and report data from Pulse
Summary: Admins can now export all tenant and report data from Viva Pulse to a .csv file, with one active export job at a time. This feature will be available worldwide by late March 2025. Admins can access the export feature from the manage tab on the Viva Pulse homepage. More details can be found [here](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/roadmap?rtc=1%26filters%3D&searchterms=407636).

Title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Three Microsoft Secure Score SCIDs will retire
Summary: Three Microsoft Secure Score SCIDs (SCID-84, SCID-2020, SCID-2051) for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will be retired between late March 2025 and late April 2025 to ensure a more accurate security posture representation. These changes will adjust the Security Score experience accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Viva Pulse: Admins can configure access to Pulse templates for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users
Summary: Admins can configure access to new Microsoft Viva Pulse templates for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users. This feature, available from late March to mid-April 2025, allows admins to manage template access and review content. No action is required before the rollout, but reviewing configurations and notifying users is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Outlook name change: "Outlook (new)" on Windows will change to "Outlook"
Summary: The installed name for new Microsoft Outlook on Windows will change from "Outlook (new)" to "Outlook" starting late March 2025, completing by early April 2025. This change is automatic and requires no admin action, but users should be informed and documentation updated.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales – Find, filter, and sort using natural language with smart grid
Summary: We are announcing the find, filter, and sort using natural language with smart grid feature for Dynamics 365 Sales. With this feature users can find and filter leads and opportunities using natural language queries. This feature will reach general availability on April 25, 2025. How does this affect me? Users can filter records, search based on text, and sort records in a grid using natural language query. You can also see the criteria applied to filter the data and can easily cancel the filters...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Updated Microsoft Viva Engage Communities app for Teams Mobile
Summary: The Microsoft Viva Engage Communities app for Teams Mobile is updated and available for iOS version 7.2.1+ and Android version 1.0.0.2025042204+. The rollout starts late March 2025 and completes by early May 2025. Key functionalities are refreshed, and no admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New calendar feature in opt-out experience
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new calendar feature that integrates with Outlook and Teams, including innovations like Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Places. The rollout starts in April 2025 for Targeted Release and May 2025 for General Availability. Users can toggle between the new and classic calendars. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Glint: Some language codes will retire from translation services
Summary: Microsoft Viva Glint will retire some language codes and update localizations starting April 10, 2025. Retired codes will be available until August 31, 2025, after which they will be removed. Admins should update or save custom translations before this date. A subscription to Microsoft Viva Suite or Viva Glint is required.

Title: Final reminder: Privileged Access Management for Microsoft Graph Data Connect will be retired on April 30, 2024
Summary: Privileged Access Management (PAM) for Microsoft Graph Data Connect (MGDC) will be retired on April 30, 2024. All tenants must use the new MGDC onboarding experience after this date. Tenants may migrate to the new experience from now until April 30, 2024, with a one-click process on MGDC settings flyout in the Microsoft 365 Admin center. If neither one-click migration nor automatic migration occurs by April 30, 2024, tenants' PAM approvals will NOT be converted, and they will need to manually us...

Title: Updates to the Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 user interface
Summary: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 UI will be updated to create better visual alignment with Microsoft Copilot (formerly Bing Chat Enterprise). The updates include adding a green shield icon, a persistent legal and data protection disclaimer, a new AI accuracy disclaimer, and removing company branding/logo from the UI. The updates will roll out in late March and be completed by mid-April 2024. These are UI updates only and do not impact Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 terms, privacy, or dat...

Title: Microsoft OneNote | Sensitivity labels now available on desktop, web, iOS, Android, and Mac
Summary: Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels are now supported in OneNote sections on Win32, Web, iOS, Android, and Mac, enabling manual classification, encryption, and access control. Admins can enforce policies and monitor usage via Purview. OneNote for Windows 10 (UWP) is not supported. Rollout completes by late February 2026.

Title: Notice: Security Copilot will be included as part of your Microsoft 365 E5 plan soon
Summary: Security Copilot will be included with Microsoft 365 E5 via a phased rollout from April 20 to June 30, 2026, providing 400 Security Compute Units per 1,000 users and core agentic features across Microsoft security products. Additional advanced capabilities may incur extra costs.

Title: View and edit Markdown files in OneDrive and SharePoint
Summary: OneDrive and SharePoint will support viewing and editing Markdown (.md) files directly in the browser with a side-by-side editor and preview, starting mid-April 2026. This feature is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and allows easy management of Markdown files alongside other Microsoft 365 files.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP - Add support of hyperlinks in warn and block toast messages for Edge browser
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will support clickable hyperlinks in warn and block toast notifications in Microsoft Edge starting April 2026. Admins can link to policies, training, or support without changing enforcement. Requires updated Defender client and Edge versions; admins control hyperlink inclusion via policy settings.

Title: Introducing video recap for Microsoft Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce AI-generated video recaps for recorded English meetings, available only to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. These narrated highlights combine key takeaways and clips, require no admin changes, and will roll out from April to May 2026.

Title: Plan for Change: Update to Intune Data Warehouse infrastructure
Summary: The Intune Data Warehouse update, now expected mid-June 2026, will reset historical data to about 30 days, refresh surrogate keys, and revise licensing definitions. The beta Power BI connector will be discontinued; users must switch to the OData feed from the Intune admin center and back up data beforehand.

Title: [Reminder] Microsoft Teams Premium Self-Service Trials (Originally announced in MC670435)
Summary: Microsoft Teams Premium self-service trials are being broadly rolled out, allowing users to start trials managed within the organization's tenant. Admins can disable trials, control license conversion, and manage trial licenses via Microsoft 365 admin center. Users won’t auto-renew; data follows Microsoft Online Subscription Agreement terms.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Move emails between accounts (new Outlook for Windows and Outlook for the web)
Summary: Users will soon be able to move emails between accounts in the new Outlook for Windows and Outlook for the web. This feature is controlled by the Set-OWAMailboxPolicy policy. Rollout starts in February 2025 for Targeted Release, April 2025 for General Availability, and May 2025 for GCC. GCC High and DoD are excluded.

Title: New Service in your Microsoft 365 subscription: Org Explorer
Summary: Your Microsoft 365 subscription is being updated with Org Explorer in Outlook, which visualizes your company's structure. Rollout starts in late-May 2025 and completes by late-June 2025. Org Explorer won't require a Viva premium license. No action is needed now.

Title: Discover agents in Microsoft Copilot iOS/Android
Summary: The Agent UX for Microsoft 365 Copilot, previously on desktop and web, is now available on mobile. Users can discover, add, and chat with agents in Teams, Outlook, and the Copilot app. Rollout starts mid-May 2025 and completes by late May 2025. No admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: Keyword report in Review set
Summary: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery will soon allow users to generate and download hit-by-term query reports on KQL queries in review sets. This feature, available in the new eDiscovery (preview) experience, will be in public preview from December 2024 to January 2025 and generally available from July to August 2025.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Policy sync status for M365 Label publishing policies
Summary: Microsoft Purview will add a Policy sync status feature for Microsoft 365 label publishing policies, providing admins visibility into synchronization across locations. Rolling out April 2026, it includes a new status column and report card in the Purview portal, improving troubleshooting without impacting users or compliance.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting March 24th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this lates...

Title: Outlook Mobile: New external image handling option for safe senders
Summary: Outlook Mobile will add a new "Load images for safe senders" option for external images, aligning with Outlook for Windows and Mac. The rollout starts early April 2026. Existing settings remain unless changed, with no impact on security or compliance. No action is required unless updates are desired.

Title: Introducing awards and certifications section in M365 profile card
Summary: Starting mid-March to early April 2026, Microsoft 365 profile cards will display an Awards and Certifications section showing titles, issuers, and details of badges. This read-only feature appears only if organizations populate these properties, highlighting recent awards for better visibility. No compliance issues noted.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced spell checking will support multiple languages
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon have enhanced spell checking with multi-language support, rolling out from April to July 2025. Users can choose languages in settings, and features include advanced spell checking, multi-language support, and a custom dictionary. No admin action is required, but user notification is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Third-party add-in user report can be sent to Microsoft for analysis
Summary: Administrators using third-party report message solutions in Outlook can now configure Defender for Office 365 to send these messages to Microsoft for analysis. The rollout starts in late March 2025 and ends early April 2025. Configuration involves setting the destination to "Microsoft and my reporting mailbox."

Title: Microsoft Teams: Ratings and reviews for apps within outlook.com and office.com
Summary: Apps in Microsoft Teams, outlook.com, and office.com will display ratings and reviews starting from late February 2025 for Targeted Release and early March 2025 for General Availability. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Record a video and share in channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow users to record video clips directly in Teams channels. This feature, previously only available in chat, enables recording of self, screen, or audio to post or reply in channels. Rollout begins early January 2025, with full availability by late February 2025. No admin action needed.

Title: Changes to OneLake operation reporting in Microsoft Fabric
Summary: Microsoft Fabric's OneLake introduces storage tiers (hot, cool, cold) and updates operation reporting by including tier names, consolidating proxy/redirect operations, and grouping by workspace in the Capacity Metrics app. Billing rates remain unchanged. Changes start April 1, 2026; item-level details move to OneLake diagnostics.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to audit log activities
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Security Investigations will add a new Audit tab for building audit log queries directly within DSI, automatically surfacing related files. This feature, replacing CSV uploads, rolls out April-May 2026, enabling faster, more accurate investigations for admins and investigators without requiring prior configuration.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – role-based access simplification
Summary: Microsoft Purview will simplify Data Security Investigations access by automatically adding the DSI Contributor role to key role groups, effective late April 2026. No action or opt-in is needed, but admins should review role memberships to ensure appropriate access and update documentation if necessary.

Title: SharePoint Advanced Management: Site admin control for restricted content discovery
Summary: SharePoint Advanced Management now lets SharePoint admins delegate Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) control to site admins, who can enable/disable RCD with justification. Delegation is off by default, can be enabled tenant-wide, improving governance and decentralizing content discoverability management. Public preview is available now.

Title: Offline attachments policy for the new Outlook for Windows
Summary: A new OWAMailboxPolicy setting, AttachmentsOfflineEnabledWin, will roll out mid-April 2026, allowing admins to control offline access to file attachments in the new Outlook for Windows. It is enabled by default and works alongside the existing OfflineEnabledWin policy without affecting its configuration.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
Summary: A new Message consumption usage report for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing is now in public preview, showing message metrics by tenant, user, and agent. It rolls out globally by September 2026, with alerts for over 2000 billed messages. No admin action is needed before rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Reduced automatic updates in Meet Now channel meeting threads
Summary: Microsoft Teams will reduce automatic updates in Meet Now channel meeting conversations, showing only one "Meeting started" message in the channel. Other updates appear in the meeting thread, keeping channels cleaner. This change rolls out from mid-March to mid-May 2026, requires no admin action, and affects all Teams users.

Title: Power Apps - Use Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-driven apps
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-driven apps in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on April 13, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature introduces an AI assistant that enables you to understand the data in your apps by engaging in natural language conversations and provides access to the full capabilities of Microsoft 365 Copilot directly in your apps. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is requi...

Title: Power Automate - Share Process license capacity across workflows
Summary: We are announcing the ability to share Process license capacity across workflows in Power Automate. This feature will reach general availability on April 21, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to create and manage flow groups that share Process license capacity across up to 25 cloud flows. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Announcing the retirement of legacy Power BI Apps (pre-audiences)
Summary: Legacy Power BI apps (pre-audiences) will no longer be supported after May 1, 2024. Users are encouraged to upgrade or rebuild their apps using Power BI apps with audiences. Technical support for legacy apps will cease after the deadline. Users can read about the changes and improvements in the new version of Power BI apps and how to upgrade in the provided link.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Track usage of your frontline teams and apps in the Teams Admin Center
Summary: Admins can track usage of frontline teams and apps in the Teams Admin Center with a usage dashboard. A table with usage data for each frontline location on Microsoft Teams, Walkie Talkie, Shifts, and Tasks can be filtered by location and date range. Admins can export this data to a CSV file. Rollout begins in April 2024 and ends in May 2024. Admins should map frontline attributes and deploy frontline dynamic teams in the Teams Admin Center. Learn more about Frontline Usage Reporting.

Title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and Palo Alto Prisma Access
Summary: Microsoft Purview now integrates with Palo Alto Prisma Access to extend data loss prevention to network traffic involving unmanaged cloud apps. The integration, available from mid-2026, requires admin activation and supports existing Purview policies for enhanced data security and compliance monitoring.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting participants can choose a breakout room from a list
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow meeting participants to choose and move between breakout rooms if enabled by the organizer. This feature will roll out from January 2024 to April 2025, depending on the release schedule. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Allow presenters to moderate Q&A
Summary: Organizers of Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars will soon be able to assign presenters to moderate Q&A sessions. This feature, available to all users with Microsoft Azure Active Directory IDs, will roll out from late February to early April 2025. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center: Non-disruptive device operations for Microsoft Teams devices
Summary: Microsoft Teams admin center will introduce a feature to ensure non-disruptive operations for Android-based Teams devices. Updates, restarts, and configurations will occur only when devices are idle. Rollout starts late February 2025 and completes by early April 2025. Admins can manage these operations without disrupting meetings or calls.

Title: Teams Mobile: New citations for Copilot in Teams responses in meetings and calls
Summary: Copilot responses in Microsoft Teams Mobile meetings and calls will include a citation number for easy access to the content source. The rollout will begin mid-April 2024 and no admin action is required. Improved user experience and productivity is expected.

Title: App names hidden in app bar for a cleaner, more focused experience
Summary: Microsoft Teams will hide app names by default in the app bar for a cleaner look, showing only icons with names visible on hover or keyboard focus. Users can re-enable names via Settings. Rollout begins late April 2026 for commercial tenants, excluding EDU, with no admin changes needed.

Title: New policy setting to require explicit consent for recording and transcription in Teams 1:1 calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams will require explicit consent for recording and transcription in 1:1 VoIP calls starting early 2026. Administrators must enable this feature, which prompts participants for consent before recording, excluding their media if declined. PSTN calls are auto-consented; explicit consent for PSTN will come later.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Unified attachment flow on Teams Mobile
Summary: Microsoft Teams Mobile for Android will get a unified attachment flow starting June 2025, making it easier to attach any content via the paperclip icon. Rollout completes by late June 2025 worldwide and by April 2026 for GCC environments. No admin action is needed.

Title: Unread News Notifications in Viva Connections
Summary: Starting late March 2026, Viva Connections will send weekly Microsoft Teams notifications about unread SharePoint news articles. Notifications are enabled by default but can be managed by users. No admin action is needed, though admins may inform users about this feature.

Title: Resize Teams window and slots
Summary: Teams will support window resizing down to 360x502px or 502x360px, and side panels will be adjustable. This update improves accessibility, multitasking, and window management, with rollout starting in March 2025 and completing by mid-May 2025. No preparation is needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Custom emojis and reactions
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to add up to 5,000 custom emojis and reactions per tenant by uploading images or GIFs. The rollout starts in July 2024 for Targeted Release, with completion by April 2025 for all environments. Admins can manage this feature via the Teams Admin Center.

Title: Microsoft Teams: File Interactive Previews
Summary: The general availability of Microsoft Teams' file interactive previews feature is delayed, with new timelines to be communicated later. The feature allows users to preview files within Teams chats and channels, starting with PDFs and later including other formats. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: New Microsoft teams-specific consent settings
Summary: Microsoft Entra and Teams are introducing new resource-specific consent settings for teams and chats to enhance secure app adoption. Title: Microsoft Teams: Updated labels for external participants in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating labels for meeting participants to increase security. The term "Unverified" will be used for participants who do not have a trusted relationship with the organizer, while "External" will be used for those who are not part of the organizer's organization but have a trusted relationship. All areas within Team meetings will consistently show accurate user labels. The update will roll out mid-February 2024 and will affect organizers and meeting participants who attend mee...

Title: Announcing Updated Settings in Microsoft Outlook for Android
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for Android is updating its settings page to make it easier to find settings. The update will roll out from mid-February to late March 2024, and only the placement of settings will change, not their functionality. Notable changes include the Help & Feedback option moving to the bottom of the Settings page and merging storage accounts with associated mail accounts. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365: Copilot for Sales plugin in Microsoft Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365: Copilot for Sales plugin in Microsoft Teams meetings. Admins can enable the Copilot for Sales plugin in Microsoft Teams meetings, which allows Copilot for Microsoft 365 to access Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales data to retrieve sales information and brand information for the account mentioned. The plugin will be available for eligible end-users in late May 2024. Admins should enable the plugin for end-users to use the feature.

Title: Stream videos can now be watched inline in Outlook
Summary: Microsoft 365 is introducing the ability to watch Stream videos inline in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows. The feature will be rolled out from mid-March 2024 to mid-May 2024. The videos will play inline for recipients within the same organization and recipients outside the organization will see a link to the video which they can watch in the Stream web app. A new policy controls the ability to preview and playback Stream videos in Microsoft 365 applications including in Outloo...

Title: Public preview announcement – support all Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps users by Microsoft Defender XDR portal
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps experience will be available for all supported by Defender for Cloud Apps admin roles in the Microsoft 365 Defender XDR portal. The rollout will begin in late February 2024 and complete mid-March 2024 for Public Preview customers. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Reminder: Classic to new Teams update, new Teams rollout, and new Teams only availability
Summary: Microsoft Teams is rolling out a new update, and all new feature development will only be available in the new Teams. After March 31, 2024, existing values for new Teams client policies will no longer be valid for non-VDI customers, and after June 30, 2024, for VDI customers. The "New Teams only" policy is now available in the Teams admin center (TAC), and a new Teams usage report is available in the Teams admin center. To ensure a seamless update to new Teams, admins should gradually roll out T...

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Planner Agent available in Frontier
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Planner Agent is now available in Frontier, enabling users with Copilot licenses to create, update, and manage tasks and plans directly in Copilot chat. It offers intelligent insights, interactive task cards, and natural language prompts. Available now in Frontier; public preview starts mid-March 2026.

Title: Microsoft Teams for Mac: Improved access to account management
Summary: Microsoft Teams for macOS will add new account management access points in the app menu and Dock icon menu by late April 2026. Existing policies and permissions remain unchanged. The update is automatic and enabled by default, requiring no user action. Notify helpdesk and update documentation if needed.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Introducing infinite scroll for chat history
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce infinite scroll for chat history, allowing users to seamlessly access older conversations as they scroll. This feature, enabled by default worldwide from early to end of April 2026, affects all users without impacting existing workflows or requiring admin action.

Title: Microsoft Office for the web: Apply sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions
Summary: Microsoft 365 Office for the web will support applying sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint starting mid-April 2026. This feature requires coauthoring on encrypted files, aligns with desktop app permissions, and respects existing admin policies. No user action is needed.

Title: Designer tools in Copilot
Summary: Designer tools in Copilot, rolling out from mid-February to early April 2026, provide users with enhanced controls to refine prompts and adjust visuals in image creation across Microsoft 365. Enabled by default, no admin changes are needed, and existing policies remain in effect.

Title: Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Role-based Copilot offerings 2026 release wave 1 plans available now
Summary: On March 18, 2026, we published the 2026 release wave 1 plans for Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, and Role-based Copilot offerings which is a compilation of new capabilities that will be released between April 2026 through September 2026. The new features and enhancements provide you with significant capabilities to help transform your business using our applications. What actions do I need to take? You can use the Release planner to view and manage release plans across all active releas...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service – Define critical questions in evaluation criteria
Summary: We are announcing the ability to define critical questions in evaluation criteria in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on April 17, 2026. How does this affect me? Critical questions allow users to mark questions within an evaluation criterion as critical and define the specific responses that result in failure. When the evaluation criteria are applied during an evaluation run and if any critical question fails, the entire evaluation is automatically mark...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Share contact information for people in Microsoft Teams channels
Summary: Users can now share contact information in Microsoft Teams channels, making it easier to reach collaborators. This feature is available globally and requires no admin action. For more details, see the provided link.

Title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for Endpoint: Mac device management support for additional MDM solutions
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for Endpoint will support Mac devices managed by additional third-party MDM solutions beyond Jamf and Microsoft Intune. Public preview starts mid-April 2025, with general availability in mid-June 2025. Existing deployments are unaffected.

Title: New Health Issue in the MDI Sensors Health Issues Tab
Summary: A new health issue for VMware sensors will be added to the Defender for Identity Sensors Health Issues tab in March 2025. Organizations should monitor this tab for alerts on network configuration mismatches and take recommended actions.

Title: New Outlook: "Automatically dismiss reminders for past events" will be on by default for Reminder window users
Summary: "Automatically dismiss reminders for past events" will be enabled by default in the new Outlook for Windows. This change will start rolling out in March 2025 and complete by May 2025. Users can re-enable past-due event reminders in Settings. More information is available [here](https://support.microsoft.com/office/add-or-delete-notifications-or-reminders-in-outlook-7a992377-ca93-4ddd-a711-851ef3597925).

Title: Microsoft Purview | AI Hub: New Data Assessments
Summary: Microsoft Purview AI Hub will introduce new data assessments to enhance data security by analyzing data sensitivity and user access, providing remediation actions. Public preview starts mid-November 2024, with general availability from late April to early May 2025. The feature is on by default and requires no prior admin action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: BYOD mode will activate cameras on meeting room audio devices
Summary: Microsoft Teams will activate the video component of audio-video peripherals as the selected camera in BYOD rooms starting May 2025. This applies to Teams for Windows and Mac desktops. Inform users about this change, which will occur automatically, and review room peripherals for impact. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified Notes pane in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will update the Notes pane in meetings to streamline design and clarify features. This applies to Teams for Windows and Mac desktops. The rollout starts in April 2025 and completes by May 2025. Changes include renaming the pane and adding new controls. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Protection (DLP): Blanket protections for unscannable file types
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Protection (DLP) will soon include blanket protection for unscannable file types. Public preview starts mid-March 2025, with general availability by late March 2025. Admins can configure this feature in policy settings. No action is required before rollout, but review and notify users. Roadmap ID 464998.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Updates to Community membership approval from email notifications
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will soon allow community admins to approve multiple membership requests from a centralized page accessed via email notifications. This update applies to various platforms and will roll out in April 2025. No admin action is required, but organizations should review configurations and notify users.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Improvements to "Activity in other accounts and orgs panel"
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the "Activity in other accounts and orgs" panel to centralize cross-tenant notifications, reducing tenant switching. The panel moves to the bottom-left sidebar, shows missed activities grouped by tenant, and allows pinning up to three tenants. Rollout begins November 2025; no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows now support phishing-resistant sign-in
Summary: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows enable phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in using Windows Hello on both managed and unmanaged devices. Public preview runs from late March to May 2026. Organizations must opt in and configure passkey policies; existing security policies remain unchanged. No compliance issues identified.

Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting March 18th, 2026 (PST). Title: Lists as a knowledge source for agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
Summary: Microsoft Lists will be supported as a knowledge source for custom agents in SharePoint and OneDrive starting late March 2026. Agents can answer questions using list data, but only one list can be used per agent. Users need appropriate permissions and a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Security Triage Agent Summaries for DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
Summary: Microsoft Defender XDR will integrate AI-generated summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts via the Microsoft Purview Data Security Triage Agent, improving alert triage. Deployment starts April 2026 (preview) and August 2026 (general). Agent management remains in Purview; DLP policies and user impact remain unchanged.

Title: Set a custom name for the OneDrive sync folder
Summary: Starting mid-March 2026, admins can set a custom local OneDrive sync folder name on Windows to reduce path length issues. New users see the custom name automatically; existing users must unlink and relink OneDrive. The feature is opt-in and requires admin configuration.

Title: Prevent/Fix: Microsoft Baseline Security Mode has automatically trigger Entra Conditional Access policy creation
Summary: Between November 2025 and February 2026, Microsoft Baseline Security Mode automatically created two disabled draft Entra Conditional Access policies in some tenants. This is not a security issue, requires no action, and a fix will remove unintended drafts and prevent automatic creation.

Title: Power Automate – Enable dark mode in Power Automate for desktop
Summary: We are launching the ability Enable dark mode in Power Automate for desktop for Power Automate. With this feature, you can switch between default and dark modes in Power Automate for desktop to enhance user experience. This feature will reach general availability on April 30, 2025. How does this affect me? Users can configure Power Automate for desktop to use light or dark mode. What action do I need to take? This message is for awareness and no action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Connections: Default experience for Home site customers
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections will automatically set the Home site as the default experience in Teams for customers who haven't set a Viva Connections experience. This rollout starts mid-January 2025 and ends late March 2025. No action is required unless you want to disable this change.

Title: Microsoft Viva Learning: Date Format selection and numerals support
Summary: Microsoft Viva Learning will support Date Format selection and numeral changes based on language preferences starting mid-March 2025. Users can select their preferred date format and language under Settings. This update applies to Teams for Windows desktop, Teams on the web, and the Viva Learning web app. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Clipchamp desktop app: Work account support
Summary: The Microsoft Clipchamp desktop app is introducing support for logins with Azure Active Directory/Entra ID accounts. This means that work accounts will be supported in the desktop app from version 3.x, which is being rolled out gradually to Microsoft 365 organizations. The rollout will begin early May 2024 and is expected to be completed by early June 2024. Users will not need to access Clipchamp from a web browser and can use the desktop app instead. Admins can manage the desktop app's availabi...

Title: Reminder: Stream (Classic) retires on April 15, 2024, and all unmigrated videos will be deleted
Summary: Stream (Classic) will be retired on April 15, 2024, and all unmigrated videos will be deleted. Admins must migrate their tenant's Stream (Classic) data to Stream (on SharePoint) before the retirement date to prevent data loss. Stream (on SharePoint) offers many capabilities, including recording and playing videos directly in many everyday work and school apps, managing video files with the same security and admin controls as the rest of your files in SharePoint and OneDrive, and searching for vi...

Title: Microsoft Outlook Mobile: Open a Teams Meeting chat from the calendar
Summary: Microsoft Outlook Mobile users will be able to open Teams Meeting chat directly from the meeting event on their Outlook mobile calendar. This feature will be rolled out in late April 2024 and will be completed by late May 2024. Users will be able to open the chat in the Teams Mobile app, and if the app is not installed, they will be linked to a page asking if they wish to download the Teams Mobile app. No admin action is required for this rollout.

Title: New admin control for AI‑generated code previews in Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages will introduce admin-controlled AI-generated code previews, available only if Copilot Pages are enabled. Rolling out mid-March to mid-April 2026, admins can enable or disable this feature via a Cloud Policy. There are no new compliance or data processing impacts.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint DLP classification support for Azure RMS–protected Office documents
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will soon classify Azure RMS–protected Office documents, enabling consistent DLP policy enforcement on encrypted files starting early April 2026. This enhances content inspection without changing user workflows, requiring Endpoint DLP client version 4.18.26030 or higher.

Title: Purview DSPM’s Data Risk Assessments now support item-level investigation and remediation of SharePoint
Summary: Purview DSPM Data Risk Assessments now support item-level investigation and remediation for SharePoint, enabling admins to detect and fix oversharing risks by applying sensitivity labels, notifying owners, or removing sharing links. This feature requires admin setup and will roll out worldwide by mid-March 2026.

Title: Upcoming retirement of select threat detections in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will retire select IaaS and PaaS threat detections by mid-May 2026 due to low impact, focusing on identity-related threats. Affected alerts and policies will be removed, but historical data remains accessible. No admin action is required, though updating related processes is recommended.

Title: Power Apps - Custom theming for model-driven apps is becoming generally available
Summary: Custom theming for model-driven apps using the modern, refreshed look has been available in preview since October 2023. This capability allows organizations to align model-driven apps with their branding by customizing colors, fonts, and app header styling using the Microsoft Fluent 2 design system. As of March 31, 2026, custom theming will reach general availability. How does this affect me? Classic theming is not honored with the modern, refreshed look, which is becoming mandatory for model-dr...

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Improve opportunity context with AI-based data enrichment
Summary: We are announcing the ability to improve the context for opportunities with AI-based data enrichment in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on April 17, 2026. How does this affect me? AI-powered data enrichment allows you to analyze your emails and highlight gaps in opportunity information and suggest updates. This feature helps you keep your opportunity data accurate and up to date, increases your confidence in pipeline data, and enables more effective deal reviews...

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Modern, in-flow email template picker for Sequences
Summary: We are announcing a modern, in-flow email template picker for Sequences within Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on April 17, 2026. How does this affect me? Title: Build SharePoint automations with Workflows—now aligned with the Teams experience
Summary: SharePoint automations now use a unified Workflows experience aligned with Teams, powered by Power Automate. This update simplifies creating and managing workflows with a streamlined interface, natural language support, and a redesigned template library. Rollout begins February 2026; no admin action is required. Existing workflows remain unaffected.

Title: Microsoft Teams - Native MacOS screen and window sharing in Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce an opt-in native macOS screen and window sharing feature using Apple's APIs, starting early December 2025 for targeted release and general availability by mid-May 2026. It is disabled by default, requires no app restart, and improves performance for Mac users in Teams meetings.

Title: Updates on default checkbox changes on tenant settings for SQL database in Fabric
Summary: SQL databases in Fabric will be enabled by default starting March 28, 2025, despite the infobox showing March 8, 2025. Tenant admins should review and decide on settings before this date. If no action is taken, the setting remains active. Contact support for further assistance.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Performance update for requesting an eSignature on a PDF
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint will update its eSignature service in mid-April to late May 2025, allowing users to create additional eSignature requests without waiting for previous ones to complete. New toast notifications will inform users of request statuses. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are advised.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Updated "Community information" experience
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will soon update the "Community information" experience for community admins, simplifying text creation and editing, and limiting the section to 32k characters. This change will apply to various Engage apps and will roll out from late March to mid-April 2025. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Network Consolidation Now Receives 15 Day Notice
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage now provides a 15-day notice for automatic network consolidation, reduced from 30 days. Admins cannot pause or cancel this process. To control the timing, start the consolidation via the Engage Admin Center. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/configure-your-viva-engage-network/consolidate-multiple-networks).

Title: Keep Edge up to date to continue using Copilot on the Edge sidebar
Summary: Keep Edge updated to version 134.0.3124.51 or newer to use Copilot on the Edge sidebar. Updates include independence from Bing authentication, support for file uploads on the 'Web' tab, and access for all eligible enterprise tenants. M365 Copilot license requirements remain unchanged.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS: Open the previous email with email auto-advance
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for iOS will introduce an "Open the Email Above" setting in mid-February 2025, completing by mid-March 2025. This will replace the "Move to the Next Email" setting. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended. More details can be found in the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 477362.

Title: Microsoft OneNote Windows app: New "OneNote (Desktop) - Protected" virtual printer
Summary: Microsoft is introducing a new "OneNote (Desktop) - Protected" virtual printer for OneNote Windows desktop app users, compatible with Windows Protected Printing (WPP). This will roll out from late February to early April 2025. Admins must configure specific group policies to ensure successful installation. Existing workflows will remain unchanged.

Title: Whiteboards created in Teams channels will now be stored in SharePoint
Summary: Whiteboards created in Teams Channel tabs will be stored in the channel’s SharePoint site starting late September 2026, improving access, compliance, and collaboration. This change is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and aligns Whiteboard storage with other Microsoft 365 apps while maintaining existing security and compliance policies.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Manage multiple phone numbers within one Teams account
Summary: Microsoft Teams Phone will allow assigning up to 10 phone numbers per user within one account, enabling calls from multiple numbers on various devices. Rolling out April-May 2026, this feature is off by default and requires admin configuration and a Teams Phone license. No prior action needed.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Upload local files now supports .eml and .msg file types
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support uploading .eml and .msg email files starting late February to March 2026, enabling users to provide email context for prompts. This feature is automatic, requires no admin setup, affects all Copilot users, and has no new compliance concerns.

As a Dynamics 365 Sales Premium license holder, you will automatically receive an increase in their Dataverse storage capacity. The default per-tenant storage capacity will be increased from 30 GB to 45 GB, and capacity accrued per user subscription license will be increased from 250 MB to 500MB. Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Control evaluation volume with sampling
Summary: We are announcing the ability to control evaluation volume with sampling in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on April 17, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to manage evaluation volume by configuring sampling. The Quality Evaluation Agent evaluation can plan support sampling where users define conditions to identify relevant interactions, then apply sampling rules to limit how many of those interactions are evaluated on each run. Sa...

Title: Trust DigiCert Global Root G2 certificate authority to avoid Exchange Online email disruption
Summary: To avoid Exchange Online email disruption by March 23, 2026, organizations must trust the updated DigiCert Global Root G2 certificate and intermediates, especially if they disable Windows CTL updates or use custom/older runtimes. Failure to update may cause mail flow issues.

Summary: We are releasing the automate interactions with Shadow DOM elements in modern web feature for Power Automate. This feature enables you to automate workflows in modern web apps built with frameworks like Angular, React, and Lit. This ensures seamless interaction with encapsulated components, making your automation scripts reliable without complex workarounds. This feature will reach general availability on April 15, 2025. Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance – User scoping role-based access control (RBAC)
Summary: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance is introducing User Scoping with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), empowering organizations to delegate management and remediation authority to specific individuals based on regions or organizational units. This new feature introduces delegate management and remediation authority for different people in different regions or organization units with role-based access control (RBAC) using Microsoft Entra administrative units. Title: SharePoint Online: Change history reports now include organization settings reports
Summary: SharePoint Online's change history reports now include organization settings reports. Admins can track and review changes made to settings that impact the entire tenant by creating up to ten instances. The feature update will be rolled out in preview beginning in March 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Public preview of administrative units support
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is rolling out public preview of administrative units support, allowing admins to subdivide the organization into smaller units and assign specific admins or role groups to manage only the members of those units. Admins can configure administrative units in Azure and assign them to solution admins or members of Insider Risk Management role groups from the permissions area of Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Title: (Upated) Office documents have a new default theme
Summary: Office documents will have a new default theme, including a new font, color palette, and updated line weights. The change will affect Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook on various endpoints. No action is needed to prepare for the change. The rollout will start mid-December 2023 and be fully rolled out by late March 2024.

Title: Changes to the Website tab in the new Teams client.
Summary: Starting mid-July 2024, Microsoft Teams will retire the ability to load websites inside the new Teams client when using the Website tab due to web security and privacy best practices. Users will be redirected to a new browser tab instead. EDU tenants will not be affected. Existing Website tabs will also be opened in a new browser tab. Encourage users to pin corresponding app tabs instead of URLs as website tabs.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center (TAC): Search now supports resource accounts
Summary: The Microsoft Teams admin center search bar will now support resource accounts. The rollout will begin in early March 2024 and will affect a wide range of entities. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout.

Summary: Microsoft 365 admins can deploy their Frontline Operational hierarchy in the Teams Admin Center, enabling them to map their organization's structure of frontline teams/locations to a hierarchy. Admins can define metadata for each team/location, which will enable numerous frontline apps and experiences in the future. Title: Microsoft Teams: Use Apple AirPods to mute/unmute yourself
Summary: Microsoft Teams on macOS Sonoma will soon allow users to mute or unmute themselves with Apple AirPods, with a rollout starting late March 2024 and completing by mid-April 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this change. Organizations not using macOS can ignore this message.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Chat/Channel Copilot will Preserve Side Pane Preferences
Summary: Microsoft Teams' Copilot will preserve side pane preferences for a specific chat thread while the app is running. This feature will be available on desktop and web. The rollout will start in early March 2024 and will be completed by late March 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Outlook: Track Read Receipts within Outlook on the Web and the New Outlook for Windows
Summary: Outlook will soon allow users to view updated read receipt statuses of recipients directly from the sent item. The rollout will begin in early January 2024 worldwide and late March 2024 for GCC. Users may want to notify others and update relevant documentation.

Title: Microsoft Viva Admin center: New capabilities for added flexibility and to manage adoption
Summary: Microsoft Viva Admin center is introducing new capabilities to increase flexibility and simplify the admin experience. These features include dynamic admin controls, Viva Insights admin welcome email, Admin center for Viva Insights, Viva Insights recommendation cards, and Viva Feature Access management control for digest email. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout, and it will begin rolling out for General Availability late March and expect to complete by late April 2024.

Title: PowerShell and Microsoft Entra admin center now support Copilot welcome emails
Summary: PowerShell and Microsoft Entra admin center now support Copilot welcome emails for licenses assigned outside of the Microsoft 365 admin center. The rollout will begin in late March 2024 and end in late April 2024. End users assigned Copilot for Microsoft 365 licenses through methods outside of the Microsoft 365 admin center will automatically receive a Copilot for Microsoft 365 welcome email if direct communications from Microsoft to end users are enabled. Organizations and individual users can...

Title: Microsoft Viva Connections: Dark mode support on Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections will now support dark mode on both Microsoft Teams Desktop and mobile devices. The rollout will begin late March 2024 and is expected to complete by late April 2024. The Viva Connections app will support user's preferred setting for dark mode on Microsoft Teams. No action is required to prepare for this feature.

Title: Microsoft Project for the web: New Assigned to Me view for Project tasks
Summary: Microsoft Project for the web will have a new "Assigned to Me" view for tasks, allowing users to access and edit their Project tasks in Planner, To Do, and Teams. The rollout will begin mid-March 2024 and end late May 2024. Project tasks will be synced with Planner, but users can turn off this feature in the Microsoft 365 admin center if they don't want Project data to cross data boundaries. No action is needed to enable the feature.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Public preview of multicloud support
Summary: Microsoft Purview Information Protection and Insider Risk Management will roll out a public preview of multicloud support in late March 2024. This will extend sensitivity labels and protection policies into data contained in Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Amazon S3. Insider Risk Management will offer ready-to-use risk indicators in Azure, AWS, and SaaS apps including Box, Dropbox, and Google Drive. Information Protection admins can get started by accessing the Information Protection sol...

Title: Use double-key encryption to protect your most sensitive files and emails in Microsoft 365 Apps
Summary: Microsoft 365 Apps users can now use Double Key Encryption (DKE) to protect sensitive content. DKE ensures that only the user can decrypt protected content. Sensitivity labels configured with DKE are available for use in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. General availability is scheduled for mid-August 2023 for the Current channel and mid-September 2023 for the Monthly Enterprise channel. Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recapping changes in Loop over extended periods
Summary: The Recap feature in Loop now allows users to summarize changes over extended periods, such as the last week or last 30 days. This update will roll out from mid-March to early April 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Summary: We are launching the set screen resolution for unattended desktop flow runs feature for Power Automate. This feature enables you to set flow-specific resolution and DPI settings, ensuring consistent performance and reducing errors. This feature will reach general availability on April 17, 2025. Summary: We recently announced updates to the business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform. The tool is designed to help IT admins migrate video content from Stream (Classic) to Stream (on SharePoint). Title: Microsoft Secure Score: New recommendations for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Summary: New Microsoft Secure Score recommendations for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will roll out in public preview from late February to mid-March 2026. They include SMB server hardening and blocking file transfer over RDP. Recommendations are off by default and require admin action to enable.

Title: Prevent/Fix: Microsoft Purview | Activity Explorer - Total count includes duplicate results
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Activity Explorer will update its UI to show "Total results loaded" instead of "Total count" to avoid confusion from duplicate counts. Exported data remains deduplicated and unchanged. No data loss or performance impact occurs. No user action is needed, but informing compliance teams is recommended.

Title: Content Security Policies (CSP) are coming to SharePoint Online and might impact your custom SPFx solutions
Summary: Starting March 1, 2026, SharePoint Online will enforce Content Security Policy (CSP), blocking scripts from untrusted sources in custom SPFx solutions. To avoid disruptions, ensure all scripts come from trusted sources and move inline scripts to files. CSP enforcement can be postponed 90 days via PowerShell.

Title: Microsoft Teams on the web: New Private Preview for Sign in with Apple and Google for consumers may affect enterprise
Summary: Microsoft Teams on the web plans a new sign-in preview with "Continue with Apple" and "Continue with Google" for consumer accounts via login.microsoftonline.com/common. Enterprise users with custom URLs won't be affected. The rollout is on hold, and no action is needed currently.

Title: License enforcement for Microsoft Purview Information Protection for sensitivity labels
Summary: Starting January 2024, new customers require specific licenses to use or continue using Information Protection sensitivity labels. Existing customers using sensitivity labels without the correct licenses will have a grace period until early April 2024. Admins and users who use Information Protection sensitivity labels need to have the required licenses assigned to them. For more details on the licenses required, please refer to the link provided in the message.

Title: Microsoft Loop: Guest Sharing
Summary: Microsoft Loop will soon allow business-to-business (B2B) guest sharing for workspaces, pages, and components, subject to administrator policy. Sensitivity labels for Loop workspaces, pages, and components will begin rolling out in the first half of 2024. Users within organizations will be able to share Loop workspaces, pages, and components with people outside of their tenant via B2B guest sharing. The rollout will happen automatically by the specified date with no admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview Audit: HighCompleteness parameter in Search-UnifiedAuditLog Audit cmdlet
Summary: Microsoft is introducing the HighCompleteness parameter to the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet, which provides a more comprehensive set of audit log records by prioritizing completeness over speed. The parameter can result in slower performance, and it will be available for public preview in mid-March 2024 and for general availability in early April 2024. Title: Microsoft Teams | Shared call history for delegates and delegators
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow call delegators and delegates to see shared call history records for the shared line, starting late April 2024. There is no impact to tenants or admins, and the rollout will happen automatically. Users may want to update relevant documentation.

Title: Insider Risk Management policy template limit increase
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will increase the limit number of policies within each insider risk policy template from 5 to 20. The update will roll out from late March 2024 to mid-April 2024. No admin action is required, but users may want to update relevant documentation. The Insider Risk Management solution can be accessed in the Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal.

Title: Plan for Change: Intune audit logs will only be retained for one year
Summary: Intune audit logs will only be retained for one year starting April 2024. Users can export logs older than one year before the change in the Intune admin center. Notify IT admins and update documentation guidelines.

Title: Sensitivity labels available soon for Viva Engage communities
Summary: Starting late March 2026, Viva Engage communities will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels applied to Microsoft 365 groups and SharePoint sites, synchronizing access controls across these platforms. Admins must manually apply labels to existing communities and prepare accordingly for this update.

Title: Find your files quickly and easily on Word, Excel and PowerPoint App home pages
Summary: A new Search box will be added to the Word, Excel, and PowerPoint app home pages by March 2026, enabling quick file search with dynamic suggestions. The feature is enabled by default, respects existing permissions, requires no admin changes, and no user action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection – Override manually applied labels and Remove labels with Auto-labeling
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces auto-labeling actions for SharePoint and OneDrive, allowing admins to override or remove manually applied sensitivity labels automatically. This enhances data classification accuracy and governance, with rollout starting mid-April 2026. The feature is admin-controlled and not enabled by default.

Title: Retirement of the Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel installation option for unmanaged devices
Summary: Starting April 6, 2026, Microsoft will retire the Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel installation option for unmanaged devices in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Existing devices remain unaffected, but new selections cannot use this channel. Managed devices via Intune or Configuration Manager are not impacted. No immediate action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Unmanaged cloud app protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
Summary: Microsoft Purview integrates with the Island Enterprise Browser to extend data loss prevention and network data security to unmanaged cloud app workflows. Administrators must enable this feature to inspect and protect browser-based data sharing using existing Purview policies. Rollout begins late March 2026 (preview) and late June 2026 (general availability).

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Disable add-in user reporting buttons now that built-in Report button is GA for all platforms
Summary: Disable add-in user reporting buttons in Microsoft Outlook as the built-in Report button is now generally available across all platforms. The Report Message and Report Phishing add-ins are in maintenance mode and will not receive improvements. Review your configuration and notify users of this change.

Title: Reminder: "Require approved client app" control in Microsoft Entra Conditional Access will be retired in March 2026
Summary: "Require approved client app" control in Microsoft Entra Conditional Access will be retired in March 2026. Organizations should update their policies to use the "Require application protection policy" grant control. For more information, visit the provided link.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Attach recent and relevant files more quickly to chats and channel posts
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing Quick attach, which displays recent and contextually relevant files when attaching a file to a Teams chat or channel post. This feature will save time when attaching files. The rollout will not affect existing file attachment options and will be limited to certain file formats. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout.

Summary: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 will enable graph grounding and web grounding in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey Designer Role
Summary: Microsoft Viva Glint will introduce a Survey designer role starting March 23, 2026, allowing designated users to create and manage surveys without access to sensitive settings. Admins must assign this role explicitly. Organizations should prepare by identifying users, updating documentation, and informing stakeholders. No compliance issues noted.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – New permissions
Summary: Microsoft Viva Glint introduces granular permissions for Advanced Configuration, Nudges, General Settings, and Integrations. The top role is renamed "Viva Glint Service Admin," assignable only via Microsoft Admin Center by M365 Global or Viva Glint Tenant Admins. Rollout begins March 23, 2026, enhancing security and role clarity.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updates to PowerPoint on‑canvas features with Agent mode
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot updates PowerPoint with Agent mode for rewrite, translate, and speaker notes features, enabling chat-based interaction and multi-step reasoning. Rollout starts mid-March 2026 for web, then Windows and Mac, completing by April end. No admin action required; users should save copies during transition.

Title: New features coming to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is expanding: Outlook will analyze entire inboxes, calendars, and meetings; Agent Mode in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will assist content creation using web data and referenced files. Rollout began January 2026, completing by March, with no admin action required for most features.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Bulk import of .eml files
Summary: Users will soon be able to bulk import .eml files in the new Microsoft Outlook for Windows, starting mid-March 2025. This feature will be enabled by default and simplifies the process of importing multiple email files. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Support for scoping policies for devices and device group in Endpoint
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will now support scoping policies for devices and device groups in Endpoint. This feature allows different policies for the same user on different devices. The rollout starts in mid-March 2025 and completes by mid-April 2025. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Multiple Yammer Networks Within Single Tenant No Longer Supported (1:Many Mode)
Summary: Yammer will no longer support multiple non-external networks within a single tenant, aligning with Microsoft 365. Automated network consolidation will occur from May 1, 2023, to mid-March 2025, resulting in the loss of secondary networks' groups and data. Users should export data and can self-initiate consolidation.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Recipient-triggered policy tips
Summary: Microsoft Purview's new feature displays policy tips only after recipients are added to an email, ensuring relevance and preventing confusion. This will roll out globally from late March to early April 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online Management Shell will replace IDCRL authentication protocol with OAuth
Summary: Starting March 28, 2025, Microsoft SharePoint Online Management Shell will replace the IDCRL authentication protocol with OAuth. Admins should install the updated version from the Microsoft Download Center. No admin action is required, but reviewing current configurations and notifying users is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Navigation enhancements
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is rolling out enhanced navigation for a seamless user experience. The changes will be available for all Viva Engage licensed organizations, with additional changes for Viva Communications and Communities bundle and Viva Suite. The rollout will begin mid-March 2024 and is expected to complete by late March 2024. No action is needed to prepare for this rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Detailed call history update | forwarded calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating its call history details for forwarded calls. Title: Email notifications for "Issues in your environment that require action"

Summary: Message Trace support on Microsoft Graph API is now in Public Preview, replacing legacy Reporting Web Service endpoints starting April 8, 2026. Admins and developers should migrate scripts and automation to the new RESTful API before retirement begins. General Availability rollout starts late January 2026.

Summary: SharePoint will enable tenant admins to centrally manage site branding via PowerShell, enforcing enterprise themes, disabling custom branding per site, auditing changes, and managing themes centrally by geo. Rollout begins late November 2025, with general availability by March 2026. Admins should prepare by reviewing PowerShell docs and updating processes.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to record and review full-screen representative activity in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on March 27, 2026. Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting February 24th, 2026 (PST). Summary: Admins can now set separate retention policies for Copilot and AI app interactions in Microsoft Purview, allowing faster deletion if needed. This feature, rolling out from mid-March to May 2026, enhances data lifecycle management and compliance controls for generative AI content.

Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will add an option to search all filtered messages when more exist beyond locally synced items, improving clarity without changing sync behavior or admin settings. This rollout begins mid-March 2026 and requires no admin action. Users applying filters like Unread or Flagged are affected.

Title: Workspace IP Firewall rules (Public Preview)
Summary: Microsoft Fabric will introduce workspace-level IP firewall rules in Public Preview from mid-January to early March 2026, allowing workspace admins to restrict inbound access by IP allowlists. Tenant admins control this feature via a toggle in the Fabric admin portal, enhancing workspace data security.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Review your organization's configured management policies
Summary: Administrators should review and update management policies for the new Microsoft Outlook for Windows. Key policies include configuring accounts based on Active Directory, controlling personal mailbox connections, and managing domain-specific mailbox connections. Detailed guidance and policy mapping from classic Outlook are available in the provided links.

Summary: The behavior of the EWSEnabled switch in Exchange Online is changing. Starting April 1, 2025, EWS will only be allowed if both the organization-level and user-level EWSEnabled flags are true. This change aims to improve policy enforcement consistency. Check the blog for more details: [The way to control EWS usage in Exchange Online is changing](https://aka.ms/EWSEnabledChange).

Summary: We are announcing the ability to improve usability and streamline the expense submission experience in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Broader access to M365 Copilot Chat insights
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat Adoption Metrics will roll out in March 2026 to tenants with at least one Copilot license, enabling default insights on usage trends, adoption by group, retention, and app-level breakdowns. Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Support multilingual evaluation criteria
Summary: We are announcing the ability to define evaluation criteria in a selected language and receive evaluation results in that same language in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for February 2023
Summary: Microsoft Intune Service Update for February 2023 has been released, bringing some exciting changes. The update will be visible in the Tenant Status blade of the Intune console. Click on the links provided to learn more about the new features.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Turning on DLP analytics
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) analytics feature analyzes data protection challenges, generates recommendations, and provides policy improvement opportunities. Admins can turn on analytics in Purview's DLP overview page to receive weekly recommendations. The feature uses an intelligent algorithm to identify risks and suggest mitigations, with the top two recommendations prioritized as cards. Admins can view all recommendations and take necessary actions. No action is required to...

Title: Microsoft 365: Release of In-Person Events (IPE) including Hybrid RSVPing (HRSVP)
Summary: Microsoft 365 will release In-Person Events (IPE) with Hybrid RSVPing (HRSVP) in March 2024. Organizers can request in-person attendance, while attendees can confirm if they can participate in-person or virtually. The new functionalities will be available on Microsoft Outlook on the Web (OWA) and the new Outlook Desktop for Windows. No preparation is required.

Title: New Teams rollout schedule for Commercial and EDU customers
Summary: The message announces an updated timeline for the rollout of the new Teams to Commercial and Education customers. The new Teams is available for all customers today and is being enabled in stages. Teams Admin Center policy controls will remain available until end of March 2024, at which point they will only apply to VDI users if applicable. All new feature development will only be available in new Teams. Microsoft will continue rolling out new Teams on behalf of customers until early April 2024....

Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is updating conversation analytics with new features, including real-time updates, expanded reactions breakdown, and time period filters. These updates will be available to all Microsoft 365 customers, while additional capabilities like sentiment analysis will be exclusive to Viva Suite or Viva Employee Communications and Communities license holders.
