Title: New Microsoft 365 app launcher for web apps
Summary: Microsoft 365 is updating its app launcher for web apps, with a modern look, app search, consistency, quick creation options, and a suite-wide approach. The rollout will begin in March 2024 and end in June 2024, with no action needed from users or admins to prepare. The documents section showing a short list of recently accessed documents will be removed.

Title: Copilot for Microsoft 365 in Teams chat on mobile
Summary: Microsoft 365's Copilot will be available in Teams iOS and Android App for licensed users, appearing at the top of the Chat list for easy access. The update will roll out to commercial tenants in early March 2024, and users can continue to use it as before.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: Sway will retire from the "Create" tab
Summary: Sway will be retired from the "Create" tab in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app between March 24 and March 31, 2025, due to low usage. Users can still access Sway from the "Apps" section. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows usage report for Microsoft 365 apps
Summary: A new "Outlook for Windows migration progress" report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center starting early March 2025. This report will track the adoption of the new Outlook for Windows, requiring no admin action before rollout. Review configurations and notify users about the change.

Title: Upcoming Changes for M365 Copilot Chat with Link Safety
Summary: Upcoming changes to M365 Copilot Chat include integration with SafeLinks for URL protection, native time-of-click URL reputation checks, and the cessation of hyperlink redaction. Rollout begins in late March 2025 and completes by late May 2025. These updates enhance link security in chat responses.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Filter between active and archived teams in Shifts app schedules
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon introduce a dropdown filter in the Shifts app to switch between active and archived teams, reducing clutter. The rollout will start in late February 2025 and finish by late March 2025. No admin action is required, but notifying users and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic association of BYOD rooms and peripherals
Summary: Microsoft Teams will automatically associate BYOD rooms and peripherals using meeting room invite data. The rollout starts mid-January 2025 for Targeted Release and late January 2025 for General Availability, completing by late March 2025. Users will benefit from auto selection of devices, shared display mode, speaker attribution, and more.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New skin tone settings and reactions
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing new skin tone settings for emojis and reactions, allowing users to set their preferred skin tone in the app's settings or emoji/reaction menu. The rollout will occur from late October 2024 to late March 2025, depending on the release group. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Private moderator replies to individual attendees
Summary: A new Microsoft Teams feature allows moderators to privately respond to attendee questions during events. This feature will roll out from late January to late March 2025. Moderators can enable or disable it in Q&A settings. Notify meeting organizers about this update. More details will be in the Q&A documentation.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: ​Network share coverage and exclusion support on Mac endpoints​
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will now protect sensitive data in network shares and mapped network drives on Mac endpoints. The rollout timeline has been updated: Public Preview in early March 2025 and General Availability in early April 2025. Configure DLP policies and exclusions via the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Updated feedback policies
Summary: Updated feedback policies for Outlook mobile on iOS and Android will roll out from late January 2025 to early March 2025. The new behavior will align with current documentation, allowing users to include log files and content samples when feedback is submitted if the policy is not configured. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: New Allow and Off modes for each activity
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP is adding two new modes, "Off" and "Allow," to the existing "Audit only," "Block," and "Block with override" options. The rollout will occur in March 2025. These modes will be available by default, and prerequisites include specific Defender Antimalware client versions. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Transitioning from Microsoft 365 Chat to Copilot in Teams
Summary: Microsoft 365 Chat in Teams will be replaced by Copilot app starting early March 2024, and users are advised to use Copilot instead. Copilot licensed users won't be able to use M365 Chat app in Teams. Previous chat history won't be transferred to Copilot. Refer to the provided link for more information.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights: Expanded access to Microsoft Copilot Dashboard (Preview) and new admin controls
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding access to the Copilot Dashboard (Preview) and introducing new admin controls. Admins can manage access to the dashboard, and more organizational leaders will have access. The rollout will start in mid-March 2024 and end in late April 2024. Summary: The Edge management service in Microsoft 365 admin center is rolling out a new feature for automatic profile switching. IT admins can configure profile switching behaviors for end users to enforce context separation between work and personal browsing. Title: Upgrade for the latest Microsoft Fluent Design System visual styling on Microsoft SharePoint
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint will upgrade to the latest Fluent visual styling, with minor changes in padding or color on various UI controls. The rollout will begin in late February 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-April 2024 for Worldwide. No action is needed to prepare for this change.

Title: Microsoft Viva Glint: Use Microsoft 365 admin center to assign your organization's Viva Glint admins
Summary: Microsoft Viva Glint admins can now be assigned through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Global Tenant Admins can search, select, and confirm Viva Glint Admins by searching for these employees in their company’s Active Directory. The rollout will begin early March 2024 and expect to complete by mid-March 2024. The message provides information on what is needed to assign Viva Glint Admins.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Logged-in user details on the Purview device onboarding page
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will show the currently signed-in user's email on Windows devices in the device onboarding page, aligning with macOS. Rolling out from late February to mid-April 2026, this feature aids admins in device validation without affecting users or DLP policies. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention – File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
Summary: Microsoft Purview will add a file-testing feature on the Classification page to test files against Sensitive Information Type classifiers. Rolling out from late February to April 2026, it helps identify sensitive content without policy changes and is automatically enabled for all tenants. No action needed.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention – Export DLP and label policy configurations
Summary: Microsoft Purview will introduce a new export feature for Data Loss Prevention and label publishing policies, allowing admins to download full policy configurations as ZIP files. Rolling out from March to May 2026, this feature aids troubleshooting without affecting policy enforcement or user experience.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Notebooks: Overview page with Copilot-powered summaries and insights
Summary: Microsoft is introducing Copilot-powered summaries and insights as the default landing page in Copilot Notebooks, starting with web preview in November 2025 and general availability by March 2026. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required, and no user action is needed to enable this feature.

Title: Toggle to new Outlook
Summary: Microsoft has postponed the opt-out phase for new Outlook in Enterprise from April 2026 to March 2027, giving organizations 12 months to prepare. Admins can use policies for staged migration, users can switch back temporarily, and resources are provided for smooth transition and adoption.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Upcoming changes to Microsoft Places licensing and feature access
Summary: Starting April 1, 2026, Microsoft Places licensing will shift from user-based to space-based, making core features widely available without Teams Premium. Advanced features like desk reservations and analytics will require a Shared Space license. Teams Premium users retain current capabilities until renewal, then must switch to Shared Space licensing.

Title: OneNote for iOS: Introducing automatic local backups
Summary: OneNote for iOS will automatically create local backups of notebooks stored in the iOS Files app, enabling self-service recovery via PC or Mac. This feature, rolling out mid-March to mid-April 2026, respects existing Intune app protection policies and is enabled by default unless restricted by organizational settings.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Updates to font management capabilities
Summary: Microsoft is updating SharePoint and Viva Connections with new font management capabilities, including hiding Microsoft font packages, applying font packages in site templates, and new PowerShell commands. Rollout begins mid-October 2024, completing by late February 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Edge links on MacOS will seamlessly open

Rollout starts late October 2024 and completes by late February 2025. Admins can control this feature via policy. No immediate action required, but review configurations and notify users.

Title: Update to Get-CsPhoneNumberAssignment
Summary: The Get-CsPhoneNumberAssignment cmdlet page size limit will be updated to a maximum of 1,000 numbers per query. The rollout will begin in early February 2025 and complete by late February 2025. Requests exceeding this limit will result in a "Bad request" starting January 6, 2025.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Updated permissions section in the Microsoft Teams app details page

The update includes an "Expand All" button and will roll out globally from mid to late March 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Entra: New built-in Viva Glint Tenant Administrator role

The rollout will occur from late March to early April 2025. Admins should review the role's documentation, assess current roles, and communicate changes to staff.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Increasing policy template limits

The rollout will start in mid-March 2025 for Public Preview and early July 2025 for General Availability. No admin action is required.

Title: Microsoft OneNote: The "me@onenote" feature will retire; use "Send to OneNote" instead
Summary: Microsoft OneNote will retire the "me@onenote" feature on March 26, 2025, due to low usage. Users should use the "Send to OneNote" feature in Outlook instead. No admin action is required, but users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

Summary: Microsoft OneNote will retire app-only authentication for Microsoft Graph APIs on March 31, 2025. Organizations using app-only tokens must switch to delegated authentication tokens to avoid unauthorized errors. This change aims to enhance data security. Summary: Microsoft 365 (Office) app is now the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. Changes in the Microsoft Outlook apps for iOS and Android will occur in March 2025, including a new icon for Microsoft accounts. No admin action is required, but users should be notified. Learn more [here](https://support.microsoft.com/office/the-microsoft-365-app-transition-to-the-microsoft-365-copilot-app-22eac811-08d6-4df3-92dd-77f193e354a5).

Title: Microsoft Outlook: To Do in Microsoft Outlook for Mac
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for Mac will have the To Do app available for commercial users starting from March 2024. Tenants who have enabled the To Do app will see it in the left navigation of Outlook for Mac for eligible users. Users will notice a new entry point in Outlook for Mac if their active commercial Microsoft account has been granted access by their tenant administrator. Ensure that the To Do workload is enabled for your tenant.

Title: Files in Outlook for iOS will open in Word, Excel or Powerpoint app on iPad

Title: New device settings experience in Teams on the web

Title: Tenant Default Change – Workspace Admins Will Be Allowed to Enable Monitoring
Summary: Starting March 23, 2026, the tenant setting allowing Workspace Admins to enable monitoring in Microsoft Fabric will be enabled by default. Monitoring is not auto-enabled; Workspace Admins decide to activate it, providing logs and metrics access while maintaining existing governance and security controls.

Title: Outlook Folder Recursive Search
Summary: The Outlook Folder Recursive Search feature has been canceled. It was intended to allow searches within sub-folders. The rollout, initially planned for late November 2024 to late December 2024, was rescheduled to late February 2025 to late March 2025. Refer to Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 151025 for details.

Title: Yammer Rebranding to Viva Engage Domain Migration Update
Summary: Yammer is rebranding to Viva Engage, with web and email domain changes. The web domain change occurred from late March to mid-April 2024. The email domain change timeline will be communicated later. Admins should review and update configurations, bookmarks, and rules. Users need to reinstall PWAs and re-enable desktop notifications.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: New reporting buttons integrated with Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Summary: Outlook for iOS/Android is getting new reporting buttons, allowing users to report emails as phishing, junk, or not junk. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams Phone: Improved Calling Plan Porting wizard will be GA for US and Canada in the Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams Phone is launching an improved Calling Plan Porting wizard for the US and Canada in the Teams admin center by early February 2025. Enhancements include simplified portability checks, the ability to save draft orders, and edit validated orders. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights: New “Brokers of Information flow” insights category available for Change Management template
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights is introducing a new "Brokers of Information flow" insights category in the Change Management template, highlighting key employee groups that disseminate information. This feature will roll out globally from mid to late February 2025. No admin action is required, but user notification and documentation updates are recommended.

Summary: New user Connection Settings for headset microphones in the Walkie Talkie app on Microsoft Teams for Android will optimize battery life for older Bluetooth headsets by allowing them to disconnect after inactivity. Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Quality Evaluation Agent for Bulk Case Evaluation
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use Quality Evaluation Agent (QEA) for Bulk Case Evaluation in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on March 20, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables supervisors to automate continuous quality assessments across their organization at scale. Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Enhancing the quarantine email preview experience
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is updating the quarantine email preview to simplify views, limit URL hover previews, and remove some "Load external content" buttons. Rollout starts November 2025, completing by mid-December. Users will see a clearer, more secure preview; no configuration changes are needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams admin center: App centric management for app installation and changes to app setup policies
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce app-centric management for admin app installation, allowing admins to install apps directly for users, groups, or everyone. Existing app setup policies remain but no new additions allowed. Rollout begins mid-October 2025, completing by March 2026 in two phases. No action needed for Phase 1 tenants.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Drive confident engagement with enhanced consent‑based segmentation
Summary: We are announcing improvements to enhanced consent‑based segmentation in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys. This feature will reach general availability on March 20, 2026. Title: Follow‑up on Required Custom Domain Configuration for Teams Event Email Templates
Summary: Teams Premium organizations using custom HTML templates for Teams Events emails must reference a verified custom domain in Microsoft 365 to ensure delivery and prevent spoofing. Enforcement began January 31, 2026. Default templates are unaffected. Verify domains and update templates accordingly to avoid disruptions.

Title: Search feedback experience update: Legacy Search
Summary: The legacy Search & Intelligence Feedback portal is retired, consolidating Microsoft Search feedback into the Microsoft 365 Product feedback experience. Users now submit simpler thumbs up/down feedback, and admins access it in the Microsoft 365 admin center under Product feedback with improved policy alignment. No admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Rewards: Retirement of Azure AD Account Linking
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the Azure AD Account Linking feature for Microsoft Rewards by March 19, 2026. Users can no longer link work accounts to earn Rewards points. Existing points remain unaffected, personal accounts work as usual, and no admin actions are required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of the Microsoft Teams app from the Amazon Appstore
Summary: Microsoft will retire the Microsoft Teams app from the Amazon Appstore in mid-March 2026. Users can no longer download or update it there, and existing versions will lose support. Organizations should guide users to switch to the Teams Web app or the Android app via Google Play Store.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Use SharePoint quick steps to automate common tasks and workflows with new column type
Summary: SharePoint Quick steps are now available as a column type in lists and libraries, enabling inline automation like email, Teams chat, approvals, and flows directly from data views. Rollout begins mid-February 2026, is enabled by default, and respects existing permissions. No user action required.

Title: Retirement of “Suspected identity theft (pass-the-ticket)” classic alert
Summary: The “Suspected identity theft (pass-the-ticket)” classic alert will retire between March 18-22, 2026, replaced by the “Pass-the-Ticket (PtT) attack” XDR alert. Existing alerts remain accessible. No admin action is required, but update workflows, alert tuning, and documentation accordingly. No compliance issues noted.

Title: March 2026 Secure Score category update
Summary: In March 2026, Microsoft will update Secure Score categories to improve accuracy, which may affect identity and app Secure Scores.

Title: Introducing simplified admin controls to manage external collaboration in Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a simplified external collaboration admin experience with three modes—Open, Controlled, and Custom—available in the Teams admin center. Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection – Email attachment preview in Activity Explorer
Summary: Starting February 2026, Microsoft Purview Activity Explorer will let admins preview flagged email attachments in Exchange Online without downloading them, simplifying investigations. Summary: We are announcing the ability to configure customer payment due dates without the use of workarounds or enforcement of requirements across all projects in a contract in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. Title: Improving licensing checks for secondary accounts in the new Outlook for Windows
Summary: Starting February 1, 2024, the new Outlook for Windows will match the classic Outlook for Windows in licensing checks for multi-account scenarios, allowing secondary accounts licensed with entry-level subscription plans to be added. Users will need to add the account that includes a license for the Outlook & Microsoft 365 desktop apps as the Primary Account, which will be used for determining the license that applies when adding additional secondary accounts. Title: Reuse Files in Word to be retired
Summary: The Reuse Files feature in Word will be retired by February 2024. Starting August 2023, users will not be able to see Reuse Files on the ribbon in the Word user interface. However, users can use Search in Word to search their files, preview them, and reuse them. Microsoft will gradually remove entry points for this feature starting in late August 2023. Organizations may consider updating their training and documentation as appropriate.

Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is enhancing its end-user email notification capability for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange. Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Admins can block external users in Microsoft Teams from Defender Portal
Summary: Starting mid-February 2026, admins can block external Microsoft Teams users via the Tenant Allow/Block List in the Microsoft Defender portal, controlling access and deleting existing communications. This applies to Teams and Defender XDR, with audit logging and limits of 4,000 domains and 200 emails blocked.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Smarter delivery of Community Announcement notifications
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is updating Community Announcement notifications to use a smarter, behavior-based delivery system. Users will receive notifications through their most engaged channel first, with a secondary channel if unopened. Immediate email notifications remain available for urgent announcements. Rollout begins mid-September 2025, completing by January 2026.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Brand impersonation protection for Teams Chat
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new security feature to alert users of potential brand impersonation in Teams Chat, especially during initial contact from external domains. Rollout begins late October 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-November 2024 for General Availability, completing by mid-February 2025. This feature will be enabled by default with no admin configuration needed.

Title: Microsoft Loop – Promote Members to Owners in Loop workspaces
Summary: Microsoft Loop will soon allow promoting members to owners in shared workspaces. The rollout, starting mid-February 2025 and ending late March 2025, requires no action for preparation. This update is detailed in Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 362124.

Title: Microsoft Loop – Common Admin Management Tasks Enabled for all Loop workspaces
Summary: Microsoft Loop's common admin management tasks will be enabled for all new and existing workspaces, with a rollout starting in late February 2025 and ending in May 2025. Admins will manage Loop workspaces via SharePoint Embedded admin center or PowerShell, with changes visible in Loop experience from December 2024 for new workspaces and by March 2025 for existing ones. No preparation is needed for this update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Describe it to design it in Teams Workflows
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a 'Workflow builder' in the Workflows app, allowing users to describe the automation they need, which will then generate a matching workflow. This feature will first appear in Teams chat and channel overflow menu, with a global rollout starting late September 2024. It requires a Teams account with Power Automate access in Europe or the US and currently supports English descriptions for cloud flows only.

Title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Loop – New personal Loop workspace
Summary: The Microsoft Loop app now includes a personal workspace for users, akin to a SharePoint Embedded container, with governance similar to OneDrive. The Ideas workspace will become a shared Loop workspace. Rollout begins mid-February 2025, completing by late March 2025. No action is needed for preparation, but Loop workspace creation can be disabled via admin policies. Roadmap IDs: 422727, 422729.

Title: Web links in the new Outlook for Windows to open side-by-side with email in Microsoft Edge
Summary: The new Outlook for Windows will open web links in Microsoft Edge side-by-side with the email, enhancing productivity. This update, rolling out from late July 2024 to late January 2025, applies to AAD and MSA accounts. Users can manage this feature through Outlook settings or policy configuration.

Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing two new features to enhance app discovery and adoption. Title: Microsoft Entra: Enablement of Passkeys in Authenticator for passkey (FIDO2) organizations with no key restrictions
Summary: Starting late January 2025, organizations with enabled passkey (FIDO2) policy and no key restrictions will have passkeys in the Microsoft Authenticator app. Users can add this via aka.ms/MySecurityInfo, and it's enforced by Conditional Access policy. Organizations preferring not to enable this can impose key restrictions.

Title: General Availability of Direct Routing Phone Number Inventory
Summary: Direct Routing Phone Number Inventory is now generally available for Microsoft Teams Phone customers, allowing management of assigned and unassigned numbers. Unassigned numbers won't be removed from management storage, and can be released using New-CsOnlineTelephoneNumberReleaseOrder. The feature is accessible via Teams PowerShell cmdlets and will be in Teams Admin Center preview, with full release expected mid-February 2025.

Title: Coming Soon: Update to Apps user interface experience in Intune
Summary: The Intune admin center's 'Apps' area will soon have a UI update, offering a consistent look and improved navigation, starting early February 2025 and reaching all admins by month's end. This update is for admin center UI only and includes scenario-focused navigation, updated naming, dedicated monitoring reports, platform-specific pivots, and consistent list views. No action is needed, just awareness.

Summary: Clipchamp's integration with Copilot Visual Creator allows users to generate videos from typed prompts, sourcing from Microsoft 365's stock media. Videos are saved in OneDrive and can be edited in Clipchamp. The feature rolls out from mid-February to mid-March 2025 and is available with Microsoft 365 Copilot plan. Users can control access and provide feedback within the app.

Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights will enhance Microsoft 365 Copilot's adoption insights by adding usage intensity and retention metrics to the Copilot Dashboard. Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will add new ready-to-use risk indicators for Microsoft Fabric lakehouse activities, available worldwide by late February 2026. Summary: The "Require approved client app" control in Microsoft Entra Conditional Access will retire in June 2026. After deprecation, existing workbooks will not receive new responses unless migrated. Migration support and notifications will be provided.

Summary: Microsoft Lists now offers an admin control to hide real-time collaborators at the site collection level, available worldwide since early December 2024. Title: Microsoft Graph: New default passcode in the Create Meeting API
Summary: The Microsoft Graph API's Create Meeting API will require a passcode by default from February 24, 2025, changing the current default setting. Title: Microsoft Teams: More predictable recording experience with Who keeps recording
Summary: Microsoft Teams is adding a feature to show the recording owner's information, ensuring participants can contact the correct person. It rolls out in March 2025. Recordings save to the organizer's OneDrive by default, with fallback logic for recording ownership if needed. Users should ensure the -MeetingRecordingOwnership setting is correct.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: AI administrator role authorization to manage Copilot settings
Summary: The AI administrator role in Microsoft 365 admin center authorizes users to manage Copilot settings, with a rollout starting in January 2025. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Reduced file sizes for Microsoft Teams meeting recordings exported from Clipchamp
Summary: Clipchamp now compresses Microsoft Teams meeting recordings for smaller file sizes without quality loss. This feature is globally available since mid-January 2025 and is enabled by default, requiring no admin action but may necessitate user notification and documentation updates.

Title: Deploy a frontline worker pilot in Teams Admin Center
Summary: Teams Admin Center will enable deployment, management, and monitoring of frontline worker pilots, allowing admins to configure workloads, assign users, share app access via QR code, and track adoption.
